jobs.bdjobs.com/jobdetails?id=1539555&fc.source_content:
Requirements Education Bachelors degree with a major in Marketing Additional Requirements Strong interest in Sales & Marketing Career-oriented and willing to build a long-term career Freshers are encouraged to apply Responsibilities & Context ORTRIO Limited, a subsidiary of AKSID Corporation Limited, is the exclusive distribution partner for a leading manufacturer of specialty water treatment chemicals in Bangladesh. We are seeking a mid-level Marketing & Sales Representative to drive new customer acquisition and revenue growth across industrial sectors. This role is ideal for a technically proficient sales professional eager to excel in a high-growth, B2B technical sales environment. Key Responsibilities New Business Development: Identify and acquire new customers across targeted industries including textiles, food & beverage, pharmaceuticals, power, and manufacturing. Build a strong sales pipeline and expand the market for water treatment chemicals. Client Relationship Management: Develop strong relationships with plant managers, engineers, procurement teams, and other key decision-makers. Conduct regular site visits to understand customer requirements. Technical Sales & Consulting: Provide technical guidance on water treatment solutions, including boiler, cooling tower, RO, and wastewater applications. Conduct product presentations, demonstrations, and trials. Sales Target Achievement: Meet and exceed assigned sales targets through effective territory management, account planning, negotiation, and customer conversion while maintaining company profitability guidelines. Market Intelligence: Track market trends, competitor activities, and customer needs, providing relevant insights to management. Reporting & Coordination: Maintain sales records, prepare forecasts and reports, and coordinate with technical, marketing, logistics, and customer service teams to ensure effective customer support. Working Conditions Work Environment: Based at AKSIDs Head Office in Dhaka, with a significant amount of time spent in the field. Expect a field-oriented role, visiting industrial facilities, production plants, and client offices regularly. Travel Requirements: Frequent travel within Bangladesh (up to 60-70% of the time) to meet clients on-site. This includes travel to industrial hubs outside Dhaka. A valid driving license and willingness to travel by car and occasionally by air/rail to distant client sites are required. Reporting Line: You will report to the Managing Director at Ortrio. Regular meetings and reporting will be required to discuss pipeline status, market issues, and strategy. Collaboration: Work closely with cross-functional teams including technical service engineers from Metito, marketing team, and customer service/logistics to ensure timely product delivery and support. Schedule: Full-time position (weekday business hours), with flexibility needed to accommodate client schedules. Occasionally, you may need to attend industry events or client meetings in evenings or weekends as per business needs. Requirements Additional Requirements Required qualifications and experience Direct, hands-on experience dealing with Dhaka-based manufacturers, workshops, importers, or wholesale markets. Candidates must be able to describe specific sourcing work they personally carried out. Sufficient technical literacy to read and write product specifications and assess build quality, materials, and durability. A background in engineering, industrial design, product development, or a technical trade is an asset but is not required if practical sourcing experience is strong. Currently based in Dhaka, with the mobility and willingness to spend a substantial share of working time in markets and workshops across the city. Fluency in both English and Bangla. Ability to work independently with limited supervision, plan ones own fieldwork, and deliver on schedule. Competence in maintaining structured records in spreadsheets and writing clear, organised reports. Not required but any experience with connected or remotely managed devices (e.g., IoT controllers, pay-as-you-go solar, vehicle telematics) would be useful. Assets Experience sourcing cooling, refrigeration, solar, or battery-powered equipment. Prior work in or around informal markets, street vending, or urban informal enterprise. Experience supporting research projects and working to research-driven standards of documentation and consistency. Responsibilities & Context 1. Background IFPRI, in partnership with the Shakti Foundation, one of Bangladeshs largest microfinance institutions, is developing and evaluating an asset-based loan product that will help street food vendors in Dhaka acquire mobile cooling solutions. As part of our research, the product will be offered to a sample of vendors during an initial launch and rigorously evaluated through a randomized controlled trial. A central design feature of the product is that vendors will be offered a menu of mobile cooling solutions at a range of price points, so that each vendor can select what fits the scale of their business and the goods they sell. This can include products that serve to cool both the food being sold, the vendor themselves, or both, as well as ventilation solutions for vendors who cook on site or at home. This is likely to include insulated/ventilated cart modifications, evaporative cooling units, battery-powered coolers, or other lithium battery based solution packages. Responsibilities & Context
1. Background
IFPRI, in partnership with the Shakti Foundation, one of Bangladesh`s largest microfinance institutions, is developing and evaluating an asset-based loan product that will help street food vendors in Dhaka acquire mobile cooling solutions. As part of our research, the product will be offered to a sample of vendors during an initial launch and rigorously evaluated through a randomized controlled trial.
A central design feature of the product is that vendors will be offered a menu of mobile cooling solutions at a range of price points, so that each vendor can select what fits the scale of their business and the goods they sell. This can include products that serve to cool both the food being sold, the vendor themselves, or both, as well as ventilation solutions for vendors who cook on site  or at home. This is likely to include insulated/ventilated cart modifications, evaporative cooling units, battery-powered coolers, or other lithium battery based solution packages.

Requirements Additional Requirements Age At least 18 years Essential requirements: Education: • Desirable finance, business or administration related diploma. Experience: • Essential previous working experience of at least two years in relevant jobs. • Desirable experience in MSF or other NGOs in developing countries. Languages: • Mission language and local language essential Knowledge: • Essential computer literacy (word, excel, internet) Competencies: • Results and Quality Orientation L2 • Team work and Cooperation L2 • Behavioural Flexibility L2 • Commitment to MSF Principles L2 • Stress Management L3 Responsibilities & Context Main Purpose: Execute administrative and finance related tasks and follow up of project accountancy to support the Project Finance Manager following MSF standard and procedures, in order to ensure legal compliance and keep a strict control over monetary resources to achieve project objectives. Accountabilities: • Implementing cash management procedures in order to ensure the highest control and security, assisting the Project Fin Manager in the prevision of monthly treasury and planning in order to en-sure the coverage of daily needs, advances on salaries, payroll, etc. • Processing the payment to suppliers and keep strict on all documentation involved, informing the administration manager of any sort of disparity • Carrying out all accounting tasks and activities, classifying, preparing and filing of all accounting pieces in accounting software, in order to ensure strict control of all expenditures and the reliability of statements and documentation. • Making all administrative information available to the staff (posting, meetings, etc.), supporting the Accountancy Manager (ACMA) in translating documents into local language and assisting in meetings upon request. • Any other administrative task delegated by the Accountancy Manager (ACMA) MSF Section/Context Specific Accountabilities: MSF Cox’s Bazar office is considered as sub office to Dhaka Intersection Support Team (IST), therefore the Finance Assistant will be considered as part of IST finance team member, and for any reason the Finance coordinator can request the Fin Assistant to join IST at Dhaka any time (support, cover gap, etc). • To help the Finance coordinator on the execution of the IST objective by supporting with the proper advise on finance when needed. • Cash Management: To handle 5 (Five) cash box and entry book in cash register UF. • Processing payment of big volume of local purchase for OCA, OCB & OCP mission and workshop Payment. • Encode all the transection into UF. • VAT & TAX challan summary report for different FD’s and organize softcopy of the challan in the finance share folder (PD, PIT & Suppliers). • Challans share to Supplier’s as per need. • Employee & Supplier/Vendor TDS Certificate Download • Organize monthly IST BKK and send to Dhaka IST • To Scan OCA BKK (Heavy duty scanner availability) • To prépare monthly 6 (six) bank reconciliation for IST accounts • Monthly checking IMS PD tracker, uploading in UF & share with all the IST IMS • Prepare monthly medical Tracking sheet & share to Medical • Book adjusting entries in UF for IMS cost reimbursement. • Monthly VAT & TDS deposit information update in the Compliance Overview tracker. • Prepare monthly IST VAT return report with issuing Mushok 6.6 • Monthly workshop related expense report share to IST Workshop Manager. • Bank Signatory add documents preparation for CXB IST • Collaboration with OC’s when they need or ask for. • Help to other work as per need, budget preparation (FD6 & MSF internal), VAT return submission in NBR site, financial statement preparation. • To perform any other task delegated by Finco, and to be flexible to support on some HR tasks. Support to HR & Admin Team: • Support IST HR/Admin team with accommodation and housekeeping arrangements • Monthly IR submission for Food, Hygiene & Stationery Items for CXB IST Office, Warehouse, House, Ukhiya Workshop. • Check the inventory align with Supply Sup. And physical check the stock in present and make Forecast of Monthly Consuption for quarterly basis and submit (Food, Hygiene & Stationery Items for CXB IST Office, Warehouse, House, Ukhiya Workshop) • Distribute ID Cards and Ribbon to colleagues (as per need). • Making all administrative information available to the staff (posting, meetings, leave form, etc.) • Sending staff files (signed contracts, signed JDs, leave form, etc) to HR Assistant/HRM to encode them in Homere. • Additional HR/ Admin tasks delegated by the IST HRCo/Dep HRCo. Compensation & Other Benefits Contract and Benefit: • Fixed term contract for 06 months . Salary according to level 6 (Six) of the internal MSF salary grid (BDT 85,500 Gross). Salary is non-negotiable. Income tax deduction from salary based on current income tax rule. • 2 annual leave days per month worked. • Weekly 2 holidays. • Medical Reimbursement for employee and direct dependents based on Health Care Policy- Locally Recruited Staff. Others: There will be no provisions for relocation. Workplace Work at office Employment Status Full Time Job Location Coxs Bazar

Essential requirements:
Education:
• Desirable finance, business or administration related diploma.

• Essential previous working experience of at least two years in relevant jobs.
• Desirable experience in MSF or other NGOs in developing countries.
Languages:
• Mission language and local language essential
Knowledge:
• Essential computer literacy (word, excel, internet)
Competencies:
• Results and Quality Orientation L2
• Team work and Cooperation L2
• Behavioural Flexibility L2
• Commitment to MSF Principles L2
• Stress Management L3
Responsibilities & Context
Main Purpose:
Execute administrative and finance related tasks and follow up of project accountancy to support the Project Finance Manager following MSF standard and procedures, in order to ensure legal compliance and keep a strict control over monetary resources to achieve project objectives.
Accountabilities:
• Implementing cash management procedures in order to ensure the highest control and security, assisting the Project Fin Manager in the prevision of monthly treasury and planning in order to en-sure the coverage of daily needs, advances on salaries, payroll, etc.
• Processing the payment to suppliers and keep strict on all documentation involved, informing the administration manager of any sort of disparity
• Carrying out all accounting tasks and activities, classifying, preparing and filing of all accounting pieces in accounting software, in order to ensure strict control of all expenditures and the reliability of statements and documentation.
• Making all administrative information available to the staff (posting, meetings, etc.), supporting the Accountancy Manager (ACMA) in translating documents into local language and assisting in meetings upon request.
• Any other administrative task delegated by the Accountancy Manager (ACMA)
MSF Section/Context Specific Accountabilities:
MSF Cox’s Bazar office is considered as sub office to Dhaka Intersection Support Team (IST), therefore the Finance Assistant will be considered as part of IST finance team member, and for any reason the Finance coordinator can request the Fin Assistant to join IST at Dhaka any time (support, cover gap, etc).
• To help the Finance coordinator on the execution of the IST objective by supporting with the proper advise on finance when needed.
• Cash Management: To handle 5 (Five) cash box and entry book in cash register UF.
• Processing payment of big volume of local purchase for OCA, OCB & OCP mission and workshop Payment.
• Encode all the transection into UF.
• VAT & TAX challan summary report for different FD’s and organize softcopy of the challan in the finance share folder (PD, PIT & Suppliers).
• Challans share to Supplier’s as per need.
• Employee & Supplier/Vendor TDS Certificate Download
• Organize monthly IST BKK and send to Dhaka IST
• To Scan OCA BKK (Heavy duty scanner availability)
• To prépare monthly 6 (six) bank reconciliation for IST accounts
• Monthly checking IMS PD tracker, uploading in UF & share with all the IST IMS
• Prepare monthly medical Tracking sheet & share to Medical
• Book adjusting entries in UF for IMS cost reimbursement.
• Monthly VAT & TDS deposit information update in the Compliance Overview tracker.
• Prepare monthly IST VAT return report with issuing Mushok 6.6
• Monthly workshop related expense report share to IST Workshop Manager.
• Bank Signatory add documents preparation for CXB IST
• Collaboration with OC’s when they need or ask for.
• Help to other work as per need, budget preparation (FD6 & MSF internal), VAT return submission in NBR site, financial statement preparation.
• To perform any other task delegated by Finco, and to be flexible to support on some HR tasks.
Support to HR & Admin Team:
• Support IST HR/Admin team with accommodation and housekeeping arrangements
• Monthly IR submission for Food, Hygiene & Stationery Items for CXB IST Office, Warehouse, House, Ukhiya Workshop.
• Check the inventory align with Supply Sup. And physical check the stock in present and make Forecast of Monthly Consuption for quarterly basis and submit (Food, Hygiene & Stationery Items for CXB IST Office, Warehouse, House, Ukhiya Workshop)
• Distribute ID Cards and Ribbon to colleagues (as per need).
• Making all administrative information available to the staff (posting, meetings, leave form, etc.)
• Sending staff files (signed contracts, signed JDs, leave form, etc) to HR Assistant/HRM to encode them in Homere.
• Additional HR/ Admin tasks delegated by the IST HRCo/Dep HRCo.
Compensation & Other Benefits
Contract and Benefit:
• Fixed term contract for 06 months. Salary according to level 6 (Six) of the internal MSF salary grid (BDT 85,500 Gross). Salary is non-negotiable. Income tax deduction from salary based on current income tax rule.
• 2 annual leave days per month worked.
• Weekly 2 holidays.
• Medical Reimbursement for employee and direct dependents based on Health Care Policy- Locally Recruited Staff.
Others: There will be no provisions for relocation.

Online application: Please submit your application online at the link below by 07/10/2026. You need to attach your CV and Certificates in a PDF format during application.

• Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

Requirements Education Bachelor/Honors Additional Requirements Age 22 to 26 years Only Male Ideal Candidate We are looking for someone who is: Highly organised and responsible Good with Excel/Google Sheets and numbers Strong at planning and follow-up Comfortable managing factory workers and suppliers Able to solve problems independently Comfortable dealing with logistics companies and government offices Experienced in manufacturing, supply chain, procurement or export Experience with wood products, furniture, homeware or Amazon/FBA is a plus. The Role You will work primarily from our Khulna factory and report directly to the UK-based management team. Because the business is still being established, this is an opportunity to help build the systems and processes from the ground up , rather than simply maintain an existing operation. The aim is to create a reliable operation where production, inventory, quality, purchasing and export are organised and predictable as the business grows. Responsibilities & Context About Stonewell Supply We currently have a wood manufacturing factory in Khulna, Bangladesh , and are in the process of formally establishing and developing the wider Stonewell Supply business. We are a UK-based company developing wooden homeware products for international markets, initially selling through Amazon UK. We are looking for a Supply Chain to help us build and organise the systems needed to grow the business. Location: Khulna, Bangladesh Responsibilities You will help manage the supply chain from raw materials to production, finished products and export . Production planning — decide what needs to be produced, when and in what quantities. Inventory — track raw wood, work-in-progress, finished products and packaging. Demand planning — use sales data to plan future production and avoid stockouts. Quality control — coordinate inspections and reduce defects and rework. Wood & moisture management — monitor drying, storage and moisture levels. Packaging — ensure the correct packaging is available for production. Export & logistics — coordinate shipments from the Khulna factory to the UK. Documentation — manage invoices, packing lists, export paperwork and records. Business & export registration — assist with business registration, trade licence, ERC, chamber registration, export-related requirements and renewals. Cost control — track production and landed costs. Supplier management — monitor suppliers for price, quality and reliability. Reporting — provide a clear weekly report on production, inventory, QC, shipments, costs and problems. Skills & Expertise Other Relevant Skills Demand Planning Inventory Management Procurement Management System Production Planning Quality Control Supply Chain Management Employment Status Full Time Gender Only males are allowed to apply. Requirements Education Bachelor/Honors Additional Requirements Age 22 to 26 years Only Male Ideal Candidate We are looking for someone who is: Highly organised and responsible Good with Excel/Google Sheets and numbers Strong at planning and follow-up Comfortable managing factory workers and suppliers Able to solve problems independently Comfortable dealing with logistics companies and government offices Experienced in manufacturing, supply chain, procurement or export Experience with wood products, furniture, homeware or Amazon/FBA is a plus. The Role You will work primarily from our Khulna factory and report directly to the UK-based management team. Because the business is still being established, this is an opportunity to help build the systems and processes from the ground up , rather than simply maintain an existing operation. The aim is to create a reliable operation where production, inventory, quality, purchasing and export are organised and predictable as the business grows. Responsibilities & Context About Stonewell Supply We currently have a wood manufacturing factory in Khulna, Bangladesh , and are in the process of formally establishing and developing the wider Stonewell Supply business. We are a UK-based company developing wooden homeware products for international markets, initially selling through Amazon UK. We are looking for a Supply Chain to help us build and organise the systems needed to grow the business. Location: Khulna, Bangladesh Responsibilities You will help manage the supply chain from raw materials to production, finished products and export . Production planning — decide what needs to be produced, when and in what quantities. Inventory — track raw wood, work-in-progress, finished products and packaging. Demand planning — use sales data to plan future production and avoid stockouts. Quality control — coordinate inspections and reduce defects and rework. Wood & moisture management — monitor drying, storage and moisture levels. Packaging — ensure the correct packaging is available for production. Export & logistics — coordinate shipments from the Khulna factory to the UK. Documentation — manage invoices, packing lists, export paperwork and records. Business & export registration — assist with business registration, trade licence, ERC, chamber registration, export-related requirements and renewals. Cost control — track production and landed costs. Supplier management — monitor suppliers for price, quality and reliability. Reporting — provide a clear weekly report on production, inventory, QC, shipments, costs and problems. Skills & Expertise Other Relevant Skills Demand Planning Inventory Management Procurement Management System Production Planning Quality Control Supply Chain Management Employment Status Full Time Gender Only males are allowed to apply. The HR Manager performs advanced professional work advising Hotel Sarina Dhaka team leaders and team members on the application of employment, benefits and workers compensation laws and regulations and employment policies in the contexts of hiring, discipline, employment termination, training, compensation, benefits, leave, equal opportunity and other human resources issues. The HR Manager must be open and available to discuss human resources matters with the entire workforce. The HR Manager reports to the General Manager, address employee safety issues, and oversee third party administrator and outside counsel in the handling of workers compensation matters. Provide leadership in effective conflict resolution for all personnel. Analyze benefits options and cost alternatives for providing employee benefits, recommend benefits program modifications and implement approved benefits modifications. Work with senior management to craft consistent, equitable and competitive compensation and incentives. Develop and implement human resources programs and policies and periodically update Team Member and Team Leader Handbooks. Serve as a resource for team leaders in handling employee issues and assist them in counseling employees, conducting evaluations, staff training, problem-solving and consensus-building. Serve as a resource for all team members by being available and accessible to discuss all human resources related issues. Oversee the Organizational Development & Training function and develop employee training programs. Maintain inter- and intradepartmental work flow by providing information to and cooperating with co-workers. Assist in hiring by providing job descriptions and advertisements, and in the case of hiring of senior team leaders, by screening and interviewing candidates. Work with the Management, and inform on matters involving benefits, employee safety and workers compensation issues. Oversee handling of employment-related inquiries, such as employment verification requests and unemployment compensation inquiries and proceedings. Chair/serve on various Hotel Sarina Dhaka committees, as well as outside human resources or industry-related groups. Develop, implement and participate in employee recognition programs. Enhance job performance by applying up-to-date professional and technical knowledge gained by attending seminars and conferences and reviewing professional publications. Perform other duties as assigned by the Management/ General Manager ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS Prepare and maintain accurate records, files and reports, including responsibility for maintaining personnel records. Organize and work independently on multiple assigned tasks/projects and complete assignments within specified deadlines. Communicate effectively verbally and in writing to all levels of staff and management, outside officials and agencies, and the public, expressing ideas and instructions clearly and concisely. Compile and analyze complex information, and research and develop solutions to complex issues. Work well under pressure. Accurately follow verbal and written directions from senior management. Demonstrate skills critical for managerial success including leadership, decisiveness, flexibility, sound business judgment, and highly developed personal, analytical and communication skills. jobs.bdjobs.com/jobdetails?id=1540311&fc.source_content:
Requirements Education Bachelor/Honors Experience At least 3 years The applicants should have experience in the following business area(s): Cement Industry, Group of Companies, Third Party Auditor (Quality, Health, Environment, Compliance Additional Requirements Age 30 to 40 years Only Male Candidates having FMCG experience will be given preference. Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Ability to work independently, taking full responsibilities for sales audit function. Strong decision-making ability, problem identification and resolution. Mentality to visit across the country as it requires frequent field trip to analyze the real market setup. Ability to perform duties and respond to request in a timely manner. Attitude to work as a team and take the leadership if it requires. Strong reporting skill and have excellent command over Microsoft office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) Responsibilities & Context Perform market audit to ensure companys guidelines around sales processes comply with regulatory standards set by Management. As a representative, contact the responsible authority with relevant information for compensation and follow its disposition recommendation regarding distribution product damage. Assessing suspicious claims from the distribution chain and physically inspects the impairment to find out the real scenario. Identifying the nature of market backed damage & come up with specific recommendations to minimize that product damage percentage. Ensuring proper segmentation of damage products based on their damage nature as per the guideline provided by authority. Prepare reports, commentaries based on practical market visits and present findings and recommendations on those issues. Other duties and assignments as necessary. Skills & Expertise Audit Handling Distributors or Dealers Inventory Management Store Management Other Relevant Skills Market Audit Regulatory Compliance Root Cause Analysis Compensation & Other Benefits T/A,Mobile bill Festival Bonus: 2 Lunch Facilities: Full Subsidize Lunch Facility Workplace Work at office Employment Status Full Time Gender Only males are allowed to apply. Job Location Dhaka

Requirements Education Experience 1 to 3 years The applicants should have experience in the following business area(s): Training Institutes, School, Kindergarten, Coaching Center Additional Requirements Requirements সংশ্লিষ্ট ক্ষেত্রে ৬ মাস থেকে ২ বছরের বাস্তব কাজের অভিজ্ঞতা। ভালো English Communication & International Communication Skill থাকতে হবে। Client Handling ও Follow-up-এ দক্ষ হতে হবে। Professional attitude এবং ভালো interpersonal skills থাকতে হবে। Computer ও সাধারণ office applications ব্যবহারে দক্ষতা থাকতে হবে। নতুন বিষয় দ্রুত শেখার আগ্রহ ও দায়িত্বশীলতার মানসিকতা থাকতে হবে। নিম্নোক্ত যেকোনো সেক্টরে কাজের অভিজ্ঞতা থাকলে আপনি এই পদের জন্য আবেদন করতে পারবেন: International Communication Admission Department Education Consultancy Student Consultancy Travel & Tourism Visa Processing / Visa Consultancy Study Abroad Consultancy International Student Admission উল্লিখিত যেকোনো একটি বা একাধিক সেক্টরে ৬ মাস থেকে ২ বছরের কাজের অভিজ্ঞতা থাকা প্রার্থীদের অগ্রাধিকার দেওয়া হবে। Responsibilities & Context Department: International Communication & Admission Industry: Education Consultancy & Travel & Tourism LMA International-এর International Communication & Admission Department-এর জন্য একজন দায়িত্বশীল ও অভিজ্ঞ Mid-Level Executive নিয়োগ দেওয়া হবে। আমরা বর্তমানে Education Consultancy, Travel & Tourism এবং Europe-এর Job Visa / Work Visa সংক্রান্ত সেবা নিয়ে কাজ করছি। এই বিভাগের কার্যক্রম আরও সম্প্রসারণের জন্য সংশ্লিষ্ট সেক্টরে কাজের অভিজ্ঞতা রয়েছে—এমন প্রার্থীদের কাছ থেকে আবেদন আহ্বান করা হচ্ছে। Key Responsibilities International students ও clients-এর সাথে নিয়মিত যোগাযোগ ও follow-up করা। Admission ও consultancy-related তথ্য প্রদান এবং প্রয়োজনীয় গাইডলাইন দেওয়া। Europe-এর Work Visa / Job Visa ও Study Abroad সংক্রান্ত client support দেওয়া। Client-এর প্রয়োজন অনুযায়ী সঠিক তথ্য প্রদান ও সংশ্লিষ্ট টিমের সাথে সমন্বয় করা। Admission, documentation ও application-related কাজে সহযোগিতা করা। Client relationship ও communication বজায় রাখা। প্রতিষ্ঠানের সার্ভিস সম্পর্কে prospective clients-কে বিস্তারিতভাবে জানানো। Skills & Expertise Other Relevant Skills Client Relationship Customer Service Sales Target Achievement Education Counseling Student Counseling Tour and Travel visa Compensation & Other Benefits আলোচনা সাপেক্ষে - প্রার্থীর যোগ্যতা, দক্ষতা ও অভিজ্ঞতার ভিত্তিতে বেতন নির্ধারণ করা হবে। Employment Status Full Time Job Location Dhaka

Requirements Additional Requirements স্পষ্টভাবে কথা বলা, মনোযোগ দিয়ে শোনা এবং গ্রাহকের সঙ্গে ব্যবসায়িক সম্পর্ক তৈরির দক্ষতা থাকতে হবে। Sales, Customer Service বা Account Management-এ অভিজ্ঞতা থাকলে অগ্রাধিকার দেওয়া হবে। ই-কমার্স, B2B সেলস বা চীন থেকে পণ্য সোর্সিং সম্পর্কে ধারণা থাকলে বাড়তি সুবিধা। WhatsApp Business, Excel/Google Sheets এবং কম্পিউটার ব্যবহারে দক্ষ হতে হবে। বাংলা ও বাংলিশে গ্রাহকের সঙ্গে লিখিত যোগাযোগ করতে পারতে হবে। দায়িত্বশীল, ধৈর্যশীল এবং নিয়মিত ফলোআপ ও লক্ষ্যমাত্রা অনুযায়ী কাজ করার মানসিকতা থাকতে হবে। গ্রাহকের অভিযোগ বুঝে সংশ্লিষ্ট টিমের সঙ্গে সমন্বয়ের মাধ্যমে সমাধান করতে আগ্রহী হতে হবে। অভিজ্ঞ প্রার্থীদের পাশাপাশি প্রয়োজনীয় দক্ষতাসম্পন্ন নতুনরাও আবেদন করতে পারবেন। Responsibilities & Context Wholesale Plus গ্রাহকদের সঙ্গে দীর্ঘমেয়াদি ব্যবসায়িক সম্পর্ক তৈরি, নিয়মিত ফলোআপ এবং রিপিট অর্ডার বাড়ানোর জন্য ৫ জন Key Account Manager (KAM) নিয়োগ দেবে। প্রধান দায়িত্বসমূহ: নির্ধারিত গ্রাহকদের সঙ্গে ফোন ও WhatsApp-এ নিয়মিত যোগাযোগ ও ফলোআপ করা। গ্রাহকের ব্যবসা ও পণ্যের চাহিদা বুঝে সোর্সিং, কোটেশন ও অর্ডার করতে সহায়তা করা। পুরোনো ও নিষ্ক্রিয় গ্রাহকদের পুনরায় অর্ডারে আগ্রহী করা। সম্ভাব্য গ্রাহকদের অনুসন্ধান ফলোআপ করে অর্ডারে রূপান্তর করা। অর্ডার, পেমেন্ট ও ডেলিভারির আপডেট দেওয়া এবং সংশ্লিষ্ট টিমের সঙ্গে সমন্বয় করা। গ্রাহকের অভিযোগ ও সমস্যা সমাধানের অগ্রগতি অনুসরণ করা। প্রয়োজন অনুযায়ী গুরুত্বপূর্ণ ব্যবসায়িক ও কর্পোরেট গ্রাহকদের ভিজিট করা। গ্রাহকের তথ্য, যোগাযোগের বিবরণ ও পরবর্তী ফলোআপের তারিখ নির্ধারিত সিস্টেমে সংরক্ষণ করা। মাসিক বিক্রয় ও রিপিট অর্ডারের লক্ষ্যমাত্রা অর্জনে কাজ করা। দৈনিক কাজ ও সাপ্তাহিক অগ্রগতির রিপোর্ট দেওয়া এবং গ্রাহকের মতামত জানানো। Skills & Expertise Other Relevant Skills Relationship Management/ Key Account Management Customer Relationship B2B and B2C sales and marketing Lead Generation Complaint Handling skill Workplace Work at office Employment Status Full Time Job Location Dhaka

Requirements Additional Requirements স্পষ্টভাবে কথা বলা, মনোযোগ দিয়ে শোনা এবং গ্রাহকের সঙ্গে ব্যবসায়িক সম্পর্ক তৈরির দক্ষতা থাকতে হবে। Sales, Customer Service বা Account Management-এ অভিজ্ঞতা থাকলে অগ্রাধিকার দেওয়া হবে। ই-কমার্স, B2B সেলস বা চীন থেকে পণ্য সোর্সিং সম্পর্কে ধারণা থাকলে বাড়তি সুবিধা। WhatsApp Business, Excel/Google Sheets এবং কম্পিউটার ব্যবহারে দক্ষ হতে হবে। বাংলা ও বাংলিশে গ্রাহকের সঙ্গে লিখিত যোগাযোগ করতে পারতে হবে। দায়িত্বশীল, ধৈর্যশীল এবং নিয়মিত ফলোআপ ও লক্ষ্যমাত্রা অনুযায়ী কাজ করার মানসিকতা থাকতে হবে। গ্রাহকের অভিযোগ বুঝে সংশ্লিষ্ট টিমের সঙ্গে সমন্বয়ের মাধ্যমে সমাধান করতে আগ্রহী হতে হবে। অভিজ্ঞ প্রার্থীদের পাশাপাশি প্রয়োজনীয় দক্ষতাসম্পন্ন নতুনরাও আবেদন করতে পারবেন। Responsibilities & Context Wholesale Plus গ্রাহকদের সঙ্গে দীর্ঘমেয়াদি ব্যবসায়িক সম্পর্ক তৈরি, নিয়মিত ফলোআপ এবং রিপিট অর্ডার বাড়ানোর জন্য ৫ জন Key Account Manager (KAM) নিয়োগ দেবে। প্রধান দায়িত্বসমূহ: নির্ধারিত গ্রাহকদের সঙ্গে ফোন ও WhatsApp-এ নিয়মিত যোগাযোগ ও ফলোআপ করা। গ্রাহকের ব্যবসা ও পণ্যের চাহিদা বুঝে সোর্সিং, কোটেশন ও অর্ডার করতে সহায়তা করা। পুরোনো ও নিষ্ক্রিয় গ্রাহকদের পুনরায় অর্ডারে আগ্রহী করা। সম্ভাব্য গ্রাহকদের অনুসন্ধান ফলোআপ করে অর্ডারে রূপান্তর করা। অর্ডার, পেমেন্ট ও ডেলিভারির আপডেট দেওয়া এবং সংশ্লিষ্ট টিমের সঙ্গে সমন্বয় করা। গ্রাহকের অভিযোগ ও সমস্যা সমাধানের অগ্রগতি অনুসরণ করা। প্রয়োজন অনুযায়ী গুরুত্বপূর্ণ ব্যবসায়িক ও কর্পোরেট গ্রাহকদের ভিজিট করা। গ্রাহকের তথ্য, যোগাযোগের বিবরণ ও পরবর্তী ফলোআপের তারিখ নির্ধারিত সিস্টেমে সংরক্ষণ করা। মাসিক বিক্রয় ও রিপিট অর্ডারের লক্ষ্যমাত্রা অর্জনে কাজ করা। দৈনিক কাজ ও সাপ্তাহিক অগ্রগতির রিপোর্ট দেওয়া এবং গ্রাহকের মতামত জানানো। Skills & Expertise Other Relevant Skills Relationship Management/ Key Account Management Customer Relationship B2B and B2C sales and marketing Lead Generation Complaint Handling skill Workplace Work at office Employment Status Full Time Job Location Dhaka

Requirements Education Masters in commerce background from any reputed university. Additional Requirements Age At most 45 years Minimum 1 years experience in the NGO sector Experience in Hospital management is preferable; Excellent organizational and multi-tasking ability, strong communication, report writing, presentation, and negotiation skills; Proficient in English (oral and written); Age limit could be consider as per candidate experiance. Responsibilities & Context Job Context: Dhaka Ahsania Mission (DAM) is a non-government development organization founded in 1958 by Khan Bahadur Ahsanullah, an eminent educationist, reformer, and Sufi with the aim of social and spiritual development of the entire human community. DAM has been contributing for the betterment of the disadvantaged population through operating 35 institutions and also 8 sectors of development. The Health and Nutrition Sector is one of the core sectors of DAM which has also been operating 7 institutions and 9 projects. DAM Health and Nutrition Sector is going to recruit a competent and self-motivated individual for the position of Accounts and Admin Officer for "Mayer Hashi General Hospital and Diagnostic Center" at Ashulia, Dhaka. Job Responsibility: Oversee day-to-day administrative operations, including scheduling, inventory management, and facility coordination, to ensure efficient hospital functioning. Assist central HR in the overall recruitment and employee HR relevant relevant process. Coordinate effectively with various departments to facilitate smooth and uninterrupted hospital operations. Supervise and manage support staff, including clerical, front desk, housekeeping, and other administrative personnel. Assist in the development, implementation, and periodic review of hospital policies, procedures, and compliance standards. Maintain accurate, confidential, and up-to-date patient records, administrative documentation, and institutional files. Monitor administrative workflows and identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency and service quality. Manage patient billing, invoicing, account reconciliation, and related financial documentation. Oversee payroll processing and ensure timely and accurate payments to employees, suppliers, and service providers. Prepare and maintain financial reports, budgets, cash-flow projections, and periodic financial forecasts. Monitor hospital expenditures, control operational costs, and implement appropriate cost-saving measures. Coordinate with auditors, tax consultants, financial institutions, and relevant regulatory authorities as required. Ensure compliance with applicable financial regulations, accounting standards, tax requirements, and internal hospital policies. Maintain proper financial records and supporting documentation for audit, reporting, and management review purposes. Provide management with timely financial and administrative information to support effective planning and decision-making. Perform any other tasks time to time given by the authority. As a member of the organization, uphold and comply with DAM’s Safeguarding Policies and Code of Conduct, and take appropriate action to prevent, report, and respond to safeguarding concerns in accordance with established procedures. Skills & Expertise Other Relevant Skills Operational Management Workplace Work at office Employment Status Full Time Job Location Dhaka (Ashulia)

jobs.bdjobs.com/jobdetails?id=1540951&fc.title: Executive - Internal Audit

raw_source_fields.experience: will be an advantage; however, fresh graduates with strong academic credentials from any public university are encouraged to apply. Effective communication and interpersonal skill Critical thinking and analysis The ability to write clear, concise, and grammatically correct English reports is crucial. Problem solving abilities Proficiency in IIA Standards, risks and controls frameworks (COSO etc.) Highest level of integrity Maintains objectivity in appearance and fact Ability to quickly learn new areas of business Flexibility to travel and visit various locations of the organizations partners, including call centers, distribution houses, among others. Responsibilities & Context Support the development of risk-based audit plans and roadmaps aligned with organizational goals, and assist in maintaining the audit universe, risk register, and other relevant tools to continuously assess, link, and prioritize critical business risks. Perform internal audit activities in accordance with IIA Standards, IIA Code of Ethics, Code of Conduct, organizational policies and procedures, and applicable regulatory requirements, while staying updated on audit methodologies, industry best practices, trends, and emerging issues that may impact the business. Demonstrate adherence to established policies and procedures and apply a systematic, disciplined, and value-adding approach to internal audit activities that meets the needs of the organization. Develop and document engagement plans, including objectives, scope, timelines, and resource requirements, considering the organization’s strategies, objectives, and risks relevant to each engagement. Independently perform and document assigned audit engagements by identifying, analyzing, evaluating, and documenting sufficient and appropriate information to achieve engagement objectives within approved timelines, budgets, and departmental standards. Develop, maintain, and update control assessment frameworks, models, criteria, and Risk & Control Matrices (RCMs) at the engagement level to assess the adequacy and effectiveness of governance, risk management, internal controls, processes, and systems. Maintain professional objectivity and independence throughout audit engagements; disclose any actual or perceived impairment of independence or objectivity, ensure balanced assessments based on relevant facts, and avoid undue influence from personal interests or other parties. Consider the possibility of significant errors, fraud, and non-compliance during assigned engagements and conduct appropriate examinations and verifications in line with professional standards and the level of diligence expected from a competent internal auditor. Ensure audit quality and timely delivery by assessing whether engagements adequately cover the approved scope and key risks, objectively evaluate governance, risk management, and controls, identify current business issues and their strategic or operational implications, and provide appropriate recommendations. Communicate audit results in an accurate, objective, clear, concise, constructive, complete, and timely manner, and work with auditees, process owners, and management to develop appropriate action plans and resolve identified control issues and risks. Conduct periodic follow-ups on audit recommendations and action plans, ensure timely implementation of agreed actions, and maintain the audit follow-up tracking system as required by the department. Escalate to the Head of Internal Audit (HIA), through the appropriate channel, where management or divisional heads accept a level of risk that may be unacceptable to the organization. Maintain a thorough and current understanding of the organization’s objectives, strategies, processes, systems, capabilities, employees, culture, industry practices, and business environment to ensure relevant and effective audit assessments. Consider the work of other assurance providers and assess whether reliance on their work is appropriate based on their scope and procedures, while coordinating with other control and monitoring functions to ensure effective use of audit resources. Build and maintain effective working relationships with process owners and business management to support improvements in internal controls, risk management, business processes, effectiveness, and efficiency. Assist the supervisor in functional, administrative, and other audit-related matters as and when required. Skills & Expertise Audit reporting Compliance Compliance and Integrity Critical and analytical thinking Data analysis Internal Control Problem solving and decision making Risk Assessment Target Oriented Other Relevant Skills Compliance code of conduct Internal Audit Risk Analysis

Problem solving abilities Proficiency in IIA Standards, risks and controls frameworks (COSO etc.) Highest level of integrity Maintains objectivity in appearance and fact Ability to quickly learn new areas of business Flexibility to travel and visit various locations of the organizations partners, including call centers, distribution houses, among others. Demonstrate adherence to established policies and procedures and apply a systematic, disciplined, and value-adding approach to internal audit activities that meets the needs of the organization. Develop and document engagement plans, including objectives, scope, timelines, and resource requirements, considering the organization’s strategies, objectives, and risks relevant to each engagement. Independently perform and document assigned audit engagements by identifying, analyzing, evaluating, and documenting sufficient and appropriate information to achieve engagement objectives within approved timelines, budgets, and departmental standards. Develop, maintain, and update control assessment frameworks, models, criteria, and Risk & Control Matrices (RCMs) at the engagement level to assess the adequacy and effectiveness of governance, risk management, internal controls, processes, and systems. Consider the possibility of significant errors, fraud, and non-compliance during assigned engagements and conduct appropriate examinations and verifications in line with professional standards and the level of diligence expected from a competent internal auditor. Consider the work of other assurance providers and assess whether reliance on their work is appropriate based on their scope and procedures, while coordinating with other control and monitoring functions to ensure effective use of audit resources. Build and maintain effective working relationships with process owners and business management to support improvements in internal controls, risk management, business processes, effectiveness, and efficiency. raw_source_fields.age: 24 to 30 years Responsibilities & Context Job Context: We are seeking a proactive and detail-oriented Jr. Executive, Business Development to join our team. In this role, you will play a key part in bridging connections between pharmaceutical clients and international suppliers. Job Responsibilities Client Communication & Requirement Gathering: Regularly communicate with pharmaceutical companies to identify and understand their new requirements for Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients (APIs) and Excipients. Supplier & Source Development: Identify, evaluate, and develop potential foreign suppliers, factories, and principals for high-quality pharmaceutical raw materials. Technical & Regulatory Documentation: Assist pharma clients by promptly providing essential technical documents, including Certificates of Analysis (COA), Methods of Analysis (MOA), Material Safety Data Sheets (MSDS), and Stability Reports etc. Commercial Coordination: Request, collect, and analyze price quotations from international factories, suppliers, and principals to ensure competitive sourcing. Sample Procurement: Coordinate with foreign partners to collect and deliver required product samples to clients for testing and evaluation. Skills & Expertise Other Relevant Skills Business Development Supplier Management Supply Chain Management

Requirements Education Minimum HSC / Bachelor's / Master's degree or equivalent. Candidates from any academic background may apply if they meet the required experience and skill criteria. Career growth and promotion opportunities. Respectful and supportive Islamic work environment. Scheduled leave and other applicable benefits. Requirements Education Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, Management, Marketing, or a related field. Candidates with relevant academic background and practical experience in e-commerce, procurement, inventory, or supply chain operations will be preferred. Proficiency in MS Excel/Google Sheets and willingness to work with POS/ERP systems. Ability to manage multiple tasks and meet deadlines. Willingness to conduct market visits when required. Freshers with strong knowledge and interest in supply chain and e-commerce operations may also be considered. Key Skills Supply Chain Management, Procurement, Vendor Management, Inventory Management, Purchasing, E-commerce Operations, Product Management, Market Research, Negotiation, POS/ERP, Data Management, Pricing & Promotion, Supplier Coordination Responsibilities & Context Job Responsibilities: Manage suppliers and maintain strong, professional relationships with existing and potential vendors. Review and compare multiple supplier quotations and order sheets to identify the most competitive options. Conduct market and brand research to identify high-demand, top-selling, and potential “hero” products for onboarding. Identify slow-moving and dead stock and take necessary initiatives to improve inventory turnover. Monitor near-expiry products and coordinate timely clearance or promotional activities. Maintain regular communication and coordination with suppliers regarding orders, pricing, availability, delivery, and other business matters. Schedule and coordinate meetings with suppliers and relevant internal teams. Conduct physical market visits to gather market insights, monitor competitors, and identify new product opportunities. Perform daily operational activities and maintain accurate product and inventory data in the POS system. Coordinate with the product upload team to ensure accurate and timely product listings. Maintain regular communication with the warehouse team regarding stock availability, receiving, dispatch, and inventory-related issues. Assist in inventory control, procurement, purchasing, and replenishment activities. Verify and audit product names, images, descriptions, specifications, and other product information. Monitor and manage product pricing, promotional pricing, discounts, and offers. Coordinate products and offers for various sales campaigns and promotional activities. Generate content ideas based on products, campaigns, and promotional requirements and coordinate with content creators for execution. Assist in preparing and reviewing product-related captions and promotional content. Plan and prepare themes, product selections, talking points, and scripts for live selling sessions. Prepare and monitor supplier payment schedules and coordinate with relevant teams regarding vendor payments and outstanding dues. Maintain proper records and reports related to suppliers, purchasing, inventory, pricing, and product activities. Perform other operational and ad-hoc responsibilities as assigned by the management. jobs.bdjobs.com/jobdetails?id=1542459&fc.source_content:
Requirements Education Bachelor/Honors Experience Additional Requirements Age 22 to 35 years Only Male Minimum 1–2 years of experience in a retail store as a Store Manager or in a similar designation. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills. Self-motivated and able to work in a fast-paced environment. Strong knowledge of retail operations, inventory control, cash handling, and audit procedures. Proficiency in basic computer applications (POS systems, MS Excel, email, and reporting tools). High level of integrity, discipline, and compliance with company policies. Willingness to accept transfers and assignments as per company requirements. Physically fit to manage day-to-day store operations and floor supervision. Responsibilities & Context Ensure smooth daily store operations by maintaining opening hours, cleanliness, visual merchandising, security, and excellent customer service in line with company policies. Drive sales performance by achieving daily/weekly targets, managing stock effectively, promoting new and slow-moving merchandise, and initiating approved local promotions. Achieve 100% or more in Pairs/Turnover Sales as per the Companys Seasonal/Yearly Estimate for the Store. Maintain accurate stock, cash, and accounting records; ensure timely bank deposits, audit compliance, and submission of reports to Head Office. Constantly improve Store Managers proficiency and motivation, and maintain a sound human relations climate. Lead, train, and supervise store staff through scheduling, performance monitoring, meetings, and adherence to company standards and instructions. Safeguard company assets by controlling inventory age, maintaining furniture and fixtures, handling customer claims, and ensuring proper receiving, dispatch, and transfer of merchandise. Skills & Expertise Coaching and Mentoring skills Exceptional customer service skills. jobs.bdjobs.com/jobdetails?id=1542501&fc.source_content:
Requirements Education BBA/MBA/M.Com in Accounting, Finance or related discipline. Fresh graduates or candidates with 1 year of relevant experience may apply. Experience Additional Requirements Age At least 25 years Basic understanding of accounting, inventory control and audit procedures. Good numerical and analytical skills with strong attention to detail. Working knowledge of MS Excel. ERP/Oracle experience will be an added advantage. Candidates should be honest, responsible and willing to perform regular physical inventory checks. Responsibilities & Context We are looking for energetic, detail-oriented professionals to join our Finance Team in the role of Executive – Finance Audit & Controls . Conduct regular physical inventory counts and stock verification across stores, warehouses and production-related inventory locations. Reconcile physical inventory with ERP/system records and investigate shortages, excesses and variances. Perform surprise stock counts and other inventory control checks. Review inventory movement, consumption, adjustments, transfers, wastage and supporting documentation. Review vouchers, bills, invoices, payments and other financial transactions for accuracy and compliance. Verify proper approvals and supporting documents. Check procurement and other finance-related transactions. Identify discrepancies, unusual transactions and internal control gaps. Prepare clear checking/audit observations and follow up on corrective actions. Support periodic internal control reviews and physical verification of assets where required. Ensure compliance with company policies and financial control procedures. Skills & Expertise Accounts and audit Accounts and Finance Data analysis Microsoft Office Workplace Work at office Employment Status Full Time Job Location Cumilla (Cumilla Adarsha Sadar)
Applicants are encouraged to submit Video CV.

raw_source_fields.age: At least 25 years Only Male Responsibilities & Context Perform post-audit verification to ensure proper implementation of audit observations and corrective actions. Verify inventory, stock records, and project materials against physical quantities and supporting documents. Monitor advances, outstanding balances, collections, and related documentation. Review and verify project expenses, and supporting documents for accuracy and compliance. Verify vehicle-related documents, including logbooks, fuel records, maintenance records, bills, and other supporting documents. Identify discrepancies, control weaknesses, irregularities, and potential financial or operational risks and report them to management. Check compliance with company policies, procedures, and internal control requirements. Prepare audit findings, verification reports, and other audit-related reports with clear observations and recommendations. Coordinate with relevant departments and project teams to obtain necessary documents, explanations, and supporting information. Follow up on previous audit findings and monitor the status of corrective actions. Maintain proper audit working papers, records, checklists, and supporting documents for future reference. Conduct field visits to project locations and business concerns when required for audit and verification purposes.
raw_source_fields.gender: Only males are allowed to apply.

jobs.bdjobs.com/jobdetails?id=1541468&fc.title: Senior Relationship Officer/Relationship Officer for Liability Marketing

raw_source_fields.experience: in Liability Marketing or Deposit Mobilization from any reputed Commercial Bank will be considered as added advantage. Strong sales, business development and negotiation skills Sound knowledge of CASA, FDR, deposit pricing and liability products Ability to build relationships with senior corporate and institutional decision-makers Target-oriented, with pipeline and portfolio management ability Good understanding of banking operations, KYC and AML/CFT requirements Excellent communication and presentation skills Proficiency in MS Office and MIS tools Ability to work independently and collaboratively Responsibilities & Context Senior Relationship Officer/Relationship Officer-Liability Marketing Unit (LMU) will be responsible for achieving assigned deposit mobilization targets, with primary focus on CASA, through acquiring new customers, and growing existing relationships across corporate, institutional, government, SME and high-net-worth segments. The role involves building and maintaining a strong customer base, promoting the bank’s liability products, and ensuring compliance with internal policies and regulatory guidelines. This is a target based position requiring strong communication, negotiation skills and a result oriented mindset to contribute to the bank’s overall business growth. Job Responsibilities: Deposit Mobilization: Achieve assigned CASA and overall deposit targets, prioritizing low-cost CASA while generating quality FDR and other deposits where appropriate. Customer Acquisition: Identify, approach and onboard New-to-Bank customers from corporate, multinational, government, institutional, SME and HNI segments. Relationship Management: Build long-term relationships with key decision-makers, conduct regular client visits, understand customer needs and offer suitable liability solutions. Pipeline & Sales Planning: Maintain an updated prospect database and sales pipeline, prepare monthly/quarterly/annual sales plans, follow up on leads, and track proposals through to fund placement. CASA Growth & Retention: Promote transactional banking to build sustainable operating balances, monitor portfolio inflows/outflows and maturities, and take proactive steps to retain deposits and deepen wallet share. Compliance : Ensure all activities comply with Bank policies, Bangladesh Bank regulations and AML/CFT requirements, including proper KYC, accurate documentation, approved pricing, and prompt escalation of suspicious activity. Coordination & Reporting: Work with Branches and other units for smooth onboarding and service, maintain records of sales activities, submit timely reports, and perform other duties as assigned by management. Skills & Expertise Other Relevant Skills Compliance Customer Acquisition Relationship Management Sales Planning

jobs.bdjobs.com/jobdetails?id=1542742&fc.title: Sales Audit Officer, Hygiene Business

raw_source_fields.age: At most 35 years Strong knowledge of FMCG sales processes, distributor operations, trade promotions, and ERP/SAP systems with advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel; Power BI knowledge will be an added advantage. Excellent analytical, communication, and report-writing skills with high integrity, attention to detail, and willingness to travel extensively for field and distributor audits. Responsibilities & Context Conduct regular field and system audits to ensure compliance with sales policies, SOPs, and company guidelines across the sales network. Audit distributor operations, including inventory, stock reconciliation, cash collections, credit management, and trade claims to ensure accuracy and control. Verify sales transactions, promotional activities, trade schemes, and incentive claims to detect discrepancies, non-compliance, or fraudulent practices. Monitor field sales execution, including route compliance, market coverage, merchandising standards, and outlet visitation quality. Analyze sales and audit data to identify operational risks, unusual trends, control gaps, and opportunities for process improvement. Prepare comprehensive audit reports with findings, root-cause analysis, and actionable recommendations, and monitor the implementation of corrective actions. Conduct surprise market and distributor audits while collaborating with Sales, Finance, Supply Chain, and Internal Audit to strengthen governance and internal controls. Drive continuous improvement by recommending enhancements to sales processes, audit controls, compliance practices, and operational efficiency. Skills & Expertise Analytical Skill Presentation skill Sales Audit

Requirements Education Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA) in Accounting Master of Business Administration (MBA) in Accounting CA (Chartered Accountancy) qualification or relevant CA-level qualification, as required by the employer. A Bachelor's or Master's Degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related discipline may be preferred. Professional accounting qualifications and relevant training will be considered an advantage. Responsibilities & Context Mainamoti Medical College & Hospital is seeking a qualified, responsible, and detail-oriented Accounts Officer to manage financial records, accounting operations, and financial reporting. The selected candidate will support the organization's financial management, ensure accurate documentation, and maintain compliance with applicable accounting standards and financial regulations Maintain daily financial transactions, accounting records, and ledgers. Prepare financial statements, reports, and management accounts. Monitor income, expenditure, cash flow, and budget utilization. Manage accounts payable, accounts receivable, and bank reconciliations. Assist in preparing annual budgets and financial forecasts. Ensure accurate preparation of vouchers, bills, invoices, and payment documents. Support internal and external audits and coordinate with auditors. Ensure compliance with applicable tax, VAT, and other financial regulations. Monitor financial documentation and maintain proper filing systems. Prepare periodic financial reports for management review. Perform other accounting and finance-related duties assigned by management. Requirements Education Diploma Minimum Diploma/Bachelor's degree in any discipline. Experience At least 2 years The applicants should have experience in the following business area(s): Marine Industry Additional Requirements Age At least 26 years Only Male We are looking for someone who is strong in field coordination and people management . The ideal candidate should: Be confident and comfortable dealing with divers and field workers. Have a firm but respectful personality. Be able to control difficult situations without unnecessarily escalating conflicts. Be capable of resolving disagreements between team members. Have good leadership and communication skills. Be able to give clear instructions and ensure they are followed. Be responsible and dependable. Be able to work under pressure and in difficult field conditions. Be willing to travel and stay at project locations when required. Have good organizational and documentation skills. Be comfortable communicating with clients, vessel personnel and company management. The ability to manage people, maintain discipline and keep the diving team working together is one of the most important requirements of this position. Experience Experience in any of the following will be an advantage: Commercial diving operations Marine/shipyard operations Offshore or port operations Ship inspection Field operations Construction/site supervision Workforce/team coordination Marine documentation Underwater inspection Ship repair or maintenance Candidates without diving experience may also apply if they have strong field coordination and people-management skills. Required Skills People & Field Management Strong leadership and people-management skills Conflict-resolution ability Ability to maintain discipline among field personnel Good communication and coordination skills Ability to work with workers from different backgrounds Ability to remain calm under pressure Computer & Documentation MS Word MS Excel Report preparation Document formatting File and folder management Basic presentation skills Photo & Video Basic to intermediate video editing skills Ability to use software such as CapCut, Filmora, DaVinci Resolve, Adobe Premiere Pro or similar Basic photo editing and image organization Important Working Conditions This is not a purely office-based position . The selected candidate will be required to work at vessels, ports, terminals, shipyards, workshops and other diving project locations. The candidate may occasionally need to: Work early morning or late night depending on vessel schedules. Work on weekends or public holidays during urgent operations. Travel outside Chattogram. Stay at project locations when required. Work in challenging marine and weather conditions. Coordinate with teams under time pressure. What We Expect From You We are looking for someone who can take ownership of the field operation . You should be the type of person who can: “Go to the site → organize the team → make sure everyone knows their job → keep discipline → solve problems → monitor the work → collect the information → report back to management.” If you are comfortable managing people, communicating with workers and taking responsibility in the field, this position may be suitable for you. Responsibilities & Context Department: Diving Operations About the Position Nishi Salvage & Diving is looking for a responsible, confident and firm Field Coordinator to manage and coordinate our commercial diving teams during underwater inspection and marine diving projects. This position is primarily a field coordination and people-management role . The successful candidate will work closely with divers, diving supervisors, boat crews and office management to ensure that diving operations are properly coordinated, disciplined and completed according to the project requirements. The person will also be responsible for preparing underwater inspection reports, organizing inspection documentation and editing underwater photographs and videos . We are looking for someone who can manage people firmly but professionally, handle disagreements calmly, maintain discipline and keep the field operation running smoothly. Key Responsibilities Field & Diving Team Coordination — Primary Responsibility Coordinate daily activities of divers, diving supervisors, boat crews and field personnel. Ensure that the diving team understands the assigned scope of work and daily requirements. Coordinate manpower, diving equipment, boats and other field requirements with the operations team. Monitor the attendance, discipline and work performance of field personnel. Ensure that instructions from management and the Diving Supervisor are properly communicated and followed. Maintain a professional and respectful working environment among divers and field workers. Handle disagreements, misunderstandings and conflicts between team members before they affect the diving operation. Act as a communication bridge between the office, diving team, vessel crew, clients and supervisors. Keep management updated about field progress, manpower issues, operational problems and delays. Take immediate action on routine field coordination issues and escalate serious matters to management. Ensure that unnecessary arguments, disputes or personal issues do not disrupt the project. Maintain discipline while treating field workers fairly and professionally. Coordinate mobilization and demobilization of diving teams and equipment. Travel to vessels, ports, terminals, shipyards and other project locations as required. Be available outside normal office hours when required by vessel schedules or diving operations. Project Monitoring & Field Reporting Monitor daily progress of underwater inspection and diving activities. Collect accurate information from divers and diving supervisors. Maintain daily field activity records. Record completed work, pending work, difficulties and important observations. Communicate field updates to management on time. Coordinate with vessel representatives, clients and surveyors when required. Ensure that required photographs, videos and inspection information are collected during the operation. Underwater Inspection Documentation Prepare professional underwater inspection reports based on information collected from the diving team. Organize inspection findings, photographs, videos and observations. Prepare daily work reports, inspection records, checklists and other project documentation. Review diver notes and underwater inspection findings for completeness. Compile technical information into clear and properly formatted reports. Maintain proper records for completed diving projects. Ensure reports are prepared and submitted within project deadlines. Underwater Photo & Video Editing Review underwater inspection photographs and videos recorded during diving operations. Select relevant photographs and video footage for reports. Edit underwater inspection videos for client and surveyor presentation. Add vessel name, inspection area, date, location, labels and other relevant information where required. Organize and properly store project photos, videos and final reports. Maintain an organized digital archive of completed projects. Skills & Expertise People Management skill Report Writing Video Editing Other Relevant Skills Documentation Team management Video Editing Workplace Work at office Employment Status Full Time Gender Only males are allowed to apply. Job Location Chattogram (Chattogram Sadar)
Applicants are encouraged to submit Video CV.

Responsibilities & Context
Department: Diving Operations
About the Position
Nishi Salvage & Diving is looking for a responsible, confident and firm Field Coordinator to manage and coordinate our commercial diving teams during underwater inspection and marine diving projects.
This position is primarily a field coordination and people-management role. The successful candidate will work closely with divers, diving supervisors, boat crews and office management to ensure that diving operations are properly coordinated, disciplined and completed according to the project requirements.
The person will also be responsible for preparing underwater inspection reports, organizing inspection documentation and editing underwater photographs and videos.
We are looking for someone who can manage people firmly but professionally, handle disagreements calmly, maintain discipline and keep the field operation running smoothly.
Key Responsibilities
Field & Diving Team Coordination — Primary Responsibility
Coordinate daily activities of divers, diving supervisors, boat crews and field personnel.
Ensure that the diving team understands the assigned scope of work and daily requirements.
Coordinate manpower, diving equipment, boats and other field requirements with the operations team.
Monitor the attendance, discipline and work performance of field personnel.
Ensure that instructions from management and the Diving Supervisor are properly communicated and followed.
Maintain a professional and respectful working environment among divers and field workers.
Handle disagreements, misunderstandings and conflicts between team members before they affect the diving operation.
Act as a communication bridge between the office, diving team, vessel crew, clients and supervisors.
Keep management updated about field progress, manpower issues, operational problems and delays.
Take immediate action on routine field coordination issues and escalate serious matters to management.
Ensure that unnecessary arguments, disputes or personal issues do not disrupt the project.
Maintain discipline while treating field workers fairly and professionally.
Coordinate mobilization and demobilization of diving teams and equipment.
Travel to vessels, ports, terminals, shipyards and other project locations as required.
Be available outside normal office hours when required by vessel schedules or diving operations.
Project Monitoring & Field Reporting
Monitor daily progress of underwater inspection and diving activities.
Collect accurate information from divers and diving supervisors.
Maintain daily field activity records.
Record completed work, pending work, difficulties and important observations.

raw_source_fields.age: At least 18 years Responsibilities & Context Job Summary The selected candidates will work on researching real estate market trends, analyzing customer preferences, evaluating competitors and identifying new opportunities for property development. Key Responsibilities Conduct market surveys and research to understand real estate market trends, customer preferences and emerging opportunities. Generate innovative ideas for new property development concepts, product offerings and market positioning. Prepare market research reports, presentations and recommendations for management. Maintain databases of market information, competitor projects and customer feedback. Collaborate with management and other departments to support strategic planning and business development initiatives.

Requirements Education Bachelor’s degree in Human Resource Management, Business Administration, Management, or a related field. MBA/PGD in HRM will be an advantage. Experience 1 to 3 years The applicants should have experience in the following business area(s): Manufacturing (FMCG), Retail Store Additional Requirements Only Male Must be proactive, energetic, responsible, and well-organized. Willingness to visit factory/production facilities regularly as required. Willingness to handle HR, administration, procurement, and factory coordination responsibilities. Must have good interpersonal and communication skills. Candidates who can join immediately or within a short notice period will get preference. Ability to work under pressure and meet deadlines. Experience Requirements 1–3 years of relevant experience in HR & Administration. Candidates with experience in HR operations, recruitment, attendance management, employee documentation, payroll support, administrative procurement, factory coordination, and general administration will be preferred. Experience in manufacturing, FMCG, retail, or factory-based organizations will be an advantage. Required Skills & Competencies Good knowledge of HR & Administrative functions. Strong communication and interpersonal skills. Good command of MS Office, particularly MS Excel and MS Word. Ability to maintain accurate records and documentation. Good organizational and time-management skills. Strong coordination and negotiation skills. Basic understanding of procurement and vendor management. Ability to handle confidential information professionally. Strong problem-solving and multitasking abilities. Strong sense of responsibility, discipline, and professionalism. Ability to work independently as well as in a team. Ability to communicate effectively with factory workers, employees, management, vendors, and external parties. Responsibilities & Context Department: Human Resources & Administration Job Summary: We are looking for a proactive, responsible, and well-organized HR & Admin Executive to manage day-to-day HR, administrative, procurement, and factory coordination activities. The ideal candidate should have good communication skills, strong interpersonal ability, practical knowledge of HR operations, and the ability to handle multiple administrative responsibilities efficiently. Key Responsibilities HR Responsibilities Assist in end-to-end recruitment activities, including job posting, CV screening, interview scheduling, candidate coordination, and onboarding. Maintain and update employee personal files, HR records, attendance, leave, and other employee-related documents. Prepare and maintain appointment letters, confirmation letters, increment letters, transfer letters, warning letters, and other HR documents. Monitor daily attendance, late attendance, leave, overtime, and employee movement. Assist in monthly payroll preparation and provide necessary HR-related data. Ensure proper implementation of company HR policies, rules, procedures, and guidelines. Handle employee queries and provide necessary support regarding HR-related matters. Assist in employee onboarding, orientation, and induction programs. Maintain confidentiality of employee and organizational information. Support management in maintaining a positive and disciplined workplace environment. Prepare regular HR reports and employee-related reports as required by management. Administration & Factory Coordination Manage day-to-day administrative activities to ensure smooth and efficient office operations. Regularly visit factory/production facilities to monitor HR and administrative activities and ensure proper coordination between the head office and factory. Coordinate with factory management and employees regarding attendance, manpower, employee issues, administrative requirements, and operational matters. Ensure availability and proper management of stationery, office supplies, equipment, and other administrative materials. Manage office and factory-related documentation and maintain proper records. Coordinate with vendors, suppliers, service providers, and external parties for administrative requirements. Assist in maintaining proper workplace facilities and ensuring necessary administrative support for employees. Support management in organizing meetings, events, employee engagement activities, training programs, and other organizational activities. Handle any other day-to-day administrative tasks assigned by management. Administrative Purchase & Procurement Handle administrative purchasing and procurement activities for office and factory requirements. Source and communicate with suppliers/vendors for necessary products and services. Collect and compare quotations, prices, product quality, and delivery schedules. Coordinate purchase orders, deliveries, and follow-up with suppliers. Maintain proper purchase records, bills, invoices, quotations, and supporting documents. Ensure timely procurement of office stationery, supplies, equipment, and other administrative requirements. Develop and maintain good relationships with suppliers and service providers. Ensure purchases are made within approved budgets and company policies. Skills & Expertise Employee Management Factory HR Administration General Administration HR Operation Payroll Administration Procurement Recruitment & Selection Other Relevant Skills Employee Management Factory HR Administration General Administration HR Operation Payroll Administration Procurement Recruitment & Selection Compensation & Other Benefits Compensation & Benefits Competitive salary based on experience and qualifications. Festival Bonus. Other benefits as per company policy. Career growth and professional development opportunities. Employment Status Full Time Gender Only males are allowed to apply. Job Location Dhaka
Applicants are encouraged to submit Video CV.
