Must be proactive, energetic, responsible, and well-organized.
Willingness to visit factory/production facilities regularly as required.
Willingness to handle HR, administration, procurement, and factory coordination responsibilities.
Must have good interpersonal and communication skills.
Candidates who can join immediately or within a short notice period will get preference.
Ability to work under pressure and meet deadlines.
Experience Requirements
1–3 years of relevant experience in HR & Administration.
Candidates with experience in HR operations, recruitment, attendance management, employee documentation, payroll support, administrative procurement, factory coordination, and general administration will be preferred.
Experience in manufacturing, FMCG, retail, or factory-based organizations will be an advantage.
Required Skills & Competencies
Good knowledge of HR & Administrative functions.
Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
Good command of MS Office, particularly MS Excel and MS Word.
Ability to maintain accurate records and documentation.
Good organizational and time-management skills.
Strong coordination and negotiation skills.
Basic understanding of procurement and vendor management.
Ability to handle confidential information professionally.
Strong problem-solving and multitasking abilities.
Strong sense of responsibility, discipline, and professionalism.
Ability to work independently as well as in a team.
Ability to communicate effectively with factory workers, employees, management, vendors, and external parties.
Responsibilities & Context
Department: Human Resources & Administration
Job Summary:
We are looking for a proactive, responsible, and well-organized HR & Admin Executive to manage day-to-day HR, administrative, procurement, and factory coordination activities. The ideal candidate should have good communication skills, strong interpersonal ability, practical knowledge of HR operations, and the ability to handle multiple administrative responsibilities efficiently.
Key Responsibilities
HR Responsibilities
Assist in end-to-end recruitment activities, including job posting, CV screening, interview scheduling, candidate coordination, and onboarding.
Maintain and update employee personal files, HR records, attendance, leave, and other employee-related documents.
Prepare and maintain appointment letters, confirmation letters, increment letters, transfer letters, warning letters, and other HR documents.
Monitor daily attendance, late attendance, leave, overtime, and employee movement.
Assist in monthly payroll preparation and provide necessary HR-related data.
Ensure proper implementation of company HR policies, rules, procedures, and guidelines.
Handle employee queries and provide necessary support regarding HR-related matters.
Assist in employee onboarding, orientation, and induction programs.
Maintain confidentiality of employee and organizational information.
Support management in maintaining a positive and disciplined workplace environment.
Prepare regular HR reports and employee-related reports as required by management.
Administration & Factory Coordination
Manage day-to-day administrative activities to ensure smooth and efficient office operations.
Regularly visit factory/production facilities to monitor HR and administrative activities and ensure proper coordination between the head office and factory.
Coordinate with factory management and employees regarding attendance, manpower, employee issues, administrative requirements, and operational matters.
Ensure availability and proper management of stationery, office supplies, equipment, and other administrative materials.
Manage office and factory-related documentation and maintain proper records.
Coordinate with vendors, suppliers, service providers, and external parties for administrative requirements.
Assist in maintaining proper workplace facilities and ensuring necessary administrative support for employees.
Support management in organizing meetings, events, employee engagement activities, training programs, and other organizational activities.
Handle any other day-to-day administrative tasks assigned by management.
Administrative Purchase & Procurement
Handle administrative purchasing and procurement activities for office and factory requirements.
Source and communicate with suppliers/vendors for necessary products and services.
Collect and compare quotations, prices, product quality, and delivery schedules.
Coordinate purchase orders, deliveries, and follow-up with suppliers.
Maintain proper purchase records, bills, invoices, quotations, and supporting documents.
Ensure timely procurement of office stationery, supplies, equipment, and other administrative requirements.
Develop and maintain good relationships with suppliers and service providers.
Ensure purchases are made within approved budgets and company policies.
Other Relevant Skills
Compensation & Other Benefits
Compensation & Benefits
Competitive salary based on experience and qualifications.
Festival Bonus.
Other benefits as per company policy.
Career growth and professional development opportunities.

Full Time
Gender
Only males are allowed to apply.
Job Location
Dhaka

Interested candidates are requested to submit their updated CV mentioning "HR & Admin Executive" in the subject line.
Candidates with relevant experience in HR, Administration, Administrative Purchase, and Factory Coordination are strongly encouraged to apply.

We are especially interested in candidates who have previous experience in: Recruitment | Talent Acquisition | Candidate Sourcing | BDjobs Recruitment | LinkedIn Recruitment | Mass Hiring | Interview Coordination Responsibilities & Context Department: Recruitment Office Time: 10.0 AM – 6:00 PM Job Overview SKYLINK AIRWAYS is looking for an experienced and target-oriented Talent Acquisition Specialist who will be responsible only for candidate recruitment and hiring. The selected candidate will focus on finding suitable candidates for the companys vacancies, conducting initial screening, arranging interviews and ensuring selected candidates join the company. Maintain regular communication with candidates throughout the recruitment process. Follow up with selected candidates until their joining. Maintain a proper candidate database and recruitment tracker. Build and maintain a strong pipeline of potential candidates. Meet assigned monthly recruitment targets. Submit regular recruitment updates to management. The primary responsibility will be: Candidate Sourcing → CV Screening → Calling → Interview → Selection → Joining Recruitment Target The candidate will be responsible for achieving assigned monthly hiring targets and maintaining a continuous pipeline of suitable candidates. At Universe Group, our journey began in 2016 with a simple yet powerful vision—to make finding a dream home as inspiring and extraordinary as the universe itself. We are committed to excellence, trust, integrity, and personalized service.

Guide team members in customer handling, negotiation, and closing.

Handle inquiries, objections, and important clients professionally.
Follow up on leads and ensure effective lead conversion.

Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly sales reports.
Track individual and team performance against targets.
Report sales progress, challenges, and opportunities to the Sales Manager.
5. Business Development
Identify new customers, sales opportunities, and market trends.
Support marketing campaigns, market research, and competitor analysis.
6. Coordination
Coordinate with Marketing, Legal, Finance, Customer Service, and Project Teams for smooth sales operations.

Requirements Experience At least 2 years The applicants should have experience in the following business area(s): Business-to-Business (B2B) Software and Services Startup Additional Requirements Age At least 30 years Only Male Experience working with business owners, executives, government organisations, regulatory bodies, legal or compliance matters, or multiple businesses would be useful. We do not expect one person to already know everything. What matters is having broad knowledge, being able to understand new subjects quickly and knowing how to find the information or people needed to get something done. Requirements We are looking for someone who can think independently and deal with a wide range of work. You should have: Very good knowledge of Bangladesh A good understanding of business in Bangladesh Knowledge of Bangladeshi government departments, systems and administrative processes Knowledge or experience across several industries Good research and problem-solving skills Strong written and spoken Bangla and English Good organisation and attention to detail Confidence speaking with businesses, professionals and government organisations Good computer and internet research skills The ability to manage several matters at once Good judgement The ability to work without constant supervision The ability to learn about unfamiliar subjects quickly Discretion when dealing with private or commercially sensitive information Responsibilities & Context We are looking for an experienced and intelligent person to assist with the management of several businesses and projects. This role goes beyond the normal responsibilities of a Personal Assistant or secretary. There will be administrative work, but a large part of the job will involve dealing with business matters, researching issues, speaking with different organisations and helping resolve problems. You may be given a task or problem without detailed instructions and expected to work out how to handle it. This could involve researching the issue, finding the correct person or organisation to contact, making enquiries, following up and reporting back. A good understanding of Bangladesh is important. You should be familiar with the business environment, different industries, government departments, regulations and administrative processes. The Role You will sometimes be given an objective rather than step-by-step instructions. You will be expected to understand what needs to be done, research it where necessary, speak to the relevant people and follow the matter through. The work can vary significantly depending on what the businesses need at the time. You should be comfortable taking on work that may not fall under a typical secretary or Personal Assistant job description. We are looking for someone who can gradually take responsibility for more matters and become closely involved in the day-to-day running of several businesses. Location and Travel You may be based anywhere, provided you are reliable and available when required. Knowledge of Bangladesh is essential. You must also be willing to travel to Dhaka when necessary. Responsibilities Assist with several businesses and projects at the same time Manage meetings, correspondence, documents, appointments and deadlines Communicate with companies, executives, consultants, lawyers, government offices and other organisations Research companies, industries, regulations and government procedures Make enquiries and deal with government departments and other organisations when required Find the correct people or departments to contact regarding particular issues Follow up on applications, enquiries and outstanding matters Coordinate between businesses, employees and outside organisations Prepare reports and summaries when required Organise meetings, appointments and travel Keep track of important matters and make sure they are followed up Handle confidential business information and documents Help resolve problems as they arise Take on responsibilities outside normal PA work when required Travel to Dhaka for meetings or business matters when necessary Skills & Expertise Government Liaison Operation Project Management Other Relevant Skills Business Administration Operations Management Government Liaison Business Research Stakeholder Communication Compensation & Other Benefits Salary: The salary is ৳100,000 to ৳200,000 per month, depending on experience and ability. The exact amount will depend on your background, knowledge, experience and the level of responsibility you are able to handle. There is room for increased responsibility and progression for someone who performs well in the role. Workplace Work at office Employment Status Full Time Gender Only males are allowed to apply. jobs.bdjobs.com/jobdetails?id=1543284&fc.source_content:
Requirements Education BBA or MBA in Human Resource Management. Experience At least 2 years The applicants should have experience in the following business area(s): Hospital, Diagnostic Centre, Manpower Recruitment, Travel Agency, Group of Companies Additional Requirements Age At least 21 years Only Male Manage calendars, coordinate meeting & Prepare Meeting Minutes. English typing speed of at least 40 words per minute (WPM) and Bijoy Bangla typing speed of at least 30 WPM. Hands-on experience in Admin and HR. Have to expert at IT and modern software related knowledge. Strong communication and interpersonal skills. Sound knowledge of HR policies, procedures, and the Bangladesh Labor Act & Labor Rules. Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications (Word, Excel, and PowerPoint) and HR-related software. Experience in CV sorting, screening, and shortlisting through BDJobs. Ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously and perform effectively under pressure. Smart, energetic, self-motivated, and a strong team player with a positive attitude. Responsibilities & Context JSK Group , a rapidly expanding and diversified business conglomerate with interests in Hospital & Diagnostic Services, Passenger Transport, Capital Market Brokerage House, Sara Express and Overseas Recruitment & Training, is looking for a smart, dynamic, and energetic Executive-Admin & HR . The selected candidate will be responsible for handling Admin & HR operations, recruitment, employee relations, and HR documentation across multiple business units under JSK Group . Job Responsibilities: Answer phone calls, sort emails, and greet office visitors. Order office supplies and maintain office equipment. Process basic invoices, track expenses, and reconcile budgets. Handle end-to-end recruitment process — job posting, candidate sourcing, interviewing, and onboarding. Maintain accurate employee records, personal files, and attendance database. Support in payroll preparation, leave management, and benefits administration. Conduct orientation programs for new employees and ensure smooth joining formalities. Assist in performance appraisal and employee evaluation processes. Handle employee queries, grievances, and ensure a healthy work environment. Support HR audits, training programs, and compliance with labor laws and company policy. Coordinate with different units (Hospital, Diagnostic, Transport, Brokerage, Training Center) to fulfill manpower needs. Prepare periodic HR reports for management review. Skills & Expertise HR and Administration Compensation & Other Benefits As per company policy. Workplace Work at office Employment Status Full Time Gender Only males are allowed to apply. Job Location Dhaka (Motijheel)

jobs.bdjobs.com/jobdetails?id=1543010&fc.source_content:
Requirements Education Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Human Resource Management (HRM), Business Administration (BBA/MBA), or a related discipline. A Post Graduate Diploma (PGD) in HRM or specialized compliance/auditing training is often preferred. Experience At least 3 years The applicants should have experience in the following business area(s): Business-to-Business (B2B) Software and Services Startup Additional Requirements Age 30 to 35 years Minimum 3 years of experience in HR and Administration preferably in a service-based or B2B environment. Prior background in security services, facility management, or large-scale workforce/guard operations is a strong advantage. Skills & Expertise Documentation HR and Compliance Recruitment and Selection Additional Requirements Age: 30–35 years (flexible for highly skilled candidates) Good Knowledge of MS Office, MS Word, Excel Ability to write clear, persuasive copy in both English and Bengali Strong Communication, coordination and prob solving skills. Ability to work independently and maintain confidentiality. Responsibilities & Context Job Context: An HR Executive is a core human resources professional who manages day-to-day HR operations, bridging the gap between company management and employees. Job Responsibilities Manage employee documentation, personal files and HR database. Handle daily attendance, leave, late/absent records and monthly HR reports. Coordinate recruitment, CV screening, interviews and employee onboarding. Prepare appointment, confirmation, experience and relieving letters. Manage HR requirements for office and project/site employees. Handle employee queries, HR policies, notices and general employee relations. Manage resignation, clearance and full & final settlement documentation. Ensure compliance with company policies and applicable Bangladesh Labour Laws. Maintain strict confidentiality of employee information. Skills & Expertise Other Relevant Skills HR Documentation Human Resource Management Recruitment & Selection Employee Relations HRIS/ HR Database Management B2B (Business to Business) Compensation & Other Benefits Mobile Allowance Festival Bonus Annual Increment Career Growth Opportunity Employment Status Full Time Job Location Dhaka
Applicants are encouraged to submit Video CV.

Requirements Education Bachelor of Science (BSc) Experience At least 3 years The applicants should have experience in the following business area(s): Computer Hardware/Network Companies, Garments, Multinational Companies, Software Company, Technical Infrastructure, Textile Additional Requirements Age 25 to 35 years IT end user support experience. Customer Service oriented. Effective communication with end users and colleagues in the IT area. Oriented to the fulfillment of policies, procedures as well as the follow-up of the assigned tasks. Experience as Service Desk, Helpdesk or Network Support. Experience in remote support of IT problems and escalation of incidents to other IT Areas. Experience in Service Desk Platforms (Service-Now or similar) Strong understanding of IT Networking services (Internet Services, DNS, TCP/IP, WAN LAN SERVICES). Responsibilities & Context The IT Support Sn Technician is responsible for providing advanced remote technical support to GILDAN users globally, focusing on complex and critical issues that require specialized knowledge and elevated access privileges. The Global position is responsible for the onboarding, testing, and deployment of new automation technologies across all regions, as well as the responsible of the administration of massive end-user accounts in different systems, and IT support tools that impacts users globally. With the Highest privileges on the systems will be responsible of the account administration. Major Responsibilities Oversee the management of software and tools required for the global administration of accounts, and ticketing systems across all regions. Ensure that solutions are standardized and scalable to meet global needs. Create and update documentation for known issues and solutions with a global audience in mind and provide training to Level 1 and Level 2 support teams worldwide to ensure consistent support practices across all locations. Identify and standardize IT lifecycle processes across all regions to ensure global consistency. Develop and maintain documentation for known issues and solutions with a global scope. Identify advanced automation technologies that are compatible with Gildan’s global operations and integrate them seamlessly into existing systems worldwide to optimize efficiency and scalability. Identify and address existing problems by analyzing patterns and behaviors in devices across all regions, conducting thorough root cause analysis of recurring issues to prevent future incidents and enhance system reliability on a global scale. Leverage the global ticketing database to predict upcoming issues and proactively reduce future problems worldwide, ensuring continuous improvement in IT support and system performance. Perform internal audits to Account management processes, deep technical expertise and forensic, with elevated access privileges. Guarantee the daily operation compliance and supervise any daily operations of account creation, audit creations, departures, and modifications, responsible for account management KPI compliance and participate and be responsible of any audit related to account management, assist in any continuous improvement for account management. Lead and participate in the planning, development, and execution of global IT support projects focused on enhancing IT services and infrastructure across all regions. Collaborate with cross-functional teams worldwide to implement new technologies, tools, and processes that boost the efficiency and capabilities of IT support on a global scale, ensuring consistency and alignment with Gildan’s global operations. jobs.bdjobs.com/jobdetails?id=1543811&fc.source_content:
Requirements Education BBA/MBA in International Business, Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, Marketing or related discipline. Graduates/Postgraduates in English/EEE/CSE with strong business communication skills are also encouraged to apply. Additional Requirements Age 20 to 40 years Experience Requirements 1–5 years relevant experience in International Sourcing, Foreign Communication, Procurement, Import/Export, International Business or Supply Chain. Fresh graduates with excellent English communication and strong commercial aptitude may also be considered for Executive. Additional Requirements Excellent English communication and business correspondence skills. Strong negotiation and supplier relationship management skills. Good understanding of international sourcing, procurement and import processes. Ability to communicate confidently with Chinese and overseas suppliers. Good analytical and MS Excel skills. Proactive, organized and result-oriented. Preferred / Advantage Experience in industrial machinery, textile/garments machinery, printing/digital printing/sublimation machinery, spare parts, China sourcing, machinery trading/import or B2B business will be preferred. Responsibilities & Context Job Context Hasan Trade is a leading industrial machinery importer and solution provider in Bangladesh, serving the Textile, Garments, Printing, Signage, Packaging, Manufacturing and related industries. We are looking for a dynamic, commercially minded and result-oriented professional to manage international sourcing and supplier coordination while supporting new product sourcing, market development and business growth initiatives. Key Responsibilities International Sourcing & Supplier Development Identify and develop overseas manufacturers, suppliers and potential business partners, particularly from China. Source industrial machinery, spare parts, printing equipment, inks, consumables and related products based on market and customer requirements. Communicate with overseas suppliers regarding product specifications, pricing, MOQ, lead time, payment terms and commercial matters. Evaluate and compare suppliers/products and negotiate competitive pricing and favorable terms. Build and maintain strong relationships with existing and potential overseas suppliers. Procurement & Import Coordination Coordinate procurement activities from requirement identification to order confirmation and shipment. Follow up PI, purchase orders, production, inspection, packing and shipment with overseas suppliers. Coordinate LC/TT payment and commercial/shipping documentation with Finance, Commercial and Logistics teams. Monitor shipment schedules and maintain proper supplier, order and shipment records. Business Development & Market Expansion Conduct market research to identify new products, technologies, brands and business opportunities. Explore potential international brands/manufacturers for new partnerships and product representation. Identify products and solutions with potential for introduction and expansion in Bangladesh. Support Sales & Marketing with product information, supplier capabilities, pricing and market intelligence. Assist Management in evaluating new products, brands and business opportunities. Cross-functional Coordination Coordinate with Sales & Marketing, Commercial, Logistics and Service teams for smooth business execution. Coordinate product-related technical queries, spare parts and after-sales requirements with overseas suppliers and the Service Department. Skills & Expertise Other Relevant Skills International Sourcing Supply Chain Management Compensation & Other Benefits Attractive salary package (Negotiable based on experience and competency) Mobile allowance Festival bonuses Other benefits as per company policy & Practice Employment Status Full Time Job Location Dhaka (Purana Paltan)

Requirements Education Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA) in Accounting Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field is preferred. Additional Requirements Age 25 to 35 years Only Male Candidates with relevant practical experience and strong accounting skills may also apply. Required Skills & Experience Experience in accounts, operations, retail, customer service, or studio management is an advantage. Basic to intermediate knowledge of Microsoft Excel, Word, and accounting software. Strong organizational, communication, and problem-solving skills. Ability to manage staff and coordinate multiple tasks. Must be confident and comfortable appearing on camera. Professional attitude, honesty, punctuality, and attention to detail. Willingness to learn about automotive detailing products and services. Responsibilities & Context Workplace: 100 Feet Road, Madani Avenue, Dhaka 1212 About MO’S Detailing MO’S Detailing is a professional automotive detailing studio specializing in premium car care services, including Paint Protection Film (PPF), ceramic coating, paint correction, interior deep cleaning, and professional car washing. We are looking for a responsible, organized, and energetic individual to manage our accounts, daily studio operations, customer coordination, and social media presentation. Key Responsibilities Studio & Operations Management Supervise daily studio operations and ensure smooth workflow. Monitor staff attendance, punctuality, productivity, and discipline. Coordinate job allocation and service delivery. Ensure quality standards are maintained for all detailing services. Monitor cleanliness, equipment handling, and overall studio presentation. Manage customer appointments, service updates, complaints, and feedback. Coordinate with suppliers and ensure essential products are available. Customer Service & Sales Coordination Welcome customers and explain available detailing services. Assist customers in selecting suitable PPF, ceramic coating, paint correction, and interior care packages. Prepare quotations, service orders, and customer invoices. Follow up with customers and maintain customer records. Support sales growth through professional communication and service recommendations. Social Media & On-Camera Presentation Confidently appear in videos, reels, and promotional content for MO’S Detailing. Explain detailing services, products, and procedures in a clear and engaging manner. Participate in educational videos, service demonstrations, and promotional campaigns. Coordinate with the content creation team for filming and social media activities. Help build customer trust and strengthen the brand’s online presence. Skills & Expertise Content Creation Office Management Other Relevant Skills Video Editing Studio Management Social Media Management Compensation & Other Benefits Competitive, negotiable salary. Opportunity to grow with a premium automotive detailing brand. Professional working environment. Opportunities to develop skills in business operations, automotive care, sales, and digital content creation. Workplace Work at office Employment Status Full Time Gender Only males are allowed to apply. Job Location Anywhere in Bangladesh

About MO’S Detailing
MO’S Detailing is a professional automotive detailing studio specializing in premium car care services, including Paint Protection Film (PPF), ceramic coating, paint correction, interior deep cleaning, and professional car washing. We are looking for a responsible, organized, and energetic individual to manage our accounts, daily studio operations, customer coordination, and social media presentation.
Key Responsibilities
Studio & Operations Management
Supervise daily studio operations and ensure smooth workflow.
Monitor staff attendance, punctuality, productivity, and discipline.
Coordinate job allocation and service delivery.
Ensure quality standards are maintained for all detailing services.
Monitor cleanliness, equipment handling, and overall studio presentation.
Manage customer appointments, service updates, complaints, and feedback.
Coordinate with suppliers and ensure essential products are available.
Customer Service & Sales Coordination
Welcome customers and explain available detailing services.
Assist customers in selecting suitable PPF, ceramic coating, paint correction, and interior care packages.
Prepare quotations, service orders, and customer invoices.
Follow up with customers and maintain customer records.
Support sales growth through professional communication and service recommendations.
Social Media & On-Camera Presentation
Confidently appear in videos, reels, and promotional content for MO’S Detailing.
Explain detailing services, products, and procedures in a clear and engaging manner.
Participate in educational videos, service demonstrations, and promotional campaigns.
Coordinate with the content creation team for filming and social media activities.
Help build customer trust and strengthen the brand’s online presence.
Other Relevant Skills
Compensation & Other Benefits
Competitive, negotiable salary. Opportunity to grow with a premium automotive detailing brand. Professional working environment. Opportunities to develop skills in business operations, automotive care, sales, and digital content creation.

Responsibilities & Context We are seeking a proactive, analytical, and result oriented individual to join our Procurement Department as a Management Trainee Officer (MTO). The selected candidate will have the opportunity to develop practical knowledge and professional skills in procurement operations, strategic sourcing, supplier management, and supply chain processes. Job Responsibilities Assist in day-to-day procurement activities, including sourcing, purchasing, and supplier coordination. Identify and evaluate potential suppliers to ensure competitive pricing, quality, and timely delivery. Collect quotations, prepare comparative statements (CS), and support supplier selection. Assist in preparing purchase requisitions (PR), purchase orders (PO), and other procurement documents. Communicate and negotiate with vendors regarding pricing, delivery schedules, and payment terms. Coordinate with internal departments to understand purchasing requirements and ensure timely procurement. Monitor purchase orders and follow up with suppliers to ensure on-time delivery. Maintain accurate procurement records, supplier databases, and relevant documentation. Assist in analyzing procurement costs and identifying opportunities for cost optimization. Support the preparation of procurement reports, MIS, and other management reports. Ensure compliance with organizational procurement policies and procedures. Perform other procurement-related tasks assigned by the department. Skills & Expertise Microsoft Office Other Relevant Skills Strategic Sourcing Vendor Negotiation Purchase orders Cost optimization Procurement

Requirements Education Bachelor’s Degree from Recognized University in Management / HRM / Public Administration Experience 2 to 3 years The applicants should have experience in the following business area(s): Architecture Firm, Engineering Firms, HVAC System, Interior Design Additional Requirements Only Male 2–3 years of similar professional experience. Experience from Real Estate / Engineering Firm / Construction / Industrial are priority. Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Word, PDF Edit, Powerpoint is Mandatory. Skills in English and Bangla typing are required Skills in Emailing, Office Letter, Agreement, Application, SOP, Notice writing. Knowledge of Bangladesh Labor Act. Excellency in organizational communication and interpersonal skill. Good command of both English and Bangla Responsibilities & Context Brownfield Engineering Limited (BFEL) is an established engineering and project execution company in Bangladesh, engaged in industrial, power, Real Estate, infrastructure and engineering projects. We work with leading local and international organizations and maintain a professional, disciplined and performance-driven working environment. We are looking for a smart, responsible and well-organized Executive – Administration who can effectively support our day-to-day corporate administration and coordinate with management, employees, vendors and external stakeholders. Key Responsibilities: Maintain day-to-day office administration and ensure smooth office operations. Maintain employee attendance, leave records, personnel files, and HR documentation. Assist in recruitment, interview coordination, employee onboarding, and joining formalities. Prepare official letters, notices, memos, reports, and meeting minutes. Provide administrative support to management and coordinate meetings and official programs. Manage office supplies, stationery, utilities, and other administrative requirements. Coordinate with vendors, service providers, government offices, and external stakeholders. Arrange official travel, transportation, hotel bookings, and other logistical requirements. Monitor office support staff, drivers, security, and housekeeping activities, where applicable. Maintain confidentiality of company information documents, update / renewal of license, employee records, and management discussions. Organize company’s event, managing supplies and training session for employee development. Follow up on assigned tasks within deadline and perform other relevant HR & Admin duties as required by management. Company Type: Engineering Firm, Real Estate Location: 55 Shah Mokdum Avenue, Sector 12, Uttara, Dhaka Compensation & Other Benefits 2 Festive Bonuses Mobile Bill (as per company policy) Professional working environment and career development opportunities Employment Status Full Time Gender Only males are allowed to apply. raw_source_fields.age: 25 to 45 years Responsibilities & Context চাকরির দায়িত্বসমূহ: কোম্পানির বিক্রয় বৃদ্ধি ও ব্যবসায়িক উন্নয়নের লক্ষ্যে মার্চেন্ডাইজিং কৌশল প্রণয়ন ও বাস্তবায়ন করা। পণ্য সংগ্রহ, সরবরাহকারীদের সঙ্গে সম্পর্ক বজায় রাখা, মূল্য নির্ধারণ, ক্রয় এবং পণ্যের পর্যাপ্ত মজুত নিশ্চিত করা। পণ্যের বৈচিত্র্য, মজুতের পরিমাণ, বিক্রয় কার্যক্রম এবং বাজারের চাহিদা পর্যবেক্ষণ করা। বিভিন্ন আউটলেট বা বিভাগে সময়মতো পণ্য ক্রয় ও সরবরাহ নিশ্চিত করা। প্রতিযোগিতামূলক মূল্য, উন্নত মানের পণ্য এবং অনুকূল ব্যবসায়িক শর্ত নিশ্চিত করতে সরবরাহকারীদের সঙ্গে আলোচনা ও দর-কষাকষি করা। বিক্রয়, ক্রয়, মজুত ব্যবস্থাপনা এবং স্টোর পরিচালনা বিভাগের সঙ্গে সমন্বয় করে কাজ করা। লাভজনকতা বৃদ্ধির জন্য নতুন পণ্য, সরবরাহকারী এবং বাজারের সুযোগ চিহ্নিত করা। পণ্যের গুণগত মান বজায় রাখা এবং সঠিক মার্চেন্ডাইজিং কার্যক্রম নিশ্চিত করা। বিক্রয়, পণ্য মজুত, ক্রয় এবং বিভাগের কার্যক্রমের ওপর নিয়মিত প্রতিবেদন তৈরি করা। শিক্ষাগত যোগ্যতা: ন্যূনতম এইচএসসি (HSC) পাস। অভিজ্ঞতা: মার্চেন্ডাইজিং, রিটেইল ম্যানেজমেন্ট, সুপারশপ পরিচালনা, পণ্য ক্রয় অথবা সংশ্লিষ্ট ক্ষেত্রে ন্যূনতম ২ বছরের বাস্তব অভিজ্ঞতা থাকতে হবে।

jobs.bdjobs.com/jobdetails?id=1544271&fc.source_content:
Requirements Education Bachelors in Finance/Accounting from a reputed public/private university with a minimum CGPA of 3.00. Must possess CA (CC) from a reputed Chartered Accountancy firm. Candidates with CA Certificate level examinations will be given preference. Experience At least 3 years The applicants should have experience in the following business area(s): Pharmaceutical/Medicine Companies Additional Requirements At least 3 years of professional experience in Finance & Accounts. Job requirements may be relaxed for highly deserving candidates. Responsibilities & Context BEACON GROUP is one of the fastest growing conglomerates in Bangladesh. After the success in local market, Beacon is the most popular Bangladeshi company in global market for its high quality products. To support and strengthen our existing team, we are currently looking for a smart, energetic, & committed individuals. Key Responsibilities Maintain accurate books of accounts and record all financial transactions in accordance with applicable accounting standards. Prepare monthly, quarterly and annual financial statements, including Statement of Financial Position, Profit or Loss, Cash Flow Statement and Changes in Equity. Prepare annual budgets, monitor actual performance against budget and investigate significant variances. Monitor cash balances, bank accounts, fund requirements and ensure adequate liquidity for business operations. Perform bank reconciliations and resolve outstanding or unusual transactions. Verify supplier invoices, process payments and maintain accurate records of trade and other payables. Maintain the fixed asset register, calculate depreciation, monitor additions/disposals and conduct periodic verification. Review payroll-related accounting entries, employee benefits, deductions and statutory payments. Any other tasks assigned by management time to time. Skills & Expertise Other Relevant Skills Budgeting and Forecasting Cash Flow Management Financial accounting Financial Analysis Financial Statement Fixed Asset Management Payroll Processing Compensation & Other Benefits Attractive remuneration package with excellent career growth opportunities. Employment Status Full Time Job Location Dhaka
Applicants are encouraged to submit Video CV.

jobs.bdjobs.com/jobdetails?id=1544734&fc.source_content:
Requirements Education Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Economics, Statistics, or a related discipline. Experience At least 2 years The applicants should have experience in the following business area(s): Group of Companies, IT Enabled Service Additional Requirements Key Qualifications: Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to convert data and research into practical business recommendations. Strong understanding of market research, competitor analysis, customer behavior, and business fundamentals. Proficiency in Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets; knowledge of dashboards and reporting tools is an advantage. Practical knowledge of AI tools for research, analysis, reporting, and productivity. Strong communication, presentation, negotiation, and coordination skills. Ability to prepare professional business reports, presentations, proposals, and analysis. Strong commercial awareness with the ability to identify business opportunities and understand their potential impact. Experience Requirements: 2+ years of relevant experience in Business Development, Market Research, Business Analysis, Sales, or related areas is preferred. Responsibilities & Context We are looking for a proactive and analytical Executive, Business Development (Digital Commerce and AI) to identify new business opportunities, support growth initiatives, and drive commercial performance. The role will focus on market research, business analysis, opportunity identification, partnership development, and cross-functional execution. Key Responsibilities: Research market trends, customer preferences, competitor activities, industry developments, and emerging business opportunities. Analyze sales, customer, product, and market data to identify growth opportunities and performance gaps. Identify and recommend new products, markets, customer segments, partnerships, and business initiatives. Generate and evaluate potential business leads, partnerships, and growth opportunities. Use AI tools and platforms to accelerate market research, competitor analysis, data analysis, business intelligence, content preparation, and reporting. Identify opportunities to apply AI and automation to improve business processes, customer experience, digital commerce operations, and team productivity. Evaluate emerging AI technologies, tools, and business use cases and recommend practical applications for the organization. Support the development of business proposals, presentations, business cases, and partnership plans. Conduct market and competitor analysis to support business decisions and strategic initiatives. Monitor key business and growth metrics, including revenue, customer acquisition, conversion, customer retention, and campaign performance. Prepare regular reports and dashboards highlighting business performance, key findings, opportunities, and recommended actions. Collaborate with Sales, Marketing, E-commerce, Product, Finance, and other relevant teams to execute business development initiatives. Coordinate with internal teams and external partners to support partnership and business development activities. Evaluate the effectiveness of business and growth initiatives and recommend improvements. Maintain business development action plans and follow up with relevant teams to ensure timely execution. Verify the accuracy and reliability of business data, reports, research findings, and analysis. Monitor emerging technologies, consumer behavior, and market developments and assess their potential business impact. Support process and workflow improvements to improve business development efficiency and execution. Perform other business development and analytical tasks assigned by management. Skills & Expertise Other Relevant Skills Business Development Market Research Business Analysis Competitor Analysis Market trend analysis Artificial intelligence (AI) Compensation & Other Benefits Festival Bonuses Competitive Salary Yearly Salary Review Employment Status Full Time Job Location Dhaka (Gulshan)

Research market trends, customer preferences, competitor activities, industry developments, and emerging business opportunities.

Collaborate with Sales, Marketing, E-commerce, Product, Finance, and other relevant teams to execute business development initiatives.
Coordinate with internal teams and external partners to support partnership and business development activities.
Evaluate the effectiveness of business and growth initiatives and recommend improvements.
Maintain business development action plans and follow up with relevant teams to ensure timely execution.
Verify the accuracy and reliability of business data, reports, research findings, and analysis.
Monitor emerging technologies, consumer behavior, and market developments and assess their potential business impact.
Support process and workflow improvements to improve business development efficiency and execution.
Perform other business development and analytical tasks assigned by management.

Requirements Education Master of Business Administration (MBA) in Marketing Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA) in Marketing Experience 1 to 3 years The applicants should have experience in the following business area(s): IT Enabled Service, Business-to-Business (B2B) Software and Services Startup, Software Company, Computer Hardware/Network Companies, Telecommunication Freshers are also encouraged to apply. Additional Requirements Age 18 to 30 years Only Male At least 1 year of experience The applicants should have experience in the following business area(s): IT-enabled Product & Service, Direct Selling/Marketing Service Company, Computer Hardware/Network Companies, Electronic Equipment/Home Appliances, Environmental & Industrial Sensor Manufacturer. Freshers are also encouraged to apply. Responsibilities & Context Kickstart Your Career with a research-based organization! IoTixLab Limited is offering an exciting Sales & Marketing Trainee Program tailored for the bright minds of reputed universities across Bangladesh. We are looking for Smart, Energetic, Confident & self-motivated guys who can take the challenge to become future business leaders in this sector. Setting up and achieving goals & quarterly sales targets is a must. Follow up and visit prospective customers regularly. Generate new leads through field visits, networking, referrals, and local marketing. Achieve company revenue and profit targets with proper planning & execution. Ability to work under pressure and maintain satisfactory results. To deal efficiently and politely with all telephone, email, internet, and in-person inquiries. Manage brand presence on social networks, including Facebook, LinkedIn, and others when required. Ideal candidates must be smart- dedicated, hard-working, honest, sincere, and committed to the company. Answering client queries about product specifications and uses. jobs.bdjobs.com/jobdetails?id=1544741&fc.title: Sr. Executive, Procurement & Commercial

raw_source_fields.education: Masters in Accounting/Finance from a reputed university Professional qualification on Supply Chain Management Background of Civil Engineering or Apparel Merchandising are encouraged to apply Relevant Certifications in Supply Chain Management are advantageous.

jobs.bdjobs.com/jobdetails?id=1544741&fc.source_content:
Requirements Education Masters in Accounting/Finance from a reputed university Professional qualification on Supply Chain Management Background of Civil Engineering or Apparel Merchandising are encouraged to apply Relevant Certifications in Supply Chain Management are advantageous. Experience At least 3 years The applicants should have experience in the following business area(s): Supply Chain Additional Requirements Key Qualifications: Good knowledge of local and international procurement processes. Understanding of commercial operations, import/shipment documentation, and inventory management. Strong negotiation, analytical, communication, and problem-solving skills. Proficiency in MS Office, particularly Excel. Strong attention to detail, follow-up, and coordination skills. Experience Requirements: 3+ years of relevant experience in Procurement, Commercial, Supply Chain, or related fields. Experience in LC, import, international procurement, or commercial operations will be preferred. Fresh graduates with strong potential may also be considered. Responsibilities & Context We are looking for a capable Sr. Executive, Procurement & Commercial to manage and support local and international procurement and commercial activities. The role will coordinate with suppliers, process procurement and commercial documentation, follow up on orders and shipments, and coordinate invoices and payments. The position will work closely with internal departments to ensure timely procurement, smooth material flow, and effective resolution of supplier and commercial issues. Key Responsibilities: Source and coordinate with local and international suppliers to ensure competitive pricing, quality, and timely delivery. Collect and evaluate quotations, prepare comparative statements, negotiate prices, and support procurement decisions. Prepare and process Purchase Orders (PO), Work Orders (WO), and other procurement documents. Follow up on purchase orders, production, deliveries, shipments, and supplier commitments. Coordinate local and international procurement, including import, shipment, and commercial documentation. Coordinate LC opening, amendments, and related documentation with suppliers and Finance/Banking teams. Follow up on LC terms, shipment schedules, shipping documents, and supplier commitments. Coordinate with Merchandising, Finance, Logistics, Stores, and other departments for smooth procurement and material flow. Verify supplier invoices, bills, and supporting documents and coordinate payment processing with Finance. Maintain supplier records, procurement data, LC status, order/shipment status, and related reports. Monitor supplier performance and coordinate resolution of delivery, quality, pricing, and commercial issues. Support cost-saving initiatives through negotiation, alternative sourcing, and supplier comparison. Coordinate with Stores and relevant departments to ensure timely availability of required materials. Support inventory planning by monitoring procurement status and material requirements. Ensure procurement and commercial activities comply with company policies, approved procedures, and applicable requirements. Maintain professional relationships with suppliers and support supplier development. Prepare regular procurement and commercial reports for management. Skills & Expertise Other Relevant Skills Supply Chain Management Purchase/ Procurement Export Import Through LC International Procurement Commercial Compensation & Other Benefits Festival Bonuses Competitive Salary Yearly Salary Review Employment Status Full Time Job Location Dhaka (Gulshan)
Applicants are encouraged to submit Video CV.

Marketing Support: Assist with vehicle promotions, advertising campaigns, and other sales and marketing activities. Documentation: Prepare quotations, sales orders, invoices, and other necessary documents. Customer Relationship Management: Build long-term relationships with customers and encourage repeat business and customer referrals. Sales Reporting: Prepare and submit daily, weekly, and monthly sales reports to management. After-Sales Service: Follow up with customers after purchases and assist in resolving complaints or service-related issues. Communication with Prospective Car Buyers: Maintain regular communication with potential car buyers, provide vehicle information according to their interests and requirements, and follow up effectively to close sales. Requirements Education Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA) in Accounting & Information System, Accounting, Cost & Management Accounting, Cost Accounting, Finance Experience At least 1 year The applicants should have experience in the following business area(s): Immigration and Education Consultancy Service Freshers are also encouraged to apply. Additional Requirements Age At least 22 years Only Male Interested candidates who meet the mandatory requirements are requested to email their updated CV and a cover letter to career@okimmigration.ca, explaining their knowledge of double-entry accounting, proficiency in Excel or Google Sheets, familiarity with AI tools such as ChatGPT, Gemini, or Claude, and relevant IT or accounting experience, as well as how their skills would help OK Immigration clear its accounting backlog, standardize financial records, and develop a customized accounting solution during the four-month internship. Responsibilities & Context Position Overview OK Immigration is seeking a motivated, detail-oriented Accounting & IT Intern (Accounting Systems Development) for a four-month, full-time internship at our Chattogram office. This hands-on role is designed for an accounting student or recent graduate who wants to apply theoretical knowledge in a real business environment while helping us clear our accounting backlog, standardize records, and build a customized accounting solution using suitable digital applications. Mandatory Requirements · Sound knowledge of double-entry bookkeeping, including debits, credits, journal entries, general ledgers, trial balances, and basic financial statements. · Practical skills in Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets, including formulas, financial calculations, and data organization. · Familiarity with AI tools such as ChatGPT, Google Gemini, and Claude, and the ability to use them thoughtfully for research, spreadsheet support, and workflow development. · A combination of accounting knowledge and relevant IT proficiency is essential. · Strong attention to detail, analytical ability, confidentiality, and willingness to learn and implement new processes. Additional Qualifications — Preferred · Currently studying or recently completed a degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related discipline. · Familiarity with QuickBooks, Xero, Tally, Zoho Books, or other accounting applications. · Experience with advanced spreadsheets, PivotTables, data validation, automation, cloud applications, or low-code/no-code tools. · Any practical experience in bookkeeping, account reconciliation, financial data entry, or reporting. Job Responsibilities Accounting & Backlog Clearance · Review and organize historical transactions and supporting documents to help clear pending bookkeeping work. · Post transactions using double-entry principles; maintain journals, ledgers, cashbooks, and basic accounting schedules. · Assist with reconciliation of bank transactions, receipts, expenses, payables, and receivables; flag discrepancies for review. Standardization & System Development · Help design a suitable chart of accounts and standardized templates for income, expenses, receivables, payables, and reporting. · Work with management to evaluate, configure, test, and document a customized accounting solution using relevant applications. · Help build accurate spreadsheet formulas, reports, checks, and practical procedures that the team can continue using. AI & Technology Support · Use ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, and other suitable tools to support research, spreadsheet development, documentation, and workflow improvements. · Check all AI-generated formulas, classifications, and outputs before use; protect confidential financial information. · Explore simple automation opportunities to reduce repetitive data entry and improve consistency. Reporting & Team Support · Prepare basic financial summaries and progress updates on backlog clearance and system development. · Organize electronic records and perform other related accounting and systems-support tasks assigned by management. Skills & Expertise Accounting Accounts and Finance Accounting Software Workplace Work at office Employment Status Full Time Gender Only males are allowed to apply. Job Location Chattogram (Chittagong GPO)

OK Immigration is seeking a motivated, detail-oriented Accounting & IT Intern (Accounting Systems Development) for a four-month, full-time internship at our Chattogram office. This hands-on role is designed for an accounting student or recent graduate who wants to apply theoretical knowledge in a real business environment while helping us clear our accounting backlog, standardize records, and build a customized accounting solution using suitable digital applications.
· Sound knowledge of double-entry bookkeeping, including debits, credits, journal entries, general ledgers, trial balances, and basic financial statements.
· Practical skills in Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets, including formulas, financial calculations, and data organization.
· Familiarity with AI tools such as ChatGPT, Google Gemini, and Claude, and the ability to use them thoughtfully for research, spreadsheet support, and workflow development.
· A combination of accounting knowledge and relevant IT proficiency is essential.
· Strong attention to detail, analytical ability, confidentiality, and willingness to learn and implement new processes.
· Currently studying or recently completed a degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related discipline.
· Familiarity with QuickBooks, Xero, Tally, Zoho Books, or other accounting applications.
· Experience with advanced spreadsheets, PivotTables, data validation, automation, cloud applications, or low-code/no-code tools.
· Any practical experience in bookkeeping, account reconciliation, financial data entry, or reporting.
· Review and organize historical transactions and supporting documents to help clear pending bookkeeping work.
· Post transactions using double-entry principles; maintain journals, ledgers, cashbooks, and basic accounting schedules.
· Assist with reconciliation of bank transactions, receipts, expenses, payables, and receivables; flag discrepancies for review.
· Help design a suitable chart of accounts and standardized templates for income, expenses, receivables, payables, and reporting.

· Check all AI-generated formulas, classifications, and outputs before use; protect confidential financial information.
· Explore simple automation opportunities to reduce repetitive data entry and improve consistency.
· Prepare basic financial summaries and progress updates on backlog clearance and system development.
· Organize electronic records and perform other related accounting and systems-support tasks assigned by management.

Requirements Education Graduate in any discipline. Experience At least 1 year Additional Requirements Only Female Only Females are allowed to apply. Minimum of 1 year of relevant experience in HR and accounts. Strong communication and interpersonal skills. Proficient in MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) and Tally Prime software . Detail-oriented with excellent organizational skills. A minimum commitment of 2 years is required. Responsibilities & Context A+ Consultancy & Mega Solutions is as specialized company for complete infrastructure safety solution in Bangladesh provides a versatile range of products and services include the design, consultancy, supply, engineering, installation and maintenance. We are looking for dynamic personal who are ready to lead the team, achieve growth and enhance our specialization. Job Location: Gulshan- Badda Link Road, Dhaka. Job Description: We are seeking a highly motivated and detail-oriented HR and Accounts Executive to join our team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for managing HR functions and assisting with basic accounting tasks. This position is a fantastic opportunity for an individual looking to grow their career in human resources and accounting. Key Responsibilities: Daily Cash Inflow check and entry to TALLY SOFTWARE (Specially in TALLY Prime) Maintain petty cash, ledger book, registers & Prepare to invoices, expense forms and payment request Monitor and follow-up on outstanding receivables. Closely monitor and operate all payments and expenditure Assist in preparing monthly. Quarterly and annual financial reports Ensure bill, voucher checking, verifying and proper recording as per guideline Handle accounts including invoice process Prepare & maintain mushak TDS and VDS treasury challan. Prepare documents for tax filing and audits. Communicate with vendors, clients and banks regarding financial matters To generate monthly sales accounts reports & submit to Higher Authority. Manage recruitment processes, including job postings, resume screening, interviewing, and onboarding of new employees. Maintain employee records and manage HR documentation. Assist in the development and implementation of HR policies and procedures. To check and verify all sorts of requisition, expenditure and other bills, Sales bill etc. Maintain organized records of transactions and supporting documents Archive financial data for future reference and audits Manage Daily accounting operations Any Other duties as assigned by the management from time to time Skills & Expertise Other Relevant Skills Accounts and Finance Financial Reporting Petty Cash Managementment Tally Prime Software Compensation & Other Benefits Sales incentive. Yearly Increment. TA/DA, Mobile Bill Yearly Two Festival Bonus. Employment Status Full Time Gender Only females are allowed to apply. Job Location Dhaka

Monitor market prices, competitor products, supplier performance, and identify opportunities for cost savings and business growth. jobs.bdjobs.com/jobdetails?id=1544874&fc.source_content: Requirements Education Diploma in Engineering Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA) Minimum Bachelor’s Degree from a recognized university. Additional Requirements Age 18 to 34 years Only Female Good communication skills in Bangla and English. Basic computer proficiency, including Microsoft Word, Excel, email, and online documentation systems. Strong organizational skills and attention to detail. Ability to communicate professionally with clients over phone calls and messages. Honest, punctual, responsible, and willing to learn. Previous experience in visa processing, travel agencies, or customer service will be an advantage. Fresh graduates with the right attitude are also encouraged to apply. Additional Requirements Must be proficient in Microsoft Word, Excel, email, and online application systems. Must have strong attention to detail when preparing and checking visa application documents. Must be capable of maintaining accurate passport entry and exit records. Responsibilities & Context Our mission: To make international travel more accessible through professional visa assistance and reliable client service. Our tagline: Crafting Your Global Journey. Key Responsibilities Prepare, organize, and verify visa application documents according to destination-specific requirements. Handle visa application forms, supporting documents, and submission procedures. Coordinate visa application submissions through the relevant embassies, visa application centres, and authorized channels. Keep clients updated regarding application progress, additional document requirements, and processing timelines. Track passports from entry into the office until submission, collection, and final delivery to clients. Maintain accurate passport entry and exit registers and update application tracking records. Communicate with clients over phone calls, WhatsApp, and other official communication channels. Coordinate with internal team members to ensure timely and accurate application processing. Maintain client confidentiality and handle passports and sensitive documents responsibly. Follow company procedures, embassy guidelines, and established service standards. Skills & Expertise MS Excel MS Office Other Relevant Skills Visa Processing Air Ticketing and Visa processing. visa file processing. Compensation & Other Benefits T/A,Tour allowance,Mobile bill Lunch Facilities: Full Subsidize Salary Review: Yearly Festival Bonus: 2 Competitive and negotiable salary based on qualifications and experience. Lunch bill provided by the company. Monthly phone bill allowance. Annual salary review. Other benefits according to company policy. Practical learning opportunities in international visa processing and travel consultancy. Opportunity to develop documentation, client management, communication, and professional coordination skills. Career growth opportunities based on performance and company requirements. Why Join Visa Crafters BD? At Visa Crafters BD, you will gain hands-on experience in international visa processing and travel services while working with a growing online travel agency. You will have the opportunity to develop valuable professional skills, learn destination-specific visa procedures, and build a career in the travel and tourism industry. Workplace Work at office Employment Status Full Time Gender Only females are allowed to apply. Job Location Dhaka (Banani)

Responsibilities & Context Dhaka Logistics Services & Solution is looking for smart, enthusiastic, and customer-focused individuals for the position of Customer Service Executive - Contact Centre . Selected candidates will work under Dhaka Logistics Services & Solution and will be deputed to Mutual Trust Bank PLC (MTBL) to provide quality customer support and handle inbound and outbound calls from customers regarding banking services. Requirements Education Bachelor/Honors Additional Requirements Required Skills Good communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills. Basic knowledge of Canva, photo editing, and video editing. Analyse advertising performance, including reach, impressions, clicks, CTR, cost per lead, and campaign results. Prepare performance reports and recommend improvements to increase campaign effectiveness. Communicate with prospective students and clients, manage enquiries, and follow up on leads. Conduct B2B outreach to universities, educational institutions, agencies, and potential business partners. Support partnership development, brand awareness, and marketing campaigns for study abroad and IELTS services. Skills & Expertise Advertising & Promotion Advertising Branding Digital Marketing (Social Media Marketing) Marketing Other Relevant Skills Social Media Management Content Creation Graphic Design Compensation & Other Benefits Salary: BDT 15,000-20,000 per month, depending on skills and experience. Requirements Education Higher Secondary Additional Requirements Only Female Responsibilities & Context Promote the company’s Europe visa and immigration services to potential clients. Generate new leads through online and offline marketing activities. Build and maintain strong relationships with prospective and existing clients. Respond to customer inquiries via phone calls, WhatsApp, email, and social media platforms. Explain visa requirements, processing procedures, and available services professionally. Schedule client appointments and follow up with potential customers regularly. Meet monthly sales and marketing targets set by the company. Develop and implement effective marketing strategies to increase brand awareness. Create and manage promotional campaigns on social media and other digital platforms. Coordinate with the processing team to ensure smooth client service. Maintain accurate records of client interactions and sales activities. Conduct market research to identify new business opportunities and competitors. Attend promotional events, seminars, and exhibitions when required. Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly marketing and sales reports. Maintain a high level of professionalism, honesty, and customer satisfaction at all times. Create promotional video advertisements and voice-over advertisements for the company’s services as required. Skills & Expertise Other Relevant Skills Client Relationship Digital Marketing (Social Media Marketing) Immigration Education Consultancy Service Lead Generation Market Research Sales & Marketing Compensation & Other Benefits T/A,Mobile bill,Performance bonus,Provident fund Salary Review: Half Yearly Festival Bonus: 3 Salary & Benefits Probation Period: 3 months. Salary Review: Salary will be reviewed based on performance after successful completion of the 3-month probation period. Performance Appraisal: Outstanding performers will be considered for salary increments and career growth opportunities. Per File Commission: Attractive commission will be provided for every successfully processed client file, as per the companys commission policy. Target Achievement Incentive: Employees who achieve or exceed their monthly sales targets will receive an attractive performance bonus/commission. Career Growth: Opportunity for promotion and additional incentives based on performance and contribution to the company. Training & Development: Professional training and continuous learning opportunities will be provided to enhance skills and career development. jobs.bdjobs.com/jobdetails?id=1545347&fc.source_content:
Requirements Education Bachelor/Honors Bachelor's Degree in Business Administration, Marketing, or a related discipline. Candidates with strong relevant experience and proven sales leadership ability may also be considered. Experience 2 to 3 years The applicants should have experience in the following business area(s): Healthcare/Lifestyle product, E-commerce, F-commerce Additional Requirements Age 25 to 32 years Experience Requirements 2–3 years of relevant experience in telesales, telemarketing, call center sales, or a similar sales role. Previous experience leading, supervising, or managing a telesales team will be an advantage. Additional Requirements Strong verbal communication, persuasion, negotiation, and customer-handling skills. Good leadership, interpersonal, team-coordination, and employee-motivation abilities. Proven ability to work toward sales targets and improve conversion rates. Familiarity with CRM systems, call monitoring, lead management, and sales reporting. Good analytical, reporting, and problem-solving skills; proficiency in Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets is an advantage. Strong sense of responsibility, discipline, time management, and ability to work under pressure. Responsibilities & Context Company Name: Buzzblu-Hedaaya Position: Telesales Leader / Telesales Manager Job Category: Sales & Marketing Job Level: Team Leader / Mid-Level Management Job Location: Shonir Akhra, Dhaka, Bangladesh Job Context: Buzzblu-Hedaaya is looking for dynamic, target-oriented, and experienced candidates to lead and supervise its telesales operations. The selected candidates will help achieve sales targets, guide telesales executives, improve conversion rates, maintain sales quality, and ensure effective execution of sales strategies and daily operations. Key Responsibilities Lead, supervise, motivate, and support telesales executives to achieve assigned sales targets. Develop and implement telesales strategies and support sales campaigns to achieve daily, monthly, and quarterly targets. Distribute leads, assign daily tasks, monitor call productivity, and ensure timely customer follow-up. Monitor individual and team performance, including call volume, conversions, sales, revenue, lead quality, and customer engagement. Coach team members to improve sales techniques, negotiation, objection handling, and customer communication. Review sales calls and ensure compliance with approved scripts, pricing, company policies, and professional standards. Maintain accurate CRM records, customer information, lead status, and sales activity updates. Monitor attendance, punctuality, discipline, and compliance with operational procedures. Identify underperforming employees, provide feedback, and implement improvement plans where necessary. Assist with recruitment, onboarding, training, and performance evaluation of telesales employees. Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly sales performance reports for management and recommend corrective actions. Coordinate with Marketing, HR, Finance, and other relevant departments to ensure smooth operations. Forecast sales performance, identify operational challenges, and recommend resource allocation or process improvements. Escalate customer complaints, policy violations, and operational issues to the appropriate authority. Maintain a positive, productive, accountable, and customer-focused team environment. Skills & Expertise Customer Support through Phone Manage workload and meet deadline Motivation skills Problem solving and decision making Team Leader (Sales) Team management Training & Development Working under pressure Other Relevant Skills Telesales sales strategy Lead management Customer Relationship Compensation & Other Benefits Performance bonus Salary: BDT 14,000-30,000 per month, depending on experience and qualifications Other Benefits: As per company policy Performance Incentives: As per company policy, where applicable Monthly salary: BDT 14,000-30,000, depending on experience, qualifications, and role suitability. Other benefits as per company policy. Performance-based incentives, where applicable, as per company policy. Employment Status Full Time Job Location Dhaka (Shonir Akhra)

jobs.bdjobs.com/jobdetails?id=1544743&fc.source_content:
Requirements Education Minimum Bachelors Degree or equivalent. Educational qualifications in Marketing, Media, Journalism, or a relevant discipline will be preferred. Experience 1 to 3 years The applicants should have experience in the following business area(s): Automobile, Motor Workshop Additional Requirements 1–3 years of experience in content creation, videography, or digital marketing will be preferred. Freshers with strong creative skills and relevant knowledge are encouraged to apply. Experience in the automobile industry or car sales business will be an added advantage. Strong interest in automobiles and willingness to learn about vehicle features and specifications. One Must be proficient in writing accurate and informative scripts covering various aspects of Auto Mobiles. One must be adept at speaking in Standard Bangali in a highly Engaging and appealing manner. Experience creating content for Facebook, YouTube, Instagram, and TikTok. Excellent Bangla communication and presentation skills. Creativity, punctuality, and the ability to work collaboratively as part of a team. Responsibilities & Context Job Context Sanzida Car Selection Ltd. is a reputed automobile sales company offering a wide range of reconditioned vehicles from various brands. To strengthen our digital marketing, branding, and vehicle sales activities, we are looking for a creative, talented, and enthusiastic Content Creator. The selected candidate will be responsible for producing engaging automotive videos and photographs, creating social media content, and attracting potential customers through various digital platforms. Job Responsibilities You need to show cars to customers visiting the showroom and sell cars to them. Create engaging video content highlighting vehicle features, packages, engine capacity, mileage, and specifications. Produce Reels, YouTube Shorts, and promotional videos for Facebook, YouTube, Instagram, and other social media platforms. Create car reviews, vehicle walkaround videos, feature highlights, and showroom promotional content. Prepare video scripts, captions, titles and descriptions for social media content. Develop SEO-friendly titles, descriptions, and content publishing plans for YouTube and Facebook. Create engaging content to attract potential car buyers and support sales activities. Monitor content performance and suggest creative ideas to improve audience engagement and reach. Coordinate with the Digital Marketing and Sales teams to support promotional campaigns. Create promotional content highlighting new vehicle arrivals, special offers, down payment facilities, car loan options, and sales campaigns. Maintain consistent brand identity while producing and publishing high-quality content regularly. Skills & Expertise Other Relevant Skills Video Content Creator Search Engine Optimization (SEO) promotional activities Digital Marketing (Social Media Marketing) Compensation & Other Benefits Mobile bill allowance. Other benefits as per company policy. Employment Status Full Time Job Location Dhaka (Tejgaon)
Applicants are encouraged to submit Video CV.

Responsibilities & Context Immediate Joining We are looking for an efficient IT support site engineer who has sound knowledge on installing & configuring both Electronic & Networking devices. Job Responsibilities: Regular maintenance of the IT systems used in the electronic toll collection(ETC). This includes troubleshooting and resolving any technical issues that arise in the toll collection systems, surveillance cameras, network connectivity, and other related technologies. Ensuring stable and secure network operations. This includes overseeing the installation and management of network devices, performing network upgrades, and ensuring reliable internet connectivity. Installing, updating, and managing the software used for toll collection, including ensuring that it integrates seamlessly with other systems like vehicle detection and classification systems. Providing technical support to staff at the toll plaza. This involves training employees on new systems, assisting them with technical difficulties, and ensuring they can effectively use the technology. Developing and implementing emergency plans for IT systems in case of system failures, power outages, or other emergencies that could impact operations. Should have experience in Maintaining and Troubleshooting core data center network, LAN, WAN devices & Firewall devices. Should have experience in installing and configuring CCTV Cameras Should have experience in Maintenance & repair of all types of electrical channels, lighting systems other electrical works which are needed to smooth operation. Safeguarding the data collected at the excel load control(WIM), which includes financial transactions and vehicle information. Implementing and managing data backup and recovery plans, and ensuring compliance with data protection regulations. Continuously seeking ways to improve the efficiency and effectiveness of the IT systems at the toll plaza. This may involve researching and implementing new technologies or processes. Skills & Expertise CCTV Installation Electrical Installation and Maintenance Installation and Maintenance IT system support and maintenance Operation & Maintenance Server Maintenance Software Business Analysis Software Installation Other Relevant Skills Information technology LAN/ WAN CCTV Installation Maintenance and Troubleshooting Compensation & Other Benefits Performance bonus,Tour allowance Salary Review: Yearly Festival Bonus: 2 Yearly salary increment. Fully subsidized lunch or accommodation. Outstanding working environment. On the Job Training and Development. Workplace Work at office Employment Status Full Time Gender Only males are allowed to apply. Job Location Anywhere in Bangladesh

Requirements Education Diploma in Computer in Computer Science & Engineering Additional Requirements Age 18 to 30 years Only Male Responsibilities & Context Job Title: Executive – Software Solutions Job Location: Dhaka (travel outside Dhaka may be required) Job Context Provide on-site software support to customers, assist with day-to-day software operations, and support bill collection and software sales activities. Job Responsibilities Visit customer premises to provide software support and resolve basic technical issues. Assist customers in using ERP, accounting, inventory, POS, and other business software. Install and configure software and provide user training as required. Collect monthly and annual software fees and follow up on outstanding payments. Assist customers with daily software operations and coordinate with the technical team to resolve complex issues. Support software sales activities and maintain accurate records of customer visits and payment collections. Educational Requirements Diploma in Computer Science and Engineering (CSE) from a recognized institution. A bachelor’s degree is not required for this position. Experience Requirements Freshers are encouraged to apply. Experience in software support or customer service will be an advantage. Additional Requirements Basic computer skills and proficiency in Microsoft Office. Good communication and customer service skills. Willingness to travel within and outside Dhaka for customer visits. Compensation & Other Benefits Mobile phone allowance. Reimbursement of transportation expenses for official field visits. Collection commission as per company policy. Sales commission as per company policy. Skills & Expertise Accounting Software ERP Software IT Support Service Software Implementation Workplace Work at office Employment Status Full Time Gender Only males are allowed to apply. Job Location Dhaka
