jobs.bdjobs.com/jobdetails?id=1545210&fc.source_content:
Requirements Education Bachelor/Honors Fresh graduates Additional Requirements Age 20 to 30 years Only Male Fresh graduates with excellent English communication and strong analytical abilities are encouraged to apply. Important Requirements Strong English proficiency is mandatory, including speaking, listening, reading, and writing. Candidates must be able to communicate ideas and explain their reasoning clearly in English. Excellent logical reasoning, critical thinking, and analytical skills are essential. Candidates must be comfortable working with detailed instructions and completing research-intensive tasks. Basic computer proficiency and familiarity with AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, or Gemini are preferred. Prior experience in AI training, data annotation, research, content evaluation, or quality assurance will be considered an advantage. Responsibilities & Context We are looking for highly motivated, analytical, and detail-oriented individuals to join our team as AI Research & Quality Analysts . The selected candidates will work on AI-related research, response evaluation, quality assurance, and problem-solving activities. This role requires excellent English communication skills, strong logical reasoning, critical thinking, and the ability to understand and evaluate complex information. Candidates from different educational backgrounds are welcome. Previous AI experience is not mandatory, but strong analytical abilities and a willingness to learn are essential. Key Responsibilities Evaluate AI-generated responses for accuracy, relevance, clarity, completeness, and logical consistency. Analyze complex questions and identify reasoning errors, factual inaccuracies, and inconsistencies. Compare multiple AI-generated responses and provide clear, evidence-based evaluations. Conduct online research, verify information, and assess the reliability of sources. Follow detailed English instructions, project guidelines, and quality standards. Develop and review prompts, questions, and evaluation criteria for AI systems. Provide clear written explanations and constructive feedback on AI-generated content. Apply logical reasoning, critical thinking, and problem-solving skills to challenging tasks. Identify potential issues, document findings, and recommend improvements. Maintain accuracy, consistency, and attention to detail while working on assigned projects. Participate in English-language meetings, assessments, training sessions, and project discussions. Learn and adapt to new AI platforms, tools, workflows, and project requirements. jobs.bdjobs.com/jobdetails?id=1545522&fc.source_content:
Requirements Education হিসাববিজ্ঞান, ফিন্যান্স বা সংশ্লিষ্ট বিষয়ে স্নাতক ডিগ্রি। Additional Requirements Experience Requirements: অ্যাকাউন্টস ও ফাইন্যান্স বিভাগে পূর্ব অভিজ্ঞতা থাকা বাধ্যতামূলক। ফার্নিচার ব্যবসা, শোরুম বা ট্রেডিং প্রতিষ্ঠানে হিসাব পরিচালনার অভিজ্ঞতাসম্পন্ন প্রার্থীদের অগ্রাধিকার দেওয়া হবে। Additional Requirements: MS Excel এবং হিসাবরক্ষণ সফটওয়্যারে দক্ষতা। আর্থিক হিসাব ও প্রতিবেদন তৈরিতে দক্ষতা। সততা, দায়িত্বশীলতা ও নির্ভুলভাবে কাজ করার সক্ষমতা। Responsibilities & Context Job Responsibilities: প্রতিষ্ঠানের দৈনিক হিসাব-নিকাশ ও আর্থিক লেনদেন পরিচালনা করা। বিক্রয়, ক্রয়, ক্যাশ, ব্যাংক লেনদেন ও খরচের হিসাব সংরক্ষণ করা। দৈনিক, মাসিক ও বার্ষিক আর্থিক প্রতিবেদন প্রস্তুত করা। ইনভয়েস, বিল, ভাউচার এবং অন্যান্য আর্থিক নথিপত্র যাচাই ও সংরক্ষণ করা। পাওনা ও দেনা হিসাব পর্যবেক্ষণ এবং সময়মতো হিসাব সমন্বয় করা। প্রতিষ্ঠানের আর্থিক নীতিমালা ও হিসাবরক্ষণ পদ্ধতি অনুসরণ নিশ্চিত করা। প্রয়োজন অনুযায়ী ম্যানেজমেন্টকে আর্থিক প্রতিবেদন ও হিসাবসংক্রান্ত তথ্য প্রদান করা। Skills & Expertise Other Relevant Skills Accounting Software Financial Reporting MS Excel Employment Status Full Time Job Location Dhaka

এই চাকরির জন্য বিজ্ঞাপনদাতা ব্যাক্তি/প্রতিষ্ঠান আপনার কাছ থেকে কোন অর্থ চাইলে কিংবা নিয়োগ প্রক্রিয়া চলাকালীন কোন প্রকার হয়রানিমূলক (শারীরিক/মানসিক) আচরণ করলে অতিসত্ত্বর আমাদেরকে জানান অথবা জবটি রিপোর্ট করুন। চাকরি পাওয়ার জন্য কোন ব্যাক্তি/প্রতিষ্ঠানকে অর্থ প্রদান করবেন না। চাকরিকালীন কোন প্রকার হয়রানির (শারীরিক/মানসিক) সম্ভাবনা থাকলে সেখানে জয়েন করবেন না। কোন প্রকার অর্থ লেনদেন বা নিয়োগদাতা কর্তৃক হয়রানির দায়িত্ব বিডিজবস বহন করবে না।

Requirements Education Bachelor/Honors Experience At least 2 years The applicants should have experience in the following business area(s): Advertising Agency, Agro based firms (incl. Agro Processing/Seed/GM), Tea Garden Freshers are also encouraged to apply. Additional Requirements Age 24 to 35 years Only Male All official report must be prepared in English. Responsibilities & Context Arkay Multimedia Limited invites applications from energetic and pro-active individuals for the position of Supervisor - Outdoor Beautification and Development Coordinator Work. · Plan, develop and care for all our beautification and landscaping projects. · Ensuring that the day-to-day activities of the gardeners are being carried out as per schedule, routine and plan and work is carried out efficiently · Recruiting quality Gardeners and training them · Monitoring that each gardener is performing their daily routine job · Monitoring efficiency level of each Gardener. · Distributing daily work of gardeners so that optimum efficiency of work is achieved · Ensuring regular maintenance of our sites and replacing dead or missing plants with new plants. · Ensuring that Gardeners are wearing their uniform and raincoats when required and keeping track of their uniforms. · Setting up quality standards and ensuring we are up to the standard required. · Ensure regular watering is done. Creating and maintaining a weekly watering schedule. · Arranging watering trucks to ensure smooth watering of our project sites. · Ensuring regular hedge cutting is done and creating a routine and plan for hedge cutting. · Ensuring that height and dimensions of hedge are being followed as per company guidelines. · Ensuring grass cutting is done and creating a routine and plan for grass cutting. · Any equipment not functioning must be immediately repaired or replaced. · Must have inventory of all gardening equipment and must ensure that they are stored safely at the end of the day’s work. · In case of absence of staff, must recruit daily labor to ensure that the work is carried out smoothly. · Must have a passion for plants and greenery. · Must have leadership and commanding Skills. · Must know how to get the job done effectively and efficiently within the shortest time possible · Must be able to assess the present quality of our landscaping sites and methods to improve it. · Must ensure regular removal of unwanted plants, shrubs and weeds. · Must ensure regular booming and removal of dirt or debris or unwanted materials from our landscaping projects. · Must ensure that gardening tools including watering tanks, pipes, nozzles, rickshaw vans are repaired regularly and all items are useable. · Must keep track of daily gardeners attendance. · Must keep track of their in time to work and their out time. · Must have time management skills to ensure the gardeners are working effectively & efficiently. · Must be able to work at site for long hours under hard conditions such as rain or direct sun. · Must be able to work at night if and when required. · Must ensure that all gardening equipment’s are available to the gardeners. · Must visit sites daily to provide example to team members on how to work efficiently. · Work in field and come to head office for daily meetings. · Assist in preparation of work schedule and job assignment. · Budget and sourcing plants for replacement of damaged plants. · Regularly replace all damaged plants. · Ensuring that the condition of grounds and gardens meet the standards and quality of our designs. · Make sure that the health of landscape is at its best condition. Consult with horticulturist if there is bacterial attack on plants. Skills & Expertise Gardener Compensation & Other Benefits T/A Salary Review: Yearly Festival Bonus: 2 Workplace Work at office Employment Status Full Time Gender Only males are allowed to apply. Job Location Dhaka
Applicants are encouraged to submit Video CV.

Responsibilities & Context
Arkay Multimedia Limited invites applications from energetic and pro-active individuals for the position of Supervisor - Outdoor Beautification and Development Coordinator Work.
· Plan, develop and care for all our beautification and landscaping projects.
· Ensuring that the day-to-day activities of the gardeners are being carried out as per schedule, routine and plan and work is carried out efficiently
· Recruiting quality Gardeners and training them
· Monitoring that each gardener is performing their daily routine job
· Monitoring efficiency level of each Gardener.
· Distributing daily work of gardeners so that optimum efficiency of work is achieved
· Ensuring regular maintenance of our sites and replacing dead or missing plants with new plants.
· Ensuring that Gardeners are wearing their uniform and raincoats when required and keeping track of their uniforms.
· Setting up quality standards and ensuring we are up to the standard required.
· Ensure regular watering is done. Creating and maintaining a weekly watering schedule.
· Arranging watering trucks to ensure smooth watering of our project sites.
· Ensuring regular hedge cutting is done and creating a routine and plan for hedge cutting.
· Ensuring that height and dimensions of hedge are being followed as per company guidelines.
· Ensuring grass cutting is done and creating a routine and plan for grass cutting.
· Any equipment not functioning must be immediately repaired or replaced.
· Must have inventory of all gardening equipment and must ensure that they are stored safely at the end of the day’s work.
· In case of absence of staff, must recruit daily labor to ensure that the work is carried out smoothly.
· Must have a passion for plants and greenery.
· Must have leadership and commanding Skills.
· Must know how to get the job done effectively and efficiently within the shortest time possible
· Must be able to assess the present quality of our landscaping sites and methods to improve it.
· Must ensure regular removal of unwanted plants, shrubs and weeds.
· Must ensure regular booming and removal of dirt or debris or unwanted materials from our landscaping projects.
· Must ensure that gardening tools including watering tanks, pipes, nozzles, rickshaw vans are repaired regularly and all items are useable.
· Must keep track of daily gardeners attendance.
· Must keep track of their in time to work and their out time.
· Must have time management skills to ensure the gardeners are working effectively & efficiently.
· Must be able to work at site for long hours under hard conditions such as rain or direct sun.
· Must be able to work at night if and when required.
· Must ensure that all gardening equipment’s are available to the gardeners.
· Must visit sites daily to provide example to team members on how to work efficiently.
· Work in field and come to head office for daily meetings.
· Assist in preparation of work schedule and job assignment.
· Budget and sourcing plants for replacement of damaged plants.
· Regularly replace all damaged plants.
· Ensuring that the condition of grounds and gardens meet the standards and quality of our designs.
· Make sure that the health of landscape is at its best condition. Consult with horticulturist if there is bacterial attack on plants.
Compensation & Other Benefits
Workplace
Work at office
Employment Status
Full Time
Gender
Only males are allowed to apply.
Job Location
Dhaka
Address:
House 42, Park Road, Baridhara Diplomatic Zone

raw_source_fields.education: Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA) in Accounting Master of Business Administration (MBA) in Accounting, Finance যেকোনো স্বীকৃত বিশ্ববিদ্যালয় থেকে হিসাববিজ্ঞানে বিসিএ (BBA in Accounting) বা এমবিএ (MBA in Accounting/Finance)। CIMA / CA Knowledge Level সম্পন্ন প্রার্থীদের অগ্রাধিকার দেওয়া হবে।

Requirements Education Bachelor/Honors Masters Experience At least 3 years The applicants should have experience in the following business area(s): Advertising Technology (AdTech) Startup, BPO/ Data Entry Firm, Business-to-Business (B2B) Software and Services Startup, Consulting Firms, Direct Selling/Marketing Service Company, Event Management, Immigration and Education Consultancy Service, Market Research Firms Additional Requirements Age 20 to 40 years Responsibilities & Context About PlayD8 Ltd PlayD8 Ltd is a UK-based company providing smart offshore staffing solutions to businesses across various industries. We are looking for a results-driven Digital Marketing Manager to lead our digital marketing initiatives, develop effective growth strategies, and drive measurable business results. The ideal candidate must have strong hands-on experience in paid advertising, performance marketing, lead generation, conversion optimisation, and digital growth strategy. The candidate must be well versed with Meta & Google advertisement policies. This role requires a commercially minded professional who can manage advertising campaigns, analyse performance data, optimise marketing budgets, and identify opportunities to increase customer acquisition and business growth. Key Responsibilities Digital Growth Strategy: Develop and implement data-driven digital marketing strategies aligned with business objectives, lead generation targets, and revenue growth. Requirements Education Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA) Experience At least 1 year The applicants should have experience in the following business area(s): Immigration and Education Consultancy Service, University, School, College, Multinational Companies Additional Requirements Age 25 to 30 years Only Male English Proficiency: Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English; must be confident in corporate presentations and public speaking. Mobility & Flexibility: Comfortable with frequent local travel, field visits, outdoor activations, and flexible work schedules around events and seminars. Personality: High energy, strongly extroverted, approachable, and proactive with natural relationship-building skills. Meeting & Negotiation Skills: Confident in conducting high-level B2B and institutional meetings with school principals, headmasters, and administrative authorities. Experience in Student Counseling or the Education Management/Overseas Study Industry is highly encouraged. Responsibilities & Context Position Overview PFEC Global , a multinational education consultancy with 20 years of experience and operations across Australia, India, Sri Lanka, Bangladesh, and Indonesia, is seeking an energetic, outgoing, and results-driven Business Development Executive for its Chattogram team. The role focuses on building and maintaining strategic partnerships with schools, colleges, universities, and English-medium coaching centres to strengthen PFEC Global’s brand presence and generate student leads for overseas education. The selected candidate will also contribute to business development initiatives for Enhance English , a sister concern of PFEC Global. Key Responsibilities Institutional Networking & Relationship Management Conduct frequent field visits and direct outreach to schools, colleges, universities, O/A Level coaching centers, and English medium institutions across Chattogram. Build strong rapport and long-term partnerships with school administrators, counselors, faculty members, and student clubs. Position PFEC Global as the first choice for students seeking abroad education consulting and guidance. Events, Activations & Representation Represent PFEC Global at education expos, university seminars, school/college career fairs, and outdoor promotional activations. Coordinate, organize, and execute campus-level seminars, workshops, and student engagement activities. Lead corporate and institutional business meetings with confidence and professionalism. Business Development Support for Enhance English Cross-promote Enhance English services (IELTS, English language training, and skill development programs) during institutional visits and events. Identify potential collaboration opportunities for Enhance English with coaching centers and academic institutions. Lead Generation & Pipeline Growth Identify, engage, and capture prospective student leads interested in studying abroad. Collaborate closely with the internal student counseling team to ensure smooth handover and conversion of generated leads. Skills & Expertise Communication and interpersonal skill Business Development Relationship Management Knowledge of Educational Programs Workplace Work at office Employment Status Full Time Gender Only males are allowed to apply. Job Location Chattogram
Applicants are encouraged to submit Video CV.

jobs.bdjobs.com/jobdetails?id=1546562&fc.source_content:
Requirements Education Bachelor of Science (BSc) in Applied Statistics and Data Science, Economics, Mass Communication & Journalism Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA) Experience At least 1 year The applicants should have experience in the following business area(s): Manufacturing (FMCG), Group of Companies, Automobile Freshers are also encouraged to apply. Additional Requirements Age At least 25 years 1–2 years of relevant experience in market research, EdTech, digital content, sales or business development. Practical familiarity with AI tools and modern digital applications. Strong research, analytical, writing and communication skills. Experience with online learning platforms, content production or digital marketing will be an advantage. Responsibilities & Context Market Research & Content Development (70%) Conduct market and competitor research to identify customer needs, emerging trends in the Bangladesh economy and potential business opportunities. Analyze industry trends, skill requirements and market insights to support the development of relevant digital learning products. Use modern AI tools to support research, content creation and digital learning product development. Develop, review and refine learning content to ensure accuracy, quality, clarity and a natural, engaging tone. Support the preparation of course materials, scripts, presentations and other digital learning assets. Maintain research databases, content documentation and project progress reports. Business Development & User Acquisition (30%) Support product launches, marketing initiatives and user acquisition activities. Requirements Education Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA) in Human Resource Management Experience At least 3 years The applicants should have experience in the following business area(s): Group of Companies, Retail Store Additional Requirements Age At least 28 years Experience in Retail Fashion Industry will be an advantage. Excellent communication & Interpersonal Skill. People oriented and results driven. Self-driven to work under pressure and self-motivated to take new initiatives. Ability to work independently with minimal supervision. Responsibilities & Context Outlet: Conduct need analysis to identify skill gaps and future learning needs for Outlet staff. Designing, developing, and delivering training programs as per business needs. Stay abreast of the latest trends in learning and development and incorporate best practices into programs. Delivering new Joiner Induction Training. Package Employee Training Module prepare, co-ordinate, prepare training plan and delivering as per management decision. Training budget prepare and settle after training. Monthly Training Report prepare and share with management. Management: Conduct needs analysis to identify skill gaps and future learning needs for management staff. Assist to Develop engaging and effective learning programs, both in-person and online. Implement a variety of learning methods (e.g., coaching, mentoring, e-learning, workshops) to address diverse learning needs. Coordinate with external training providers and manage training logistics. Align training programs with career development and succession planning. Maintain all training documentation & share the report with stakeholder for further plan & Improvement. Develop Employee Profile time to time for review & assist for PMS documentation. Introduce Career development program of outlet staffs. SOP and policy development for smooth operation process. (If needed) People Engagement: Support the implementation of employee engagement activities and programs. Assist in organizing team-building activities, company events, and employee recognition programs. Collect and analyze employee feedback to improve engagement initiatives. Conduct periodical HR related survey, compile, share with team and stakeholder and take corrective action plan. Work on welfare & wellness activities to entire Sailor. Recruitment & Selection : Participate in the recruitment process, including job posting, screening, and onboarding process for new employees both Outlet and Management. Onboard Recruitment Source or recruitment platform for best people selection both outlet & Management. New initiative for developing outlet people recruitment process. Assist in developing job descriptions and specifications. Support the maintenance of a talent pipeline for future hiring needs. Assist in competency framework & KPI based JD preparation. Documentation & Reporting: Maintain accurate and up-to-date HR records and documentation. Assist & prepare regular HR reports like headcount, recruitment status, training completion, and performance metrics etc. Ensure compliance with all HR policies and legal regulations. jobs.bdjobs.com/jobdetails?id=1546813&fc.source_content:
Requirements Education Master of Development Studies (MDS) Experience At least 2 years The applicants should have experience in the following business area(s): NGO Additional Requirements Preferred Experience, Knowledge and/or other Qualifications: Two years’ prior professional experience in international development or a related field. Two years’ prior experience in business development, including bid capture, live bid management, and proposal development and/or project implementation for USAID, DFID, DFAT, EU and/or other major donors, preferably within a World Vision context. Experience in implementing development programmes in one or more of WVB’s core sectors (health, livelihoods and education). Excellent interpersonal skills and high emotional intelligence (EQ). Skills in monitoring and the development of logframes. A sense of humour and the ability to thrive in fast-paced, stressful situations. Competence in using MS Word, MS Excel and PowerPoint. Understanding of USAID, DFID, DFAT and EU policies, priorities and proposal processes. Broad understanding of principled humanitarian action, emergency relief and resilience objectives, and sectors such as shelter and settlements, WASH, food security and livelihoods, humanitarian protection, and health and nutrition. Proven capacity-building, facilitation and training skills. Strong decision-making and conflict-resolution skills. Experience working in a cross-cultural environment, preferably within a South Asian context. Responsibilities & Context Job Purpose The purpose of this position is to work collaboratively with all departments to advance the acquisition of grant revenue by: developing and managing opportunity capture plans; developing bid action plans and managing live bids; coordinating go/no-go assessments; coordinating after-action reviews following submission to improve the bidding process and ability to compete generally; leading teaming strategies and processes (for both prime and sub opportunities) in close collaboration with Programme Development and Quality Assurance (PDQA), Support offices (SOs), South Asia Pacific office (SAPO) and other World Vision (WV) partners; ensuring the production of best-in-class capability statements, and updating the same on a quarterly basis; assisting in the identification of grant funding opportunities; writing key sections of proposals as necessary, including management, executive summary and other non-technical sections; developing and managing compliance matrices for all submissions; leading preparation for bi-weekly Resource Development Unit meetings with the National Director (ND) and Department Leads; and undertaking other responsibilities as required. Key Deliverables: Prepare and manage capture activities for all opportunities. Support resource acquisition and the implementation of Capture Plans, development of Bid Implementation Plans, and execution of live bids. Lead all live bids, ensuring seamless collaboration with SOs and NO partners (PDQA, Finance, People & Culture, etc.). Lead partnering for all opportunities, in close collaboration with PDQA, Finance and SOs. Knowledge management, including but not limited to: preparation and updating of capability statements; critical review of pipeline data accuracy. Key Responsibilities: Capture Oversee direct reports in the development and implementation of capture plans, bid action plans, and the execution of live bids. Prepare capture plans for all opportunities in excess of USD 5,000,000. Ensure capture plans are reviewed and endorsed by all internal partners and SOs. Manage capture plans and update them on a weekly basis for presentation at the weekly BD meeting. Resolve any complications or delays experienced during the capture process. Report on the progress of capture plans at all bi-weekly BD meetings with the ND, SDO, and other Department Leads. Bid Management Lead Go/No-Go process, launched within 24 hours of solicitation drop date, working alongside where appropriate with Business Development Managers. Develop Bid Action Plans (BAPs) for all live opportunities. Manage BAPs to ensure seamless collaboration among SOs, the NO, partners, and external bid partners (subs and primes). Develop and manage bid compliance matrices in close collaboration with SOs and all relevant internal partners. Conduct after-action reviews of all bids within 24 hours of submission. Ensure consistent support to Response and Humanitarian and Emergency Affairs (HEA) teams, providing surge support whenever needed. Knowledge Management Lead the production and dissemination of best-in-class capability statements for all technical areas, as well as one-page overviews, contributing as first author wherever necessary and appropriate. Work closely with the Communications Department to ensure full compliance with branding requirements. Custom build cape statements for specific opportunities, donors, visitors etc. as required. Review pipeline (opportunity) data to assure accuracy in advance of bi-weekly Business Development meetings. Coordinate closely with BD Analysts to ensure the status of bids (won, lost or pending) is communicated in real time. Professional & Personal Development Demonstrate an increasing understanding of and commitment to World Vision’s Core Values in the approach to work and relationships. Complete performance reviews and achieve personal development goals. Participate in training related to grant acquisition, as feasible and appropriate. Gain experience in giving and receiving feedback using the SBI model or other appropriate tools, and practise this regularly with all colleagues. Compensation & Other Benefits Provident fund,Medical allowance,Mobile bill,Weekly 2 holidays,Gratuity,Insurance Festival Bonus: 1 As per organisational policy. Workplace Work at office Employment Status Full Time Job Location Dhaka

Requirements Additional Requirements Only Male Responsibilities & Context A reputed group of companies is looking for a competent, proactive, and experienced Senior Executive/ Assistant Manager – HR & Admin to manage day-to-day HR and administrative operations. The ideal candidate should have substantial hands-on experience in core HR functions, employee management, office administration, and labour law compliance. The candidate must be capable of working independently, ensuring smooth operations, and effectively implementing company policies and procedures. Key Responsibilities Manage recruitment, selection, onboarding, separation, confirmation, transfer, promotion, resignation, and HR documentation. Maintain employee records, personal files, HR databases, attendance, and leave records. Coordinate payroll inputs, performance appraisals, training, and employee development. Implement HR policies, service rules, and disciplinary procedures; resolve employee grievances and ensure labour law compliance. Oversee office administration, maintenance, housekeeping, security, and facility management. Manage office supplies, assets, vehicles, logistics, and administrative expenses. Supervise support staff and coordinate with vendors, service providers, and relevant authorities. Arrange meetings, official events, and travel; maintain administrative records and ensure workplace safety, discipline, and cleanliness. Prepare HR & Admin reports and perform other duties assigned by management. Minimum 5 years of hands-on experience in HR & general Administration. Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel, Word, and PowerPoint. Candidates holding professional certifications in HRM, Bangladesh Labour Law, Payroll Management, or relevant HR & Administration fields will be given preference. Strong organizational, coordination, and multitasking abilities. Ability to identify solutions, work independently, meet deadlines, and manage multiple responsibilities effectively. Important Note: Candidates must have substantial, hands-on experience across core HR and Administrative functions. Applicants with only academic qualifications or limited exposure without practical, in-depth HR & Admin experience are strongly discouraged from applying. Requirements Education Applicants must have a relevant degree in one of the following disciplines: BBA/MBA in Finance, Accounting or a relevant discipline. Experience 2 to 3 years The applicants should have experience in the following business area(s): NGO, Trading or Export/Import Additional Requirements Age 25 to 32 years 2–3 years of progressive professional experience in financial modeling, credit portfolio analytics, risk analytics or fintech corporate finance. Experience in one or more of the following sectors will be preferred: o	Fintech and digital financial services o	Digital lending and consumer finance o	Banking and non-bank financial institutions o	Credit rating agencies o	Other technology-driven or credit-based businesses Candidates with hands-on experience in loan-level data analysis, portfolio performance monitoring, financial forecasting, and management reporting will receive preference. Required Skills & Competencies Credit Portfolio Analytics: Default curves, vintage/cohort analysis, roll rates, delinquency monitoring, and loss forecasting. Financial Planning & Analysis: Budgeting, forecasting, variance analysis, unit economics, and cash flow modeling. Financial Modeling: Revenue projections, profitability analysis, scenario planning, and sensitivity analysis. Data Analytics: Advanced Microsoft Excel, Power BI, and financial dashboard development. Risk & Underwriting: Credit policy evaluation, portfolio risk assessment, and repayment performance analysis. Management Reporting: Preparation of executive-level financial reports and strategic recommendations. Communication & Leadership: Strong analytical thinking, stakeholder management, presentation, and team leadership skills. Responsibilities & Context Job Location: House 67, Block – KA, Pici-culture Housing Society, Shyamoli, Dhaka - 1207 About Ambala Fintech Limited Ambala Fintech Limited is a technology-driven financial services company focused on delivering innovative, accessible, and sustainable financial solutions through digital platforms. By combining technology, financial expertise, and operational excellence, the company aims to expand financial inclusion, strengthen digital financial services, and create long-term value for customers and business partners across Bangladesh. Role Overview Ambala Fintech Limited is looking for a highly analytical and strategically minded Credit Analyst to lead financial planning, portfolio performance analysis, financial modeling, and strategic decision support. This is a strategic finance role that goes beyond traditional accounting and bookkeeping. The successful candidate will translate financial and operational data into actionable insights to support business growth, credit risk management, pricing decisions, capital allocation, and profitability. The role will work closely with management, business operations, and credit/risk teams to strengthen financial performance, improve portfolio quality, and support sustainable business expansion. Key Responsibilities Credit Portfolio & Financial Analytics Develop and maintain default curves and credit loss forecasts. Monitor delinquency, default rates, recoveries, write-offs, and portfolio profitability. Analyze loan-level and customer-level data to identify portfolio risks, performance trends, and opportunities for improvement. Recommend data-driven strategies to improve portfolio quality, collection efficiency, and risk-adjusted returns. Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A) Lead annual budgeting, roll forecasts, financial planning, and variance analysis. Develop and maintain integrated financial models covering revenue, operating costs, unit economics, cash flow, and profitability. Prepare financial projections and scenario analyses to support business planning and management decisions. Evaluate the financial feasibility of new products, business channels, strategic partnerships, and market expansion initiatives. Credit Risk & Underwriting Support Collaborate with credit and operations teams to assess and improve underwriting policies, credit limits, and customer eligibility criteria. Conduct sensitivity and scenario analyses to evaluate the financial impact of credit policy changes. Monitor portfolio performance against approved risk policies and recommend corrective actions. Assess the relationship between customer acquisition, repayment behavior, default risk, and overall profitability. Capital Planning & Management Reporting Forecast capital requirements based on business growth, financing needs, and portfolio origination plans. Prepare financial and portfolio performance reports for senior management, the Board of Directors, lenders, and investors. Support fundraising initiatives, financing arrangements, financial due diligence, and covenant monitoring where applicable. Develop dashboards and reporting frameworks to improve financial transparency and decision-making. Skills & Expertise Other Relevant Skills Financial Reporting Capital Management Risk Management Underwriting (Insurance) Cash Management Compensation & Other Benefits Salary Range: 30000 - 35000 BDT per Month Festival Bonus: 02 Weekly Holidays: Friday An opportunity to contribute to the strategic growth of a technology-driven financial services business. Direct involvement in financial strategy, portfolio performance, and business decision-making. A collaborative and performance-oriented working environment. Competitive compensation and benefits based on qualifications and experience. Professional development and career growth opportunities. Employment Status Full Time Job Location Dhaka (Shyamoli)
Applicants are encouraged to submit Video CV.

2–3 years of progressive professional experience in financial modeling, credit portfolio analytics, risk analytics or fintech corporate finance.
Experience in one or more of the following sectors will be preferred:
o Fintech and digital financial services
o Digital lending and consumer finance
o Banking and non-bank financial institutions
o Credit rating agencies
o Other technology-driven or credit-based businesses
Candidates with hands-on experience in loan-level data analysis, portfolio performance monitoring, financial forecasting, and management reporting will receive preference.
Required Skills & Competencies
Credit Portfolio Analytics: Default curves, vintage/cohort analysis, roll rates, delinquency monitoring, and loss forecasting.
Financial Planning & Analysis: Budgeting, forecasting, variance analysis, unit economics, and cash flow modeling.
Financial Modeling: Revenue projections, profitability analysis, scenario planning, and sensitivity analysis.
Data Analytics: Advanced Microsoft Excel, Power BI, and financial dashboard development.
Risk & Underwriting: Credit policy evaluation, portfolio risk assessment, and repayment performance analysis.
Management Reporting: Preparation of executive-level financial reports and strategic recommendations.
Communication & Leadership: Strong analytical thinking, stakeholder management, presentation, and team leadership skills.
Responsibilities & Context
Job Location: House 67, Block – KA, Pici-culture Housing Society, Shyamoli, Dhaka - 1207
About Ambala Fintech Limited
Ambala Fintech Limited is a technology-driven financial services company focused on delivering innovative, accessible, and sustainable financial solutions through digital platforms. By combining technology, financial expertise, and operational excellence, the company aims to expand financial inclusion, strengthen digital financial services, and create long-term value for customers and business partners across Bangladesh.
Role Overview
Ambala Fintech Limited is looking for a highly analytical and strategically minded Credit Analyst to lead financial planning, portfolio performance analysis, financial modeling, and strategic decision support.
This is a strategic finance role that goes beyond traditional accounting and bookkeeping. The successful candidate will translate financial and operational data into actionable insights to support business growth, credit risk management, pricing decisions, capital allocation, and profitability.
The role will work closely with management, business operations, and credit/risk teams to strengthen financial performance, improve portfolio quality, and support sustainable business expansion.
Key Responsibilities
Credit Portfolio & Financial Analytics
Develop and maintain default curves and credit loss forecasts.
Monitor delinquency, default rates, recoveries, write-offs, and portfolio profitability.
Analyze loan-level and customer-level data to identify portfolio risks, performance trends, and opportunities for improvement.
Recommend data-driven strategies to improve portfolio quality, collection efficiency, and risk-adjusted returns.
Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A)
Lead annual budgeting, roll forecasts, financial planning, and variance analysis.
Develop and maintain integrated financial models covering revenue, operating costs, unit economics, cash flow, and profitability.
Prepare financial projections and scenario analyses to support business planning and management decisions.
Evaluate the financial feasibility of new products, business channels, strategic partnerships, and market expansion initiatives.
Credit Risk & Underwriting Support
Collaborate with credit and operations teams to assess and improve underwriting policies, credit limits, and customer eligibility criteria.
Conduct sensitivity and scenario analyses to evaluate the financial impact of credit policy changes.
Monitor portfolio performance against approved risk policies and recommend corrective actions.
Assess the relationship between customer acquisition, repayment behavior, default risk, and overall profitability.
Capital Planning & Management Reporting
Forecast capital requirements based on business growth, financing needs, and portfolio origination plans.
Prepare financial and portfolio performance reports for senior management, the Board of Directors, lenders, and investors.
Support fundraising initiatives, financing arrangements, financial due diligence, and covenant monitoring where applicable.
Develop dashboards and reporting frameworks to improve financial transparency and decision-making.
Other Relevant Skills
Compensation & Other Benefits
Salary Range: 30000 - 35000 BDT per Month
Festival Bonus: 02
Weekly Holidays: Friday
An opportunity to contribute to the strategic growth of a technology-driven financial services business.
Direct involvement in financial strategy, portfolio performance, and business decision-making.
A collaborative and performance-oriented working environment.
Competitive compensation and benefits based on qualifications and experience.
Professional development and career growth opportunities.
Employment Status
Full Time
Job Location
Dhaka (Shyamoli)
Read Before Apply
Interested and qualified candidates are requested to submit their updated CV along with a cover letter highlighting relevant experience in financial planning, portfolio analytics, and financial modeling.
Note: Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted for further assessment.

raw_source_fields.deadline: s. Highly honesty, integrity, accountability and willingness to learn. Responsibilities & Context Job Context: Rizvi Fashions Ltd., a reputed garments manufacturing company, is looking an energetic, motivated detail-oriented and career-focused candidates to join its Finance & Accounts Department as Management Trainee Officers (MTO). The Selected candidates will receive practical exposure to accounting operations, finance reporting, cost control, VAR & TAX compliance, and other financial activities within the RMG industry. Key Responsibilities: Assist in maintaining daily accounting record, vouchers, cash book, bank books, and general ledgers. Support accounts payable, accounts receivable, and payment processing activities. Prepare bank reconciliation statements and assist in monitoring cash flow. Assist in preparing monthly financial reports, trial balances, and financial statements. Support budget preparation, cost analysis, and expense monitoring. Assist in VAT, Tax, and other statutory compliance activities. Assist in maintaining proper documentation for internal and external audits. Ensure accuracy and confidentiality of financial records. Perform other responsibilities assigned by the supervisor or management.

Assist in preparing monthly financial reports, trial balances, and financial statements. Support budget preparation, cost analysis, and expense monitoring. jobs.bdjobs.com/jobdetails?id=1546932&fc.source_content:
Requirements Education A bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Digital Marketing, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field is preferred. Relevant professional certifications in performance marketing, digital advertising, marketing analytics, AI content production, or marketing automation will be an advantage. Formal academic qualifications are secondary to demonstrable hands-on expertise, a strong portfolio, and verifiable business results. Candidates with exceptional practical skills and proven experience may be considered regardless of their academic background. Experience At most 1 year The applicants should have experience in the following business area(s): Manufacturing (Light Engineering and Heavy Industry) Additional Requirements Minimum 0-1 years of hardcore hands-on experience in performance marketing, social media scaling, and funnel building (experience in Healthcare, Medical Devices, Pharmaceuticals, or B2B Tech is a massive advantage). No "Boost Post" Marketers: If your idea of Facebook marketing is clicking the "Boost" button from the page, do not apply. You must live and breathe Meta Ads Manager, Custom Audiences, Pixel/CAPI tracking, and A/B testing. AI-Native Workflow: Must have advanced proficiency in leveraging AI tools (Midjourney, Claude, Gemini, Runway/Kling, ElevenLabs) to produce ultra-high-resolution product visuals, 3D-style medical animations, and persuasive technical copy at 10x speed. Ability to understand and translate complex medical/surgical specifications (e.g., orthopedic casting tapes, surgical antiseptics, OT equipment, diagnostic machines) into clear, high-converting visual stories for doctors, procurement officers, and hospital management. Paid Media Mastery: Meta Ads Manager (Pixel, Conversion API, Lookalike Audiences, Lead Forms, Catalog Sales), TikTok Ads, Google Search/Display Ads, and LinkedIn B2B Outreach. Visual & Video Engineering: Advanced command over Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, Premiere Pro / CapCut Pro, Canva Pro, and AI Image/Video generation prompting for studio-grade product rendering. Content & Hook Psychology: Deep understanding of 3-second video hooks, educational storytelling, clinical demonstration framing, and B2B trust-building architectures. Automation & Operations: Meta Business Suite bulk workflows, Google Sheets data organization, WhatsApp Business automation, and basic landing page/funnel optimization. Responsibilities & Context About the Role M/S Ocean Enterprise is a leading supplier of specialized medical equipment and surgical consumables. We are looking for a one-person digital powerhouse to take complete ownership of our digital ecosystem across Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn, and YouTube Shorts. Your mission is simple but demanding: transform our social channels from basic product catalogs into high-authority lead-generation engines within 6 months. You will bridge the gap between technical medical superiority and aggressive digital distribution. Responsibilities Omnichannel Ecosystem Management: Build, optimize, and scale M/S Ocean Enterprise’s presence across Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, and LinkedIn with platform-specific content strategies. High-Converting Content Production: Script, design, and edit scroll-stopping static graphics, carousels, and short-form video reels/TikToks showcasing product mechanisms, clinical benefits, and usage demonstrations of our medical machines and surgical consumables. Bulk Automation & Scheduling: Architect a streamlined content pipeline using Google Sheets, Canva/Adobe Suite, and Meta Business Suite to bulk-create and schedule 30 to 60 days of strategic content in advance without sacrificing quality. Precision B2B & Doctor-Targeted Paid Ads: Set up and scale advanced Meta & TikTok ad campaigns focusing on Lead Generation, WhatsApp/Messenger conversion, and Retargeting. Build hyper-targeted funnels specifically aimed at surgeons, medical college procurement heads, clinic owners, and wholesale distributors across Bangladesh. Technical Copywriting & Localization: Write authoritative, medically accurate, yet commercially persuasive copy in both English and Bengali that addresses the pain points of healthcare professionals (durability, patient safety, cost-efficiency, certification). Lead Funnel & CRM Integration: Design automated response workflows (ManyChat / WhatsApp Business API) so that every comment, inbox query, or lead form submission from a doctor or hospital is instantly captured, qualified, and routed to our Sales & Service Engineers. Data Analytics & Competitors' Spying: Track weekly KPIs (Cost Per Lead, ROAS, Hook Rate, Hold Rate, Engagement Rate), monitor competitor ad libraries, and pivot strategies aggressively to dominate market share within 180 days. Workplace Work at office Employment Status Full Time Job Location Anywhere in Bangladesh
Applicants are encouraged to submit Video CV.

Responsibilities & Context
About the Role
M/S Ocean Enterprise is a leading supplier of specialized medical equipment and surgical consumables. We are looking for a one-person digital powerhouse to take complete ownership of our digital ecosystem across Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn, and YouTube Shorts. Your mission is simple but demanding: transform our social channels from basic product catalogs into high-authority lead-generation engines within 6 months. You will bridge the gap between technical medical superiority and aggressive digital distribution.
Responsibilities
Omnichannel Ecosystem Management: Build, optimize, and scale M/S Ocean Enterprise’s presence across Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, and LinkedIn with platform-specific content strategies.
High-Converting Content Production: Script, design, and edit scroll-stopping static graphics, carousels, and short-form video reels/TikToks showcasing product mechanisms, clinical benefits, and usage demonstrations of our medical machines and surgical consumables.
Bulk Automation & Scheduling: Architect a streamlined content pipeline using Google Sheets, Canva/Adobe Suite, and Meta Business Suite to bulk-create and schedule 30 to 60 days of strategic content in advance without sacrificing quality.
Precision B2B & Doctor-Targeted Paid Ads: Set up and scale advanced Meta & TikTok ad campaigns focusing on Lead Generation, WhatsApp/Messenger conversion, and Retargeting. Build hyper-targeted funnels specifically aimed at surgeons, medical college procurement heads, clinic owners, and wholesale distributors across Bangladesh.
Technical Copywriting & Localization: Write authoritative, medically accurate, yet commercially persuasive copy in both English and Bengali that addresses the pain points of healthcare professionals (durability, patient safety, cost-efficiency, certification).
Lead Funnel & CRM Integration: Design automated response workflows (ManyChat / WhatsApp Business API) so that every comment, inbox query, or lead form submission from a doctor or hospital is instantly captured, qualified, and routed to our Sales & Service Engineers.
Data Analytics & Competitors' Spying: Track weekly KPIs (Cost Per Lead, ROAS, Hook Rate, Hold Rate, Engagement Rate), monitor competitor ad libraries, and pivot strategies aggressively to dominate market share within 180 days.

Requirements Education Bachelor/Honors Experience At least 3 years The applicants should have experience in the following business area(s): Real Estate Responsibilities & Context জব কনটেক্সট: রিয়েল এস্টেট একটি গতিশীল খাত, যেখানে রয়েছে ক্যারিয়ারে উন্নতি, সফলতা অর্জন এবং দীর্ঘমেয়াদে পেশাগত দক্ষতা বিকাশের সুযোগ। জেদ্দা হাউজিং লিমিটেডে যোগ দিয়ে একটি সম্ভাবনাময় ও মর্যাদাপূর্ণ খাতে নিজের ক্যারিয়ার গড়ে তুলুন, যেখানে আপনার দক্ষতা, কাজের পারফরম্যান্স ও আগ্রহ আপনাকে আরও এগিয়ে নিতে পারে। দায়িত্বসমূহ : প্রতিষ্ঠানের আবাসন প্রকল্পের প্লট বিক্রয়ের লক্ষ্যমাত্রা অর্জন করা। সম্ভাব্য গ্রাহক সংগ্রহ এবং প্লট ক্রয়ের বিষয়ে আগ্রহী গ্রাহকদের সঙ্গে যোগাযোগ ও ফলোআপ করা। গ্রাহকদের প্লটের অবস্থান, মূল্য, কিস্তি সুবিধা ও অন্যান্য শর্তাবলি সম্পর্কে বিস্তারিত তথ্য প্রদান করা। গ্রাহকদের প্রকল্প সাইট পরিদর্শনের ব্যবস্থা করা এবং প্লট বুকিং ও বিক্রয় কার্যক্রম সম্পন্ন করতে সহায়তা করা। বাজার পরিস্থিতি বিশ্লেষণ করে নতুন গ্রাহক তৈরি এবং বিক্রয় বৃদ্ধির উদ্যোগ গ্রহণ করা। নির্ধারিত বিক্রয় লক্ষ্যমাত্রা অর্জন এবং নিয়মিত বিক্রয় প্রতিবেদন প্রদান করা। Skills & Expertise Communication and interpersonal skill Real Estate Marketing Strategic Planning Target Achievement Compensation & Other Benefits বার্ষিক উৎসব বোনাস পারফরম্যান্সভিত্তিক ইনসেনটিভ কাজের পারফরম্যান্সের ভিত্তিতে পদোন্নতির সুযোগ কোম্পানির নীতিমালা অনুযায়ী অন্যান্য সুযোগ-সুবিধা Workplace Work at office Employment Status Full Time Job Location Gazipur (Sreepur)

Accountant Intern
Application Deadline: Nov 20, 2026

Experience: 0 to 1 years
Published: Oct 22, 2026
Requirements
Education
Educational Requirements
BBA or BCom in Accounting, Finance, or a related discipline.
Final-year students and recent graduates may apply.
Workplace
Work at office
Employment Status
Full Time
Application
Online
Job Description
Job Summary
Jabbar Jute Mills is looking for a motivated and detail-oriented Accounts Intern to support daily accounting and finance operations. The selected candidate will gain practical experience in bookkeeping, financial documentation, payment processing, reporting and manufacturing accounts.
We are looking for someone comfortable with digital tools, familiar with basic AI-assisted productivity, and eager to learn.
Key Responsibilities
Assist with daily accounting entries and maintain accurate financial records.
Prepare and organize payment vouchers, receipts, invoices and supporting documents.
Assist with accounts payable, accounts receivable and cashbook maintenance.
Help reconcile bank statements, cash balances and ledger entries.
Assist in preparing daily, weekly and monthly financial reports.
Maintain bills, invoices, expense records and accounting documents.
Verify supplier bills, purchase records and payment requests.
Assist with inventory accounting and raw material purchase documentation.
Use Microsoft Excel and accounting software to maintain financial data.
Use AI tools to assist with documentation, spreadsheet tasks, data organization and report drafting.
Verify AI-generated information and calculations against original records.
Coordinate with the Accounts, Purchase, Store and Administration departments.
Perform other tasks assigned by the Accounts Department.
Additional Requirements
Age At least 23 years
Only Male
Experience
Freshers are encouraged to apply.
Previous accounting or internship experience is an advantage.
Additional Requirements
Basic understanding of accounting principles and bookkeeping.
Good working knowledge of Microsoft Excel and Microsoft Office.
Basic AI literacy, including familiarity with tools such as ChatGPT, Gemini or Claude.
Ability to use AI tools for research, documentation, spreadsheet assistance and routine administrative tasks.
Ability to evaluate AI-generated information critically and verify accuracy before use.
Understanding of data privacy and the importance of protecting confidential financial information.
Strong numerical accuracy, analytical thinking and attention to detail.
Honest, disciplined, punctual and willing to learn.
Ability to work full-time at the factory office in Bhairab, Kishoreganj.
Skills: Accounting, Accounting Data Entry, Accounts and Finance, Accounts Payable Receivable, Bank Reconciliation, Bookkeeping, Financial analysis and reporting, Financial Reporting, Microsoft Excel, Reporting and Documentation
Company Address: Bhairab Bazar
Company Business
History: Jabbar Jute Mills Ltd. prides itself for being one of the oldest jute producers in the country. Established in 1965 by JB M. Nasir, under the jurisdiction of the government of Pakistan at the time, it, along with all other jute mills in the country, was converted into a public limited company by the newly formed government of Bangladesh in 1971. Jabbar Jute Mills Ltd was privatized again in 1984. Since then, new leadership has resulted in a flourishing mill, producing various types of finished jute products for the local and international markets. The Mill Based just outside the capital of Bangladesh in Bhairab, the Jabbar Jute Mill spans over 45 acres of land and currently employs over a 1000 people. Capable of producing various types of finished jute products including Hessian and Sacking products, new machinery and improved techniques allow the production of 5,500 MT of product annually, many of which are exported to various parts of the world. Products 2 Inch Heavy Cees, Standard Binola, Standard B. Twill, Hessian Cloth

Job Description
Are you good at English and confident talking to people? Then we’d like to meet you.
We are growing our Dhaka team and looking for smart, confident people who want to start or grow their career in international business development. You don’t need to come from a particular industry. You could be a fresh graduate or at the beginning of your career. If you communicate well, are curious, and are willing to learn, we will train you.
What will you actually do?
You’ll work with international campaigns across the US, UK, Australia and APAC and speak directly with businesses and decision-makers in these markets.
Your day will involve:
Starting conversations with businesses overseas
Speaking with managers, business owners and decision-makers
Understanding their business needs
Introducing the product or service you are representing
Finding genuine business opportunities
Booking qualified meetings
Following up with people you have already spoken with
You won’t be expected to know everything when you join. Training, campaign knowledge and regular coaching will be provided.
You might be a good fit if…
Your spoken English is strong
You enjoy talking to people
You can have a natural conversation without simply reading a script
You are confident enough to speak with someone you’ve never met
You are curious and learn quickly
You can take feedback and improve
You are comfortable working towards targets
You want exposure to an international working environment
Fresh graduates are encouraged to apply. We care more about how you communicate and your potential than what your previous job title was.
What do you get from the role?
Exposure to international markets and businesses
Practical experience in B2B sales and business development
Experience speaking directly with international business professionals
Hands-on training and coaching
Performance-based incentives
Opportunity to grow into Senior BDR and leadership positions
What will success look like?
Once you are trained, your core targets will be:
100 outbound calls per day
5 meaningful business conversations per day

Published: Oct 22, 2026
Requirements
Education
Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a relevant discipline.
Employment Status
Full Time
Application
Online
Job Description
Job Responsibilities
Sales Auditing: Reconcile daily POS sales, cash receipts, card settlements, and online payment transactions with bank deposits.
Transaction Recording: Record daily sales, cash receipts, and supplier invoices in Tally or other accounting software.
Petty Cash Management: Monitor store petty cash, verify expense receipts, and ensure timely replenishment.
Accounts Payable (AP): Verify supplier invoices against purchase orders and delivery records, maintain payment schedules, and ensure timely payments.
Accounts Receivable (AR): Manage customer credit accounts, wholesale transactions, and corporate billing, where applicable.
Inventory Reconciliation: Reconcile physical stock with book inventory and investigate discrepancies affecting the cost of goods sold (COGS).
Bank Reconciliation: Reconcile bank statements and payment gateway settlements with internal accounting records.
Payroll Processing: Calculate salaries, overtime, and commissions, and ensure accurate payroll deductions and compliance with applicable tax regulations.
Financial Reporting: Prepare monthly Profit and Loss (P&L) statements, balance sheets, and budget variance reports.
VAT & Tax Compliance: Ensure accurate VAT calculations, timely submissions, and compliance with applicable VAT, income tax, and other statutory requirements in Bangladesh.
Budgeting & Forecasting: Assist in preparing operational budgets, cash flow forecasts, and profitability analyses.
Cost & Variance Analysis: Monitor operating expenses, analyze product profit margins, and identify inventory discrepancies and potential financial irregularities.
Audit Support: Maintain accounting records, supporting documents, and financial reports for internal, external, and statutory audits.
Additional Requirements
Age At least 18 years
CA (CC), CMA, or other relevant professional qualifications will be considered an advantage.
Experience Requirements
3–5 years of relevant experience in Accounts & Finance.
Practical experience in VAT and Tax compliance in Bangladesh is mandatory.
Experience in retail businesses or multi-outlet operations will be preferred.
Required Skills & Competencies
Proficiency in MS Excel and accounting software, particularly Tally.
Sound knowledge of accounting principles, VAT, and taxation.
Strong analytical and numerical skills.
High attention to detail, accuracy, and integrity.
Ability to meet deadlines and manage multiple tasks effectively.
Company Address: Uttara Office : Road 13, House 1, Sector 1, Dhaka Square Building (6th Floor) Jashimuddin, Uttara 1230
Company Business
Experience Group is one of Bangladesh’s fastest-growing and most diversified apparel, textiles, and accessories manufacturers, with leadership based in Dhaka and London. Our companies include Experience Design Limited (AMIRÁ), Harry Fashion Limited, Experience Clothing Company Limited, Experience Accessories Company Limited, and Experience Textile Limited. We partner with leading global fashion brands and produce high-quality garments, fabrics, and packaging across multiple categories. With modern facilities, strong technical teams, and a culture built on trust, innovation, and performance, we are shaping the next generation of Bangladesh’s export industry. At Experience Group, people grow fast. We provide a collaborative workplace, real responsibility, and opportunities to learn directly from industry leaders. If you want to build a long-term career in a dynamic and forward-thinking organization, you’ll feel at home here.

Job Description
A. Card Sales:
Achieve individual and team sales targets for Islamic Credit Cards and Prepaid Cards, as set by management.
Plan and schedule the monthly sales target and visit calendar and track progress against it.
Visit individual and corporate customers to promote and sell Islamic card products.
Identify prospective customers through regular field visits, corporate tie-ups, and the bank’s existing customer base.
Arrange meetings with prospective clients, explain product features, Shariah-compliant structure, and applicable fees, and collect the required documents.
Verify the completeness of applications and documents (KYC, income proof, etc.) before submission and follow up with the processing unit until the card is issued.
Brief and train sales executives on products and services so they have adequate product knowledge.
Develop short- and long-term sales forecasts to support the marketing plan.
Plan strategies for acquiring new business, including campaigns, merchant offers, and corporate partnerships.
Maintain strong relationships with customers and provide excellent after-sales service, such as card activation, limit queries, and complaint resolution.
Prepare field visit and sales reports and present them to management.
B. Card Recovery:
Lead the card recovery team and ensure the collection of monthly installments and overdue amounts from cardholders.
Monitor accounts regularly to identify overdue and long-outstanding dues and classify them by aging.
Review the history of each delinquent card file, including usage, payment pattern, and past contact records.
Contact cardholders by phone, SMS, letter, and personal visit to secure repayment.
Visit defaulting cardholders at their residence or workplace to recover dues.
Negotiate repayment arrangements, such as rescheduling or settlement, within the bank’s policy and Shariah guidelines.
Ensure any late payment charge is handled as per Shariah-approved policy (charity, not bank income), and avoid conventional interest-based terms.
Coordinate with the legal and credit administration units on legal notices and further action for non-responsive accounts.
Prepare a daily time-wise work plan, weekly collection plan, and monthly tour plan, and submit them to the supervisor.
Achieve the collection and delinquency-reduction targets set by management.
Prepare regular recovery reports (collection status, NPL/delinquency ratio, aging analysis) for the manager.
Maintain good relationships with existing and potential customers while carrying out recovery in a professional and ethical manner.
C. Compliance & General:
Follow the bank’s policies, Shariah guidelines, central bank regulations, and anti-money laundering (AML/KYC) requirements.
Keep customer information confidential and use it only for authorized purposes.
Maintain accurate records of all customer interactions, visits, and collections in the system.
Ensure fair, respectful, and ethical dealing with customers, with no harassment or pressure tactics.
Coordinate with the Marketing, Operations, Credit, and Customer Service departments.
Perform any other duties assigned by management.

No third class/division in any academic record.
Minimum 2 years of experience in card sales and card recovery in any reputed bank or financial institution.
Working knowledge of credit card and prepaid card products, sales processes, and recovery procedures.
Proven ability to meet individual sales and collection targets.
Strong communication and negotiation skills for dealing with customers.
Basic analytical skills, with the ability to read and interpret collection, aging, and delinquency data.
Good relationship-building and customer service skills.
Willingness to do regular field visits for sales and recovery.
Awareness of Shariah principles in Islamic banking, and of AML/KYC and central bank guidelines.
Proficiency in MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) for reports and tracking.

Job Description
Confidence Infrastructure PLC is starting a new Agri Business that buys processed rice from external millers and distributes it to customers. We are hiring Purchase Officers to handle day-to-day buying under the direction of the Purchase Lead. The work covers talking to suppliers, collecting quotations, issuing purchase orders, following up deliveries and keeping procurement records. The role is based in North Bengal and involves regular visits to millers and suppliers.
Job Responsibilities
Collect quotations and daily price offers from millers and suppliers, and prepare comparative statements.
Visit millers and suppliers in North Bengal to check their stock, capacity and rice quality.
Collect samples before purchase for QC review when needed.
Prepare purchase requisitions and purchase orders for approval, and send approved orders to suppliers.
Follow up with suppliers on delivery schedules, and coordinate transport, lifting and receipt with Logistics, Store and QC.
Check supplier bills, challans and weighment slips, and send them to Accounts for payment.
Follow shortage and quality claims with suppliers until they are settled.
Keep a complete procurement file for every purchase, in line with company procurement policy.
Keep the supplier database and documents up to date, such as the trade licence, food-grain licence, TIN and BIN/VAT certificates.
Share supplier price data with the Purchase Lead and Market Intelligence.
Additional Requirements
Procurement or supply chain work in food, agro or FMCG businesses.
Basic knowledge of rice varieties and quality parameters (moisture, broken percentage, grain size, colour and purity).
Experienced in collecting quotations, preparing comparative statements and processing purchase orders.
Good at following up deliveries and keeping supplier documents in order.
Comfortable with an ERP procurement module, MS Excel and MS Word.
Honest and detail-oriented, follows through on tasks, and communicates and works well with others.
Willing to be based anywhere in North Bengal and to travel often to millers and suppliers.

Job Description
KNOWLEDGE HUB INSTITUTE TRUST (KHI Trust)
POLICY•INFO•INTEL•DECEN
Program Associate (Finance & Accounts)
Reports To:
Deputy Director, Finance
The Knowledge Hub Institute Trust (KHIT) is a results-oriented think and do tank that turns complex policy challenges into practical, evidence-based solutions, working across its six core thematic Research Units — Energy & Climate, Fiscal Justice, Business & Human Rights, Business Climate, Social Justice, and AI & Digitization — to strengthen institutions and drive inclusive impact in Bangladesh. KHI invites applications from accomplished finance and account professionals for the position of Program Associate (Finance & Accounts) to support the Institute’s financial management, accounting, administrative, and compliance functions.
Key Responsibilities
Assist in day-to-day financial operations, including voucher preparation, data entry, bookkeeping, and maintenance of accurate financial records.
Support the preparation of monthly financial statements, expenditure reports, and other financial information.
Assist in budget preparation, budget monitoring, and expenditure tracking for organizational activities and donor-funded programmes.
Process payments, maintain cash and bank records, and assist with bank reconciliations.
Support payroll processing, staff reimbursement, and other employee-related financial transactions.
Assist in preparing donor financial reports and maintaining supporting documents in accordance with grant agreements and donor requirements.
Maintain financial files, vouchers, bills, receipts, and other supporting documents for audit and compliance purposes.
Assist in VAT, income tax, and other statutory compliance activities, as required.
Support procurement documentation, asset registers, inventory records, and related financial administration.
Coordinate with programme and administrative teams to collect financial information and ensure timely processing of transactions.
Assist in internal and external audits by providing relevant financial records and supporting documents.
Perform any other duties assigned by the Deputy Director, Finance or the Executive Director.
Additional Requirements
Qualifications & Experience:
Minimum 1–3 years of relevant experience in finance, accounting, or financial administration, preferably in an NGO, nonprofit, or development organization.
Good knowledge of accounting principles, financial reporting, budgeting, bank reconciliation, and MS Excel. Experience with accounting software will be an advantage.
Basic understanding of donor-funded project financial management and reporting requirements will be an advantage.
Familiarity with Bangladesh’s VAT, income tax, and applicable financial compliance requirements.
Strong numerical and analytical skills, attention to detail, integrity, organizational ability, and effective communication skills.
Candidates with experience in NGO/CSO financial management and donor-funded projects will receive preference.
Compensation & Other Benefits
Compensation: An attractive remuneration package, negotiable and commensurate with the candidate`s qualifications and experience, will be offered along with other admissible benefits.

Requirements
Education
Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA) in Accounting, Finance
Master of Business Administration (MBA)
Workplace
Work at office
Employment Status
Full Time
Application
Online
Job Description
Job Summary
Responsible for multi-outlet sales reporting, cash handling, accounting entries, digital payment and bank reconciliation, supplier payments, collections, and financial documentation, ensuring accuracy, timely reporting, and compliance with company policies.
Key Responsibilities
Sales & Accounting:
Prepare daily outlet-wise sales sheets and summaries; verify POS reports, supporting documents, payment channels (cash, cards, bKash, Foodpanda, Pathao, Foodi, etc.), discounts, promotions, refunds, voids, and complimentary meals; identify discrepancies and post accurate, timely Sales Journal Vouchers (JV), Cash Vouchers (CV), receipts, deposits, supplier payments, petty cash, and other approved transactions in Accounts Care, maintaining correct ledgers, cost centres, references, and audit trails.
Cash & Fund Management:
Collect, count, verify, record, and safeguard outlet cash; reconcile collections with sales, deposit funds on time, and report shortages or excesses. Collect and maintain separate records of tips, excess money, scrap-sale proceeds, birthday contributions, and other designated funds; deposit within approved timelines and submit collection summaries and supporting documents.
Reconciliation & Banking:
Reconcile monthly bKash, card, cash, POS, merchant, accounting, and bank records; investigate charges, refunds, failed or delayed settlements, missing deposits, incorrect credits, and discrepancies. Follow up with banks, payment providers, and outlets; monitor outstanding settlements; prepare reconciliation statements and maintain deposit slips, bank statements, cheque records, transfer confirmations, payment advice, and related documents.
Food Bills & Supplier Payments:
Maintain and collect outstanding food bills from management, employees, and authorized persons; issue receipts, update ledgers, deposit collections, and report dues. Verify supplier invoices against purchase orders, delivery challans, goods receipt records, quantities, rates, calculations, VAT, tax deductions, and approvals; identify duplicate or unauthorized claims, prepare payment vouchers and schedules, process approved payments, retain evidence, and assist with supplier balance reconciliation.
Documentation & Reporting:
Maintain secure, organized, outlet-wise and date-wise physical and electronic records of sales reports, cash sheets, card slips, vouchers, collections, and banking documents; send required hard copies to the warehouse or designated office. Ensure signatures, approvals, supporting documents, and cross-references are complete. Assist with daily, weekly, monthly, and month-end reports, cash verification, reconciliations, outstanding transaction lists, collections, supplier payments, and unreconciled balances.
Compliance & Coordination:
Coordinate with outlet managers, warehouse personnel, suppliers, banks, and relevant departments; support internal and external audits; maintain confidentiality and audit-ready records. Follow company policies, authorization procedures, segregation of duties, internal controls, and document-retention rules. Report suspected fraud, duplicate payments, unauthorized transactions, and irregularities; correct errors only with authorization and perform other finance-related duties assigned by Management.
Key Performance Expectations
Accurate and timely reporting and accounting entries; timely deposits; completion of monthly reconciliations within deadlines; prompt resolution and reporting of variances; proper supplier and petty cash documentation; complete, audit-ready records; and compliance with company policies and internal controls.
Reporting To:
Accounts & Finance Manager or designated authority.
Additional Requirements
Age 25 to 35 years
Experience Requirements
2–3 years of relevant experience in Accounts, Finance, or Cash Management.
Practical experience in sales reporting, cash collection, bank deposits, digital payment reconciliation, and supplier payments.
Accounting software experience; knowledge of Accounts Care is an advantage.
Multi-outlet transaction experience, preferably in the restaurant, retail, or FMCG industry.
Skills: Cash Handling, Maintain sales records
Compensation & Other Benefits
Mobile bill
Salary Review: Yearly
Lunch Facilities: Full Subsidize
Festival Bonus: 2
Company Address: JL bhaban,1 Gulshan Avenue, Gulshan-1, Dhaka-1212

Job Description
কোম্পানির ক্যাম্পেইন পিকআপের মাধ্যমে ঢাকা শহরের বিভিন্ন এলাকায় সরাসরি মার্কেটিং কার্যক্রম পরিচালনা করা।
কোম্পানির পণ্য (দুধ, ঘি, সরিষার তেলসহ অন্যান্য পণ্য) প্রচার, ব্র্যান্ড পরিচিতি বৃদ্ধি এবং বিক্রয় সম্প্রসারণে কাজ করা।
নতুন গ্রাহক সংগ্রহ করা এবং বিদ্যমান গ্রাহকদের সাথে সুসম্পর্ক বজায় রাখা।
নতুন গ্রাহকদের নাম, মোবাইল নম্বর, ঠিকানা ও প্রয়োজনীয় তথ্য সংগ্রহ করে নির্ধারিত খাতা/রেজিস্টারে সঠিকভাবে এন্ট্রি করা এবং নিয়মিত আপডেট রাখা।
নির্ধারিত মাসিক ও দৈনিক বিক্রয় লক্ষ্যমাত্রা (Sales Target) অর্জন করা।
বিক্রয় বৃদ্ধি ও কর্মদক্ষতার ভিত্তিতে অতিরিক্ত ইনসেনটিভ ও ইনক্রিমেন্ট অর্জনের সুযোগ গ্রহণ করা।
নিয়মিত বাজার সমীক্ষা (Market Survey) পরিচালনা করা এবং প্রতিযোগী প্রতিষ্ঠানের পণ্য, মূল্য ও বিপণন কার্যক্রম সম্পর্কিত তথ্য সংগ্রহ ও প্রতিবেদন প্রদান করা।
ডিস্ট্রিবিউটর, হোলসেলার, রিটেইলার এবং কর্পোরেট গ্রাহকদের সাথে নিয়মিত যোগাযোগ ও ব্যবসায়িক সম্পর্ক বজায় রাখা।
বিভিন্ন প্রচারণামূলক কার্যক্রম (Promotional Activities), পণ্য প্রদর্শনী (Product Display), টেস্টিং ক্যাম্পেইন এবং বিক্রয় বৃদ্ধিমূলক কার্যক্রম বাস্তবায়ন করা।
দৈনিক কার্যক্রম, নতুন গ্রাহক সংগ্রহের তথ্য এবং বিক্রয় প্রতিবেদন প্রস্তুত করে কর্তৃপক্ষের নিকট জমা দেওয়া।
কোম্পানির ব্র্যান্ড ইমেজ ও সুনাম অক্ষুণ্ণ রেখে দায়িত্ব পালন করা।
কর্মস্থল:
ঢাকা মহানগরীর বিভিন্ন এলাকা (ক্যাম্পেইন পিকআপের মাধ্যমে ফিল্ড মার্কেটিং)।

কোম্পানির ক্যাম্পেইন পিকআপের মাধ্যমে ঢাকা শহরের বিভিন্ন এলাকায় সরাসরি মার্কেটিং কার্যক্রম পরিচালনা করা।
কোম্পানির পণ্য (দুধ, ঘি, সরিষার তেলসহ অন্যান্য পণ্য) প্রচার, ব্র্যান্ড পরিচিতি বৃদ্ধি এবং বিক্রয় সম্প্রসারণে কাজ করা।
নতুন গ্রাহক সংগ্রহ করা এবং বিদ্যমান গ্রাহকদের সাথে সুসম্পর্ক বজায় রাখা।
নতুন গ্রাহকদের নাম, মোবাইল নম্বর, ঠিকানা ও প্রয়োজনীয় তথ্য সংগ্রহ করে নির্ধারিত খাতা/রেজিস্টারে সঠিকভাবে এন্ট্রি করা এবং নিয়মিত আপডেট রাখা।
নির্ধারিত মাসিক ও দৈনিক বিক্রয় লক্ষ্যমাত্রা (Sales Target) অর্জন করা।
বিক্রয় বৃদ্ধি ও কর্মদক্ষতার ভিত্তিতে অতিরিক্ত ইনসেনটিভ ও ইনক্রিমেন্ট অর্জনের সুযোগ গ্রহণ করা।
নিয়মিত বাজার সমীক্ষা (Market Survey) পরিচালনা করা এবং প্রতিযোগী প্রতিষ্ঠানের পণ্য, মূল্য ও বিপণন কার্যক্রম সম্পর্কিত তথ্য সংগ্রহ ও প্রতিবেদন প্রদান করা।
ডিস্ট্রিবিউটর, হোলসেলার, রিটেইলার এবং কর্পোরেট গ্রাহকদের সাথে নিয়মিত যোগাযোগ ও ব্যবসায়িক সম্পর্ক বজায় রাখা।
বিভিন্ন প্রচারণামূলক কার্যক্রম (Promotional Activities), পণ্য প্রদর্শনী (Product Display), টেস্টিং ক্যাম্পেইন এবং বিক্রয় বৃদ্ধিমূলক কার্যক্রম বাস্তবায়ন করা।
দৈনিক কার্যক্রম, নতুন গ্রাহক সংগ্রহের তথ্য এবং বিক্রয় প্রতিবেদন প্রস্তুত করে কর্তৃপক্ষের নিকট জমা দেওয়া।
কোম্পানির ব্র্যান্ড ইমেজ ও সুনাম অক্ষুণ্ণ রেখে দায়িত্ব পালন করা।
কর্মস্থল:
ঢাকা মহানগরীর বিভিন্ন এলাকা (ক্যাম্পেইন পিকআপের মাধ্যমে ফিল্ড মার্কেটিং)।
কর্মঘণ্টা (দুই শিফটে):
প্রথম শিফট: সকাল ৬:০০টা থেকে সকাল ১১:০০টা পর্যন্ত।
দ্বিতীয় শিফট: বিকাল ৩:৩০টা থেকে রাত ৮:৩০টা পর্যন্ত।
মোট কর্মঘণ্টা: দৈনিক ১০ ঘণ্টা।
বিশেষ শর্ত: প্রতিষ্ঠানের কাজের প্রয়োজনে নির্ধারিত সময়ের অতিরিক্ত কাজ করতে হতে পারে।

Additional Requirements
যোগ্যতা ও অভিজ্ঞতা
ডিজিটাল মার্কেটিংয়ে ন্যূনতম ১ বছরের বাস্তব ও সাম্প্রতিক কাজের অভিজ্ঞতা থাকতে হবে।

Facebook/Meta Ads-এ বিশেষ দক্ষতা থাকতে হবে।
Google Ads ও TikTok Ads পরিচালনার অভিজ্ঞতা থাকতে হবে।
Content Research, Market Research ও Competitor Analysis সম্পর্কে ভালো ধারণা থাকতে হবে।
E-commerce ব্যবসার বিজ্ঞাপন পরিচালনা ও বিক্রয় বৃদ্ধির অভিজ্ঞতা থাকলে অগ্রাধিকার দেওয়া হবে।
ডেটা বিশ্লেষণ করে সঠিক সিদ্ধান্ত নেওয়ার সক্ষমতা থাকতে হবে।
Ad Budget পরিচালনার অভিজ্ঞতা
দৈনিক ন্যূনতম $200–$500 বা তার বেশি Ad Budget পরিচালনার বাস্তব অভিজ্ঞতা থাকতে হবে।
বড় বাজেটের Ad Campaign পরিচালনা, অপটিমাইজ ও স্কেল করার দক্ষতা থাকতে হবে।
বিজ্ঞাপনের বাজেট বাড়ানোর সঙ্গে সঙ্গে ROAS ও লাভজনকতা বজায় রাখার সক্ষমতা থাকতে হবে।
পারফরম্যান্স ও ব্যবসার লক্ষ্য অনুযায়ী দৈনিক $500+ Ad Spend পরিচালনা ও স্কেল করার আত্মবিশ্বাস এবং বাস্তব দক্ষতা থাকতে হবে।
Compensation & Other Benefits
বেতন: ৩০,০০০–৬০,০০০ টাকা
বেতন নির্ধারণ: অভিজ্ঞতা, দক্ষতা ও পারফরম্যান্স অনুযায়ী।
মাসিক বেতন ৩০,০০০–৬০,০০০ টাকা। প্রার্থীর অভিজ্ঞতা, বিজ্ঞাপন পরিচালনার সক্ষমতা, বাজেট ব্যবস্থাপনা এবং পূর্ববর্তী কাজের ফলাফলের ভিত্তিতে বেতন নির্ধারণ করা হবে।
