WELCOME TO K C MODEL SCHOOL & COLLEGE K C Model School and College (KCMSC) is a renowned educational institution near Uttara, at 275, Prembagan, Dakshinkhan, Dhaka-1230. It was founded in 2014 by a leading industrialist of Bangladesh, Al-Hajj Md. Khashru Chowdhury (CIP), founder of Nipa Group. He dreamt of making it an ideal institution that would produce citizens capable of meeting the challenges of the 21st century. KCMSC is housed in a magnificent ten-storied building accommodating students ranging from Play Group to Grade Twelve. It offers both Bangla and English Versions of National curricula of education. KCMSC started its auspicious journey on 1st January 2015 with 2200 students. The mission of KCMSC is to enable students to explore their full potential physically, mentally, and spiritually to make them responsible global citizens. Brig Gen Mushfiqur Rahman SPP, psc (retd) was involved with this institution as its Chief Advisor from its very outset. In addition, very efficient and experienced educationists were appointed as principals and Vice Principals to build up a strong senior management team. The teachers are selected on the basis of merit and competence through a transparent and fair recruiting process. The classroom ambiance, student-teacher interaction, and teaching methods are all carefully designed for students to develop a lifelong desire to learn. Our digitally equipped and spacious classrooms enable students to be more than spectators. They are encouraged to actively participate in class activities. Each of the classrooms is neatly designed to accommodate about 30 students. In addition, there are three large digital classrooms equipped with multi-media projectors and smart boards to facilitate PowerPoint presentations. The Physics, Chemistry, Biology, and ICT labs are well-equipped and well-utilized for practical-oriented learning. We focus not only on grades and results but also on the critical and analytical thinking capability of the students. The institution has a rich Library and all students have a weekly Library Class. The aim is to inculcate broad-based reading habits in our students. Since its inception, the institution has striven to maintain a measured but steady pace of growth in the number of students. This policy has, so far, paid rich dividends in terms of institutional development. We are now confident that this conservative rate of growth has enabled us to assess, reflect upon and design our future course, thus avoiding the risks of unplanned hasty expansion. It has also resulted in a comprehensive, systematic, and structured evolution of such school facilities as Wi-Fi to cope with the requirement of online classes during the Covid-19 pandemic. It can safely and proudly be said that it is one of the very few educational institutions which had effectively and regularly conducted online classes during the pandemic. The adoption of a gradual but carefully defined expansion policy has helped KCMSC to build a healthy relationship among its workforce, its student body, and the guardians at large. Today, KCMSC looks forward to a future of constant and uninterrupted growth and hopes to set an example of an institution that is able to endure the test of trying times in the coming years. We firmly believe that to create a prosperous nation, there is no alternative to building a generation of well-educated citizens who will lead the nation forward.

Job Description
Develop and execute brand strategies and marketing plans to drive brand equity, market share, and business growth.
Plan and execute integrated 360-degree marketing campaigns across ATL, BTL, digital, social media, influencer marketing, and consumer activation.
Strengthen brand positioning, awareness, preference, and loyalty through consistent brand communication and consumer engagement.
Analyze consumer insights, market trends, competitor activities, and channel opportunities to identify growth drivers.
Develop marketing and category plans covering product innovation, renovation, pricing, and portfolio optimization.
Prepare sales budgets, Consolidated Marketing Plans (CMP), and Profit & Loss (P&L) statements for the assigned portfolio.
Monitor national and zonal sales performance against budgets and recommend corrective actions.
Coordinate with cross-functional teams and external agencies to ensure effective campaign development and execution.
Plan and execute new product launches, including positioning, pricing, go-to-market strategy, and post-launch evaluation.
Monitor brand performance, marketing expenditure, and campaign effectiveness; present monthly Brand Performance Reviews (BPR) and recommend improvements.
Conduct market and household visits to generate consumer insights and identify emerging trends and business opportunities.
Maintain marketing reports, sales tracking, budgeting dashboards, and income statements in coordination with relevant departments.

Age At most 32 years

Pharmaceuticals; Agribusiness; Consumer Brands.

প্রদবশপত্র (Admit Card) :  
৮.১ প্রার্থী তার User ID এবাং Password ব্যবোর কদর েমব ও শরমজদেশন নম্বর সাংবমলত প্রদবশপত্র (Admit Card) download করদত পারদবন। 
৮.২ মবজ্ঞাপদন উমিমিত ন্যযনতর্ মশক্ষাগত শ াগ্যতা/অমভজ্ঞতা/প্রমশক্ষন/প্রকাশনা এবাং বয়সসীর্া না র্থাকদল শকান  প্রার্থী আদবেন করার শ াগ্য বদল  মবদবমিত েদবন না। শকাদনা  প্রার্থী পরীক্ষার মফ জর্া মেদয় 
Admit Card পাওয়ার পর একামিকবার অনলাইন আদবেন ফরর্ জর্া মেদত পারদবন না। শকান প্রার্থী অনলাইদন আদবেন ফরর্ পূরণ কদর মফ জর্াোন সিন্ন করদল তার আদবেন চূড়ান্তভাদব গৃেীত 
েদয়দে বদল গণ্য েদব। প্রার্থী মর্থ্যা/মভন্ন/ভুল তথ্য মেদয় একামিকবার ফরর্ পূরণ কদর একামিক Admit Card েেণ করদল, মবজ্ঞমির মবষয় শকাদডর কলাদর্ উমিমিত সাংমিষ্ট মবষয় শকাড ব্যতীত মভন্ন মবষয় 
শকাড িারা শরমজদেশন সিন্ন করদল এবাং প্রমক্রয়ায়দণর শ দকান স্তদর জামলয়ামত প্রর্ামণত েদল এরূপ প্রার্থীর সার্মেক প্রা মর্থমতা বামতল েদব। উক্ত প্রার্থী  ভমবষ্যদত মবমপএসমস কর্তমক মবজ্ঞামপত সকল পদে 
আদবেদনর জন্য অদ াগ্য শঘামষত েদবন এবাং এ িরদনর প্রার্থীর মবরুদি আইনানুগ ব্যবস্থা েেণ করা েদব।    
 
 
৯. BPSC Form-5A (Applicant’s Copy) প্রামি ও জর্াোন: 
      প্রার্থীদের BPSC Form-5A (Applicant’s Copy) কমর্শদনর Web Address: www.bpsc.gov.bd শর্থদক ডাউনদলাড কদর মনদম্নাক্ত কাগজপত্র/তথ্যামেসে কমর্শন কর্তমক মনদে মমশত সর্দয় 
এবাং স্থাদন জর্া মেদত েদব: 
৯.১ প্রার্থীদক জর্াপ্রোনকৃত সনে/কাগজপদত্রর একটি তামলকা মনদজ স্বাক্ষর কদর BPSC Form-5A (Applicant’s Copy) এর সাদর্থ জর্া প্রোন করদত েদব। 
 
  
৯.২ মশক্ষাগত শ াগ্যতা প্রর্াদণর জন্য শবাডম বা মবশ্বমবদ্যালয় েদত অমজমত সকল সনে (স্নাতদকাত্তর/স্নাতক/মবএসমস/এইিএসমস/মডদলার্া বা সর্র্াদনর মূল বা সার্ময়ক সনে/অন্যান্য সনে প্রদ াজয শক্ষদত্র) এর সতযাময়ত 
ফদটাকমপ। মূল সনদের ফদটাকমপ প্রোদন অপারগ েদল সার্ময়ক সনদের ফদটাকমপ গৃেীত েদব। মশক্ষাগত শ াগ্যতার প্রর্াণস্বরূপ মবশ্বমবদ্যালয় বা সব মদশষ পরীক্ষার র্াকমমশট প্রার্থমর্কভাদব েেণদ াগ্য েদব তদব 
সাক্ষাৎকার শবাদডম মূল/সার্ময়ক সনে অবশ্যই োমিল করদত েদব। িার বের শর্য়ামে স্নাতক/স্নাতক সম্মান মডমেিারী প্রার্থীদের জর্াকৃত সনে/র্াকমমশট/শটমেদর্ামনয়াল-এ  মে অমজমত মডমের শর্য়াে ০৪ বের   সুস্পষ্ট 
উদিি না র্থাদক শসদক্ষদত্র অমজমত মডমে ০৪ বের শর্য়ামে র্দর্ম মবভাগীয় প্রিান/পরীক্ষা মনয়ন্ত্রক/শরমজোর কর্তমক প্রেত্ত প্রতযয়নপদত্রর সতযাময়ত কমপ আদবেনপদত্রর সাদর্থ অবশ্যই জর্া মেদত েদব। অন্যর্থায় তাদের অমজমত 
মডমে ০৩ বের শর্য়ামে মেদসদব গণ্য করা েদব; 
 
৯.৩ বয়স প্রর্াদণর জন্য মশক্ষাদবাডম কর্তমক প্রেত্ত এসএসমস/সর্র্াদনর মূল/সার্ময়ক সনদের সতযাময়ত কমপ; “ও” শলদভল এবাং “এ” শলদভল মডমেিারী প্রার্থীদের শক্ষদত্র জন্ম তামরি সাংবমলত োমলমলক প্রর্াণ জর্া 
মেদত েদব। বয়স প্রর্াদণর জন্য এমফদডমভট েেণদ াগ্য েদব না; 
৯.৪  মবদেশ শর্থদক অমজমত মডমেিারী প্রার্থীদের শক্ষদত্র সাংমিষ্ট ইকুইভযাদলন্স কমর্টি/মশক্ষা র্ন্ত্রণালয় কর্তমক প্রেত্ত ইকুইভযাদলন্স সনদের সতযাময়ত ফদটাকমপ; 
৯.৫  আদবেনকারীর স্থায়ী ঠিকানা পমরবমতমত েদল পমরবমতমত স্থায়ী ঠিকানার সপদক্ষ প্রর্াণক সনদের সতযাময়ত কমপ; 
৯.৬  উচ্চতর মশক্ষাগত শ াগ্যতার (মডদলার্া/এর্মফল/এর্এস/এর্মড ইতযামে) সনদের সতযাময়ত ফদটাকমপ (প্রদ াজয শক্ষদত্র);`  
৯.৭  অমভজ্ঞতার সনে জর্াোদনর শক্ষদত্র সাংমিষ্ট পদের শেল/দেড, িাকমরদত শ াগোন এবাং পমরতযাদগর সুষ্পষ্ট তামরিসে শর্য়াে (প্রদ াজয শক্ষদত্র এনদডাসমকৃত/পৃষ্ঠাাংকনকৃত আটি মদকল-৪৭ ফরর্),  িাকমর িলর্ান           
       র্থাকদল মবজ্ঞমিদত উমিমিত অনলাইন আদবেনপত্র জর্াপ্রোদনর শশষ তামরদির র্দধ্য অমজমত অমভজ্ঞতা গণনাপূব মক  র্থা র্থ কর্তমপক্ষ প্রেত্ত অমভজ্ঞতার সনেপত্র জর্াপ্রোন করদত েদব। োড়পদত্রর কমপ  
       অমভজ্ঞতার সনে মেদসদব মবদবমিত েদব না।

Company Business
The ADL-BioTech Research and Development Unit has been established in 2010 as one of the new dimensions of American Dairy Limited and its a corporate entity of ADL, Gazipur, Bangladesh. The ADL-BioTech works with vertical genetic improvement of available cattle genetic resources in Bangladesh to maximize the economic as well as biological efficiency of animals to develop profitable livestock farming system. By principle, the ADL-BioTech Unit aims at developing farmers friendly assorted HYB cattle gene pools, in a possible short span of time, to promote milk and beef turnover in the country by adopting modern biotechnological methods and techniques used in advance animal agriculture system in tropical conditions. It has been working with the domesticated ruminant species including dairy and beef cattle breeds since 2003. However, the ADL-BioTech would work with other ruminants like goat and buffalo breeds. Meanwhile, the ADL has launched a mega project on genetic improvement of dairy cattle in its own client groups by establishing a HYV nucleolus breeding herd to operate an ONBS in combination with MOET breeding technique utilizing superior exotic germplasm by scholarly effort of its stockpile of regular and consultative expert panel of scientists to develop profitable livestock farming environment in its own client groups, and the livestock farming community in the country as well. The ADL-BioTech likely to work with the latest animal breeding and reproductive biotechnologies like AI, MOET, IVF, production and use of bovine sexed semen, community based alternative young bull breeding program, and molecular biology/ genetic engineering like karyotyping, DNA/gene sequencing, genome analysis, nuclear transplantation, trangenesis etc. modern animal breeding and reproductive biotechnologies to bring forth a revolutionary breakthrough in traditional animal agriculture system in Bangladesh. Necessary establishments and facilities are verily under way and hopefully be completed very soon.

Training and professional development opportunities.

Job Description
Executive – HR & Admin
Job Context
We are looking for a proactive, organized, and responsible
Executive – HR & Admin
to manage day-to-day Human Resources and administrative activities of our growing organization.
The selected candidate will be responsible for recruitment, employee documentation, attendance and leave management, onboarding and separation, HR policies, payroll coordination, office administration, and maintaining a professional working environment.
We are looking for someone who is sincere, detail-oriented, comfortable working in a growing organization, and capable of independently handling routine HR activities.
Job Responsibilities
Manage the complete recruitment process including job posting, CV screening, candidate shortlisting, interview scheduling, initial interviews, reference checks, and recruitment documentation.
Coordinate employee onboarding and orientation for newly recruited employees.
Prepare and maintain employee personal files and HR records.
Prepare appointment letters, confirmation letters, increment letters, promotion letters, warning letters, show-cause letters, experience certificates, NOCs, and other HR-related documents.
Maintain employee attendance, leave, late attendance, absence, and working-hour records.
Coordinate monthly payroll information, attendance reports, deductions, incentives, and other salary-related information with the Accounts department.
Maintain and regularly update employee databases and organizational records.
Handle employee confirmation, transfer, promotion, resignation, termination, clearance, and separation procedures.
Develop, update, and maintain Job Descriptions (JD), HR policies, SOPs, organizational charts, and employee guidelines.
Support management in implementing KPI and employee performance evaluation systems.
Ensure employees follow company rules, office discipline, attendance policies, and professional workplace standards.
Assist management with employee relations, grievance handling, disciplinary procedures, and workplace issues.
Ensure HR activities comply with applicable Bangladesh Labour Law, company policies, and internal procedures.
Maintain confidentiality of employee and company information.
Coordinate office administration, office supplies, assets, employee requirements, and general operational support.
Prepare regular HR reports for management, including recruitment status, attendance, manpower, employee turnover, and other HR information.
Coordinate employee training and development activities when required.
Support management in workforce planning and future recruitment requirements.
Perform any other HR & Administrative responsibilities assigned by management.
Educational Requirements
Bachelor’s degree in Human Resource Management, Business Administration, Management, or any relevant discipline.
BBA/MBA with a major in Human Resource Management will be preferred.
Experience Requirements
2 to 4 years
of practical experience in HR and Administration.
Candidates with experience in
E-commerce, Retail, Trading, FMCG, Group of Companies, or similar organizations
will be given preference.
Additional Requirements
Age:
24 to 32 years
Both males and females are encouraged to apply.
Good knowledge of recruitment and selection procedures.
Practical understanding of employee onboarding and separation processes.
Basic to good knowledge of
Bangladesh Labour Act and Labour Rules
.
Strong knowledge of HR documentation and employee file management.
Good command of
Microsoft Excel, Word, PowerPoint, and Google Workspace
.
Experience with HRIS/HRMS software will be an advantage.
Comfortable using modern productivity and AI tools will be an added advantage.
Good written and verbal communication skills in both
Bangla and English
.
Strong organizational and interpersonal skills.
Must be detail-oriented, responsible, honest, and capable of maintaining confidentiality.
Ability to handle multiple tasks and work independently with minimum supervision.
Strong problem-solving ability and a proactive working attitude.
Willingness to work in a fast-growing and performance-driven organization.

Yearly Salary Review
Performance-based Increment

Lunch facilities as per company policy

Sales, Marketing এবং Business Development সম্পর্কে আগ্রহ থাকতে হবে।
নতুন গ্রাহক তৈরি ও ব্যবসায়িক সম্পর্ক গড়ে তোলার মানসিকতা থাকতে হবে।

বিল, ভাউচার, রসিদ ও অন্যান্য আর্থিক নথিপত্র যাচাই করা।
প্রকল্পের বাজেট অনুযায়ী ব্যয় পর্যবেক্ষণ এবং বাজেট বাস্তবায়নে সহায়তা করা।
ব্যাংক লেনদেন, ব্যাংক স্টেটমেন্ট ও ব্যাংক সমন্বয় (Bank Reconciliation) কার্যক্রমে সহায়তা করা।
কর্মীদের ভ্রমণ বিল, সম্মানী ও অন্যান্য অনুমোদিত ব্যয়ের হিসাব প্রস্তুত করা।
মাসিক আর্থিক প্রতিবেদন ও প্রয়োজনীয় হিসাব বিবরণী তৈরিতে সহায়তা করা।
প্রকল্পের আর্থিক নীতিমালা, প্রতিষ্ঠানের নিয়মাবলি এবং দাতা সংস্থার নির্দেশনা অনুসরণ করা।
অডিটের জন্য প্রয়োজনীয় আর্থিক নথি ও প্রমাণপত্র প্রস্তুত এবং সংরক্ষণ করা।
ঊর্ধ্বতন কর্তৃপক্ষের নির্দেশনা অনুযায়ী অন্যান্য আর্থিক ও প্রশাসনিক দায়িত্ব পালন করা।
Additional Requirements
Age At most 35 years
হিসাবরক্ষণ ও আর্থিক নথিপত্র সংরক্ষণে দক্ষতা।
MS Word, MS Excel ও কম্পিউটার পরিচালনায় দক্ষতা।
আর্থিক প্রতিবেদন তৈরি ও তথ্য সংরক্ষণের সক্ষমতা।
সততা, দায়িত্বশীলতা এবং সময়ানুবর্তিতা।
দলগতভাবে কাজ করার মানসিকতা ও যোগাযোগ দক্ষতা।

Festival Bonus: 2

Senior Sales Representative
Application Deadline: Nov 24, 2026
Vacancy: 6
Age: At least 24 years
Location: Dhaka (DOHS Mohakhali)
Salary: Negotiable
Experience: At least 2 years
Published: Oct 25, 2026
Requirements
Education
Bachelor/Honors
Diploma
Masters
Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Marketing, English, Real Estate, or a related field.
Workplace
Work at office
Employment Status
Full Time
Application
Online
Job Description
Please read the complete job description carefully before applying.
Sampan Group is expanding its business operations in international markets and the real estate sector. We are looking for a confident, target-driven, and experienced Senior Sales Representative who can generate leads, build strong client relationships, negotiate effectively, and close sales deals.
Key Responsibilities
Identify, research, and connect with potential local and international clients.
Generate new leads, manage sales pipelines, and convert prospects into customers.
Communicate professionally with clients through phone calls, emails, WhatsApp, and other digital channels.
Present company services, educational programs, corporate training solutions, and real estate projects based on client needs.
Negotiate with prospective clients, handle objections, prepare proposals, and successfully close sales deals.
Follow up consistently with potential clients to improve conversion rates and maintain long-term relationships.
Arrange client meetings, property site visits, project presentations, and follow-up sessions.
Present real estate projects, property features, pricing, payment plans, and investment opportunities to prospective buyers.
Guide interested clients through the property sales process, from initial inquiry and site visits to booking and sales confirmation.
Coordinate property visits, address client questions, and follow up after visits to move prospects toward booking.
Assist clients with booking procedures, required documentation, and payment-related information in coordination with the relevant team.
Build and maintain strong relationships with buyers, investors, business partners, and international clients.
Maintain accurate customer records, sales pipelines, booking updates, and performance reports.
Analyze sales performance, market trends, and competitor activities to identify growth opportunities.
Collaborate with marketing and management teams to improve lead quality, sales strategies, and conversion rates.
Manage international client communications across different time zones when required.
Additional Requirements
Age At least 24 years
Sales experience preferred.
Strong English communication and negotiation skills.
Lead generation, follow-up, and deal-closing abilities.
Real estate site visit and booking knowledge is a plus.
Proficient in Microsoft Office and digital tools.
Target-driven with strong client relationship skills.
Flexible to communicate across international time zones.
Requirements
Relevant experience in sales, business development, international sales, real estate, edtech, or corporate training sales.
Strong spoken and written English communication skills, particularly for international client interactions.
Excellent negotiation, persuasion, presentation, and sales-closing skills.
Experience in lead generation, client follow-up, relationship management, and sales conversion.
Knowledge of real estate sales processes, property presentations, site visits, and booking procedures is an advantage.
Ability to build trust, handle objections, and maintain long-term client relationships.
Strong reporting, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office and digital communication tools.
Ability to work independently, manage multiple prospects, and achieve sales targets.
Willingness to communicate with international clients across different time zones when necessary.
Additional Advantages
Experience handling international clients or working with global markets.
Experience in real estate, property sales, or investment-related client management.
Experience in education, professional development, course sales, or corporate training.
IELTS/TOEFL background or relevant experience in education-related sales.
Skills: Business/ Product Development, Client Relationship, Communication and interpersonal skill, Field Visit, Lead Generation, Negotiation Persuasion Skills, Sales & Marketing, Sales Target Achievement, Strong Communication skill with foreign clients, Telecommunication
Compensation & Other Benefits
T/A,Tour allowance,Mobile bill,Performance bonus
Lunch Facilities: Partially Subsidize
Festival Bonus: 2
Salary Review: Half Yearly
Competitive base salary with sales commission and performance-based incentives.
Opportunities to work across international markets and the real estate sector.
Exposure to international business development and diverse client segments.
Professional development and career advancement opportunities.
A collaborative and growth-oriented work environment.
Base Salary + Commission

Job Description
Identify, develop and acquire new payroll banking business opportunities through market research, business networking and corporate engagement.

Attractive compensation package will be offered to the deserving candidates selected for the positions based on the experience and competency.

NCC Bank PLC. has been operating as one of the leading Private Commercial Banks with its strong business network of 132 branches and 10 sub-branches across the country and providing personalized & customer-friendly banking services to its client in a responsive and technology-based environment.

Experience: 0 to 1 years

Workplace
Work at office
Employment Status
Full Time
Application
Online
Job Description
প্রধান দ্বায়িত্বসমূহ:
ফোন, Facebook, WhatsApp ও অন্যান্য অনলাইন মাধ্যমে গ্রাহকদের সঙ্গে যোগাযোগ করে পণ্য বিক্রয় নিশ্চিত করা।
গ্রাহকের প্রয়োজন বুঝে উপযুক্ত পণ্য সম্পর্কে সঠিক তথ্য প্রদান করা।
নতুন গ্রাহক তৈরি এবং বিদ্যমান গ্রাহকদের সঙ্গে সুসম্পর্ক বজায় রাখা।
Sales Target অর্জনের জন্য নিয়মিত ও পরিকল্পিতভাবে কাজ করা।
অর্ডার গ্রহণ, অর্ডারের তথ্য যাচাই এবং সংশ্লিষ্ট টিমের কাছে সঠিকভাবে হস্তান্তর করা।
গ্রাহকের প্রশ্ন, অভিযোগ ও সমস্যার দ্রুত এবং ভদ্রতার সঙ্গে সমাধান করা।
পণ্যের বৈশিষ্ট্য, মূল্য, অফার ও সুবিধা সম্পর্কে আপডেট থাকা।
Follow-up Call/Message-এর মাধ্যমে সম্ভাব্য গ্রাহকদের অর্ডারে রূপান্তর করা।
দৈনিক ও মাসিক Sales Report প্রস্তুত করা।
প্রতিষ্ঠানের বিক্রয় বৃদ্ধি ও নতুন বিক্রয় কৌশল বাস্তবায়নে সক্রিয়ভাবে সহযোগিতা করা।
Additional Requirements
Age 20 to 32 years
অভিজ্ঞতা :০-১ বছর।
প্রয়োজনীয় যোগ্যতা ও পরিশ্রম করার মানসিকতা থাকলে ফ্রেশারদের ও অগ্রাধিকার দেওয়া হবে।
Company Address: Rampura,Banasree,Dhaka-1219
Company Business
Shahin E-Mart is a Bangladeshi e-commerce platform that sells organic food, gadgets, and lifestyle items. Founded by Shahin Alam, it aims to deliver natural, chemical-free products directly to customers.

Shamadhan Services Limited
Internal Audit Executive
Application Deadline: Nov 6, 2026
Vacancy: 1
Age: 25 to 30 years
Location: Dhaka
Salary: Negotiable
Experience: At least 3 years
Published: Oct 26, 2026
Requirements
Education
Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA) in Finance, Accounting
BBA/MBA in Finance/ Accounting/ Business Administration with CA (CC)
Employment Status
Full Time
Application
Online
Job Description
Conduct regular financial, operational, and process audits.
Review accounting records, vouchers, bills, invoices, payments, receipts, and supporting documents.
Audit cash, bank transactions, inventory, procurement, fixed assets, payroll and operational expenses.
Review and verify transactions recorded in the company's ERP system.
Check compliance with company policies, SOPs, management instructions, and applicable laws and regulations.
Conduct physical verification of inventory, fixed assets, and other company assets.
Identify financial irregularities, control weaknesses, process gaps, wastage, and potential fraud risks.
Conduct surprise audits and special investigations as instructed by the management.
Prepare audit working papers, audit observations, and comprehensive Internal Audit Reports.
Recommend corrective and preventive actions to improve internal control and operational efficiency.
Follow up on previous audit findings and monitor implementation of corrective actions.
Coordinate with Accounts, Finance, HR, Commercial, Procurement, Store, IT and other departments during audit activities.
Maintain strict confidentiality of all financial, operational, and management information.
Perform any other duties assigned by the, Management.
Additional Requirements
Age 25 to 30 years
Only Male
Practical experience with ERP-based accounting and auditing will be highly preferred.
Good understanding of Internal Control, Risk Management, Compliance and Corporate Governance.
Strong proficiency in MS Excel, MS Word, and ERP software.
Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.
Good report-writing and communication skills.
Ability to identify irregularities and analyze financial and operational data.
High level of integrity, confidentiality, and professional ethics.
Ability to work independently and meet deadlines.
Willingness to visit business locations when required.
Company Address: Mirpur-1, telecom bhaban, level- 06

অতিথি ও ক্লায়েন্টদের সাক্ষাৎকার গ্রহণ এবং প্রয়োজনীয় ক্ষেত্রে বাহিরে কাজ করা (যেমন, হোম ভিজিট বা বিয়ের দেখাদেখি)।

আগ্রহী প্রার্থীদের সদস্যতা লাভের লক্ষ্যমাত্রা পূরণে প্রয়োজনীয় পদক্ষেপ নেওয়া।

বিক্রয় কৌশল বাস্তবায়নে মার্কেটিং টিমের সাথে সমন্বয় করা।

Age 35 to 45 years
প্রার্থীর একাডেমিক মেধা/ যোগ্যতা আমাদের কাছে গুরুত্বপূর্ণ নয়।
প্রার্থীকে অবশ্যই কর্পোরেট বা সার্ভিস সেলস বিষয়ে অভিজ্ঞ ও পারদর্শী হতে হবে। Sales বুঝতে হবে।
দীর্ঘদিন কাজ করার মানসিকতা থাকতে হবে। বিবাহিতদের অগ্রাধিকার দেয়া হবে।
সেলস বিষয়ে সেল্ফ এডুকেটেড ও উচ্চতর ট্রেনিং করেছেন, অভিজ্ঞতা সম্পন্ন এমন হলে অগ্রাধিকার পাবেন।

Performance bonus
Salary Review: Yearly

Festival Bonus: 2
Sales Commission-based as per company policy
Other Benefits: প্রার্থীকে অফিস কর্তৃক দুপুরের খাবার সরবরাহ করা হবে। প্রার্থী কর্মস্থলে অবস্থাকালিন মসজিদের গিয়ে সালাত আদায় করতে পারবেন।
বেতনের পাশাপাশি প্রতিটি প্রজেক্ট সফলতার বিপরীতে আকর্ষনীয় বোনাস দেয়া হয়।
বছরে ২টি উৎসব বোনাস (বেতনের ৫০%) দেয়া হয়।
Company Address: Kha-48/B (1st Floor), Opposite of Cambrian College, Bashtola Bus Stop, Bir Uttam Rafiqul Islam Ave, Shahjadpur, Gulshan, Dhaka-1212.
Company Business
We help those who are practicing Muslim, who pray Salah five times, Who don?t support any kind of dowry, who earn halal, who do not support visiting any shrine, so called peer, does not use Tabeej, who follows Shaheeh Sunnah of prophet Muhammad (may peace be upon him) and who wants to marry in accordance to the Islamic Sharya. We also work for divorced, separated, aged brothers and sisters. Another concern of our is the pre and post marriage counseling. At first we take a certain amount of service charge and collect bio data from the interested brothers/sisters. Then we interview them about their deen, Akeeda and personal necessary information?s. After that if any brother shows interest in any certain sister?s bio data we contact with the sister?s Wali and arrange a face to face meeting following Islamic guidelines. After collecting the service charge we go forward with our work by sorting out specific bio-data?s for our clients. We also fix a succession charge if we are successful in finding them what they want by discussing the amount with our clients prior to the marriage. We do not charge any other payments except the service charges mentioned above. We also consider discounts for the needy brothers and sisters. Marriage is from Allah and fully dependent on the destiny (Kadr). We only can help you in that process of finding the right practicing muslim/muslimah by trying our best. Till now we have more than 86 success stories Ma sha Allah. So we do not guarantee any success rather we can guarantee our dedication in helping you. In sha Allah. We are a small organization and we need funds to run our services. That is the purpose of charging fees. And no, we are not doing business by using the name of Islam rather we are doing business in accordance to the Islamic guidelines. An-Nur Islamic Marriage Media is a nonpolitical organization and we try to follow proper Islamic Sharya laws. Our main goal is to help find practicing muslim/muslimah the right partner to fulfill his or her Deen. We do work for brothers and sisters of Deen who: ?	Who are not follower/ mureed of any Peer. ?	Who does not visit any kind of shrine or place of Bida?ah. ?	Who does not use any amulet/ Tameemah/ Taweez. ?	Who are regular in their Salaah. ?	Who don?t support/ take any kind of dowry. ?	Who earn their livelihood in halal way. ?	Who follows Shaheeh Sunnah of Prophet Muhammad (May peace be upon him) who wants to marry in accordance to the Islamic Shariah. ?	Who wants to avoid wedding arrangements those are against Islamic culture.

Job Description
Diligently prepare comprehensive monthly and annual financial reports, leveraging proficiency in ERP systems or equivalent accounting software to ensure accuracy and compliance.
Process all types of billing vouchers, maintain daily cash records, ledgers, and stock books, ensuring meticulous attention to detail and adherence to accounting principles
Oversee daily sales tracking and ensure prompt bank deposits, implementing effective fund management strategies to maintain optimal liquidity
Formulate and submit weekly cash/fund requisitions to the Head Office, aligning with organizational budgeting and financial planning protocols
Review and authorize payment documents in strict accordance with organizational financial policies, ensuring integrity and accountability in all transactions
Manage the issuance of cheques and vouchers, guaranteeing timely disbursement to employees, partners, and vendors, while maintaining comprehensive records
Ensure all payments, purchase authorizations, and financial transactions comply with staff regulations, financial rules, and delegated authorities
Execute precise VAT and tax deductions from supplier bills, ensuring timely remittance to the bank in compliance with statutory requirements
Prepare monthly bank reconciliation statements, incorporating Head Office adjustments, and accurately record debit/credit notes to maintain financial integrity
Prepare and issue delivery challans, money receipts, and gate passes for clients, ensuring proper documentation and record-keeping
Maintain office premises, guest accommodations, dining facilities, and oversee other administrative tasks to ensure a conducive working environment
Participate in all aspects of product sales, delivery, and receipt; maintain up-to-date stock books and asset registers with date-wise entries for accurate inventory tracking
Prepare necessary reports and coordinate collections through designated personnel, ensuring timely submission and follow-up
Ensure the safety of team members from any harm, abuse, neglect, harassment and exploitation to achieve the programme’s goals on safeguarding implementation. Act as a key source of support, guidance and expertise on safeguarding for establishing a safe working environment
Practice, promote and endorse the issues of safeguarding policy among team members and ensure the implementation of safeguarding standards in every course of action.
Follow the safeguarding reporting procedure in case any reportable incident takes place, encourage others to do so
Perform any other jobs as assigned by the management
Additional Requirements
Age, academic credentials, and professional experience requirements may be waived for candidates demonstrating extraordinary qualifications and a proven record of excellence
Comprehensive understanding of fundamental accounting principles, including but not limited to inventory management, financial oversight, profit and loss analysis, and income statement preparation
Demonstrated expertise in utilizing Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) systems or equivalent accounting software to streamline financial operations
Ability to dissect complex financial data
Aptitude for identifying issues and implementing effective solutions promptly
Proficiency in compiling comprehensive reports that accurately reflect financial standings and projections
Excellent verbal and written communication capabilities to convey financial information clearly and concisely to stakeholders

Advanced MS Excel, MS Word.
Understands internal controls and audit requirements.
Assist in preparing Financial Statement and Bank Reconciliation.

Two Festival Bonus
Mobile Bill Allowance
Full subsidize lunch

নতুন ব্যবসার সুযোগ খোঁজা। এর জন্য নিয়মিতভাবে সরকারি ও বেসরকারি কনস্ট্রাকশন প্রজেক্ট সাইট, কর্পোরেট অফিস এবং রেডি-মিক্স কনক্রিট (RMC) প্ল্যান্ট পরিদর্শন করা।
ডিলার ও স্টেকহোল্ডার ম্যানেজমেন্ট:
নতুন ডিলার ও ডিস্ট্রিবিউটর নিয়োগ করা। এছাড়া ঠিকাদার (Contractor) এবং কনসালট্যান্টদের সাথে সুসম্পর্ক বজায় রাখা যাতে প্রজেক্টে আপনার কোম্পানির পণ্য ব্যবহারের সুপারিশ করা হয়।
সেলস টার্গেট ও আলোচনা:
কোম্পানির নির্ধারিত মাসিক এবং বার্ষিক বিক্রয় লক্ষ্যমাত্রা অর্জন করা। সিদ্ধান্ত গ্রহণকারীদের সাথে পণ্যের দাম ও অন্যান্য বাণিজ্যিক বিষয়ে সফলভাবে আলোচনা ও নেগোসিয়েশন করা।
মার্কেট ইন্টেলিজেন্স:
বাজারে প্রতিযোগী কোম্পানিগুলোর কার্যক্রম, তাদের পণ্যের বৈশিষ্ট্য এবং দাম পর্যবেক্ষণ করা। এসব তথ্য এবং বিক্রয়ের পূর্বাভাস নিয়মিত ম্যানেজমেন্টকে রিপোর্ট করা।
পেমেন্ট কালেকশন:
ডিস্ট্রিবিউটর এবং ক্লায়েন্টদের কাছ থেকে সময়মতো বকেয়া টাকা আদায় নিশ্চিত করা যাতে কোম্পানির নগদ প্রবাহ (Cash Flow) ঠিক থাকে।
Additional Requirements
Age At least 25 years
Experience :
Freshers can also apply, but preference will be given to those who have work experience in Sales & Marketing in cement or paint companies
Bike Mandatory.
Skills: Good Coversation Skill, Sales & Marketing
Compensation & Other Benefits
TA DA included with salary.
Company Address: BSCIC Industrial,Bogrua
Company Business
Manufacturer and supplier of SRBS Admixture and Paint Company ensuring quality products and professional service. In this Construction Admixtures (Chemicals) Company has expert chemists controlling the quality of the product and innovation. These Admixtures (Chemicals) are enhancing the productivity and competence level in the construction sector. These products are certified.

Website Maintenance & Development
Maintain, update, and optimize corporate website applications (Frontend: Next.js/React; Backend: Python/Wagtail/Django).
Implement functional improvements, fix technical bugs, and handle regular frontend/backend updates.
Ensure cross-browser compatibility, mobile responsiveness, and optimal website load speeds.
Manage codebases and version control using Git and repository management tools (GitHub/GitLab).
Cloud Hosting & Linux Server Administration
Administer and monitor production environments hosted on DigitalOcean (Ubuntu Linux).
Manage containerized services using Docker & Docker Compose.

Manage corporate web content using CMS admin dashboards (Wagtail/Django).
Upload and publish new projects, press releases, company news, and media assets in a timely manner.

Design professional marketing and corporate collateral, including website banners, flyers, announcements, and digital media assets.

Social Media & Digital Operations
Manage corporate social media channels (LinkedIn Company Page, Facebook Page, Meta Business Suite).
Plan, schedule, and publish regular corporate updates, achievements, and industry news.
Track engagement metrics, audit SEO performance, and monitor traffic analytics using Google Analytics and Google Search Console.

Working experience with DigitalOcean, Linux (Ubuntu), Docker / Docker Compose, SSH, Nginx, SSL, and DNS management.

Proficiency in PostgreSQL or MySQL management, queries, and backup/restore workflows.
Version Control:
Active experience using Git (GitHub / GitLab) for code deployment and collaboration.
Website Security:
Understanding of website security best practices, access control, vulnerability patching, and backup management.
Graphic Design:
Intermediate skills in Canva, Adobe Photoshop, or Illustrator for creating digital banners and social posts.
Digital Media & SEO:
Hands-on experience managing LinkedIn and Meta Business Suite, alongside basic knowledge of SEO, Google Search Console, and Google Analytics.

Workplace
Work at office
Employment Status
Full Time
Application
Online
Job Description
Swapnojatra Sources
is a dynamic trading company specializing in importing diverse products from China and distributing them through both B2B and B2C channels in Bangladesh. We are expanding our operations and looking for a driven, energetic professional to lead our market expansion, liaison with our sourcing teams, and manage our sales channels. Job member working underneath. Summary We are looking for a young, energetic, and market-survey Marketing & Supply Chain Executive who will spearhead our field marketing, product sourcing coordination, and sales operations. The ideal candidate will bridge the gap between local market demands in Bangladesh and our sourcing team in China. This role requires active field movement to showcase product samples, gather market intelligence, manage B2B trader relationships, and oversee digital platforms (F-commerce and E- commerce) with the help of a junior staff
Key Responsibilities & Duties
1. Market Exploration & Demand Collection
• Regularly visit local markets to showcase product samples, assess market trends, and collect comprehensive data on market demand for various products imported from China.
• Identify potential B2B traders, retailers, and bulk buyers, and build strong business relationships.
2. Supply Chain & China Team Coordination
• Relay detailed market feedback, demand forecasts, and product specifications to the China sourcing team Ningbo Amin Trading and Swapnojatra Sources management.
• Coordinate with the supply chain network to gather necessary feedback, pricing insights, and logistics information for products sourced from China.
3. Pricing & Import Management
• Compile collected market and supply chain information to formulate competitive price offers for traders.
• Manage import workflows from China to Bangladesh based on confirmed trader demands and orders.
4. Team Leadership & Digital Operations
• Form, guide, and lead a high-performing marketing team, supervising one direct reporting staff member who will assist with field-level order collection.
• Oversee and manage the companyʼs F-commerce and E-commerce platforms to drive digital sales alongside offline channels.
Office Address:
PC Garden (3rd Floor), 20-21 Kawranbazar, Dhaka, Bangladesh.
Additional Requirements
Age 22 to 32 years
Experience:
1 to 3 years of proven experience in field marketing, trading operations, supply chain, or import-export coordination. (Fresh, highly energetic graduates with exceptional market knowledge are also encouraged to apply).
Industry Knowledge:
Full understanding of local market dynamics, trading channels, and B2B/B2C sales environments in Bangladesh.
Technical Skills:
Strong proficiency in Microsoft Office applications (MS Word, Excel, Power Point) for reporting, data analysis, and pricing calculations.
Communication:
Excellent active communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills.
Work Ethic:
High level of time-boundness, punctuality, and target-driven attitude. Field mobility is a core requirement of this role.
English and Bengali typing in computer. English Language understanding.
Willingness to travel frequently within local markets and meet various trade partners.
Energetic, proactive, and capable of working under pressure.
Compensation & Other Benefits
Competitive salary package with performance-based incentives.
Festival bonuses and mobile allowance.
Excellent career growth opportunities in a fast-expanding trading enterprise.

Work at office

Full Time

Online
Job Description
About Investit
Investit Asset Management Limited is a BSEC-licensed asset management company focused on disciplined investment management and long-term wealth creation.
We are looking for a capable, detail-oriented and responsible professional to join our Accounts & Fund Operations team. The position offers practical exposure to investment fund operations, financial reporting, regulatory processes and coordination with stake holders.
Key Responsibilities
Maintain company and mutual fund accounts, including journal entries, ledgers, reconciliations and financial records.
Handle day-to-day mutual fund operations, including investor transactions, unit subscriptions and redemptions.
Prepare and verify NAV calculations, operational reports and supporting schedules.
Assist with financial statements, audits, tax and VAT matters, and periodic regulatory reporting.
Coordinate with trustees, custodians, auditors, regulators and other stakeholders.
Maintain accurate documentation, meet reporting deadlines and follow established internal controls.
Support improvements in accounting systems, operational procedures and reporting processes.
Additional Requirements
Preferably 1–3 years of relevant experience in accounting, audit, financial services or fund operations.
Exceptional fresh graduates with strong accounting knowledge and analytical ability are also encouraged to apply.
Prior experience in asset management or the capital market is an advantage.
Required Skills and Attributes
Strong understanding of accounting principles, reconciliations and financial reporting.
Good command of Microsoft Excel and confidence in learning new software.
Strong analytical ability, attention to detail and problem-solving skills.
Ability to organize multiple responsibilities, prioritize deadlines and work accurately.
Good written and verbal communication skills.
High standards of integrity, accountability and confidentiality.
Genuine interest in developing a long-term career in finance and operations.
Compensation & Other Benefits
Competitive compensation based on skills and experience.
Practical exposure to mutual fund accounting, investment operations and regulatory processes.
Opportunity to work closely with senior management in a professional environment.
Training, professional development and performance-based compensation reviews.
Scope to take on greater responsibilities as the organization grows.
Company Address: Suite C-10, Level 10, Rangs Nasim Square, Plot 46, Road 27 (Old), 16 (New), Dhanmondi, Dhaka-1209
Company Business
Investit Asset Management Limited is a forward-thinking asset management company licensed by the Bangladesh Securities and Exchange Commission (BSEC). Led by seasoned industry experts, we are dedicated to providing superior risk-adjusted returns to our clients. Our core focus areas include: - Mutual Fund Management - Institutional Fund Management and - Corporate Advisory We are committed to delivering exceptional value and building long-lasting relationships with our clients.

Job Description
CTB Fashion is a premier bag manufacturer and supplier in Bangladesh, renowned for delivering high-quality custom-made bags, jute bags, wholesale collections, and large-scale government and corporate tender supplies. As we continue to expand our institutional footprint, we are looking for a dynamic, proactive, and results-driven Sales Executive (Tender) to lead our bidding initiatives and drive institutional sales growth.
Key Responsibilities
Identify, monitor, and analyze tender opportunities across government, corporate, NGO, and private sectors.
Handle the end-to-end tender process—from initial document preparation and technical specification alignment to timely submission and follow-up.
Navigate and manage submissions efficiently using the e-GP (Electronic Government Procurement) system and other digital bidding platforms.
Prepare competitive quotations, comprehensive proposals, and accurate compliance documentation.
Establish and nurture strong, lasting professional relationships with procurement officers, corporate clients, and strategic business partners.
Collaborate closely with internal production, design, and management teams to ensure seamless execution, competitive pricing, and on-time delivery.
Consistently meet or exceed sales quotas and contribute significantly to overall business expansion.
Additional Requirements
Age 25 to 35 years
Experience Requirements
Candidates should have 1 to 2 years of proven experience in tender, corporate, or institutional sales, with hands-on knowledge and practical expertise in Bangladesh e-GP procedures strongly preferred.
Additionally, prior working experience in the manufacturing, apparel, or bag industry will be considered a distinct advantage for this role.
Required Skills & Competencies
Understanding of tender documentation, terms, and public/private procurement procedures.
Exceptional communication, negotiation, and interpersonal relationship-management skills.
Analytical mindset with the ability to interpret complex tender requirements into winning commercial bids.
Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) and digital work platforms.
Highly accountable, organized, and driven by targets and deadlines.
Perform any other relevant duties, strategic responsibilities assigned by higher authorities to support organizational goals.
Skills: Sales & Marketing
Compensation & Other Benefits
Mobile bill
Salary Review: Yearly
Festival Bonus: 2

Competitive salary package equal with experience and qualifications.
Excellent career advancement opportunities within a rapidly expanding manufacturing brand.
collaborative, professional, and growth-oriented work environment.

CTB Fashion Popular Bag Company in Bangladesh. We manufacture and supply various types of office bags, school bags, college bags, backpacks, travel bags, etc. in Bangladesh and abroad.

Job Description
Tekvision (BD) Limited is an IT organization, and we are looking for an energetic, well-organized Assistant Officer to join our Corporate Services department. The selected candidate will support the Administration team in running our corporate office smoothly, covering office facilities, transport, procurement, vendors, security and day-to-day office support.
Job Responsibilities
Supervise day-to-day office administration activities.
Keep the office, workstations, meeting rooms and common areas clean and presentable.
Keep trade licenses, permits and certificates up to date.
Manage company transport and keep vehicle papers updated (route permit, fitness, tax token, blue book).
Oversee office security, access control and visitor management.
Work as a purchase committee member: collect quotations, find new suppliers, maintain the vendor list and help negotiate prices.
Procure stationery, office supplies and furniture from enlisted suppliers and the local market.
Maintain inventory records of office supplies and assets.
Ensure timely payment of utility and service bills (electricity, water, internet, rent, fuel, food, cleaning).
Keep office equipment, ACs, generators and UPS units in good working order and arrange repairs when needed.

Provide logistics support for meetings, training sessions and company events.
Support local and international travel arrangements, including tickets, hotels and visa documents.
Prepare office orders, notices and circulars.
Maintain administrative files and records.
Maintain liaison with government and non-government offices.
Follow cost control measures in all administrative activities.
Maintain petty cash when required.
Carry out any other tasks assigned by management.
Additional Requirements
Age At least 24 years
Good knowledge of office compliance and audit processes.
Strong written and verbal communication skills in Bangla and English.
Proficiency in MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) and email communication.
Good planning, problem-solving and report-writing skills.
Able to handle multiple tasks and work under pressure.
Willing to do outside-office work when needed.
Honest, punctual, well-presented and a good team player.

Provident fund

We specialize in delivering end-to-end solutions that drive operational excellence, enable digital transformation and foster technological innovation for businesses of all sizes. At Tekvision, we combine deep domain expertise with a bold vision for innovation. We deliver trusted, future-focused technology solutions that drive sustainable growth and digital leadership.

Company Description
Curl Ware is a web agency specializing in WordPress and Laravel development, app development, web design, and UX/UI design, ERP Software. The team focuses on delivering high-quality digital solutions that help clients strengthen and grow their online presence. Curl Ware partners with businesses and individuals to create effective, optimized, and user-centered websites and applications. The agency is driven by a mission to exceed client expectations and deliver results-oriented solutions that support long-term success.
Role Description
The Executive (Sales) Software Marketing role at Curl Ware is a full-time, on-site position based in Dhaka. This role is responsible for identifying and pursuing new business opportunities for the agency’s web, app, and digital marketing services, as well as managing relationships with existing clients. Daily tasks include prospecting and lead generation, presenting service offerings, preparing proposals and quotations, and negotiating contracts. The executive will collaborate with technical and design teams to understand project scopes, align sales pitches with client needs, and ensure smooth handover of closed deals. The role also involves tracking sales performance, maintaining accurate records in CRM tools, conducting market research, and contributing to marketing campaigns and promotional activities.

Age At most 32 years
Strong sales, negotiation, and client relationship management skills, with the ability to identify and close new business opportunities.
Knowledge of software and digital services such as web development, app development, SEO, and digital marketing, with the ability to explain technical offerings in accessible language.
Effective communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills, including experience with professional email and business proposal writing.
Ability to conduct market research, analyze customer needs, and contribute to marketing strategies and campaigns.
Proficiency with common office productivity tools and CRM or sales tracking systems.
Proactive, target-driven mindset with strong organizational skills and the ability to work collaboratively with cross-functional teams.
Prior experience in software, IT, or digital agency sales is highly beneficial.
Skills: IT & Software Marketing
Company Address: 5th Floor, 7/ka, Pisciculture Housing, Ring Road, Shyamoli, Dhaka-1207

Curl Ware is a digital agency that specializes in providing various services including WordPress development, Laravel development, SEO, web design, and UX/UI design. We aim to help businesses and individuals build their online presence through effective website development, optimization, and design. Our mission is to exceed our client’s expectations and provide them with the solutions they need to succeed.

About EvoiceBD Limited
EvoiceBD Limited is an international wholesale telecommunications company providing voice and SMS termination services to customers and partners worldwide. We are looking for a proactive, commercially minded, and detail-oriented
A2P SMS Sales & Billing Manager
to expand our A2P SMS business, develop strong relationships with international customers and suppliers, and manage billing and account reconciliation activities.
The ideal candidate should have experience in international telecom sales, A2P SMS wholesale, carrier relations, or telecom billing, along with strong communication, negotiation, and analytical skills.
Job Responsibilities
A. A2P SMS Sales & Carrier Relations
Identify, approach, and develop relationships with potential international A2P SMS customers, suppliers, aggregators, and telecom operators.
Generate new business opportunities through LinkedIn, email, industry events, professional networks, and other communication channels.
Negotiate SMS termination rates, commercial terms, credit limits, payment conditions, and traffic commitments with customers and suppliers.
Manage the complete interconnection process, including commercial negotiations, contract execution, account creation, route configuration, and testing in coordination with the technical team.
Develop and maintain strong relationships with existing customers and suppliers to increase traffic volume and business profitability.
Monitor route performance, delivery quality, pricing competitiveness, and traffic trends, coordinating with relevant teams and partners to resolve issues.
Prepare quotations, negotiate deals, follow up on business opportunities, and achieve sales and revenue targets.
B. Billing & Account Management
Manage the daily and monthly billing process for A2P SMS customers and suppliers.
Prepare, verify, and issue invoices, credit notes, statements of account (SOAs), and other billing documents accurately and on time.
Reconcile traffic records, billing reports, invoices, and SOAs to identify and resolve discrepancies.
Monitor customer outstanding balances, payment due dates, credit limits, and supplier payables.
Follow up with customers regarding overdue invoices and coordinate with suppliers to resolve billing disputes.
Maintain accurate customer and supplier account records, ensuring that all billing transactions are properly documented.
Coordinate with the sales, technical, and finance teams to resolve traffic, invoicing, and payment-related issues.
C. Reporting & Business Development
Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly sales, traffic, billing, collection, and profitability reports.
Analyse traffic volumes, revenue, costs, margins, and customer performance to identify opportunities for business growth.
Provide regular updates to management on sales activities, new interconnections, outstanding payments, route performance, and business development progress.
Work collaboratively with internal teams to improve operational efficiency, customer satisfaction, and overall business profitability.
Educational Requirements
Bachelor’s degree in any discipline.
Experience Requirements
At least 2 years of relevant experience in A2P SMS, wholesale telecommunications, carrier relations, telecom sales, billing, or account management.
Candidates with experience in both A2P SMS sales and telecom billing will be given preference.
Additional Requirements
Good understanding of A2P SMS wholesale business, SMS routing, international telecom interconnections, and commercial negotiations.
Strong sales, negotiation, communication, and relationship-management skills.
Practical experience with telecom billing, invoice preparation, SOA reconciliation, and payment follow-ups.
Proficiency in Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets for reporting, analysis, and reconciliation.
Ability to analyse business data, identify discrepancies, and resolve problems efficiently.
Self-motivated, target-oriented, organised, and capable of working independently in a remote environment.
Good written and spoken English, with the ability to communicate professionally with international customers and suppliers.
Ability to manage multiple accounts, prioritise tasks, and meet deadlines across different time zones.
Job Location
Remote / Work from Home.
Salary & Benefits
Attractive salary based on experience, skills, and industry standards.
Other benefits as per company policy.
Opportunity to work with an international wholesale telecommunications business and develop expertise in the global A2P SMS market.
Apply Now
If you have the relevant experience and are interested in developing your career in international A2P SMS sales, carrier relations, and telecom billing, we invite you to apply.
Please submit your updated CV highlighting your relevant experience in A2P SMS, telecom sales, carrier relations, and billing operations.
Additional Requirements
Age 20 to 50 years
Skills: Bulk SMS, Telecommunication, Billing, Admin and Accounts, Sales & Marketing

Job Description
Transaction Origination & Execution
•        Support the origination and execution of structured finance and syndicated lending transactions.
•        Assist in preparing indicative term sheets, financing proposals, teasers, and transaction presentations.
•        Conduct preliminary feasibility assessments of financing opportunities.
•        Assist in transaction structuring considering commercial, financial, legal, regulatory, and risk perspectives.
•        Coordinate due diligence with internal teams and external advisors.
Financial Analysis & Modeling
•        Develop and maintain integrated financial models for:
o   Project Finance
o   Corporate Finance
o   Acquisition Finance
o   Leveraged Finance
o   Refinancing transactions
•        Perform sensitivity, scenario, and stress testing.
•        Evaluate debt servicing capacity and cash flow adequacy.
•        Prepare valuation analyses using appropriate methodologies where applicable.
Credit & Risk Analysis
•        Analyze financial statements, business performance, industry outlook, and sponsor strength.
•        Assess project risks and mitigation measures.
•        Review security structures and collateral coverage.
•        Prepare comprehensive credit analysis supporting financing recommendations.
Documentation & Approval Process
•        Assist in preparing:
o   Credit Memorandum
o   Investment Memorandum
o   Board Papers
o   Executive Committee Papers
o   Syndication Information Memorandum
•        Coordinate internal approval processes.
•        Liaise with Legal, Risk Management, Compliance, Treasury, Operations, and Relationship Teams.
Syndication & Agency Support
•        Support lender identification and syndication activities.
•        Coordinate information sharing with participating financial institutions.
•        Assist in organizing lender meetings and management presentations.
•        Support financial close and post-closing documentation.
Market Research
•        Monitor:
o   Banking sector developments
o   Interest rate movements
o   Capital markets
o   Infrastructure and project finance opportunities
o   Regulatory changes
•        Prepare sector research and market intelligence reports.
Portfolio Monitoring
•        Monitor performance of completed transactions.
•        Track covenant compliance and financial performance.
•        Prepare periodic portfolio review reports.
•        Identify early warning signals and recommend corrective actions.

•        Maintain effective communication with:
o   Clients
o   Sponsors
o   Consultants
o   Lawyers
o   Technical Advisors
o   Development Finance Institutions (DFIs)
o   Multilateral Agencies
o   Participating Banks

o   Structured Finance

o   Credit Risk

o   Project Finance

Financial modeling using Microsoft Excel.
Credit risk assessment.
Corporate valuation techniques.
Cash flow forecasting.
Project finance analysis.

Excellent Microsoft Office skills (Excel, PowerPoint, Word).

:

High attention to detail.
Excellent written and verbal communication.
Ability to work under pressure and meet tight deadlines.
Strong interpersonal and stakeholder management skills.
Team-oriented with a proactive mindset.
High ethical standards and professional integrity.

Kholosh
Customer Support & Order Processing Executive (E-commerce)
Application Deadline: Nov 7, 2026
Vacancy: 1
Age: 18 to 35 years
Location: Dhaka (Dhanmondi)
Salary: Tk. 15000 - 15000 (Monthly)
Published: Oct 28, 2026
Workplace
Work at office
Employment Status
Full Time
Application
Online
Job Description
Kholosh is a premium custom phone case brand. We’re hiring someone to run day-to-day order operations from our office in Dhanmondi.
What you’ll do:
Call customers to confirm orders before dispatch
Process orders from our website, Messenger and Instagram, and book them with the courier
Keep stock records accurate and flag low stock early
Reply to customer messages and handle delivery issues, complaints and returns, escalating when needed
We’ll train you on our systems and process.
কাজের দায়িত্ব:
ডিসপ্যাচের আগে কাস্টমারকে ফোন করে অর্ডার কনফার্ম করা
ওয়েবসাইট, Messenger ও Instagram থেকে আসা অর্ডার প্রসেস করা এবং কুরিয়ারে বুক করা
স্টকের হিসাব সঠিক রাখা এবং স্টক কমে এলে আগেভাগে জানানো
কাস্টমারের মেসেজের উত্তর দেওয়া এবং ডেলিভারি সমস্যা, অভিযোগ ও রিটার্ন সামলানো, প্রয়োজনে ঊর্ধ্বতনকে জানানো
আমাদের সিস্টেম ও কাজের প্রক্রিয়া আমরা শিখিয়ে দেব।
Additional Requirements
Age 18 to 35 years
Speaks clearly and politely on the phone. A large part of this job is phone calls.
Responsible, punctual and careful with details
Proactive: raises problems without waiting to be asked
Comfortable with computers, smartphones and basic spreadsheets
Experience in e-commerce operations, customer service or a call center is a plus. Freshers with a good academic or work record will also be considered.
যাকে খুঁজছি:
ফোনে স্পষ্ট ও ভদ্রভাবে কথা বলতে পারেন। এই কাজের বড় অংশই ফোন কল।
দায়িত্বশীল, সময়নিষ্ঠ এবং খুঁটিনাটি বিষয়ে যত্নশীল
নিজে থেকে উদ্যোগী: সমস্যা চোখে পড়লে বলার অপেক্ষা না করে জানান
কম্পিউটার, স্মার্টফোন ও বেসিক স্প্রেডশিট ব্যবহারে স্বচ্ছন্দ
ই-কমার্স অপারেশন, কাস্টমার সার্ভিস বা কল সেন্টারে অভিজ্ঞতা থাকলে অগ্রাধিকার। নতুন হলে আগের কাজ বা পড়াশোনায় ভালো রেকর্ড থাকলেও বিবেচনা করা হবে।
Skills: Call Center Operation, Courier, Customer Service, Customer Support through Phone, eCommerce Operation, Inventory Management, MS Excel, Order processing
Company Address: House 1/A, Citi Tower, Road 13, Dhanmondi, Dhaka

Job Description
OMC HEALTHCARE (PVT.) LTD
., a concern of OMC Group, is a cGMP certified world class standard manufacturer of medical device for local and international market. OMCH has vast experience in medical device market with effective partnership with globally renowned multinational companies. OMCH provides the highest standards of corporate environment to build up your career. We are looking for an organised and detail-oriented Executive – Sales Admin & MIS to support our Sales Administration Department. The role involves preparing sales reports, monitoring sales team activities, handling incoming calls, and coordinating with relevant departments to ensure timely resolution of customer complaints and sales returns.
Job Responsibilities
Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly sales reports, target-versus-achievement reports, and management summaries.
Maintain accurate sales databases, customer records, and departmental documents.
Monitor sales representatives’ attendance, customer visits, daily activities, and report submissions according to company procedures.
Collect sales updates and follow up on missing reports, pending tasks, and incomplete information.
Receive incoming phone calls, respond professionally to inquiries, and communicate issues to the relevant persons.
Record customer complaints and sales return requests, including supporting documents and expected resolution dates.
Coordinate with Sales, Accounts, Warehouse, Delivery, and other relevant departments to resolve complaints, returns, and operational issues.
Follow up on return approvals, collection of returned goods, receipt confirmation, and related account adjustments, where applicable.
Track each complaint and return request until resolution, maintain updated status records, and escalate overdue cases.
Communicate progress to customers or sales representatives and confirm resolution before closing cases.
Check and reconcile sales data, identify discrepancies, and report issues to the supervisor.
Perform other relevant duties assigned by management.
Additional Requirements
Age 25 to 35 years
Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including PivotTables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, SUMIFS, and charts.
Working knowledge of Microsoft Word, email, and office applications.
Familiarity with ERP, CRM, or sales management software will be an added advantage.
Good verbal and written communication skills in Bangla and English.
Professional telephone etiquette and customer-handling skills.
Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and accuracy in data entry and reporting.
Ability to prioritize work, meet deadlines, and follow up consistently.
Ability to work with multiple departments and escalate unresolved matters promptly.
Responsible, proactive, and able to maintain confidentiality.
At least 2 years of experience in Sales Administration, MIS, Sales Coordination, or a similar role.
Experience in preparing sales reports and coordinating with multiple departments is required.
Experience handling customer complaints and sales returns will be preferred.
Compensation & Other Benefits
T/A,Tour allowance
Salary Review: Yearly
Festival Bonus: 2
Additional Allowances. Long Term Benefits- Provident Fund and Gratuity. Earned leave encashment. Phone allowance.
Result oriented, self-motivated candidate with strong interpersonal skills to lead & manage the team will be offered attractive compensation package.
Other benefits as per company policy.

Youngone Materials
Assistant Officer/Officer - Internal Audit
Application Deadline: Nov 5, 2026
Age: At least 24 years
Location: Dhaka (Savar EPZ)
Salary: Negotiable
Experience: At least 2 years
Published: Oct 28, 2026
Requirements
Education
Postgraduate in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or a related discipline.
CA Course Completed (CC) / Articled students, or ACCA/CIA/CMA/CPA/CIMA Partly Qualified candidates will get preference.
Strong academic foundation with consistent academic performance.
Workplace
Work at office
Employment Status
Full Time
Application
Online
Job Description
Participate in risk-based operational, process, and financial audits at factory and field level under the guidance of senior auditors, including process walkthroughs and preparation of Risk and Control Matrices (RCM).
Perform control testing, vouching, and substantive procedures on transactions and supporting documents; assist in data analysis to identify risk areas and control gaps.
Conduct physical verification of inventory, fixed assets, and cash, and take part in stock counts at warehouses and production floors.
Check compliance with company policies, SOPs, and factory financial transactions, including material consumption, wastage, and variance tracking.
Prepare clear audit working papers, document findings with evidence, and assist in drafting audit reports and practical recommendations.
Support the investigation team in reviewing cases arising from various sources.
Assist in preparing investigation plans and carry out assigned fieldwork with quality and timeliness.
Take part in interviews with witnesses and relevant personnel while maintaining strict confidentiality.
Collect, preserve, and organise evidence from documents, systems (SAP S/4 HANA), and site visits.
Analyse datasets using MS Excel/ERP reports to spot irregularities, unusual patterns, and root causes.
Assist in preparing factual investigation reports with practical recommendations for corrective action.
Coordinate with HR, Legal, Compliance, and other departments during audits and investigations.
Help identify fraud risks in day-to-day operations and suggest preventive controls.
Maintain organised and secure audit and case documentation with professionalism and confidentiality.
Additional Requirements
Age At least 24 years
High level of integrity and professional ethics; good communication skills in Bangla and English.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Basic knowledge of internal control and audit procedures.
Position may be upper/lower based on skills, competencies, experience and ability to work.
Basic knowledge of VAT, Tax, Accounting Standards (IFRS/IAS) and Auditing Standards.
Good command of MS Excel and MS Office; knowledge of ERP/SAP will be an added advantage.
Willingness to do frequent field visits to factories, warehouses, and sites, and to work on the production floor as required.
Eagerness to learn, ability to work in a team and independently, and to meet deadlines.
Compensation & Other Benefits
Provident fund,Mobile bill,Insurance
Lunch Facilities: Partially Subsidize
Festival Bonus: 2
Salary Review: Yearly
Company Address: Plot 4.5 - 8 & 12.5-16, DEPZ , Ashulia, Savar, Dhaka
Company Business
Backward linkage of Textile/ Garments.

bdjobs.com/h/details/1549117?ln=1.source_content:
Baraka InfraCo Solar Power Limited (A JVCo by Baraka Group & PIDG)
Executive, HR
Application Deadline: Nov 10, 2026
Vacancy: 1
Age: 24 to 30 years
Location: Dhaka
Salary: Negotiable
Experience: At least 3 years
Published: Oct 28, 2026
Requirements
Education
Bachelor’s degree in Human Resource Management, Business Administration, Management, or a related discipline.
Additional Qualification: An MBA or Postgraduate Diploma (PGD) in Human Resource Management (HRM) will be considered an added advantage.
Workplace
Work at office
Employment Status
Full Time
Application
Online
Job Description
Context:
The HR Executive manages daily HR and administrative activities for our Solar IPP joint venture, from hiring and employee records to labor-law compliance and JV requirements. Reporting to the MD, this hands-on role partners with project teams, site management, and external stakeholders to keep people operations running smoothly.
We are looking for a sharp, organized, and self-motivated professional who thrives under tight project deadlines and takes full ownership of results.
Baraka InfraCo Solar Power Limited is committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce.
Job Responsibility:
Talent Acquisition & Onboarding:
Manage the full recruitment cycle: job postings, sourcing, screening, interview coordination, offers, and joining formalities. Coordinate with recruitment agencies and build a talent pipeline for technical, project, and corporate roles (solar engineering, EPC, asset operations). Conduct smooth onboarding and induction for new hires, including documentation and orientation.
HR Policy & Compliance:
Draft & update and implement HR policies, the employee handbook, and SOPs. Ensure compliance with local labor laws and JV governance requirements; maintain statutory records and handle liaison with labor authorities. Keep employee files and contracts accurate, confidential, and audit-ready.
Payroll, Benefits & Compensation Support:
Prepare and verify monthly payroll inputs (attendance, leave, overtime, deductions) and coordinate with Finance for timely processing. Administer employee benefits, allowances, and incentives. Support salary benchmarking and compensation reviews with market data.
Performance Management:
Coordinate performance appraisal activities and KPI setting aligned with business objectives, including appraisal schedules, documentation, follow-ups, and record maintenance. Track appraisal completion, compile results, and report to the MD. Support initiatives related to employee engagement, workplace discipline, productivity, and professional development.
Training & Development:
Identify training needs with department heads and organize programs (e.g.: HSE, project management, leadership, and technical skills). Maintain training records and monitor training budgets.
Employee Relations & Culture:
Serve as the first point of contact for employee queries, grievances, and conflict resolution. Promote a positive, inclusive, and high-performance work culture; support employee engagement activities.
Administrative & Site Support:
Oversee corporate administrative functions and coordinate closely with Plant/Site Managers to ensure seamless welfare, transport, and administrative support for site-based teams.
HRIS, Reporting & Communication:
Maintain and update the HRIS and payroll systems; ensure data accuracy. Prepare regular HR reports and dashboards (headcount, attrition, hiring status, attendance, training) for the MD. Act as the HR contact for JV partner representatives, ensuring professional and timely communication.
Additional Requirements
Age 24 to 30 years
At least 3 years of relevant HR experience, with exposure to handling multiple HR areas independently within the power sector, renewable energy, infrastructure, or a structured multinational/joint-venture environment.
Good command of written and spoken English and Bangla.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, Teams, Outlook, PowerPoint, HRIS, and HR reporting.
Sound knowledge of HR operations, recruitment, payroll coordination, Bangladesh Labour Act, and HR documentation.
Strong organizational, communication, analytical, problem-solving, and interpersonal skills.
Must be proactive, smart, detail-oriented, self-motivated, and capable of working independently with minimal supervision.
Women are encouraged to apply, equal opportunity for qualified candidates.
Skills: Communication and interpersonal skill, Continuous Improvement, Energetic and self-motivated, Organizing, Proactive and Positive attitude, Professional Development, Quick learner, Working under pressure
Compensation & Other Benefits
Festival Bonus: 2
Lunch Facilities: Partially Subsidize
Other Benefits: As per company policy

Sr. Executive - Procurement
Application Deadline: Nov 26, 2026
Age: 25 to 45 years
Location: Dhaka (Kadamtali, Shyampur)
Salary: Tk. 20000 - 30000 (Monthly)
Experience: At least 3 years
Published: Oct 28, 2026
Requirements
Education
Bachelor/Honors
Workplace
Work at office
Employment Status
Full Time
Application
Online
Job Description
Procurement & Purchasing Operations
Handle day-to-day purchasing activities for factory operations, production, maintenance, administration, and other departments.
Procure mechanical spare parts, electrical items, industrial equipment, lubricants, refractory materials, consumables, tools, safety equipment, and general supplies as required.
Receive and review purchase requisitions from different departments and verify specifications, quantities, urgency, and supporting documents.
Obtain quotations from suitable suppliers and prepare comparative statements covering price, quality, delivery time, payment terms, and other relevant conditions.
Negotiate prices, payment terms, delivery schedules, warranties, and other commercial conditions to achieve the best value for the company.
Prepare purchase orders in accordance with approved requisitions, quotations, budgets, and delegated authority.
Follow up with suppliers to ensure timely delivery of ordered goods and services.
Coordinate with Production, Maintenance, Electrical, Mechanical, Store, Accounts, Commercial, and Administration departments to ensure uninterrupted operations.
Arrange urgent procurement for critical production and maintenance requirements while following the company's approval procedures.
Maintain proper procurement documentation from requisition to purchase order, delivery, and payment processing.
Supplier & Vendor Management
Identify, evaluate, and develop reliable suppliers, manufacturers, dealers, and service providers.
Maintain an updated supplier database containing contact details, product categories, pricing, payment terms, and performance records.
Develop alternative supplier sources to reduce dependency on individual vendors and minimize procurement risks.
Build and maintain professional relationships with suppliers while ensuring transparency and fairness in all transactions.
Review market prices regularly to identify competitive purchasing opportunities.
Cost Control & Commercial Negotiation
Ensure cost-effective procurement without compromising quality, safety, or operational requirements.
Negotiate competitive rates, discounts, credit facilities, transportation costs, and favorable payment terms.
Identify opportunities for bulk purchasing, framework agreements, and long-term supplier arrangements where commercially beneficial.
Monitor procurement expenditure against approved budgets and report significant price variations to management.
Prevent unnecessary purchases, duplicate orders, overstocking, and unauthorized commitments.
Inventory & Store Coordination
Coordinate with the Store Department to verify stock availability before initiating new purchases.
Review minimum stock levels, reorder requirements, consumption patterns, and critical spare-part availability.
Ensure timely replenishment of essential materials to prevent production interruptions.
Monitor slow-moving, obsolete, and excess inventory and recommend appropriate purchasing controls.
Ensure that supplied materials match the approved specifications, quantities, and purchase order terms.
Documentation & Reporting
Maintain accurate records of purchase requisitions, quotations, comparative statements, purchase orders, delivery challans, invoices, and supplier correspondence.
Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly procurement reports as required by management.
Maintain purchase-price histories and supplier performance records for future reference and analysis.
Track pending requisitions, outstanding purchase orders, overdue deliveries, and urgent procurement requirements.
Coordinate with Accounts to verify supplier invoices, purchase orders, goods receipt records, and payment terms before payment processing.
Prepare procurement summaries showing purchase values, cost savings, pending orders, and supplier-wise transactions.
Ensure that procurement records are properly maintained for internal and external audits.
Compliance, Transparency & Internal Control
Follow the company's procurement policy, approval hierarchy, financial limits, and established purchasing procedures.
Ensure that purchases are supported by authorized requisitions and appropriate management approvals.
Maintain transparency in supplier selection, quotation comparison, price negotiation, and purchase order issuance.
Avoid conflicts of interest and immediately report any suspected irregularities, fraudulent quotations, kickbacks, or unethical supplier practices.
Ensure that no purchase commitment is made beyond the employee's delegated authority.
Coordinate with relevant departments to resolve procurement disputes and maintain compliance with applicable laws and company policies.
Protect confidential commercial information, supplier quotations, negotiated prices, and company purchasing data.
Additional Requirements
Age 25 to 45 years
Only Male
Skills: Communication, Negotiation, Purchase/ Procurement
Company Address: Address: Road - 21, Plot - 32, Shyampur, Kadamtali I/A, Dhaka- 1204, Bangladesh.
Company Business
RRM Group is imbued with a forward looking vision to acquire a global perspective and become a first rate business conglomerate. RRM Group has a strong reputation history in adding value to its customer and relationships maintaining standard quality product. The pursuit of business excellence is our standard norms and significant focus on innovations, continuous research & development is our standard practice on national interest. Among the 16 concerns, The Rani Re-Rolling Mills Ltd. has a track record in manufacturing of mild steel structural Re-bars products in Bangladesh since 1997.

iSocial is a policy-driven, for-profit social enterprise delivering impact through data-driven insights, strategic advocacy, and innovative digital solutions.

DataSense – Research, policy, and data analytics arm.
Junction Bangladesh – Venture studio and ecosystem-building unit supporting startups and enterprises.
