Job Overview
iSocial Limited is seeking a proactive, organized, and experienced professional to serve as Senior Executive/Assistant, Finance & Admin. The selected candidate will support the organization’s financial management, accounting, administrative operations, procurement, compliance, and reporting functions.
The role requires strong financial and administrative skills, attention to detail, sound organizational ability, and proficiency in Microsoft Office and accounting/financial management systems.
Job Nature And Modality:
Full-time (Sunday through Thursday)
Key Responsibilities
Manage day-to-day banking operations in accordance with company policies and procedures.
Process bills and prepare payment, receipt, and journal vouchers.
Prepare monthly and annual cash flow statements and financial reports.
Record banking transactions, payments, loan adjustments, and other financial transactions.
Prepare and submit monthly VAT & Tax returns and assist in VAT & Tax-related matters.
Support internal and external audits and prepare required documentation.
Support budgeting, financial planning, cash flow management, and budget monitoring.
Monitor actual expenditure against approved budgets and prepare variance explanations and management reports.
Provide administrative and operational support for smooth functioning of the organization.
Assist in implementing and monitoring organizational policies, procedures, office rules, and administrative decisions.
Support procurement activities, including obtaining quotations, preparing comparative statements, purchase documentation, vendor coordination, and payment follow-up.
Assist in managing office assets, inventory, stationery, and other organizational resources.
Support corporate affairs and regulatory matters, including coordination with RJSC, banks, government offices, regulatory authorities, and other relevant institutions as assigned.
Perform other administrative, procurement, corporate affairs, and operational duties assigned by the AGM, Operations.
Additional Requirements
Minimum 2 years of relevant experience in finance and administration.
Experience in accounting, financial reporting, budgeting, procurement, and administrative operations.
Good knowledge of Tax and VAT compliance and financial documentation.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly MS Excel and MS Word.
Experience with accounting/ERP software such as Tally Prime or similar systems will be preferred.
Core Competencies
Strong analytical, numerical, and financial management skills
Excellent organizational and time-management skills
Strong interpersonal, communication, and negotiation skills
Ability to maintain confidentiality and handle sensitive information
Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities
Commitment to compliance, accountability, and organizational standards
Ability to work effectively in a dynamic and fast-paced environment
Compensation & Other Benefits
Salary: BDT 30,000 - 40,000 monthly (based on experience and competency)
Subsidized lunch
Two festival bonuses
Mobile/communication allowance, where applicable
Compensatory leave for working extra hours and weekends or holidays
Professional exposure to national and international development and ecosystem initiatives

bdjobs.com/h/details/1550039?ln=1.source_content:
Truvalu.enterprises Limited
Researcher (Blended Finance)
Application Deadline: Nov 7, 2026
Location: Dhaka
Experience: At least 3 years
Published: Oct 29, 2026
Requirements
Education
Bachelor`s or Master`s in Finance, Economics, Business Administration, Social Science, Sustainable Development or other relevant fields.
Employment Status
Contractual
Job Description
JOB CONTEXT
Truvalu
is a Netherlands-based impact investment company engaged in developing small, growing businesses through equity investment, business development services (“BDS”), and other relevant business advisory services in several emerging economies in Asia, East Africa, and South America. Truvalu employs a unique `Co-entrepreneurship` model that strives to improve the economic viability of businesses through capital, BDS, strategic coaching, access to finance, access to markets and networks, and access to knowledge and technology. Through a tailor-made set of BDS and investments, enterprises are intended to grow to full business maturity to increase overall social impact.
Truvalu Bangladesh
invites applications from professionals with a solid grounding in investment principles to lead and strengthen its research activities. This is a short-term role that calls for strong skills in research, understanding of financial instruments and structures, report writing and editing, and data analysis, along with excellent written and verbal communication in both English and Bangla.
JOB RESPONSIBILITIES
The successful candidate will lead a qualitative study on blended finance in Bangladesh, examining how blended finance structures can operate in the local context, the roles of different capital providers, opportunities and barriers that shape their use, and how it can scale up. This will involve designing the study, conducting key informant interviews with investors, financial institutions, development partners and enterprises, and synthesising the findings into a clear, evidence-based report. Specific responsibilities include:
Review programme documents and finalise the study scope, research questions and analytical framework with the Research and Knowledge Management team.
Prepare an inception report with the methodology, stakeholder sampling plan, interview guides for each stakeholder group, and a week-by-week work plan.
Map the blended finance landscape locally and globally: deals, funds and facilities that combine concessional and commercial capital, with the instruments they use (first-loss tranches, guarantees, concessional debt, technical assistance facilities, impact-linked financing, and results-based incentives) and the sectors they reach.
Review the regulatory and policy environment that shapes these structures. This covers Bangladesh Bank refinance and green finance schemes, rules on foreign capital and repatriation, fund registration requirements, and currency risk.
Assess which blended finance structures fit the Bangladeshi context, for which enterprise segments and ticket sizes, and why.
Review comparable emerging markets to find blended finance models that have reached scale, and assess which features could work in Bangladesh.
Analyse the roles of the different capital providers, such as catalytic, anchor and commercial. Identify where their incentives align, where they conflict, and what makes a structure workable for each.
Develop practical pathways for scaling blended finance, setting out what is needed from investors, FIs, development partners and regulators.
Identify stakeholders relevant to the study and conduct key informant interviews with them.
Capture each stakeholder`s risk appetite, return expectations, decision criteria and the role it is willing to play in a blended structure.
Keep interview notes, consent records and an evidence log in line with Truvalu’s data protection standards.
Draft an analytical report which should reach clear conclusions from the perspective of each stakeholder rather than only describing the landscape.
Support the team in turning the findings into shorter knowledge products, such as a policy brief, an article or a presentation.
The job responsibilities outlined above serve as a general outline for the position. While efforts have been made to encompass key duties, the role may encompass additional responsibilities beyond those explicitly stated to align with the evolving needs of the projects/programmes and the organisation. The organisation reserves the right to adjust, add, or remove responsibilities to meet strategic objectives and adapt to changing circumstances.
JOB LOCATION, MODALITY, AND DURATION
Location:
Dhaka, Bangladesh
Contract type:
Full-time, short-term
Duration:
3 months
Additional Requirements
At least 3 years of experience in research, analysis or advisory work in development finance, impact investing, banking or the SME finance sector.
Demonstrated experience leading qualitative research from design to final report, including developing interview guides, conducting key informant interviews and synthesising findings.
A strong understanding of financial instruments and structures such as concessional debt, guarantees, first-loss capital, equity and results-based finance. You should be able to explain how these combine in blended finance structures.
Familiarity with Bangladesh’s financial sector and regulatory environment, including the roles of Bangladesh Bank, commercial banks, NBFIs, investors and development partners.
A track record of published or client-facing analytical reports, policy papers or research publications.
Capacity to facilitate and communicate with different stakeholders, both internal and external.
Intermediate skills in data collection, quantitative and statistical analysis, and clear data visualisation.
Ability to work independently while also contributing effectively within a team environment.
Compelling presentation and influencing skills.
Compensation & Other Benefits
Negotiable (competitive salary package based on competency and experience).
Company Address: Road 30, House 16 (3rd floor) Gulshan 1, Dhaka 1212
Company Business
Truvalu.enterprises Limited is a Netherlands-based impact investment company that provides entrepreneurship development training and supports SMEs through equity investment, BDS, and other relevant business advisory services in various emerging economies across Asia, East Africa, and South America. Truvalu employs a unique Co-entrepreneurship model that strives to improve the economic viability of SMEs through capital, BDS, strategic coaching, access to finance, access to markets and networks, and access to knowledge and technology.

Job Description
আমরা একজন দক্ষ অডিট এক্সিকিউটিভ খুঁজছি, যিনি শুধু হিসাব পরীক্ষা বা ভুলত্রুটি যাচাই করবেন না, বরং প্রতিষ্ঠানের সম্পূর্ণ হিসাব চক্র নিজে পর্যালোচনা করবেন। এই পদের জন্য গাণিতিক বিশ্লেষণ এবং একাউন্টিং প্রক্রিয়ার ওপর পূর্ণ জ্ঞান ও নিয়ন্ত্রণ থাকা আবশ্যক।
মূল দায়িত্ব
অ্যাডভান্সড এক্সেল ব্যবহার:
বড় ফাইল এবং ডেটা যাচাইয়ের জন্য
VLOOKUP, SUMIF এবং Pivot Tables
ব্যবহার করা। এবং অন্যান্য পারদর্শিতা থাকতে হবে।
ইনভেন্টরি অডিট:
স্টকের পরিমাণ, পণ্যের আসা-যাওয়া এবং গুদামের প্রকৃত মালের সাথে সিস্টেমের হিসাবের
Physical Inventory Count
ও অডিট করা।
জাবেদা দাখিলা পরীক্ষা:
অ্যাকাউন্টিং টিমের পোস্টিং করা
Journal Entries
এবং সাপোর্টিং ভাউচার নিখুঁতভাবে পরীক্ষা করা।
ব্যাংক রিকনসিলিয়েশন অডিট:
ব্যাংকের হিসাবের সাথে ক্যাশ বইয়ের
Reconciliation
সঠিকভাবে হয়েছে কিনা তা যাচাই করা।
স্যালারি শিট অডিট:
পে-রোল (Payroll) বা
Salary Sheet
নিখুঁতভাবে চেক করা (উপস্থিতি, বোনাস ও ওভারটাইম যাচাই)।
কোর অ্যাকাউন্টিং ও ক্লোজিং:
Month-end Closing
এবং অন্যান্য আর্থিক প্রক্রিয়া সঠিকভাবে সম্পন্ন হয়েছে কিনা তা অডিট করা।
Additional Requirements
Age 25 to 50 years
অভিজ্ঞতা:
অডিট বা ইন্টারনাল অডিটে ন্যূনতম
3 থেকে 5 বছরের
বাস্তব অভিজ্ঞতা। ক্ষুদ্রঋণ/হাসপাতাল কার্যক্রমে জ্ঞান থাকা একটি অতিরিক্ত যোগ্যতা হিসেবে বিবেচিত হবে।
সফটওয়্যার দক্ষতা:
প্রার্থীকে অবশ্যই Mysoft, Tally, ERP সহ অন্যান্য সফটওয়্যারে 3 থেকে 5 বছরের বাস্তব কাজের অভিজ্ঞতা থাকতে হবে।
এক্সেল দক্ষতা:

Job Description
Job Summary:
We are looking for a smart, proactive, and target-oriented Executive – Sales & Marketing to join our team in the automobile industry. The ideal candidate will be responsible for promoting and selling brand-new and reconditioned passenger vehicles, developing customer relationships, achieving monthly sales targets, and handling relevant vehicle documentation, including registration and bank loan processing.
Candidates with prior experience in automobile sales, particularly in selling brand-new passenger vehicles, will be highly preferred.
Key Responsibilities:
Promote and sell brand-new passenger vehicles to individual and corporate customers.
Generate new leads through customer networking, digital platforms, referrals, and other marketing activities.
Understand customer requirements and recommend suitable vehicle models, features, specifications, and pricing.
Conduct vehicle presentations, arrange test drives, and follow up with prospective customers to convert leads into sales.
Achieve monthly sales targets and contribute to the company`s overall sales growth.
Maintain strong customer relationships and provide professional pre-sales and post-sales support.
Coordinate with relevant departments to ensure smooth vehicle delivery and customer satisfaction.
Handle vehicle registration documentation and coordinate with the relevant authorities or service providers.
Assist customers with bank loan applications, documentation, follow-ups, and coordination with financial institutions.
Prepare and maintain sales reports, customer databases, booking records, payment updates, and other necessary documentation.
Monitor market trends, competitor activities, customer preferences, and pricing to identify new sales opportunities.
Perform other sales, marketing, and administrative duties assigned by management.
Additional Requirements
Age At most 40 years
Prior experience in automobile sales, especially brand-new passenger vehicles, is highly preferred.
Experience in vehicle registration procedures and bank loan processing will be an added advantage.
Freshers with strong communication, negotiation, and sales skills may also be considered.
A valid driving license and practical driving skills are mandatory.
Skills: Automobile
Compensation & Other Benefits
Salary: Negotiable, based on experience and qualifications.
Additional incentives or benefits may be offered based on company policy and sales performance.
Company Address: Borogola, Rangpur Road, Bogura Sadar, Bogura - 5800
Company Business
Japanese reconditioned vehicles importer, wholesaler and retailer with 800+ import shipment records from Japan-based sourcing networks. A regional Dealer Partner of CG Runner BD Limited.

: Generate qualified sales opportunities, increase the sales pipeline, and contribute to the company’s overall revenue growth.

Lead Generation
: Identify, research, and qualify potential customers through online research, LinkedIn, CRM databases, and other prospecting channels.
Outbound Prospecting:

: Identifying and researching potential customers (prospects) that fi t the company’s ideal customer profile

VisionSpring
Senior Accounts Executive
Application Deadline: Nov 27, 2026
Age: At least 18 years
Location: Dhaka

Published: Oct 29, 2026
Requirements
Education
Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA) in Accounting, Finance
CACC
Workplace
Work at office

Contractual

Job Description
Are you ready to use your financial and accounting expertise to restore vision for millions of people in frontier and emerging markets? Would you like to work for an organization combining the best business and social impact practices?
VisionSpring, a global social enterprise dedicated to making vision correction accessible to everyone, is seeking a motivated and detail-oriented Senior Accounts Executive, to join our Finance & Accounts team in Bangladesh.
The Senior Accounts Executive is responsible for maintaining accurate accounting records, processing financial transactions in SAP, managing vendor accounts, ensuring tax and VAT compliance, performing reconciliations, and supporting audits and statutory reporting.
The position plays a critical role in maintaining financial integrity, ensuring timely payments, and supporting the organization's financial reporting and compliance requirements. This is a full-time contractual position, and the incumbent will report to the Senior Manager, Finance and Accounts.
The individual should have sufficient knowledge and skills to:
Accuracy and timeliness of SAP transaction postings.
Timely processing and uploading of vendor bills.
Accuracy of vendor master maintenance.
Timely completion of vendor and bank reconciliations.
Accuracy of TDS and VAT calculations.
Timely filing and reconciliation of monthly VAT returns.
WHAT YOU’LL DO
Accounting and SAP Transaction Processing
·
Record and post accounting transactions accurately and timely in SAP.
·
Prepare and process journal entries, payment entries, accruals, adjustments, and reclassification entries.
Ensure all financial transactions are properly coded and supported with adequate documentation.
Review transaction documents for completeness and compliance before posting.
Assist in monthly, quarterly, and annual financial closing activities.
Processing and Payment Administration Invoice
Review, verify, and upload vendor bills into SAP for payment processing.
·
Ensure invoices are approved according to the delegated authority matrix and organizational policies.
Monitor payment schedules and coordinate timely vendor payments.
Follow up with internal stakeholders regarding missing or incomplete documentation.
·
Maintain proper records of all processed payments and supporting documents.
Vendor Master Data Management
·
Create, update, and maintain vendor master records in SAP.
·
Verify vendor information and supporting documentation before creating new vendor accounts.
·
Ensure vendor master data is accurate, complete, and regularly updated.
·
Conduct periodic reviews of vendor records to prevent duplication and data inconsistencies.
Vendor Ledger Reconciliation
·
Perform regular reconciliation of vendor ledgers.
·
Investigate and resolve discrepancies between vendor statements and organizational records.
·
Reconcile supplier balances and ensure timely clearance of outstanding items.
·
Maintain reconciliation schedules and supporting documentation.
Bank Reconciliation and Cash Management
Prepare daily bank reconciliation statements and investigate variances.
·
Monitor daily bank transactions and ensure timely recording in SAP.
·
Coordinate with banks regarding transaction-related issues and unresolved discrepancies.
Maintain updated bank balances and cash position reports.
Tax, TDS, and VAT Compliance
Calculate Tax Deducted at Source (TDS) and Value Added Tax (VAT) applicable to vendor payments.
·
Ensure accurate deduction of taxes and VAT in accordance with Bangladesh tax and VAT regulations.
·
Prepare schedules for TDS and VAT payments.
·
Maintain tax deduction records and support documentation.
Coordinate with relevant authorities and stakeholders regarding tax-related matters when required.
VAT Return Preparation and Compliance
·
Prepare monthly VAT schedules and supporting reports.
Assist in filing monthly VAT returns within statutory deadlines.
Reconcile VAT payable, input VAT, and VAT returns with accounting records.
Maintain VAT registers, challans, submission records, and supporting documents.
·
Support compliance with all applicable VAT regulations and reporting requirements.
Financial Reconciliations and Reporting
·
Prepare account reconciliations including vendor, bank, tax, VAT, and other control accounts.
Generate SAP reports and support schedules for management review.
Assist in preparing monthly financial reports and analysis.
Support month-end and year-end closing procedures.
Audit Support
Provide accounting records, schedules, reconciliations, and supporting documents for internal and external audits.
Extract and compile financial data from SAP in required formats.
Prepare audit schedules and respond to auditor queries.
Support implementation and follow-up of audit recommendations.
Ensure timely submission of audit-related information and documentation.
Internal Controls and Compliance
Ensure compliance with VisionSpring financial policies, procedures, and internal controls.
Maintain proper filing and achieving accounting records.
Support continuous improvement of accounting processes and controls.
Protect confidentiality of financial information and organizational records.
Other Duties
Support finance team initiatives and process improvement projects.
Assist in donor reporting and grant-specific financial documentation where required.
·
Perform any other accounting and finance-related responsibilities assigned by the supervisor.
Additional Requirements
Age At least 18 years
ABOUT US
VisionSpring increases lifelong earning, learning, safety, and well-being through eyeglasses for people vulnerable to poverty.
We believe in the wonder of clear vision for everybody.
We sell and deliver radically affordable optical products and services and develop markets for eyeglasses—a 700-year-old technology that has failed to reach 1 billion people in need of vision correction, most of whom live on less than $4 a day.
We serve low-income consumers, not as beneficiaries but as customers. Our customers expect quality, affordable products and eyecare services, and will spend limited discretionary income for the immediate and tangible benefits of vision correction.
As a social enterprise, we are purpose first. We blend philanthropic and earned revenue, draw on non-profit and business practices, and use sales and efficiency metrics and social impact measures to bring vision correction to ever more people.
We catalyze collaborative action in an expansive, multisector partner network and use our evidence and experience to influence systems change and close the global clear vision gap.
We believe in scaling our impact, not our organization. We are a lean team of doers.
Compensation & Other Benefits
Weekly 2 holidays,Insurance,Mobile bill
Festival Bonus: 2
Company Address: Symphony Tower, Level 5, Block - A, Plot SE(F) 9, Road - 142, South Avenue, Gulshan 1, Dhaka 1212, Bangladesh.
Company Business
VisionSpring creates access to affordable eyewear, everywhere, because clear vision creates opportunities for increased earning, learning, safety, and civic participation, and improved quality of life. As a social enterprise, we hold mission and business goals in constructive tension. While we judge our global performance on social impact measures, our focus on sales and revenue targets ensures we grow effectively and efficiently.

bdjobs.com/h/details/1550222?ln=1.source_content:
AR Malik Seeds Private Limited
Territory Sales Officer
Application Deadline: Nov 28, 2026
Age: 28 to 35 years
Location: Anywhere in Bangladesh
Salary: Negotiable
Experience: 2 to 3 years
Published: Oct 29, 2026
Requirements
Education
Bachelor of Science (BSc) in Agriculture
Diploma in Agriculture
Employment Status
Full Time
Job Description
The most fundamental aspect of agriculture is the seed industry. AR Malik Seed began its journey to meet the demands of this business in the direction of high-yielding varieties and retaining genetic diversity, which will guarantee a long-term improvement in Bangladesh's agricultural output. AR Malik Seed is the industry leader in several goods, holds a sizable portion of the market and farmers largely embrace our seeds due to their high quality and yield. Our goal is to expand this company through appropriate hybrid seed use and communication of agricultural best practices.
Visit: https://malikseeds.com/
Context:
Our sales department is currently seeking a Territory Sales Officer to join our team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for promoting the company's products and services to potential customers within their assigned territory. Additionally, the candidate should possess excellent customer service skills and be capable of resolving queries in a timely manner. It is crucial for the candidate to have the ability to develop and implement effective sales techniques. They must be self-driven and focused on increasing market share through continuous sales processes. Creating opportunities to explore the market is an important aspect of this role. Prior work experience in the Sales department would be advantageous.
Responsibilities:
Maintain and expand the customer base:
Build and maintain relationships with dealers, distributors, and end users to create new customers and increase sales volume.
Visit potential customers regularly and maintain a client database.
Sales and Promotion:
Actively sell and promote the company's vegetable seed products to existing and potential customers, including farmers, retailers, distributors, and agricultural organizations.
Utilize various sales techniques and strategies to increase product awareness and generate demand.
Customer Relationship Management:
Build and maintain strong relationships with key customers and stakeholders within the territory.
Provide excellent customer service, address inquiries and concerns, and ensure customer satisfaction.
Product Knowledge and Support:
Develop a deep understanding of the company's vegetable seed products, including their features, benefits, and cultivation best practices.
Educate customers about the advantages of using the company's seeds and provide technical support when needed.
Target Orientation:
Must be target-oriented and motivated to achieve sales targets and sales growth.
Independent and Deadline-driven:
Ability to work independently and under pressure to meet targets and tight deadlines.
Collaboration:
Collaborate with other departments such as marketing, product development, and customer service to ensure coordinated efforts and provide valuable field feedback.
Sales Reporting:
Prepare and submit regular sales reports, including sales forecasts, territory performance analysis, and competitor insights.
Keep track of sales activities, customer interactions, and sales data using appropriate tools (Sales Dashboard).
Product Presentation and Solution Recommendations:
Present company products and services to prospective customers.
Identify customer needs and recommend suitable product solutions.
Sales Target Coordination:
Coordinate with the sales team to meet monthly and yearly sales targets.
Continuous Learning:
Stay updated with the latest advancements in the vegetable seed industry.
Additional Requirements
Age 28 to 35 years
Only Male
Previous experience in seed sales, agricultural products, or a related sales field is preferred.
Proven ability to achieve sales targets and develop business within the assigned territory.
Good communication, negotiation, and customer relationship management skills.
Knowledge of agricultural products, seed varieties, and local agricultural markets is an advantage.
Ability to build and maintain strong relationships with distributors, dealers, and retailers.
Must possess a valid motorcycle driving license and be proficient in motorcycle riding.
Must be willing to travel extensively within the assigned territory.
Sales or communication training is an added advantage.
Skills: Email, MS Excel, MS Word, Reporting Dashboard, Willing to Travel
Compensation & Other Benefits
T/A,Provident fund,Mobile bill
Salary Review: Yearly
Festival Bonus: 2
Participation in different training programs
Excellent career growth.
Professional Work Environment
Company Address: Plot # 15, Road # 02 Block # H, Sector # 02 Aftab Nagor, Dhaka - 1212, Bangladesh
Company Business
AR. Malik Seeds Private Limited was founded by Mr. A. R. Malik in the year of 1969. Prior to that, he served the Bangladesh Agricultural Development Corporation (BADC, then EPADC) as a Divisional Manager for about 10 years.The company started with the activities of developing a seed market in Bangladesh from the world?s reputed foreign seed companies. We are still continuing as such; but in addition, they have been involved with the research based marketing of Vegetable Seeds, Seed Potatoes and other various seed items since 1982.We have an experienced and highly professional board of directors and well organized marketing networks including renowned agriculturist of the country. In addition, a successful team of experienced technical personnel, combined with a large number of Seed Distributors and Dealers with a strong network covering entire Bangladesh making our company uniquely positioned for a strong positive growth.

Build Your Career in Card Sales
Position:
Card Sales (Contract)
Job Grade: Assistant Relationship Officer
Job Context:
National Bank PLC.
invites applications from energetic, customer-oriented, and target-driven individuals for the position of
Assistant Relationship Officer
in its
Card Division
. The successful candidates will be responsible for expanding the Bank’s card business by promoting Credit Cards and other card products, acquiring new customers, achieving assigned sales targets, and ensuring excellent customer service. They will also be expected to maintain strict adherence to the Bank’s internal policies, procedures, and applicable regulatory requirements.
Key Responsibilities:
Promote and sell credit cards and other card products through direct sales, customer referrals, corporate partnerships, and other approved acquisition channels.
Identify and develop new business opportunities, acquire potential customers, and achieve assigned sales targets.

1–2 years of experience

aged 32 years

Job Description
Are you a female graduate from an English-medium educational background looking to start your professional career in sales, communication and business development?
Join Advance IPSC to develop your communication and sales skills, gain valuable professional experience, and build a rewarding career in the international professional education industry.
ABOUT ADVANCE IPSC
Advance Institute of Procurement & Supply Chain Ltd. (Advance IPSC) is a professional education and training organization specializing in Procurement, Supply Chain and Logistics.
Since 2009, Advance IPSC has been committed to developing professionals through globally recognized qualifications, industry-focused training and practical learning.
As an Authorized Study Center of ASCM and CIPS-UK, we help professionals advance their careers through internationally recognized professional certifications.
JOB DETAILS
Position: Sales & Telesales Executive
Employment Type: Full-Time | In-House
Location: Gulshan-1, Dhaka, Bangladesh
Working Days: 5 Days a Week
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
Make outbound calls to prospective students worldwide and follow up with incoming leads.
Promote and sell ASCM and CIPS-UK professional certification programs.
Promote corporate training programs to B2B clients.
Counsel prospective students and understand their educational and professional backgrounds.
Recommend suitable certification programs based on candidates' career goals.
Explain course details, fees, learning options, examination procedures and enrolment processes.
Follow up consistently through phone calls, WhatsApp and other communication channels.
Convert prospective students into successful enrolments.
Handle sales enquiries, objections and negotiations professionally.
Work towards monthly sales and enrolment targets.
Maintain accurate lead sheets and follow-up records.
Build professional relationships with prospective students and working professionals.
Coordinate with the Admissions, Academic and Admin teams to ensure a smooth enrolment process.
Additional Requirements
Age 22 to 30 years
Only Female
Eligibility: Female Candidates Only
Experience: Freshers Are Strongly Encouraged to Apply
ELIGIBILITY & REQUIREMENTS
Female candidates only.
Fresh graduates and candidates with no prior professional experience are strongly encouraged to apply.
Excellent spoken and written English communication skills.
Good command of Bangla.
Confidence in communicating with prospective students and professionals over the phone in English.
Strong interpersonal, convincing, negotiation and follow-up skills.
Energetic, self-motivated and target-oriented attitude.
Basic computer skills and familiarity with Microsoft Office or Google Workspace.
Willingness to work full-time, in-house at our Gulshan-1 office in Dhaka.
Previous experience in telesales, education sales, student counselling, admissions or business development will be an advantage, but it is not mandatory.
Skills: Communication and interpersonal skill, Fluent in English, Self-confident, Telesales
Compensation & Other Benefits
Weekly 2 holidays,Mobile bill,Performance bonus
Festival Bonus: 2
WHAT WE OFFER
• Competitive Salary
• Attractive Sales Incentives of Up to USD 150 Per Successful Sale
• Professional and Supportive Working Environment
• Career Growth and Development Opportunities
• Training and Guidance for Professional Success
• Opportunity to Work with Internationally Recognized ASCM and CIPS-UK Certifications
• Exposure to the Global Procurement, Supply Chain and Professional Education Industry
Company Address: Advance Institute of Procurement and Supply Chain (Advance IPSC) is a professional education and training organization specializing in procurement, supply chain management, logistics, and professional development. The organization is an approved Study Partner of CIPS-UK and ASCM-US.
Company Business
Established in 2009, Advance PSC provides competency-based training and professional qualification programs for individuals and organizations across the private, public, and government sectors. The organization is an approved Study, Exam, and Global Distance Learning Partner of CIPS-UK (Chartered Institute of Procurement and Supply) and an authorized learning partner of ASCM (Association for Supply Chain Management). Advance PSC focuses on practical, industry-oriented learning, helping professionals develop the technical knowledge, strategic capabilities, and professional qualifications needed to advance their careers and improve organizational performance. Core Areas: • Procurement & Purchasing • Supply Chain Management • Logistics & Operations • Professional Certifications • Corporate Training • Competency Development • Executive & Professional Education

Full Time

Job Description
About Concord Stem Cell Limited
Concord Stem Cell Limited (formerly known as TotiCell Health & Research) is the first DGDA-approved and cGMP-compliant stem cell manufacturer and treatment center in Bangladesh, specializing in cell-based regenerative therapeutics for unmet medical needs.
Our work encompasses stem cell manufacturing, orthobiologics, platelet-based therapies, and related clinical services. Our marketing prioritizes scientific accuracy, responsible patient education, ethical communication, healthcare professional engagement, and measurable performance.
Position Overview
We seek a skilled, analytical, results-oriented digital marketing professional to plan, execute, monitor, and optimize campaigns; strengthen brand visibility; generate qualified patient inquiries; improve advertising returns and conversion; and coordinate with Call Center, Customer Service, Clinical, and Business Development teams. The role requires hands-on expertise in paid media, social media, healthcare content, SEO, analytics, CRM integration, and optimization, with accountability for measurable outcomes, compliance, and patient trust.
Key Responsibilities
Strategy and campaign planning.
Develop monthly and quarterly strategies, campaign plans, budgets, content calendars, and channel activities aligned with CSCL objectives. Research audiences, competitors, markets, and opportunities; plan patient education, physician engagement, institutional awareness, and lead generation for approved or appropriately authorized services. Agree objectives, KPIs, budgets, and expectations with management.
Performance marketing and paid advertising.
Independently manage Meta Ads across Facebook, Instagram, and relevant placements, and Google Search, Display, YouTube, and appropriate remarketing. Develop segmentation, targeting, retargeting, and funnels; A/B test creatives, copy, headlines, audiences, landing pages, and conversion paths. Monitor spend, lead quality, CPL, cost per qualified lead and appointment, acquisition cost, and reliably attributable revenue; recommend evidence-based budget reallocation. Implement or coordinate Meta Pixel, Conversions API, Google Tag Manager, and GA4 events.
Social media and content.
Manage official Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, YouTube, and relevant channels. Maintain monthly editorial calendars and consistent branding; create or coordinate posts, reels, videos, infographics, animations, interviews, and service explainers. Work with doctors and researchers on accurate education; coordinate photography, production, design, copywriting, approvals, audience engagement, and performance improvement.
Website management and SEO.
Coordinate website updates, service and educational pages, landing pages, inquiry forms, and appointment journeys. Conduct keyword research, on-page and local SEO; coordinate indexing, metadata, internal links, technical performance, and mobile usability. Use Search Console and GA4 to assess visibility and behavior; maintain Google Business Profile and directory accuracy, and resolve functionality and tracking issues with IT and vendors.
Lead generation and conversion.
Coordinate timely inquiry handling, source tracking, attribution, CRM integration, lead routing, and follow-up automation. Monitor inquiry-to-qualified-lead, appointment, consultation, and service uptake; assess lead quality, booking, attendance, and conversion trends. Address bottlenecks in targeting, messaging, landing pages, and lead handling; support approved, privacy-conscious AI and automation.
Analytics reporting and budget control.
Prepare daily monitoring summaries and weekly/monthly reports on spend, impressions, reach, frequency, CTR, CPC, CPM, CPL, qualified leads, and conversions. Compare planned versus actual spend and outcomes; summarize efficiency, funnel performance, and utilization. Work with Data Analytics on Power BI and management reporting; present actionable recommendations and maintain campaign, creative, budget, result, and optimization records.
Healthcare compliance and brand governance.
Obtain internal clinical/content approvals; follow applicable DGDA requirements, healthcare advertising rules, platform policies, and company standards. Avoid unsupported claims, guaranteed outcomes, exaggerated efficacy, and misleading comparisons. Distinguish approved indications from investigational applications; use patient images, testimonials, medical information, and cases only with appropriate consent and authorization. Protect confidentiality and scientific accuracy.
Coordination and vendor management.
Work with Clinical, Call Center, Customer Service, Offline Marketing, IT, and Data Analytics. Coordinate agencies, designers, creators, production teams, and technology vendors; monitor quality, timelines, and provider performance. Support physician education, webinars, approved institutional initiatives, and continuous process improvement.
AI Use Across Digital Systems and Workflow Automation
Planning and advertising.
Evaluate and implement approved AI applications with relevant teams. Use AI for audience research, planning, creative variations, testing, analysis, and recommendations; obtain authorization before campaign launches or budget changes.
Content and creative production.
Use AI for English/Bangla copy, education, graphics, scripts, editing, subtitles, and channel adaptation; verify accuracy, originality, branding, and usage rights before publication.
Websites and SEO.
Apply AI to keyword research, briefs, search, FAQs, landing pages, and conversion analysis; ensure human review of healthcare information.
CRM and lead management.
Support approved inquiry classification, lead prioritization, assignment, reminders, interaction summaries, and attribution; monitor routing accuracy and staff follow-up.
Chatbots voice AI and communication.
Coordinate approved assistants for website chat, social messages, WhatsApp, calls, appointment requests, reminders, and routine service information. Identify automated interactions and provide reliable staff handoff.
Forms surveys and engagement.
Improve forms, feedback classification, survey summaries, webinar follow-up, and patient journey analysis while collecting only necessary information.
Analytics and reporting.
Assist data preparation, spreadsheet analysis, dashboard narratives, anomaly detection, and forecasting; validate source data, calculations, and assumptions before reporting or acting.
Integration and automation.
Coordinate approved API or automation connections across advertising, websites, CRM, appointments, communication, and reporting. Document workflows, access controls, error alerts, and manual fallbacks.
Responsible use and clinical oversight.
Use approved tools and permissions; never enter identifiable patient records, confidential information, credentials, or sensitive clinical data into unapproved services. Follow consent, retention, and approval requirements. Obtain clinical approval for AI medical content; limit patient-facing AI to approved administration and education. Escalate clinical questions; prohibit diagnosis, prescribing, eligibility decisions, or guaranteed outcomes.
Testing training and measurement.
Test before deployment, review English/Bangla outputs, monitor errors and inappropriate responses, train users, and maintain an approved tool inventory. Measure time saved, response time, routing accuracy, appointment conversion, content turnaround, failures, and cost per outcome against baselines; expand only when verified benefits justify it.
Additional Requirements
Age 30 to 40 years
Experience Requirements
Senior Executive:
Preferably 2–3 years in digital/performance marketing, with hands-on paid campaign and social media management; able to independently execute campaigns, interpret data, and prepare reports.
Assistant Manager:
Preferably 3–5 years, including strategy, campaign planning, budget management, optimization, team/vendor coordination, multiple-campaign delivery, and presenting measurable outcomes to senior management.
Candidates with exceptional practical skills and demonstrable achievements may be considered based on overall suitability.
Required Technical Skills
Meta Business Suite and Ads Manager; Google Ads and GA4; Google Tag Manager and Search Console; social media/content management; advertising strategy and optimization; SEO, keywords, and landing pages; lead generation, remarketing, and conversion tracking; Excel or Google Sheets; CRM and marketing automation familiarity; professional English and Bangla communication.
Preferred Skills and Competencies
Experience in healthcare, hospitals, diagnostics, pharmaceuticals, biotechnology, or another regulated industry; patient acquisition and appointment funnels; Power BI, Looker Studio, or similar tools; Conversions API, Google Ads conversion tracking, and UTM attribution; WordPress or comparable CMS; Canva, Adobe Creative Cloud, CapCut, or related tools; AI-assisted content, automation, and conversational marketing. Strong analytical thinking, budget discipline, communication, and project management.
Key Performance Indicators
Performance will be assessed against agreed objectives covering:
Qualified lead volume and cost per qualified lead; campaign-generated appointments and consultations.
Lead-to-appointment and appointment-to-consultation conversion rates.
Paid campaign results and budget efficiency; website traffic, organic visibility, and landing-page conversion.
Social audience growth, engagement, and content performance.
Marketing-attributed service uptake and revenue where attribution is reliable.
Timely execution, reporting accuracy, and compliance with content approvals.
Specific targets will reflect approved budgets, historical performance, and organizational priorities.
Expected Deliverables
Monthly digital marketing/advertising plan; monthly content and creative calendar; structured campaign budget and KPI tracker; weekly paid advertising optimization report; monthly dashboard or management summary; lead-generation and conversion-funnel analysis; quarterly improvement and growth recommendations.
Compensation & Other Benefits
Lunch Facilities: Partially Subsidize
Salary Review: Yearly
Festival Bonus: 2
Company Address: Sima Blossom (7th floor) , Road Number # 16(new) 27(old), House Number # 3 (new) 390 (old), Dhanmondi, Dhaka.

Universe Link, an Internet Service Provider (ISP), is seeking an experienced Accounts & HR Officer to manage daily accounting operations and support HR activities. This is a single position combining accounts and HR responsibilities, with accounting as the primary focus.

Accounts Responsibilities:
• Maintain daily income and expense records, cashbooks, ledgers, vouchers and supporting documents.

• Communicate company policies and coordinate routine employee-related administrative activities.
• Maintain confidentiality and accuracy of all financial and employee records.

Sr. Executive/Executive, Sales HealthTech

Full Time

Job Description
Job Context
We are looking for a proactive, target-oriented
Sr. Executive/Executive – Sales (HealthTech)
to identify new business opportunities, build client relationships, and drive technology sales growth.
This role is ideal for sales professionals from pharmaceutical, medical equipment, diagnostic, hospital, or other healthcare-related sectors seeking to transition into technology and enterprise sales.
Product training and guidance will be provided; candidates must be eager to learn and promote our technology solutions.
Job Responsibilities
Identify, research and approach prospective clients across relevant industries, using your sales skills and network to generate health industry (e.g. Hospital, Diagnostic Centre, Clinic) leads.
Arrange and conduct client visits, meetings, presentations and follow-ups with prospective and existing healthtech clients.
Build long-term relationships with decision-makers, business owners, department heads and other stakeholders.
Learn the company's technology products and services (software, ERP, AI, system integration, digital transformation) and explain their business value to clients.
Understand client needs and coordinate with technical and presales teams to identify suitable solutions.
Assist to manage opportunities from lead generation to proposal, negotiation and closure, with senior support where required.
Follow up regularly on leads, meetings, proposals and pending actions.
Research markets, competitors and customer needs to identify opportunities.
Support account development, cross-selling and upselling with existing clients.
Maintain accurate sales pipelines, CRM records, customer databases and reports.
Coordinate with Technical, Presales, Commercial, Finance and Delivery teams.
Use Microsoft Office, CRM and AI tools for research, communication, proposals and reporting.
Work toward assigned lead, opportunity and revenue targets.
Additional Requirements
Strong communication, presentation, negotiation and relationship-building skills.
Confidence in approaching new clients and conducting professional sales conversations.
Target-driven, persistent, with strong ownership of follow-ups and results.
Ability to build client trust, understand business needs and explain technology benefits in clear, business-focused language.
Good organizational, analytical and problem-solving skills; able to coordinate with internal teams and manage multiple opportunities.
Proficiency in MS Word, Excel and PowerPoint; familiarity with CRM tools is an advantage.
Comfortable with digital tools such as email, spreadsheets,
CRM and AI assistants.
No advanced technical background is required at entry.
A proven record of meeting or exceeding sales targets.
Experience building relationships through field visits and structured follow-ups.
Experience handling business owners, senior managers, procurement teams or other decision-makers.
Skills: Client Relationship, Communication and interpersonal skill, CRM, Market Research, Negotiation, Networking, Proactive and Positive attitude, Sales, Target Oriented, Team Coordination
Compensation & Other Benefits
T/A,Provident fund,Weekly 2 holidays,Mobile bill
Festival Bonus: 2
Lunch Facilities: Full Subsidize

Job Description
About the Role
We are looking for a detail-oriented and responsible Accounts & Audit Associate to join our team. The candidate will be responsible for assisting with accounting work, bookkeeping, preparation of financial statements, and external audit assignments.
The role involves both accounting and auditing responsibilities, including recording financial transactions, maintaining accounting records, preparing audit working papers, and supporting the completion of audit engagements.
Key Responsibilities
Accounting and Bookkeeping
Record daily financial transactions, including sales, purchases, receipts, payments, and expenses.
Prepare journal entries and maintain general ledgers, cash books, and bank records.
Perform bank reconciliations and investigate discrepancies in accounting records.
Assist in maintaining accounts receivable, accounts payable, accruals, prepayments, and fixed asset schedules.
Review source documents, including bank statements, invoices, receipts, and payment records.
Assist in preparing trial balances, income statements, balance sheets, and other financial reports.
Use SQL Accounting or other accounting software to record transactions and maintain accounting records.
Assist in preparing year-end adjustments, depreciation schedules, and supporting financial statement workings.
Audit and Assurance
Assist in conducting external audits of Malaysian companies, primarily SMEs.
Prepare audit working papers, lead schedules, audit schedules, and supporting documentation.
Perform audit testing for bank balances, revenue, expenses, payroll, receivables, payables, accruals, and fixed assets.
Verify accounting balances against available supporting documents and identify discrepancies.
Document audit findings, conclusions, remarks, and audit evidence.
Assist in identifying misstatements and preparing proposed audit adjustment entries.
Support the preparation and review of financial statements and related disclosures.
Follow up with clients for outstanding documents and coordinate with senior team members to complete assignments on time.
Additional Requirements
Age At least 24 years
Only Male
Required Skills
Basic understanding of accounting principles, double-entry bookkeeping, and financial statements.
Practical knowledge of journal entries, trial balances, and bank reconciliations.
Good knowledge of accounting software.
Strong attention to detail and analytical skills.
Good written and verbal English communication skills.
Skills: Accounting, Accounts and audit, Accounts and Finance, Audit and assurance services, Audit reporting
Company Address: EDB Trade Centre (Lift-3), 93 Kazi Nazrul Islam Avenue, Karwan Bazar, Dhaka 1215
Company Business

It is a trusted education partner that linked Bangladeshi students to the top ranked public and private universities in Malaysia, China, India, Canada, Australia and many countries. It starts its journey in 2012 with the motto of serving the nation with assisting the future leaders in choosing the best school for their higher education in home and abroad. Unlike most of the educational consultancy firms, Aims Education Solution is maintaining the core business ethics and serves the students with care. It has very distinctive and qualified management team to accomplish its mission and vision to assist the students to become a global leader with choosing the right educational institution.

Manager - Business Development (Govt. Medical College & Hospital)
Application Deadline: Nov 30, 2026
Vacancy: 1

Requirements
Education
Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Management or a related discipline.
Candidates with relevant medical technology, biomedical engineering or other healthcare-sector qualifications may also be considered.
Professional training in sales management, institutional procurement, public procurement or tender management will be an advantage.
Workplace
Work at office
Employment Status
Full Time
Application
Online
Job Description
Position Purpose / Job Context:
To develop, manage and expand Meditech Imaging Limited`s business with government medical colleges, public hospitals, specialized government healthcare institutions and other relevant public-sector healthcare organizations.
The position holder will be responsible for identifying, creating, nurturing and converting business opportunities pertinent to government institutions, developing professional institutional relationships, managing government tender participation, coordinating commercial and technical proposals, and achieving assigned sales, revenue and profitability targets.
The role requires practical experience in government institutional sales, knowledge of public procurement procedures, a proven business development track record and an established network of relevant professional contacts in the healthcare sector.
Key Job Responsibilities
A. Business Development & Sales Growth
Develop and implement sales and business development strategies for government medical colleges, public hospitals and other public-sector healthcare institutions.
Identify upcoming equipment procurement, hospital development projects, equipment replacement requirements and expansion opportunities.
Develop institutional account plans and maintain a qualified sales pipeline.
Achieve assigned sales revenue, order acquisition and gross profit targets.
Promote the company`s imported medical equipment, hospital tools, accessories and related products and services.
Prepare sales forecasts, commercial proposals, quotations and institutional business plans.
Monitor market demand, competitor activities, pricing and new business opportunities pertinent to government institutions.
B. Government Tender & Procurement Management
Regularly monitor government procurement notices, tender invitations, e-GP opportunities where applicable, purchase plans and relevant institutional procurement activities.
Understand the applicable Public Procurement Act, Public Procurement Rules, tender eligibility criteria, technical specifications, submission requirements and evaluation procedures.
Coordinate the preparation of technical documents, commercial quotations, manufacturer authorizations, eligibility documents and other required tender papers.
Ensure 100% compliance with applicable tender submission requirements and deadlines for bids approved by Management.
Maintain a tender register showing tender value, submission deadline, bid status, outcome and follow-up actions.
Coordinate with Finance and Management on bid security, performance security and other financial requirements, where applicable.
Follow up on tender evaluation, award decisions, purchase orders, delivery schedules and contractual obligations.
Review unsuccessful bids and recommend corrective actions to improve future tender performance.
C. Institutional Relationship Management
Establish and maintain professional relationships with hospital administrators, authorized procurement personnel, doctors, biomedical engineering teams and other relevant institutional stakeholders.
Develop a structured database of government medical colleges, hospitals, departments, procurement contacts and potential equipment requirements.
Conduct planned institutional visits, product presentations, demonstrations and business meetings.
Identify key decision-making processes and purchasing requirements through legitimate professional engagement.
Maintain regular follow-up with existing customers to develop repeat business and long-term institutional accounts.
Ensure that all stakeholder engagement complies with applicable laws, procurement rules and company policies.
D. Cross-Functional Coordination & Reporting
Coordinate with Technical, Installation, Service, Finance, Supply Chain and Management teams to ensure effective execution of awarded contracts.
Monitor product delivery, installation, commissioning, warranty support and after-sales service coordination.
Maintain accurate CRM records, sales pipelines, customer visit reports, tender reports and revenue forecasts.
Monitor outstanding payments and coordinate collection follow-up with the Finance Department.
Submit monthly business development and performance reports to the designated reporting authority.
Immediately report significant business risks, tender disputes, customer complaints and delays affecting contract execution.
Additional Requirements
Age 30 to 70 years
Only Male
Required Experience:
Minimum 3 years of relevant sales/business development experience, preferably in medical equipment or healthcare.·
Experience in government hospital sales, tender participation, public procurement procedures and institutional account management.
Proven sales track record, established government healthcare stakeholder relationships, and experience with medical equipment importers/distributors preferred.
Required Knowledge & Skill Set:
Knowledge of medical equipment, hospital tools, accessories and product applications.
•Understanding of government procurement procedures, tender documentation and contract management.
•Strong skills in institutional sales, business development, negotiation and account management.
•Ability to prepare commercial proposals, quotations, cost estimates and sales forecasts.
•Knowledge of market research, competitor analysis, CRM and Microsoft Office applications.
• Established professional relationships within the government healthcare sector.
•Strong communication skills in Bangla and English, with effective presentation and reporting abilities.
•Ability to coordinate with Technical, Service, Finance and Supply Chain teams.
•Strong analytical, problem-solving, planning and time-management skills.
•High standards of professional integrity, accountability and ethical business conduct.
Skills: Business Development, Govt. tender process, Institutional Sales Marketing, Medical Equipment Sales
Compensation & Other Benefits
Mobile and communication allowance.
Local travel and field visit allowance, according to approved policy.
Performance-based sales incentive or commission, subject to the approved incentive scheme.
2 Festival bonus(es):
Each bonus is equivalent to one month`s gross salary.
Annual salary review, subject to performance, policy and Management approval.
Other applicable employee benefits approved by the company.
Company Address: Location: Rangs Paramount 2,Level-4, Plot # 11, Road # 17, Banani Commercial Area, Dhaka, Bangladesh
Company Business
Distributor of Carestream, Able, Vital, Biobase Biosun Co., Ltd & Seamaty Diagnostic Co., Ltd. & WEIFANG HENGCAI DIGITAL PHOTO MATERIALS CO., LTD

Job Description
Job Overview:
PRAN-RFL Group, one of the largest and most diversified conglomerates in Bangladesh, is widely recognized for its legacy of excellence, innovation, and uncompromising commitment to quality. As part of our continued expansion in international markets, we are seeking dynamic, ambitious, and highly motivated individuals to join us as
Management Trainee Officer – Export
for Natore Zone.
This role offers a valuable opportunity to gain hands-on experience in global trade operations, export management, and international market development, while contributing to the growing global footprint of one of Bangladesh’s leading business groups.
Job Location: Pran Agro Limited, Natore
This position serves as a strong gateway for young professionals to build a solid foundation in international trade. The selected candidates will gain practical exposure to export documentation, international client coordination, and compliance with global trade regulations within a fast-paced, growth-oriented corporate environment.
Key Roles:
Coordinate and execute end-to-end export order processes, ensuring accuracy, timely shipment, and strict adherence to client specifications.
Conduct market research to identify potential export opportunities and monitor global trade trends.
Communicate effectively with international clients regarding product orders, delivery schedules, and issue resolution, ensuring compliance with international trade regulations.
Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams including production, procurement, and warehousing to align inventory and production planning with export requirements.
Identify and evaluate new international business opportunities to support strategic expansion into emerging and untapped markets.
Provide actionable insights to product development teams based on customer feedback, market demand, and industry trends.
Demonstrate willingness to be stationed at factory locations when required to monitor production readiness, ensure quality compliance, and strengthen operational coordination.
Additional Requirements
Age 24 to 32 years
Females are highly encouraged to apply.
Skills: Business Development, Customer Feedback Management, Export, Export Documentation, Microsoft Excel, Microsoft PowerPoint, Proficiency in English and Bangla
Compensation & Other Benefits
* Market standard salary (Review after 6 months probation period based on performance)
* Mobile bill, Provident fund, Commission
* Lunch and Dinner Facilities: Partially Subsidized
* Yearly salary review
* Two Festival Bonuses
* Leave Encashment
* Promising career path
* Credit purchase facilities with discounts at PRAN-RFL outlets.
Company Address: PRAN RFL Center, 105 Middle Badda, Dhaka
Company Business
RFL Group is one of Bangladesh’s largest and most diversified manufacturing conglomerates. Over its 45-year journey, RFL has become synonymous with quality and reliability. The Group offers a wide range of products, including plastics, stationery, metal, melamine, PVC, chemicals, electronics, furniture, industrial products, light engineering, and leather goods.

Position Purpose
To develop, manage and expand Meditech Imaging Limited's
Pathology Business, focusing on In Vitro Diagnostics (IVD) products, laboratory equipment, diagnostic instruments, reagents, consumables and related solutions.
The position holder will be responsible for identifying business opportunities, developing customer accounts, promoting the company's product portfolio, achieving assigned sales and profitability targets, and ensuring effective coordination of product demonstrations, installation and after-sales services.
Key Responsibilities (IVD Products)
Business Development & Sales
Develop and execute sales strategies for IVD products, diagnostic laboratory equipment, instruments, reagents, consumables and accessories.
Identify business opportunities across diagnostic laboratories, hospitals, medical colleges, pathology departments and relevant healthcare institutions.
Develop new customer accounts and expand business with existing clients.
Achieve assigned sales, revenue, order acquisition and profitability targets.
Prepare quotations, commercial proposals, sales presentations and business forecasts.
Promote the company's IVD product portfolio and identify opportunities for new product placements.
Product & Market Management
Develop a strong understanding of IVD products, including analyzers, reagents, diagnostic kits, laboratory instruments and related consumables.
Understand laboratory requirements and coordinate with technical specialists to recommend appropriate diagnostic solutions.
Monitor market demand, competitor activities, pricing trends and emerging product opportunities.
Arrange and support product demonstrations, technical presentations and customer discussions.
Gather customer feedback and communicate product-related requirements to Management and relevant departments.
Customer Relationship Management

Conduct regular customer visits and follow up on quotations, product demonstrations, negotiations and pending orders.
Develop new business relationships and maintain long-term customer accounts.
Maintain an updated customer database, visit reports, sales pipeline and account records.
Identify opportunities for repeat sales of reagents, diagnostic kits, consumables and other recurring product requirements.
Tender & Operational Coordination
Identify relevant public- and private-sector tender opportunities for IVD products and laboratory equipment.
Coordinate tender documentation, technical specifications, quotations and commercial proposals with relevant internal departments.

Education
Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA) in Marketing
Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Management, Communications or a related discipline.
Workplace
Work at office
Employment Status
Full Time
Application
Online
Job Description
About the Company
Ardent MCL
is a pioneer in multi-modal brand communication, event activation, and 360-degree marketing solutions in Bangladesh. Operating as a full-service "Idea House," Ardent MCL specializes in brand management, sports marketing, events & activations, media buying, public relations, digital marketing, production, and print communications. Having executed over 180 major events and partnered with over 100 high-profile clients, Ardent MCL continues to drive perfection and creative excellence across corporate, social, and commercial landscapes.
Position Summary
The company is searching for an innovative, result-oriented, and client-focused Executive – Marketing & Client Service. The position will require to be the crucial link between the agency and selected clients, handling all aspects of client service, marketing strategy development and implementation, and flawless execution through events, activations, media, and production campaigns.
Key Responsibilities
Client Service & Relationship Management
Be the main point of contact for the allocated client account and facilitate smooth communication with clients regularly.
Understand client’s business objectives, conduct complete briefs, and turn them into an internal brief for internal teams.
Propose strategies, campaign ideas, budgets, and post-campaign reviews to the clients.
Establish and nurture long-term and trusted relationships with corporate clients.
Marketing Strategy & Campaign Implementation
Partner with internal strategy, creativity, digital, and activation teams to create an integrated brand communications strategy.
Work on campaign launches through various media channels such as direct marketing, digital campaigns, trade marketing, PR, and event activation.
Manage the timing, deliverables, budgeting, and quality control of campaigns from conception to delivery.
Work with visual production, print, and set-up teams to ensure that client brand materials meet agency standards.
Market Research & Business Development
Explore opportunities and generate leads in the corporate, development, and commercial sectors.
Perform market research, identify trends, and analyze competitors for the benefit of developing pitch decks and proposals.
Help in formulating pitch proposals, estimate costs, and prepare commercial presentations for management.
Additional Requirements
Age 25 to 30 years
Only Male
0–3 years of relevant experience; fresh graduates are encouraged to apply.
Good Bangla and English communication, negotiation and interpersonal skills.
Proactive, self-motivated and willing to undertake frequent field visits.
Basic proficiency in MS Word, Excel and PowerPoint.
Fresh graduates with strong communication skills may apply.
Communication: Excellent verbal and written communication skills in both English and Bengali.
Project Management: Strong multi-tasking skills with the ability to manage strict deadlines and high-pressure activation environments.
Interpersonal Skills: Natural networking ability with a polished, professional demeanor.
Analytical Thinking: Ability to interpret client needs, analyze campaign metrics, and refine campaign strategies accordingly.
Tech Proficiency: Hands-on experience with MS Office (PowerPoint, Excel, Word); familiarity with digital marketing tools and social media analytics is a plus.
Candidates must own a personal motorcycle (bike) with a valid driving license. The agency will reimburse the fuel costs as actual.
Mandatory Motorcycle Requirement
Candidates must own a personal motorcycle (bike).·  A valid motorcycle driving licence is mandatory.
Must be willing to use their own motorcycle for client visits, field marketing and official assignments in Dhaka and surrounding areas.
Office will bear the necessary fuel and maintenance costs related to office assignments.
Skills: Client Service/ Marketing, Communication and interpersonal skill, Event/ Campaign Coordination, Market Research, Media & Communication, MS Office, Reporting and Documentation
Compensation & Other Benefits
T/A,Medical allowance
Festival Bonus: 2
Salary & Benefits
Competitive salary (commensurate with experience and track record).
Attractive performance-based incentives and sales bonuses, Festival bonuses, Mobile allowance and official travel support.
Professional development and rapid career progression opportunities in an expanding creative environment.
Fuel and conveyance allowance as per company policy.
Company Address: 87 Purana Paltan Line, Suite # 601, Paltan Tower, (6th Floor), Dhaka-1000, Bangladesh
Company Business
Ardent MCL is a Marketing and Communication based company who are providing services in different governmental and nongovernmental sectors since 1998.

is a growing and diversified business group with operations in the healthcare sector. Our healthcare network includes multiple
Medical & Diagnostic Center
, providing a wide range of medical, diagnostic, laboratory, imaging, health screening and patient care services.
As part of our continued business expansion, we are looking for energetic, confident, target-oriented and result-driven
Executives/Sr. Executives
Marketing
to strengthen our Marketing & Business Development team. The selected candidates will be responsible for promoting healthcare services, developing new business opportunities, maintaining professional relationships with doctors and healthcare stakeholders, developing corporate clients and increasing patient flow across our Medical Centers and Sara Hospital & Diagnostics.
Job Responsibilities:
Develop and implement effective marketing strategies to promote all Diagnostics Center.
Promote hospital, diagnostic, laboratory, imaging, health check-up, medical packages and other healthcare services to potential customers.
Identify new business opportunities and develop strategies to increase patient flow, service utilization and revenue.
Build and maintain strong professional relationships with doctors, consultants, physicians, clinics, hospitals, pharmacies and other healthcare professionals.
Conduct regular visits to doctors, clinics, hospitals, corporate offices, institutions and other potential business locations.
Develop and maintain an effective doctor, referral and healthcare professional network to generate patient referrals.
Identify and approach potential corporate clients, organizations, institutions, factories, schools, universities and other establishments for healthcare service partnerships.
Develop and maintain strong relationships with corporate decision-makers, HR/Admin representatives and institutional clients.
Promote corporate health check-up packages, diagnostic packages, medical services, employee health screening and other healthcare programs.
Arrange corporate meetings, presentations and service proposals to develop new business opportunities.
Develop corporate partnerships and institutional business opportunities in coordination with management.
Generate qualified leads through field marketing, corporate visits, doctor networking, referrals and other marketing activities.
Conduct regular field visits to increase market coverage and establish the organization’s presence in targeted areas.
Introduce healthcare facilities, diagnostic services, medical packages and promotional offers to prospective clients and referral sources.
Follow up regularly with existing and potential clients, doctors, corporate organizations and referral sources to convert leads into business.
Organize and participate in health camps, medical camps, corporate health programs, awareness campaigns, seminars and promotional events.
Support the planning and execution of marketing campaigns for new services, diagnostic packages, health check-up packages and other healthcare programs.
Coordinate with internal departments to ensure smooth execution of corporate health programs, campaigns and promotional activities.
Conduct market research to identify customer needs, market trends, competitor activities and potential business opportunities.
Collect market intelligence through field visits, client meetings and customer interactions and provide relevant feedback to management.
Build and maintain long-term relationships with existing and potential clients to ensure repeat business and customer retention.
Understand client requirements and coordinate with concerned departments to provide appropriate healthcare service solutions.
Collect customer and client feedback and communicate relevant issues to the concerned departments for necessary action.
Coordinate with Hospital Administration, Diagnostic, Laboratory, Radiology, Billing, Customer Service and other relevant departments for client requirements.
Maintain an updated database of doctors, clinics, hospitals, corporate clients, institutions, referral sources and business leads.
Prepare daily, weekly and monthly reports on field visits, doctor meetings, corporate meetings, leads, referrals, client follow-ups and business performance.
Monitor individual marketing performance against assigned targets and take necessary actions to achieve business objectives.
Achieve assigned monthly, quarterly and annual marketing, sales and business development targets.
Maintain proper documentation of marketing activities, client communications, meetings and follow-up status.
Represent the organization professionally in meetings, seminars, health camps, corporate events and other external activities.
Support branding and promotional activities to strengthen the market presence and reputation of the Medical Centers and Sara Hospital & Diagnostics.
Explore new marketing channels, referral sources and partnership opportunities to expand healthcare services.
Work closely with the Marketing & Business Development team to achieve overall organizational goals.
Provide regular updates to the reporting manager regarding market activities, business opportunities, challenges and achievements.
Perform any other marketing, sales, business development or promotional activities assigned by the management.
Additional Requirements
Age At least 21 years
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
Strong relationship-building, networking and negotiation skills.
Target-oriented, energetic and result-driven personality.
Strong client-handling and presentation skills.
Willingness to conduct regular field visits.
Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
Ability to work under pressure and achieve assigned targets.
Good command of both Bangla and English.
Basic knowledge of MS Word, MS Excel, PowerPoint and Email.
Professional appearance, positive attitude and strong work ethics.
Strong organizational and time-management skills.
Ability to maintain confidentiality and professional relationships with clients and healthcare professionals.
Skills: Sales & Marketing, Market Research, Client Service/ Marketing, Market/ Consumer Research

As per company policy.

Job Description
Pharmacy Onboarding: Identify, approach, and onboard pharmacies to the MyPharma B2B App.
B2B Sales: Generate wholesale orders from registered pharmacies and achieve monthly sales targets.
Client Relationship Management: Build and maintain strong relationships with pharmacy owners and regular customers.
Wholesale Order Management: Collect orders, verify product availability, and coordinate with the operations team for timely delivery.

Target Achievement: Meet assigned monthly targets for pharmacy onboarding, order generation, and sales revenue.
