Islamic Relief Bangladesh
Assistant Admin and Logistics Officer, Humanitarian Crisis Response
Application Deadline: Nov 8, 2026
Vacancy: 1
Age: At least 18 years
Location: Noakhali (Hatiya)
Salary: Tk. 69228 (Monthly)
Experience: At least 3 years
Published: Nov 1, 2026
Requirements
Education
BBA/ Bachelor in Supply Chain Management or Accounting or any other relevant discipline.
Workplace
Work at office
Employment Status
Full Time
Application
Online
Job Description
To ensure efficient and effective Management of inventory functions - 60%
Maintain accurate records of all incoming and outgoing goods, equipment, and materials in the store.
Ensure timely updates of inventory ledgers, stock cards, and electronic systems.
Conduct regular stock reconciliations and physical stock checks to ensure consistency.
Monitor inventory levels to avoid overstock or shortages and place replenishment orders as required.
Collaborate with Vendors for the timely arrival of new stock.
Oversee the receipt of goods and materials, ensuring they meet quality and quantity specifications.
Ensure that all dispatched goods are properly documented, including waybills and delivery notes.
Arrange proper labelling and storage of received goods, ensuring the FIFO (First-in, First-Out) method is adhered to.
Supervise loading and unloading activities to prevent damage and ensure safety.
Ensure the store is well-organised, clean, and maintained according to safety and storage standards.
Implement proper storage practices to prevent contamination or spoilage of rice fortification materials.
Maintain a well-documented filing system for inventory reports, receipts, dispatches, and other relevant records.
Ensure appropriate labelling and categorisation of materials for easy tracking.
Ensure that all materials and equipment stored in the warehouse comply with IRB quality standards.
Report any discrepancies, damages, or expired goods promptly to the supervisor for appropriate action.
Ensure compliance with IRB`s guidelines on hygiene, safety, and environmental protocols in the warehouse.
Generate weekly and monthly inventory reports and submit them to the line management.
Prepare stock consumption reports, highlighting trends and any anticipated shortages or excesses.
Maintain up-to-date records of all inventory movements in digital formats for easy access and retrieval.
To support the overall logistics operations and local procurement of the project - 20%
Prepare procurement plan as per approved budget by the support of project management.
Assist with the logistics and procurement activities of the program.
Collection of quotations from the enlisted local vendors, CS making, bill summaries, and preparation of GSRN other supporting documents with bills and vouchers.
Send and track payment requests and address any logistics issues related to payments.
Maintain the numbering list for Purchase Requests (PR), MR, GDN & GRN.
Help requesters with specifications, costs, and timing to acquire goods.
To provide administrative as per project needs and ensures effective coordination and communication within the organization and with other stakeholders - 15%
Assist in the creation and maintenance of framework agreements & do required Communication,
Maintain a transparent, honest, and supportive communication structure with colleagues to ensure they are informed of applicable logistical activities and requirements.
Maintain regular contact relationships with ARRRC and Navy offices for facilitating different approvals and certifications
Facilitate ARRRC & Navy approval for project implementation and field visits.
Ensure the CFM process at all stages of the project. Contribute to handling the Complaint and Feedback Mechanism (CFM), and maintain the CFM logbook.
Identify lessons learned, good practices, and share these with the project and management team.
Ensure the visibility of the project at different stages and levels and ensure media coverage for donors.
Other requirements - 5%
Participate & be involved with seasonal programs (Ramadan, Qurbani, Winterization, etc.) activities.
Ensure the safety of team members from any harm, abuse, neglect, harassment, and exploitation to achieve the program`s goals on safeguarding implementation and act as a key source of support, guidance, and expertise on safeguarding. for establishing a safe working environment.
Being a member of Islamic Relief as a child-friendly organization, it is the core responsibility and obligation of each staff member to understand and obey IR Child Protection & PSEA Policy and respond accordingly as and when required.
Perform any other duties assigned by the Supervisor.
Additional Requirements
Age At least 18 years
The incumbent will be based in Bashanchar.
Person Specification:
Essential:
Experience
Minimum 3 years working Experience in Warehouse, Procurement, Administration, Program support, Store and stock management, administrative support in Humanitarian Response/Development sector.
Working experience in humanitarian response/FDMN context is highly preferred.
Core Competencies
Strong skills in Project Implementation Skill, Project Management, Reporting & Documentation Skill, Monitoring & Evaluation Skill, Communication & Networking. Financial Management, activity management & communication networking.
Demonstrated teamwork and collaboration skills.
Excellent in problem-solving abilities, Conflict Resolution & Decision Making.
Positive attitude and willingness to collaborate effectively within teams.
Commitment to IR Values: Sincerity, Excellence, Social Justice, Custodianship, and Compassion.
Demonstrates a high level of integrity and professionalism.
Committed to self-development, continuous learning and quality improvement; displays self-confidence and self-motivation.
Willingness to adapt to IR’s norms and values.
Commitment to the organization’s vision and mission.
Skills in planning, analytical/decision making.
Knowledge of personal Health, Safety and Security.
Excellent in Leadership and Interpersonal/Behavioral skill.
Self-confidence & Self-motivation.
IT Skills
Proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and internet applications.
Basic knowledge of database management and kobo toolbox.
Ability to handle basic hardware/software troubleshooting.
Language Requirements
Strong proficiency in reading, writing, speaking, and listening in both English, Bengali and Chittagong dialect.
Desirable
Ability to understand Social/Community Mobilization Skill, facilitation skills.
Sound knowledge in coordination/networking/communication skills.
Other Requirements
Willingness to travel frequently and work in Bangladesh’s most remote areas.
Skills: Administrative Support, Development Sector, FDMN Setting, Humanitarian Response, Procurement, Stock Management, Store Management, Warehouse Management
Compensation & Other Benefits
A consolidated salary will be provided.
No other benefits will be entitled apart from accommodation, mobile bill, tour allowance/Per-diem, insurance coverage (IPD, OPD, Life, DB, CIB), Leave (Annual, Casual, Sick, TOIL/CTO, R&R, Maternity, Paternity) etc.
Company Address: Bangladesh Country Office: House # 10, Road # 10, Block-K, Baridhara, Dhaka-1212
Company Business
Islamic Relief Worldwide (IRW) - founded in 1984 and based in Birmingham, UK - is an independent humanitarian and development organization. It supports the world’s most vulnerable people in their fight against poverty & sufferings regardless of race, political affiliation, gender, or belief, and without expecting anything in return. It is a signatory to the Code of Conduct for the International Red Cross and Red Crescent Movement. IRW has a presence in 45 countries across the globe. Some funds of the organization come from individual donations and others from institutional donors such as the DFID, EU, SIDA, CIDA/IDRF, Forum Syd, WFP, UNDP, and ECHO. Islamic Relief(IR) started working in Bangladesh in 1991 in order to help the distressed survivors of the devastating cyclone by providing emergency relief and supporting communities to rebuild in the wake of that cyclone. Initially, it focused on emergency relief & disaster preparedness activities. Later on, it expanded its programs on both humanitarian and development challenges. Now it works in an integrated manner combining emergency humanitarian assistance, short-term work opportunity, shelter support, awareness & training on different DRR, climate change, development, health & hygiene and social issues, cash grant, IGA means, health & nutrition, safe water & sanitation, education, advocacy and linkage with different service providers. As a registered charity, IR is open and transparent; it continually assesses its work and operational methods to improve impact and effectiveness. Islamic Relief values and commitment to safeguarding: IRB is committed to preventing any type of unwanted behavior at work including sexual harassment, exploitation and abuse, lack of integrity, and financial misconduct; and committed to promoting the welfare of children, young people, adults, and beneficiaries with whom IRB engages. IRB expects all staff and volunteers to share this commitment through our code of conduct. We place a high priority on ensuring that only those who share and demonstrate our values are recruited to work for us. All offers of employment will be subject to satisfactory references and appropriate screening checks, which can include criminal records checks. IRW also participates in the Inter-Agency Misconduct Disclosure Scheme. In line with this Scheme, we will request information from job applicants’ previous employers about any findings of sexual exploitation, sexual abuse, and/or sexual harassment during employment, or incidents under investigation when the applicant left employment.

Skills: Administrative Support, Development Sector, FDMN Setting, Humanitarian Response, Procurement, Stock Management, Store Management, Warehouse Management
Compensation & Other Benefits
A consolidated salary will be provided.
No other benefits will be entitled apart from accommodation, mobile bill, tour allowance/Per-diem, insurance coverage (IPD, OPD, Life, DB, CIB), Leave (Annual, Casual, Sick, TOIL/CTO, R&R, Maternity, Paternity) etc.
Company Address: Bangladesh Country Office: House # 10, Road # 10, Block-K, Baridhara, Dhaka-1212
Company Business
Islamic Relief Worldwide (IRW) - founded in 1984 and based in Birmingham, UK - is an independent humanitarian and development organization. It supports the world’s most vulnerable people in their fight against poverty & sufferings regardless of race, political affiliation, gender, or belief, and without expecting anything in return. It is a signatory to the Code of Conduct for the International Red Cross and Red Crescent Movement. IRW has a presence in 45 countries across the globe. Some funds of the organization come from individual donations and others from institutional donors such as the DFID, EU, SIDA, CIDA/IDRF, Forum Syd, WFP, UNDP, and ECHO. Islamic Relief(IR) started working in Bangladesh in 1991 in order to help the distressed survivors of the devastating cyclone by providing emergency relief and supporting communities to rebuild in the wake of that cyclone. Initially, it focused on emergency relief & disaster preparedness activities. Later on, it expanded its programs on both humanitarian and development challenges. Now it works in an integrated manner combining emergency humanitarian assistance, short-term work opportunity, shelter support, awareness & training on different DRR, climate change, development, health & hygiene and social issues, cash grant, IGA means, health & nutrition, safe water & sanitation, education, advocacy and linkage with different service providers. As a registered charity, IR is open and transparent; it continually assesses its work and operational methods to improve impact and effectiveness. Islamic Relief values and commitment to safeguarding: IRB is committed to preventing any type of unwanted behavior at work including sexual harassment, exploitation and abuse, lack of integrity, and financial misconduct; and committed to promoting the welfare of children, young people, adults, and beneficiaries with whom IRB engages. IRB expects all staff and volunteers to share this commitment through our code of conduct. We place a high priority on ensuring that only those who share and demonstrate our values are recruited to work for us. All offers of employment will be subject to satisfactory references and appropriate screening checks, which can include criminal records checks. IRW also participates in the Inter-Agency Misconduct Disclosure Scheme. In line with this Scheme, we will request information from job applicants’ previous employers about any findings of sexual exploitation, sexual abuse, and/or sexual harassment during employment, or incidents under investigation when the applicant left employment.

BRAC
Employment Officer, NSEZ Project, Skills Development Expert
Application Deadline: Nov 10, 2026
Location: Chattogram (Mirsharai)
Experience: At least 2 years
Published: Nov 1, 2026
Requirements
Education
Bachelor/Honors
Workplace
Work at office

Contractual
Application
Online
Job Description
BRAC is an international development organisation founded in Bangladesh that partners with over 100 million people living with inequality and poverty globally to create sustainable opportunities to realise potential.
Working at BRAC is not like any other job. It is a platform where you can bring about real change for people who need it the most. We are not just dreaming of a better world, we are building it. Join us to find the way.
About The Project:
BRAC, with funding support from the National Special Economic Zone Development Project of Invest Bangladesh authority, will be providing technical training to unemployed youth, aiming to boost employment opportunities in the industrial zone established at the National Special Economic Zone (NSEZ) in Mirsarai, Chattogram. Under this 14-month program, 1,500 individuals will receive demand-driven technical training aligned with the current labor market, social development training, and post-training job placement assistance.
About The Job:
The Senior Officer, Employment (Employment Officer) will support the planning, coordination, and execution of employment facilitation services under the Skills and Social Development (SSD) Program at the National Special Economic Zone (NSEZ), Mirsharai. The role focuses on industry liaison, job matching, coordinating factory-based On-the-Job Training (OJT), and tracking post-placement retention for project beneficiaries to achieve sustainable wage and self-employment outcomes.
Key Responsibilities:
Establish and maintain working relationships with investor industries, factory management, and HR teams in NSEZ and adjacent industrial areas, and coordinate employer orientations, factory visits, and local job fairs to connect trainees with hiring enterprises.
Continuously collect real-time job openings and entry-level workforce requirements from investor factories to align placement opportunities with training cohorts.
Coordinate factory-based On-the-Job Training (OJT) placements and match certified TVET and skills training graduates with relevant wage-employment opportunities based on their Individual Beneficiary Records (IBRs) and career plans.
Facilitate linkages with formal microfinance institutions and entrepreneurship development platforms to support beneficiaries pursuing self-employment or micro-enterprises.
Conduct follow-up visits and assessments for at least three months after placement to track beneficiary retention and collect and verify employment evidence, including appointment/joining letters, workplace ID cards, and wage records.
Monitor workplace conditions to verify compliance with Bangladesh Labor Law, decent work standards, and World Bank ESS2 requirements, including safe working conditions and anti-harassment/GBV safeguards.
Maintain and update real-time beneficiary employment and tracking records in the project MIS and support the Employment Services Expert in preparing weekly, monthly, and quarterly employment progress reports.
Support the documentation and resolution of employment-related feedback through the project’s Grievance Redress Mechanism (GRM).
Safeguarding Responsibilities:
Ensure the safety of Programme Participants, people who come into contact with the organisation and team members from any harm, abuse, neglect, harassment and exploitation including sexual exploitation and abuse (SEA) to achieve the programme's goals of safeguarding implementation. Act as a key source of support, guidance and expertise on safeguarding for establishing a safe working environment.
Practice, promote and endorse the issues of safeguarding policy among team members and ensure the implementation of safeguarding standards in every course of action.
Follow the safeguarding reporting procedure in case any reportable incident takes place and encourage others to do so.
**This position is open for Bangladeshi nationals only.
**BRAC does not charge any fees at any stage of the recruitment process.
Additional Requirements
At least 2–3 years of hands-on experience in employment services, job placement, corporate/industry liaison, TVET/skills development projects, or youth livelihood initiatives.
Prior experience working with industrial sectors (e.g., RMG, light engineering, electrical, manufacturing) or economic zones/EPZs is a strong advantage.
Demonstrated relationship-building and interpersonal negotiation skills with commercial employers and enterprise HR departments.
Proficiency in MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) and mobile/digital data collection tools.
Good oral and written communication skills in both English and Bangla.
Familiarity with the local socio-economic context of Chattogram/Mirsharai (ability to communicate in the local dialect is advantageous).
Skills: Communication and interpersonal skill, Negotiation Persuasion Skills
Compensation & Other Benefits
Festival Bonus, Health and Life Insurance, and others as per policy.
Company Address: BRAC Centre, 75 Mohakhali, Dhaka-1212
Company Business
BRAC is an international development organisation founded in Bangladesh that partners with over 100 million people living with inequality and poverty globally to create sustainable opportunities to realise potential.

National AgriCare (NAC) is Bangladesh's leading agrochemicals and seeds company, dedicated to enhancing agricultural productivity and sustainability. With a strong commitment to farmers and the environment, we've been leading the way in shaping the future of agriculture. Agrigate Network Limited
Executive- Internal Audit
Application Deadline: Nov 10, 2026
Vacancy: 2
Location: Dhaka
Experience: At least 1 years
Published: Nov 1, 2026
Requirements
Education
Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA) in Accounting, Finance
Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or Business Administration from a recognized university.
Must be currently pursuing Chartered Accountancy (CA) under a recognized CA firm.
Candidates undergoing CA Articleship will be highly preferred.
A strong academic understanding of accounting, auditing, taxation, and financial management is expected.
Workplace
Work at office
Employment Status
Full Time
Application
Online
Job Description
Department:
Internal Audit
Job Location:
Head Office, Baridhara, Dhaka
About the Position
Agrigate Network Limited is seeking a dedicated, analytical, and detail-oriented professional to join its Internal Audit team as an Executive. The selected candidate will be responsible for reviewing financial and operational activities, assessing internal control systems, identifying potential risks and irregularities, and ensuring compliance with organizational policies and procedures.
Candidates who are currently pursuing Chartered Accountancy (CA), particularly those undergoing Articleship, are strongly encouraged to apply. Individuals with knowledge or practical experience in Contract Broiler Farming (CBF), agriculture, livestock, or other agro-based business operations will receive additional preference.
Key Responsibilities
Conduct regular internal audits of financial, operational, and administrative activities to ensure accuracy, transparency, and compliance.
Examine financial transactions, bills, vouchers, invoices, payment records, ledgers, and other relevant supporting documents.
Review and evaluate existing internal control systems, financial procedures, and operational processes to identify weaknesses and recommend improvements.
Monitor compliance with company policies, approved budgets, financial guidelines, and established procedures.
Conduct field visits to farms, branches, project sites, and other operational locations to verify records, transactions, inventories, and business activities.
Review Contract Broiler Farming (CBF) operations, including farm-related expenses, production records, feed consumption, payment transactions, and other operational activities.
Identify financial discrepancies, operational irregularities, potential fraud risks, and areas of non-compliance.
Prepare audit observations, working papers, findings, and comprehensive audit reports for management review.
Coordinate with relevant departments to obtain necessary documents, explanations, and supporting information during audit activities.
Follow up on previously identified audit findings and monitor the implementation of corrective measures.
Assist in developing and strengthening internal audit procedures, risk management practices, and organizational control mechanisms.
Perform any other audit-related responsibilities assigned by management.
Why Join Agrigate Network Limited?
Agrigate Network Limited operates across multiple segments of the agro-based business sector, including Contract Broiler Farming, Egg Trading, Contract Fish Farming, Supply Chain Management, and other agricultural initiatives. Joining our Internal Audit team will provide an opportunity to gain practical exposure to diverse business operations, strengthen professional expertise, and contribute directly to organizational transparency, accountability, and sustainable growth.
Additional Requirements
Only Male
Experience & Additional Requirements
0–3 years of relevant professional experience. Candidates with limited experience but strong academic and technical knowledge are encouraged to apply.
Practical knowledge or understanding of Contract Broiler Farming (CBF), livestock management, agriculture, fisheries, or agro-based business operations will be considered a significant advantage.
Sound understanding of accounting principles, auditing procedures, financial documentation, and internal control systems.
Good analytical, numerical, and problem-solving abilities with strong attention to detail.
Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Word, and other relevant office applications.
Ability to prepare professional audit reports, identify discrepancies, and present findings effectively.
Strong communication, interpersonal, and coordination skills.
Willingness to undertake field visits and travel to different operational locations when required.
High level of integrity, confidentiality, accountability, and professional ethics.
Compensation & Other Benefits
T/A,Tour allowance,Mobile bill,Medical allowance
Salary Review: Yearly
Festival Bonus: 2
Salary: Negotiable (Based on qualifications and experience)
Competitive and negotiable salary based on qualifications, experience, and competency.
Corporate Health Insurance coverage.
Two Festival Bonuses annually.
Annual salary review based on organizational policy and performance.
Professional learning and career development opportunities.
Exposure to diverse business operations and practical audit experience.
Collaborative and professional working environment.
Other admissible benefits as per company policy.
Company Address: H-09, R-14, Block-K, Baridhara Diplomatic Zone, Dhaka-1212
Company Business
Agrigate is a pioneering agri-tech startup working on leveraging technology to provide advisory and marketplace solutions to a wide range of stakeholders in the agricultural sector in Bangladesh. We are committed to the sustainable development of rural communities, mainly farmers and rural entrepreneurs by utilizing technology to revolutionize information delivery, input sourcing and output sales supported by our Agrigate platform which consists of multifaceted service delivery channels, augmenting in person services delivered via our strategically located Agrigate centers with our proprietary app and web-based services. In order to implement this bold vision, Agrigate is engaged in building a robust supply chain network by working with companies who espouse our ethos of quality over profits thereby building an enriched ecosystem for all stakeholders in our platform. We believe that as a result, our platform will become an indispensable medium for farmers and rural entrepreneurs to connect with each other, with companies and the wider agricultural community to engage in various economic activities. To this end, Agrigate is working with farmers, input sellers, rural entrepreneurs, companies and business partners to contribute to the development of a rich ecosystem for the users of our platform.

The selected candidate will oversee day-to-day hospital operations, coordinate clinical and non-clinical departments, supervise human resources, manage budgets and resources, ensure regulatory compliance, and maintain high standards of patient care and service quality. The Hospital Manager will work closely with hospital management, medical leadership, and departmental teams to ensure efficient operations, financial sustainability, staff accountability, and continuous institutional development.
Key Responsibilities:
Overall Hospital Administration and Operations
Lead and supervise the overall administrative and operational activities of the hospital.
Ensure smooth, efficient, and uninterrupted delivery of hospital services.
Develop, implement, and monitor hospital policies, standard operating procedures (SOPs), and operational plans.
Establish clear accountability, reporting mechanisms, and performance standards across departments.
Human Resource and Staff Management
Supervise staff recruitment, duty rosters, attendance, discipline, performance, and productivity in coordination with hospital management.
Ensure appropriate staffing, effective deployment of human resources, and professional conduct across departments.
Promote teamwork, staff development, accountability, and a positive working environment.
Address staff-related concerns and workplace issues fairly and professionally.
Clinical Coordination and Patient Services
Coordinate with consultants, doctors, nurses, medical officers, and other healthcare professionals to support effective patient care.
Monitor patient satisfaction, service quality, waiting times, complaints, and overall service delivery.
Facilitate coordination among OPD, IPD, Emergency, Laboratory, Radiology, Pharmacy, and other hospital services.
Support clinical leadership in implementing patient safety standards and improving the quality of care.
Financial Management, Budgeting and Procurement
Monitor hospital revenue, operational expenditure, billing performance, and resource utilization.
Assist in preparing budgets, financial forecasts, and periodic management reports.
Supervise procurement, inventory control, equipment maintenance, and supply-chain management.
Identify opportunities to reduce unnecessary costs, improve efficiency, and strengthen financial sustainability.
Ensure transparency and accountability in financial and administrative processes.
Regulatory Compliance, Quality and Patient Safety
Ensure compliance with applicable government regulations, hospital licensing requirements, and relevant healthcare standards.
Coordinate with the appropriate authorities regarding licensing, inspections, documentation, and regulatory requirements.
Monitor infection prevention and control (IPC), waste management, workplace safety, and emergency preparedness in coordination with responsible departments.
Support quality assurance, risk management, internal audits, and continuous improvement initiatives.
Infrastructure and Resource Management
Ensure proper maintenance and utilization of hospital buildings, medical equipment, furniture, utilities, and other facilities.
Monitor inventory, essential supplies, and equipment availability.
Coordinate timely maintenance and repairs to minimize service interruptions.
Ensure a clean, safe, organized, and patient-friendly hospital environment.
Strategic Planning and Institutional Development
Translate management decisions into actionable operational plans and measurable outcomes.
Identify opportunities to improve hospital services, patient experience, operational efficiency, and revenue generation.
Prepare periodic operational reports, performance analyses, and recommendations for hospital management.
Support the development of new departments and services according to institutional priorities and available resources.
Stakeholder Communication and Reporting
Maintain effective communication with the Chairman or authorized hospital leadership, medical leadership, staff, suppliers, and relevant stakeholders.
Present regular updates on hospital performance, operational challenges, financial indicators, and improvement initiatives.
Represent the hospital professionally in administrative meetings and official communications when authorized.
Perform other management responsibilities assigned by the competent hospital authority.
Job Highlights
Main Purpose:
To provide effective leadership and ensure the overall operational, administrative, financial, and service-management excellence of Al-Aqsa Hospital while maintaining patient satisfaction, staff accountability, regulatory compliance, and sustainable institutional growth.
This is a key leadership position.
The selected candidate will be expected to demonstrate ownership, sound judgment, professional integrity, and the ability to make timely decisions in the best interests of the hospital and its patients.
Additional Requirements
Age 25 to 35 years
Medical Diploma or relevant health background.
Hospital/NGO project management experience in Cox's Bazar Rohingya context.
Ability to communicate and coordinate effectively with both Rohingya and Host Communities.
Skills: Communication and interpersonal skill, crisis management, Hospital management, Microsoft Excel, Microsoft Word, Team Management & Supervision, Well disciplined and productivity focused
Company Address: Town Hall Mor, Maijdee, Noakhali

Job Description
Company Overview:
PalmPay is a leading neobank and fintech platform scaling financial inclusion across emerging markets. With over 40 million users, we are building a digital financial ecosystem that empowers individuals and businesses through accessible, easy-to-use, and rewarding financial services.
Operating in Nigeria, Ghana, Tanzania, Bangladesh, Pakistan, and the Philippines, PalmPay has been recognised by CNBC as one of the Top 300 Global Fintech Companies and ranked #2 overall and #1 in financial services on the Financial Times’ Africa’s Fastest Growing Companies 2025 list.
Position Overview:
The Anti-Fraud Analyst is responsible for identifying, investigating, and mitigating potential fraud risks across the loan and EMI portfolio. The role involves reviewing customer profiles, verifying application information, analyzing suspicious activities, and conducting fraud investigations to protect the company from financial and operational losses. The incumbent will work closely with Credit, Risk, Collections, and Operations teams to ensure effective fraud detection and prevention.
Key Responsibilities:
Conduct fraud investigations related to loan and EMI applications, suspicious transactions, and policy violations within the assigned territory.
Perform regular field visits to assigned shops, merchants, and customer locations to verify information and investigate suspected fraud cases.
Review customer profiles, transaction records, and supporting documents to identify fraud indicators, document forgery, collusion, or other suspicious activities.
Prepare detailed and accurate investigation reports with findings, supporting evidence, risk assessments, and recommendations for further action.
Maintain fraud case records, ensure strict confidentiality of investigation data, and comply with company policies, SOPs, and regulatory requirements.
Additional Requirements
Age 23 to 38 years
Only Male
Strong analytical, investigative, and problem-solving skills.
Willingness to conduct frequent field visits and investigations.
Good communication and documentation skills.Ability to maintain confidentiality and professional integrity.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications.
Knowledge of KYC, fraud detection, and financial services operations will be an added advantage.
Skills: Investigative Reporting, Strong analytical and problemsolving skills.
Compensation & Other Benefits
T/A,Mobile bill
Festival Bonus: 2
Company Address: Lotus Kamal Tower 2, Level 17, Gulshan 1, Dhaka 1212

bdjobs.com/h/details/1551298?ln=1.source_content:
Eco-Social Development Organization (ESDO)
Store and Logistics Officer (Re-Circular)
Application Deadline: Nov 11, 2026
Vacancy: 01
Age: At most 35 years
Location: Thakurgaon
Salary: Tk. 20000 (Monthly)
Experience: At least 1 years
Published: Nov 1, 2026
Requirements
Education
At least graduation in any discipline, but accounting-related discipline will get preference.
Workplace
Work at office
Employment Status
Full Time
Job Description
ESDO was established in 1988 with the aim of supporting poor and marginalized people aﬀected by the devastating ﬂood and gradually moving towards achieving a broader vision of achieving sustainable, secured, and resilient livelihoods for these poor and marginalized people through improving their overall sustainable development. For the last more than three and a half decades of its development journey, ESDO has set an outstanding example of a sustainable development model for the underprivileged communities of Bangladesh. ESDO has been working in the country's primarily unserved and underserved locations, nurturing a community-focused participatory approach and people's ownership. Consequently, the ESDO's working area has already established an enabling environment. We have made notable achievements in livelihood improvement, food security and nutrition, education, women's empowerment, health, the promotion of children's rights, adolescent and youth engagement, and the rights of ethnic minorities. During this long span, we have adapted to the changing situation and provided the most time-bound effective services, especially to the poor and disadvantaged people. Considering the government's development policies, we are currently implementing a considerable number of projects and programs, including a microfinance program, through a community-focused and people-centered approach to accomplish the government's development agenda and the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) of the UN as a whole. One of the most dynamic organizations, ESDO, is expanding its development interventions across 422 upazilas under 56 districts of Bangladesh, thereby reaching over 15.73 million impoverished and vulnerable individuals.
The
Store & Logistics Officer
will support the vehicle unit & store management. ESDO is inviting applications from interested, qualified candidates for the following position.
Key Responsibilities:
Accounting Duties
Maintain daily cash book, ledger, vouchers, and financial records.
Prepare payment vouchers, receipts, and journal entries.
Process vendor bills, staff reimbursements, and payments.
Assist in monthly financial reports and budget tracking.
Maintain bank reconciliation and cash management.
Ensure proper documentation and filing of financial documents.
Support internal and external audit activities.
Ensure compliance with organizational financial policies and procedures.
Store Management Responsibilities
Maintain inventory records and stock registers.
Monitor stock levels and initiate replenishment requests.
Receive, inspect, and issue materials properly.
Conduct regular physical stock verification.
Ensure proper storage and labelling of goods/items.
Maintain store documentation, including GRN, issue notes, and stock reports.
Prevent stock loss, damage, or misuse.
Additional Requirements
Age At most 35 years
Only Male
Minimum 1-3 years of practical experience in store & accounting, preferably in NGO/INGO settings.
Good knowledge of accounting and procurement procedures.
Strong inventory and store management skills.
Ability to prepare reports and maintain documentation.
Good communication and negotiation skills.
Proficiency in MS Office (Excel, Word, Outlook).
Knowledge of ERP/accounting software is preferred.
Ability to work under pressure and meet deadlines.
Strong organizational and analytical skills.
Additional Requirements
Honest, responsible, and detail-oriented.
Good team player with problem-solving ability.
Ability to handle confidential information professionally.
Compensation & Other Benefits
Others benefit as per organizational policy.
Company Address: ESDO House, House # 748, Road no: 08, Baitul Aman Housing Society, Adabar, Dhaka-1207, Bangladesh

bdjobs.com/h/details/1551349?ln=1.source_content:
Tamim Group Of Companies, Bangladesh
Sales Representative – Retail Distribution & Sales (Cattle Feed)
Application Deadline: Nov 30, 2026
Location: Anywhere in Bangladesh
Salary: Negotiable
Published: Nov 1, 2026
Requirements
Education
Minimum HSC; graduates will be preferred.
Candidates with practical field sales ability and strong retail market knowledge will receive preference over higher academic qualifications.
Workplace
Work at office
Employment Status
Full Time
Application
Online
Job Description
Context-
Tamim Integrated Farms (TIF), a concern of Tamim Group, is an established poultry integration and contract farming organization in Bangladesh. As part of our business diversification, we are expanding into the cattle feed market through a retail-focused distribution model, utilizing our existing branch depots and distribution infrastructure.
We are looking for energetic, ambitious and result-oriented Sales Representatives with practical FMCG retail sales experience to develop our cattle feed distribution network in rural and semi-urban markets.
Job Responsibilities
1. Visit designated village bazaars, rural markets and semi-urban retail outlets daily to promote and sell the company's cattle feed products.
2.Identify, approach and appoint potential retail customers, including grocery shops, bran and grain shops, agricultural input shops and other suitable local retailers.
3.Develop new retail outlets and maintain strong business relationships with existing retailers.
4.Generate sales orders from retail shops and coordinate timely product delivery from the company's designated branch depots.
5.Achieve assigned daily, weekly and monthly sales targets, including new outlet development and sales volume.
6.Ensure timely collection of payments from retailers and strictly follow the company's cash sales and credit control policies.
7.Conduct regular market visits to identify potential customers, competitors, prevailing retail prices and market opportunities.
8.Promote product availability and build demand among local cattle farmers in coordination with retailers.
9.Maintain accurate records of retail outlets, daily visits, orders, sales, collections and competitor activities.
10.Coordinate with the Branch In-Charge regarding stock availability, delivery arrangements, sales performance and market development.
11.Build strong relationships with local shopkeepers, market associations and other relevant market influencers.
12.Expand the company's retail distribution coverage within the assigned territory through continuous market development.
Additional Requirements
Only Male
1–2 years of practical field sales experience in the FMCG sector is preferred.
Experience in selling products through grocery shops, general stores, village bazaars and small retail outlets will be highly valued.
Candidates from biscuits, confectionery, snacks, beverages, packaged foods, consumer goods and similar FMCG retail distribution businesses are particularly encouraged to apply.
Previous experience in cattle feed, poultry feed, fish feed or other animal feed sales is not required.
Fresh candidates with exceptional selling ability and strong familiarity with local retail markets may also be considered.
Skills: Agro Based company, Sales & Marketing
Compensation & Other Benefits
TA/DA, Sales Incentives and other benefits as per company policy.
Company Address: Sujabad, Shajahanpur, Bogura - 5800
Company Business
The Tamim Group of Companies owns several companies and different business units with a complementary portfolio of solutions. The conglomerate has a significant vision in the agriculture sector. TGC has a team of qualified and profound individuals alongside renowned advisors. The Tamim Group, one of the pioneers in the agriculture industry, has been expanding its business with its significant vision of youth empowerment and engagement by creating practical working sectors in Agriculture, Energy & Power, Information Technology, International Business, Sustainable Tourism, Eco-infrastructure with Agritourism segments, Rural Community Developmental projects like contractual farming, Natural Education, Holistic approach to learning, and giving back to society since 1992. Headquarters in Dhaka, with over 1500 employees nationwide.

Only Male

bdjobs.com/h/details/1551304?ln=1.source_content:
BRAC
Senior Officer, Agri Support Service Center (ASSC), Integrated Development Programme (IDP)
Application Deadline: Nov 10, 2026
Location: Anywhere in Bangladesh
Experience: 2 to 3 years
Published: Nov 1, 2026
Requirements
Education
Bachelor’s degree (B.Sc. Hons.) in Agriculture, Fisheries, or any related discipline from an accredited university. A Master’s degree in a relevant field will be considered an added advantage.
Employment Status
Full Time
Job Description
About the Role:
The Senior Officer will manage the Agri Support Service Center as a technical hub for delivering high-quality agricultural advisory services to poor and smallholder farmers, particularly BRAC Microfinance members, through field research, demonstrations, and hands-on learning. The role provides field-level technical support and promotes climate-resilient technologies, improved varieties, and timely weather and market information to enhance farm productivity, profitability, and resilience.
Key responsibilities
Provide consultation and basic diagnostic services to farmers and field staff through the Agri Support Service Center and ensure timely follow-up support.
Establish and maintain demonstration plots and field research activities to showcase climate-resilient technologies and improved crop varieties.
Conduct practical training and refresher sessions for Program Officers and farmers to strengthen technical knowledge and promote good agricultural practices.
Conduct field visits to assess crop and livestock conditions, identify diseases and production challenges, and recommend appropriate management practices under the guidance of supervisors.
Provide advisory services, including soil and water testing and basic farm performance assessments, and document findings and recommendations.
Organise field days, demonstrations, and awareness sessions to encourage the adoption of improved agricultural technologies and climate-smart farming practices.
Prepare and maintain reports, field records, and data on crop performance, farmer consultations, and Centre activities, and coordinate with farmers and relevant stakeholders to support programme implementation.
Safeguarding responsibilities
Ensure the safety of Programme Participants, people who come into contact with the organisation and team members from any harm, abuse, neglect, harassment and exploitation including sexual exploitation and abuse (SEA) to achieve the programme`s goals of safeguarding implementation. Act as a key source of support, guidance and expertise on safeguarding for establishing a safe working environment.
Practice, promote and endorse the issues of safeguarding policy among team members and ensure the implementation of safeguarding standards in every course of action.
Follow the safeguarding reporting procedure in case any reportable incident takes place and encourage others to do so.
Additional Requirements
Knowledge of crop production, livestock management, and common crop and animal diseases.
Understanding of climate-smart agriculture, improved farming technologies, and high-yielding varieties.
Technical advisory, diagnosis, and problem-solving skills related to crop and livestock management.
Knowledge of soil and water testing, agroecological conditions, and basic farm diagnostic practices.
Understanding of agricultural extension approaches, community engagement, and gender and diversity principles.
Experience Requirements:
Minimum 2–3 years of relevant experience in the development sector, preferably in agriculture, livelihoods, climate-smart agriculture, or agricultural extension programmes.
Compensation & Other Benefits
Festival Bonus, Contributory Provident Fund, Gratuity, Health and Life Insurance, Maternity/ Paternity Leave, and others as per policy.
Company Address: BRAC Centre, 75 Mohakhali, Dhaka-1212
Company Business
BRAC is an international development organisation founded in Bangladesh that partners with over 100 million people living with inequality and poverty globally to create sustainable opportunities to realise potential.

অভিজ্ঞ সেলস এক্সিকিউটিভ (Sales Executive – Overseas Recruitment)
M/S Mashallah Overseas
Recruiting Licence: R/L – 1039
আমরা আমাদের প্রতিষ্ঠানের জন্য একজন দক্ষ, অভিজ্ঞ ও ফলাফলভিত্তিক সেলস এক্সিকিউটিভ খুঁজছি, যিনি নিজ দক্ষতা, যোগাযোগ ও মার্কেটিং কৌশল ব্যবহার করে নতুন প্রার্থী এবং এজেন্ট সংগ্রহ করতে পারবেন।
বিশেষ দ্রষ্টব্য: এটি কোনো শিক্ষানবিশ বা ফ্রেশারদের জন্য চাকরি নয়। শুধুমাত্র বাস্তব Sales & Marketing অভিজ্ঞতাসম্পন্ন প্রার্থীরা আবেদন করবেন।
কাজের মূল দায়িত্ব
১. বিদেশে চাকরির জন্য আগ্রহী নতুন পুরুষ ও মহিলা প্রার্থী সংগ্রহ করা।
২. নিজের পরিচিতি, নেটওয়ার্ক ও মার্কেটিং দক্ষতা কাজে লাগিয়ে নতুন কাস্টমার তৈরি করা।
৩. বিভিন্ন জেলা ও এলাকায় নতুন রিক্রুটমেন্ট এজেন্ট ও সাব-এজেন্ট তৈরি করা।
৪. প্রার্থীদের সঙ্গে সরাসরি যোগাযোগ করে চাকরির সুযোগ, বেতন, সুযোগ-সুবিধা ও নিয়োগ প্রক্রিয়া বুঝিয়ে আগ্রহী করা।
৫. Facebook, WhatsApp ও অন্যান্য মাধ্যমে নিয়মিত মার্কেটিং ও প্রার্থী সংগ্রহ করা।
৬. WhatsApp গ্রুপ পরিচালনা, নতুন গ্রুপ তৈরি এবং নিয়মিত ফলোআপ করা।
৭. আগ্রহী প্রার্থীদের সঙ্গে নিয়মিত যোগাযোগ রেখে তাদের নিয়োগ ও ফ্লাইট পর্যন্ত নিয়ে আসা।
৮. নির্ধারিত মাসিক সেলস ও রিক্রুটমেন্ট টার্গেট পূরণ করা।
আবশ্যিক যোগ্যতা
- Sales & Marketing-এ ন্যূনতম ২–৩ বছরের বাস্তব অভিজ্ঞতা।
- Overseas Recruitment / Manpower / Travel Agency / Visa Processing সেক্টরে অভিজ্ঞদের অগ্রাধিকার।
- মানুষের সঙ্গে কথা বলে কনভিন্স করার অসাধারণ দক্ষতা থাকতে হবে।
- নিজ উদ্যোগে নতুন কাস্টমার ও প্রার্থী সংগ্রহ করতে সক্ষম হতে হবে।
- নতুন এজেন্ট ও সাব-এজেন্ট তৈরি করার অভিজ্ঞতা থাকতে হবে।
- পূর্বের কাজের সফলতার প্রমাণ বা রেফারেন্স দিতে হবে।
- টার্গেটভিত্তিক কাজ করার মানসিকতা থাকতে হবে।
বেতন ও কমিশন
- আকর্ষণীয় মাসিক বেতন (অভিজ্ঞতা অনুযায়ী)।
- প্রতিটি সফল ফ্লাইটের জন্য আকর্ষণীয় কমিশন।
- মাসিক টার্গেট পূরণে বিশেষ বোনাস।
- ভালো পারফরম্যান্সের জন্য অতিরিক্ত ইনসেনটিভ।
- যোগ্যতা ও পারফরম্যান্স অনুযায়ী আয়ের সুযোগ।
আবেদন করার নিয়ম
আবেদনকারীকে অবশ্যই CV-এর সঙ্গে নিচের তথ্য দিতে হবে:
১. পূর্বের চাকরির অভিজ্ঞতা।
২. কোন সেক্টরে Sales & Marketing করেছেন।
৩. মাসে গড়ে কতজন নতুন কাস্টমার সংগ্রহ করতে পারতেন।
৪. Overseas Recruitment-এ কাজের অভিজ্ঞতা আছে কি না।
৫. নিজের তৈরি করা এজেন্ট বা কাস্টমার নেটওয়ার্কের বিবরণ।
M/S Mashallah Overseas
R/L: 1039
Email: ms.mshallahoverseas@gmail.com
শুধুমাত্র অভিজ্ঞ ও দক্ষ প্রার্থীদের আবেদন করার জন্য অনুরোধ করা হচ্ছে। Freshers Please do not apply.

PalmPay is a leading neobank and fintech platform scaling financial inclusion across emerging markets. With over 40 million users, we are building a digital financial ecosystem that empowers individuals and businesses through accessible, easy-to-use, and rewarding financial services.
Operating in Nigeria, Ghana, Tanzania, Bangladesh, Pakistan, and the Philippines, PalmPay has been recognised by CNBC as one of the Top 300 Global Fintech Companies and ranked #2 overall and #1 in financial services on the Financial Times’ Africa’s Fastest Growing Companies 2025 list.
Position Overview:
The Junior Analyst - Credit Review will support the Credit Review team in evaluating customer creditworthiness and ensuring compliance with credit policies and procedures. The role involves reviewing customer information, verifying documentation, maintaining credit-related records, and assisting in risk assessment activities to support informed lending decisions and portfolio quality.

Assist senior analysts in reviewing loan and EMI applications, verifying customer information, and ensuring compliance with company policies, approval criteria, and documentation requirements.

Assist in identifying potential risk indicators and preparing credit files, reports, summaries, and recommendations for management review.
Maintain and update customer databases, credit records, and tracking systems, ensuring data integrity, accuracy, and proper documentation.
Learn and apply credit policies, procedures, and risk assessment guidelines under the supervision of senior analysts.

Program for Helpless And Lagged Society (PHALS)
Procurement Associate
Application Deadline: Nov 7, 2026
Vacancy: 1
Location: Coxs Bazar (Ukhia)
Salary: Tk. 40000 (Monthly)
Experience: At least 3 years
Published: Nov 2, 2026
Requirements
Education
Bachelor’s degree (or Diploma) in Business Administration, Supply Chain Management, Procurement, Commerce or another relevant field.
Training or certification in procurement or logistics is an advantage.
Employment Status
Full Time
Application
Online
Job Description
Project: Lifesaving and transitional support to refugees and host communities in Cox’s Bazar District, Bangladesh.
Location: Ukhiya, Cox's Bazar.
Duration: 5 Month (1 Nov ’26 to 31 March ’27)
Report to: Procurement Focal and Project Coordinator.
Job Context
PHALS is a non-governmental organization (NGO) working in the field of humanitarian assistance and development since 1996. In this continuation, PHALS is going to implement the Lifesaving and transitional support to refugees and host communities in Cox’s Bazar District, Bangladesh Project in Cox’s Bazar funded by FCDO and supported by IOM. We are seeking a qualified and skilled Procurement Associate who will be responsible for the timely, transparent and cost-effective procurement of goods, equipment, materials and services required for the project at Ukhiya in Cox’s Bazar District, including raw materials, packaging, machinery, spare parts, tools, personal protective equipment (PPE), training supplies and other project needs. The position ensures that all procurement follows PHALS policies and donor compliance, that purchases meet the required specifications and quality, and that records are complete and ready for audit, supporting the smooth operation of the soap production and livelihood activities for refugee and host communities. It requires practical procurement experience, attention to detail and a high level of.
Key Responsibilities
Prepare purchase requisitions, requests for quotation (RFQs) and tender documents in line with PHALS procurement policy, the approved procurement plan and donor requirements.
Identify, assess and maintain a database of qualified suppliers and vendors, and carry out market surveys and price comparisons to ensure value for money.
Procure raw materials (such as soap noodles, additives and packaging), machinery, spare parts, tools, PPE, training supplies and office and field supplies as required by the project.
Receive and register quotations and bids, prepare comparative bid analyses (CBAs), and support the procurement committee in evaluation and supplier selection.
Prepare purchase orders and contracts, and follow up with suppliers on delivery schedules, specifications and quality.
Coordinate with the Store and Warehouse Maintenance Officer on the receipt and inspection of goods, goods received notes (GRNs) and stock levels, and plan purchases to avoid stock-outs.
Coordinate with the Project Manager, Chemist, Technical Experts and the Capacity Building team to clarify requirements and technical specifications before procurement.
Maintain complete and organized procurement files, registers and tracking sheets, with all supporting documents ready for internal and donor audit.
Support the preparation and regular update of the project procurement plan, and track the status of all procurement requests.
Verify invoices, delivery documents and GRNs, and submit them to the finance team for payment in a timely manner.
Ensure compliance with PHALS procurement policy and donor rules, and uphold transparency, fair competition and the avoidance of conflicts of interest.
Arrange transport and delivery of goods to the production center and project sites, including coordination of camp access requirements where needed.
Promote safe and environmentally responsible procurement, including safe packaging, handling and storage of materials, and report any accident, incident or near miss to the Project Manager and the ESS Officer.
Prepare regular procurement reports and submit them to the Project Manager on time.
Uphold PHALS’ values, code of conduct, and commitment to safeguarding and PSEAH (Prevention of Sexual Exploitation Abuse and Harassment) .
Additional Requirements
Minimum 3 years of experience in procurement or logistics, preferably in an NGO, humanitarian or donor-funded project.
Practical knowledge of procurement procedures, including RFQs, tenders, comparative bid analysis, purchase orders and contract management.
Experience in donor-compliant procurement; experience with UN or IOM funded projects is an advantage.
Skills in market assessment, negotiation and supplier management.
Ability to keep clear, accurate and audit-ready procurement records and documentation.
Good computer skills, especially MS Excel and MS Word, for tracking and reporting.
Integrity, attention to detail and the ability to handle confidential information and meet deadlines.
Ability to work as part of a team in field conditions in camps and host communities, including flexible hours when required.
Fluency in Bangla. Knowledge of local dialects of Cox’s Bazar will be an added advantage.
Compensation & Other Benefits
Salary: BDT 40,000/- per month, and other benefits as per project budget.
Company Address: Abu Center, 1st Floor, East Bazarghata, Main Road, Coxs Bazar

Job Description
A To Z Engineering, a Value Added Distributor of Ruijie Networks in Bangladesh, is seeking three dynamic, experienced, and target-driven Regional Sales Managers to expand its sales operations and distribution network in Chattogram, Barishal, and Sylhet.
The selected candidates will be primarily responsible for driving regional sales of Ruijie/Reyee Wi-Fi Routers and Cat6 Networking Cables, identifying and onboarding new channel partners, increasing product distribution, and consistently achieving assigned sales targets.
Key Responsibilities:
1. Sales Growth: Achieve monthly, quarterly, and annual sales targets within the assigned territory.
2. New Partner Acquisition: Identify, recruit, and develop new dealers, resellers, retailers, and distribution partners.
3. Channel Sales: Generate consistent sales through existing and newly appointed business partners.
4. Market Expansion: Increase product availability, brand visibility, and market penetration throughout the assigned region.
5. Partner Relationship Management: Build and maintain strong, long-term business relationships with channel partners.
6. Field Sales Activities: Conduct regular market visits, partner meetings, sales presentations, and product promotions.
7. Revenue Generation: Identify new business opportunities and convert potential partners into active, revenue-generating customers.
8. Sales Performance Monitoring: Track partner sales performance, identify growth opportunities, and implement effective sales strategies.
9. Target Achievement: Take full ownership of regional sales targets and maintain consistent sales performance.
10. Reporting & Coordination: Submit regular sales reports, market updates, and forecasts to management while coordinating order processing and payment collection.
Additional Requirements
Age At least 28 years
Only Male
Local Market Knowledge: Candidates must have strong familiarity with the IT market and dealer network in their respective regions.
Existing Partner Network: An established network of IT dealers, networking product retailers, resellers, and local distributors will be a significant advantage.
Field Sales Commitment: Must be willing to travel extensively within the assigned territory to develop new business opportunities.
Target-Oriented Mindset: Must be confident in achieving assigned sales targets and consistently delivering measurable business growth.
Independent Working Ability: Capable of managing regional sales operations with minimal supervision.
Sales Leadership: Must demonstrate strong initiative, accountability, problem-solving ability, and professional integrity.
Regional Preference: Candidates currently residing in Chattogram, Barishal, or Sylhet will be given preference for their respective territories.
Product Experience: Prior experience selling Ruijie, Reyee, TP-Link, Tenda, MikroTik, or similar networking brands will be an added advantage.
Skills: Channel Sales, Dealer development, Business Development, Distribution Supply Chain Management, Sales Target Achievement, Territory sales, Partnership Development, IT hardware and networking knowledge, Client Acquisition, Sales & Marketing
Company Address: 304, New Elephant Road, Dhaka
Company Business
Distributor of Ruijie Reyee products

Job Description
Job Context
SKS Foundation in partnership with IDCOL is going to implement a project titled Domestic Rooftop Solar (DRS) Project. Following positions will be recruited for implementing the project`s interventions:
Job Responsibilities
Ensure proper installation of solar panels, inverters, mounting structures, batteries, cables, and protection equipment.
Ensure compliance with electrical safety standards and installation guidelines.
Monitor installation progress and ensure projects are completed within the approved timeline.
Troubleshoot technical problems during installation and commissioning.
Ensure compliance with project requirements.
Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly site progress reports.
Coordinate with clients and internal departments.
Ensure materials, tools, and equipment are available at project sites.
Identify potential customers in residential, commercial, and industrial solar markets.
Generate new business opportunities and develop customer relationships.
Conduct client meetings, presentations, and technical discussions.
Understand customer requirements and recommend suitable solar solutions.
Prepare technical and commercial proposals, quotations, and BOQs.
Follow up on sales leads, quotations, and ongoing negotiations.
Support contract finalization and achieve assigned sales targets.
Develop relationships with corporate clients.
Manage day-to-day technical operations related to solar projects.
Provide technical support for solar PV systems, hybrid systems, and off-grid solutions.
Coordinate preventive and corrective maintenance activities.
Diagnose primary faults related to solar panels, inverters, batteries, and electrical systems.
Handle customer technical complaints and ensure timely resolution.
Recommend system improvements to enhance efficiency and reliability
Coordinate between sales, engineering, procurement, installation, and accounts teams.
Report project progress, sales performance, technical issues, and operational challenges to management.
Ensure compliance with company policies and operational procedures.
Perform any other tasks assigned by management.
Additional Requirements
Age At most 40 years
Solar inverter and battery technologies.
Knowledge on Electrical wiring, protection systems, and earthing.
Site survey and feasibility assessment.
MS Office, Excel, AutoCAD, and solar design software.
Customer relationship management and negotiation.
Compensation & Other Benefits
Others benefits will be as per project budget provision.
T/A, Weekly 2 holidays
Company Address: College Road, Uttar Horinsinha, Gaibandha- 5700.
Company Business
SKS Foundation is a long reputed national NGO engaged in service delivery and rights based activities for disadvantaged hardcore poor people for their quality life and livelihoods. With this exposure, the expectation from civil society, private and public organizations remain high such that SKS Foundation provides a top quality service to the increasing numbers of very poor and chars dwellers in Bangladesh since 1987. It started development work for the poor and marginalized people through different program interventions. The growth and development of SKS Foundation is the joint effort of a few local self-devoted young men and women, social workers from various academic disciplines.

Application Deadline: Nov 12, 2026
Vacancy: 3
Age: At most 35 years

Published: Nov 2, 2026
Requirements
Education

Bachelor/Honors
Masters
Training or certification in Student Counseling, Education Consultancy, or Visa Processing will be an added advantage.
Knowledge of international student admission procedures and visa application processes.
Practical understanding of visa documentation and application requirements for Canada, Australia, South Korea, China, Malaysia, Russia, and European countries.
Workplace
Work at office
Employment Status
Full Time
Application
Online
Job Description
Job Responsibilities:
We are looking for a smart, confident, well-educated, ambitious, and experienced professional to join our team as a Student Counselor & Visa Processing Officer. The ideal candidate should have strong practical knowledge and hands-on experience in student visa processing, admission procedures, and visa documentation for Canada, South Korea, China, Malaysia, Australia, Russia, and European countries.
The candidate must possess excellent communication, interpersonal, counseling, and organizational skills, along with the ability to guide students and clients professionally throughout their application journey.
Key Responsibilities:
Provide professional counseling and guidance to students regarding higher education opportunities, admission procedures, and visa requirements.
Provide accurate information and consultation regarding Student Visas related services.
Maintain regular communication with students, clients, institutional representatives, and respective visa processing teams.
Communicate with students in person, over the phone, and through email to understand their requirements and provide appropriate guidance.
Collect, review, verify, and organize all necessary documents required for visa applications.
Ensure that students' documents are complete, accurate, and properly arranged according to the respective country's visa requirements.
Prepare application documents, complete necessary forms, and maintain proper records and documentation files.
Monitor students' application progress and provide timely updates regarding each stage of the visa processing procedure.
Maintain and update daily processing reports and other relevant administrative records.
Handle incoming and outgoing calls, emails, and client inquiries professionally.
Build and maintain strong relationships with students, parents, and prospective clients.
Support marketing and promotional activities through social media, newspaper advertisements, and other marketing channels.
Coordinate with internal teams and international representatives to ensure smooth application processing.
Provide continuous support and guidance to students throughout the admission and visa application process.
Perform other relevant duties and responsibilities as assigned by management.
Career Opportunity:
This is an excellent opportunity for a motivated and career-oriented individual who wants to build a successful career in the international education consultancy and visa processing industry.
Additional Requirements
Age At most 35 years
Must be smart, presentable, confident, and professionally minded.
Must have excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
Must be well-educated, ambitious, responsible, and self-motivated.
Previous experience in student counseling, education consultancy, or visa processing will be highly preferred.
Practical knowledge of visa application procedures for Canada, South Korea, China, Malaysia, Australia, Russia, and European countries is highly desirable.
Must have good English communication skills (both written and spoken).
Must be proficient in computer operations, email communication, and Microsoft Office applications.
Must have strong organizational, problem-solving, and multitasking abilities.
Must be patient, empathetic, and capable of handling students and clients with professionalism and care.
Must be able to work independently as well as collaboratively within a team.
Professional Qualities:
The ideal candidate should demonstrate a high level of professionalism, honesty, patience, and dedication. They should be capable of building trust with students and clients, understanding their individual needs, and providing reliable guidance throughout the entire application process.
Good Communication Skills
Computer Knowledge
English Proficiency
Customer Handling Skills

raw_source_fields.age: 20 to 25 years Only Male Strong customer service mindset with the ability to handle complaints professionally and empathetically. Good knowledge of order processing workflows, including order confirmation, invoicing, fulfillment coordination, and return/refund procedures. Familiarity with e-commerce platforms such as Shopify, similar systems will be an advantage. Strong typing speed with high accuracy in data entry and order processing. Ability to multitask and work efficiently in a fast-paced environment. Knowledge of courier management and shipment tracking processes is an added advantage. Responsibilities & Context We’re looking for a detail-oriented and highly motivated Order Processing & Customer Support Executive to join our growing e-commerce company, TREKMAD . In this role, you’ll be responsible for ensuring smooth order flow—from processing customer purchases to coordinating fulfillment and delivery. Your work will directly impact customer satisfaction by making sure every order is handled accurately, efficiently, and on time. Note : This role requires close coordination with warehouse, courier partners, and customer service teams, as well as occasional after-hours monitoring during peak order periods. Key Responsibilities Process online orders accurately across e-commerce platforms. Prepare invoices, packing lists, and order documentation. Track shipments, manage returns, and resolve delivery issues. Verify order details, payment status (COD/prepaid), and stock availability. Communicate with customers about order confirmation, shipping updates, or stock issues. Resolve customer complaints and provide appropriate solutions, ensuring a positive customer experience. Handle exceptions (returns, failed COD, delays). Track shipments, resolve delivery exceptions, and update customers accordingly. Coordinate with warehouse/fulfillment team for timely order picking, packing, and dispatch. Maintain daily return entry to the inventory with proper documentation. Monitor and manage last-mile delivery partners for on-time delivery. Make sure returns/exchanges are processed smoothly in line with company policy. Ensure fulfillment KPIs (order accuracy, on-time delivery) are achieved. Skills & Expertise Communication Ecommerce Flexibility and Adaptability Leadership Order Management Shopify Team management Teamwork Woocommerce WordPress Other Relevant Skills Ecommerce Order processing Client Relationship

Job Purpose: The Deputy Project Manager – Business Development is responsible for coordinating and ensuring sustainable livelihood opportunities for skills training graduates across assigned camps and host community centres. The role focuses on building pathways for self and wage employment, creating strong linkages with local market actors, private sector partners, and community-based initiatives. This position also leads volunteer and participant management, supports coordination with CiC offices, and ensures compliance with administrative and financial procedures in line with project objectives. Major Responsibilities: Employment Linkage and Market Engagement Facilitate self and wage employment for skills training graduates in coordination with private sector actors, NGOs, and community networks. Build and maintain partnerships with market actors (e.g. SMEs, local contractors) to create viable livelihood pathways. Coordinate career counselling and post-training support (e.g., entrepreneurship, referrals for volunteer roles, apprenticeships). Supervise the mobilisation and engagement of institutional participants (volunteers already in jobs) for advanced training. Oversee the enrolment of graduates into production centres and support small-scale business setups. Entrepreneurship and SME under Green Innovation Hub Mapping Rohingya entrepreneurs, especially women, by skills, experience and business aspirations Designing tailored support, such as business planning, mentoring and referrals Supporting the creation and growth of Small and Medium Enterprise, including women-led businesses Managing the selection, disbursement and monitoring of SME cash grants Tracking grant recipients’ performance, with case studies and lessons learned Overseeing the Green Innovation Hub Engaging community businesses to provide services through the hub Coordinating with market actors, private sector partners, CiC offices and stakeholders Administration, Coordination, and Volunteer Management Submit need assessments, monthly updates, and completion reports to CiC offices across assigned camps. Ensure timely and accurate processing of payments for volunteers, labourers, utilities, and training participants. Lead recruitment, onboarding, supervision, and performance tracking of volunteers per project guidelines. Represent BRAC at camp-level meetings and coordination platforms, especially with CiC, UN agencies, and sectoral working groups. Conduct community consultations and ensure continuous feedback is incorporated into programme adaptation. Monitoring, Budgeting, and Reporting Track employment outcomes, follow-up on placed graduates, and document case studies and impact stories. Coordinate with M&E team to ensure timely data collection on employment status, income generation, and market engagement. Assist with budget planning and financial tracking, ensuring efficient use of self/wage employment resources. Contribute to donor reports and programme reviews, ensuring accuracy and timely submission. Safeguarding: Ensure the safety of Programme Participants, people who come into contact with the organisation and team members from any harm, abuse, neglect, harassment and exploitation including sexual exploitation and abuse (SEA) to achieve the programme's goals of safeguarding implementation. Act as a key source of support, guidance and expertise on safeguarding for establishing a safe working environment Practice, promote and endorse the issues of safeguarding policy among team members and ensure the implementation of safeguarding standards in every course of action Follow the safeguarding reporting procedure in case any reportable incident takes place and encourage others to do so Skills & Expertise Business Analysis Business Development Livelihoods Compensation & Other Benefits Medical allowance,Mobile bill,Weekly 2 holidays Salary Review: Yearly Festival Bonus: 2 Health & Life Insurance Paternity/ Maternity leave and Others as per Organisation policy Workplace Work at office Employment Status Contractual Job Location Coxs Bazar (Teknaf, Ukhia)

Working experience in credit administration desks in Bank’s branches will be preferable. Preference will be given to candidates having MTO/PO background in commercial banks/ financial institution. Preference will be given to candidates with experience in a centralized credit administration division within a commercial bank or financial institution. Responsibilities & Context Process and execute loan-related transactions in the Core Banking System (CBS) in accordance with approved credit facilities, bank policies and operational guidelines. Process loan and advance disbursements after verifying the necessary approvals, documentation and compliance requirements. Process loan repayments, installment adjustments, interest applications and other credit-related transactions accurately and within the prescribed timelines. Enter, update, and verify loan account information, repayment schedules, interest rates, maturity dates and other relevant data in CBS. Ensure that all transactions are supported by proper documentation and comply with the banks credit policies, operational procedures and applicable regulatory requirements. Monitor loan accounts and transaction records to identify discrepancies, irregularities or unauthorized transactions and report them to the appropriate authority. Assist in reconciling loan accounts, resolving transaction discrepancies and preparing periodic operational reports. Coordinate with branches, the Credit Administration Division, Credit Risk Management, Finance and Accounts and other relevant departments to ensure smooth processing of credit transactions. Maintain proper transaction records, ensure adherence to maker-checker procedures and support internal and external audits. Perform any other duties as assigned by Management to support smooth banking operations. Skills & Expertise Credit Administration Other Relevant Skills Account Reconciliation Regulatory Compliance Compensation & Other Benefits Attractive compensation package will be offered to the deserving candidates selected for the positions based on the experience and competency.
