Salary: Negotiable
Experience: At least 3 years
Published: Nov 3, 2026
Requirements
Education
Bachelor/Honors
Employment Status
Full Time
Application
Online
Job Description
A. Finance & Accounts Audit
Review financial transactions, payment vouchers, journal vouchers, receipts, invoices and supporting documents.
Verify the accuracy and authenticity of financial records and accounting entries.
Examine cash and bank transactions, bank reconciliations, petty cash, and cash balances.
Review accounts payable, accounts receivable, advances and outstanding balances.
Verify proper authorization and approval of all financial transactions.
Examine expense claims, employee reimbursements and other operational expenditures.
Review monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements and identify unusual variations.
Check the accuracy of fixed asset records, depreciation and asset disposal transactions.
Identify unauthorized payments, duplicate payments, fictitious expenses and financial irregularities.
Ensure compliance with approved budgets and financial policies.
B. Procurement & Purchase Audit
Review purchase requisitions, purchase orders, quotations, comparative statements and supplier selection procedures.
Verify compliance with the company`s procurement policy and approval matrix.
Examine vendor selection, price competitiveness and procurement transparency.
Verify supporting documents for purchases and ensure proper authorization.
Review supplier agreements, contracts, and payment terms.
Check whether goods and services received match purchase orders and invoices.
Identify potential conflicts of interest, overpricing, duplicate purchases and unauthorized procurement.
Review vendor payments and outstanding supplier balances.
Ensure proper documentation and maintenance of procurement records.
C. Inventory & Store Audit
Conduct periodic physical verification of raw materials, finished goods, spare parts, and other inventory.
Reconcile physical stock with inventory records and ERP/software balances.
Review inventory receiving, issuing, transfer, and dispatch procedures.
Examine Material Receive Notes (MRR), Material Issue Notes (MIN), Delivery Challans, and Stock Transfer Notes.
Identify excess, obsolete, damaged, expired, and slow-moving inventory.
Review stock valuation methods and inventory adjustments.
Verify proper authorization for stock adjustments, write-offs, and disposal.
Investigate stock shortages, wastage, pilferage, and unexplained variances.
Evaluate warehouse security and inventory control systems.
D. HR & Administration Audit
Review employee recruitment, appointment, confirmation, promotion, transfer, and separation documentation.
Verify employee attendance, leave records, overtime, and payroll information.
Check salary structures, allowances, deductions, bonuses, and employee benefits.
Verify compliance with approved manpower budgets and organizational structures.
Examine employee files and ensure proper documentation.
Review final settlements, gratuity, provident fund, and other applicable employee benefits.
Verify compliance with the Bangladesh Labor Act, 2006, and Bangladesh Labor Rules, 2015, as amended and applicable.
Review administrative expenses, vehicle expenses, utility bills, security expenses, and office maintenance costs.
Identify ghost employees, duplicate payroll entries, unauthorized overtime, and payroll irregularities.
E. VAT & Tax Audit
Review VAT and tax-related records, returns, challans, invoices, and supporting documents.
Examine compliance with the Value Added Tax and Supplementary Duty Act, 2012, and applicable rules.
Verify VAT registration, BIN information, and applicable VAT documentation.
Review Mushak forms, including applicable VAT invoices, purchase records, sales records, and returns.
Verify proper deduction and deposit of Tax Deducted at Source (TDS) and VAT Deducted at Source (VDS), where applicable.
Review withholding tax calculations, payments, and supporting certificates.
Verify timely submission of VAT returns and income tax returns.
Review tax assessments, notices, audit objections, and correspondence with the National Board of Revenue (NBR).
Identify potential tax exposures, incorrect VAT treatments, and non-compliance.
Coordinate with the Finance & Accounts Department and external tax consultants regarding audit observations.
F. Regulatory & Statutory Compliance Audit
Monitor compliance with applicable laws, regulations, and statutory requirements in Bangladesh.
Review compliance with company policies, SOPs, delegated authorities, and management instructions.
Check applicable trade licences, environmental clearances, fire licences, factory licences, and other statutory approvals.
Verify timely renewal of licences, permits, registrations, and certificates.
Review compliance with applicable labour, tax, VAT, environmental, and company-related regulatory requirements.
Monitor compliance with Bangladesh Labor Act and other applicable employment regulations.
Identify regulatory risks and report non-compliance to management.
Maintain a compliance checklist and monitor statutory deadlines.
G. Operational & Management Audit
Conduct operational audits of different departments, factories, branches, and business units.
Evaluate the effectiveness of existing internal control systems.
Review departmental SOPs and identify process inefficiencies.
Examine production costs, wastage, consumption, and operational performance, where applicable.
Evaluate resource utilization and cost-control measures.
Identify opportunities to improve productivity and operational efficiency.
Assess risks associated with business processes and recommend improvements.
H. Fraud Detection & Investigation
Identify suspicious transactions, financial irregularities, and possible fraudulent activities.
Conduct preliminary investigations as assigned by management or the Audit Committee.
Examine suspected misuse of company funds, assets, and resources.
Collect and preserve relevant audit evidence.
Report significant irregularities through the appropriate reporting channel.
Maintain confidentiality and professional independence throughout investigations.
I. Audit Reporting & Follow-up
Prepare audit plans, audit programmes, working papers, and audit checklists.
Conduct audits according to approved audit schedules.
Prepare audit findings with supporting evidence and risk assessments.
Discuss audit observations with concerned department heads.
Submit audit reports with practical recommendations to management.
Follow up on implementation of audit recommendations.
Maintain an Audit Observation Register and track unresolved issues.
Highlight repeated irregularities and significant control weaknesses.
Submit periodic audit progress reports to the Head of Internal Audit and management.
Additional Requirements
Age At least 28 years
Only Male
Bachelor`s or Master`s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration or a relevant discipline.
Professional qualifications such as CA (CC), ACCA, CMA, CIA, or relevant part-qualification will be an added advantage.
Skills: Accounts and audit, Internal Audit, Inventory Audit
Compensation & Other Benefits
Salary Review: Yearly
Festival Bonus: 3
Company Address: Lotus kamal tower two, 9th floor, Gulshan 1, Dhaka 1212
Company Business
Toppay Services Limited is a registered telecommunications company offering services like mobile data, cable subscriptions, electricity bill payments, and airtime top-ups. The companys primary business activities are classified as information technology consultancy and other related activities.

Job Description
easybuy.com.bd বাংলাদেশের একটি ক্রমবর্ধমান ই-কমার্স প্ল্যাটফর্ম। আমরা অভিজ্ঞ কল সেন্টার কর্মী নিয়োগ দিতে চাই, যাঁরা বিস্তারিত প্রশিক্ষণ ছাড়াই প্রথম দিন থেকে নিজে গ্রাহক সামলাতে পারবেন এবং দ্রুত, আন্তরিক ও পেশাদার সেবা দিতে পারবেন।
দায়িত্ব ও কর্তব্য
অর্ডারের অবস্থা, ডেলিভারি ও মূল্য পরিশোধ সংক্রান্ত গ্রাহকের ফোন ধরে তথ্য দেওয়া।
নতুন অর্ডার নিশ্চিত করতে এবং পণ্য পাঠানোর আগে গ্রাহকের ঠিকানা ও তথ্য যাচাই করতে গ্রাহককে ফোন করা।
গ্রাহকের অভিযোগ মনোযোগ দিয়ে শুনে দ্রুত সমাধান দেওয়া এবং প্রয়োজনে ঊর্ধ্বতন কর্মকর্তাকে জানানো।
পণ্য ফেরত, টাকা ফেরত, পণ্য বদল ও অর্ডার বাতিলের অনুরোধ নিষ্পত্তি করা।
ডেলিভারি ব্যর্থ বা দেরি হলে কুরিয়ার দলের সাথে যোগাযোগ করে বিষয়টির অগ্রগতি দেখা।
পণ্য সম্পর্কে গ্রাহকের প্রশ্নের উত্তর দেওয়া এবং সুযোগ বুঝে অতিরিক্ত পণ্য কেনার পরামর্শ দেওয়া।
প্রতিটি ফোনালাপের তথ্য নির্ধারিত সফটওয়্যার বা শিটে সঠিকভাবে লিখে রাখা।
প্রয়োজনে ফেসবুক পেজের ইনবক্স ও সরাসরি বার্তালাপে সহায়তা করা।
প্রতিদিনের ফোনের সংখ্যা, সমাধানের হার ও বারবার আসা সমস্যার প্রতিবেদন জমা দেওয়া।
প্রতিষ্ঠানের নীতিমালা, অফার ও পণ্যের তথ্য সম্পর্কে হালনাগাদ থাকা।
Additional Requirements
Age At least 21 years
কল সেন্টার বা গ্রাহকসেবায় ২ থেকে ৩ বছরের অভিজ্ঞতা।
গ্রাহকের ফোন গ্রহণ ও গ্রাহককে ফোন করা, দুই ধরনের কাজেরই অভিজ্ঞতা থাকতে হবে।
ই-কমার্স, খুচরা বিক্রয় বা ডেলিভারিভিত্তিক ব্যবসায় অভিজ্ঞতা থাকলে অগ্রাধিকার।
অতিরিক্ত যোগ্যতা
স্পষ্ট উচ্চারণে পরিষ্কার, মার্জিত ও আত্মবিশ্বাসী বাংলায় কথা বলার দক্ষতা।
ভালো ইংরেজি বোঝার ক্ষমতা এবং প্রাথমিক ইংরেজিতে কথা বলতে পারা।
ধৈর্য ধরে গ্রাহকের কথা শোনা এবং রাগান্বিত গ্রাহককে শান্ত করার সক্ষমতা।
দ্রুত সিদ্ধান্ত নেওয়া ও সমস্যা সমাধানের দক্ষতা।
ফোনে কথা বলার সময় দ্রুত টাইপ করা এবং গ্রাহক তথ্য ব্যবস্থাপনা সফটওয়্যার, এক্সেল বা গুগল শিট ব্যবহারের দক্ষতা।
কল সেন্টারের সফটওয়্যার ও হেডসেট নিয়ে কাজ করতে স্বচ্ছন্দ হতে হবে।
ভালো স্মরণশক্তি, একসাথে একাধিক কাজ সামলানোর ক্ষমতা এবং গ্রাহকের তথ্য গোপন রাখার সততা।
নিজ উদ্যোগে কাজ করার মানসিকতা এবং দলগতভাবে কাজ করার দক্ষতা।
অর্ডার নিশ্চিতকরণ বা বিক্রয়ের অভিজ্ঞতা থাকলে বাড়তি সুবিধা।
Skills: Customer Care, Customer Comuunication, Customer Relationship, Customer Service, Customer Support, Customer Support through Phone, Handling Customers, Sell to Customer Needs
Compensation & Other Benefits
Performance bonus
Salary Review: Yearly
Company Address: Newmarket, Star Palace (Star Hotel) 10th floor
Company Business
online product sourcing company

bdjobs.com/h/details/1552165?ln=1.title: Market Development Officer
bdjobs.com/h/details/1552165?ln=1.source_content:
Protibondhi Community Centre (PCC)
Market Development Officer
Application Deadline: Nov 15, 2026
Location: Bhola (Bhola Sadar)
Salary: Tk. 30000 - 35000 (Monthly)
Experience: 2 to 3 years
Published: Nov 3, 2026
Requirements
Education
Bachelor/Honors
Bachelor`s Degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Agriculture, Dairy Science, Rural Development, or a related field.
Workplace
Work at office
Employment Status
Contractual
Application
Online
Job Description
Organization:
Protibondhi Community Centre (PCC)
Green Dairy Social Enterprise
(A Social Enterprise Initiative of Protibondhi Community Centre – PCC)
Duty Station/Working Area:
Bhola Sader, Bhola
Employment Type:
Full-time, yearly Contract (Renewable)
About Green Dairy Social Enterprise
Green Dairy Social Enterprise- an inclusive social enterprise led by persons with disabilities and underprivileged communities is committed to strengthening sustainable dairy value chains, improving milk market access for smallholder farmers, and promoting nutritious dairy products within local communities. We are seeking a dynamic and motivated professional to support market expansion, sales growth, and community engagement initiatives.
Key Responsibilities
Marketing & Sales:
Develop and implement marketing and sales strategies to increase dairy milk product sales.
Identify and establish new market opportunities, retailers, distributors, and institutional buyers.
Build and maintain strong relationships with customers, vendors, and business partners.
Monitor market trends, consumer preferences, and competitor activities.
Prepare sales forecasts, reports, and market analysis.
Community Engagement:
Conduct community outreach programs, awareness campaigns, and promotional activities.
Maintain close relationships with dairy farmers, producer groups, and community stakeholders.
Facilitate customer feedback collection and ensure customer satisfaction.
Support initiatives that strengthen dairy farmer participation in the milk value chain.
He or she would be responsible to take initiative regarding against the environmental pollution and take necessity necessary action of sustainability.
Business Development:
Promote Green Dairy products and services within target markets.
Explore opportunities for expanding dairy milk collection and distribution networks.
Assist in developing partnerships with local businesses, institutions, and development organizations.
Contribute to achieving organizational sales and growth targets.
He or she have fulfill monthly sales target (80%+)
Safeguarding and Code of Conduct
The applicant must comply with PCC`s organizational policies, including safeguarding, child protection, prevention of sexual exploitation and abuse, confidentiality, non-discrimination, disability inclusion, and professional conduct policies.
The Officer must ensure that all interactions with children, persons with disabilities, caregivers, and vulnerable community members are conducted with respect, dignity, safety, confidentiality, and informed participation.
Additional Requirements
Required Qualifications
Strong communication, negotiation, and relationship management skills.
Demonstrated ability to work independently and achieve sales targets.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications.
Motorcycle driving skills with a valid driving license will be considered an advantage.
Minimum 2-3 years of relevant experience in:
Marketing and Sales
Community Engagement
Dairy Milk Business or Dairy Value Chain Development
Preferred Experience
Experience working with dairy farmers, milk collection centers, or dairy enterprises.
Knowledge of milk marketing, dairy product distribution, and rural market development.
Familiarity with social enterprise or development sector programs.
Required Competencies
Strong interpersonal and networking skills.
Result-oriented and self-motivated.
Excellent reporting and documentation skills.
Problem-solving and analytical abilities.
Willingness to travel extensively within Bhola and surrounding areas.
Compensation & Other Benefits
Benefits
Competitive salary package (BDT 30,000-35,000).
Mobile and field travel allowance as per organizational policy.
Professional development and career growth opportunities.
Opportunity to contribute to sustainable dairy sector development and social impact.
Company Address: Nathpara, Raghobpur, Sambhugonj Mymensingh.

Application Deadline: Nov 15, 2026
Location: Bhola (Bhola Sadar)
Salary: Tk. 20000 - 22000 (Monthly)
Experience: 1 to 2 years
Published: Nov 3, 2026
Requirements
Education
Bachelor/Honors
Bachelor's Degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, Management, or a relevant discipline.
Employment Status
Contractual
Application
Online
Job Description
Organization:
Protibondhi Community Centre (PCC)
Green Dairy Social Enterprise (A Social Enterprise Initiative of Protibondhi Community Centre – PCC)
Duty Station/Working Area:
Bhola Sader, Bhola
Employment Type:
Full-time, yearly Contract (Renewable)
About Green Dairy Social Enterprise
Green Dairy Social Enterprise is an inclusive social enterprise led by persons with disabilities and underprivileged communities. It is committed to strengthening sustainable dairy value chains, improving market access for smallholder dairy farmers, and promoting nutritious dairy products within local communities.
We are seeking a responsible, honest, and detail-oriented Cashier and Logistics Officer to manage daily financial transactions, inventory records, and logistics operations efficiently.
Key Responsibilities
Cash Management and Financial Record-Keeping
Receive and process daily cash collections and customer payments.
Maintain accurate records of cash transactions, receipts, and expenditures.
Prepare daily cash reports and reconcile cash balances.
Assist in maintaining financial records and supporting internal and external audits.
Ensure compliance with organizational financial policies and procedures.
Coordinate with the Accounts Team for timely financial reporting and documentation.
Logistics and Inventory Management
Monitor stock levels of milk and other dairy products.
Maintain inventory records and prepare stock movement reports.
Coordinate transportation and delivery schedules.
Support milk collection and product distribution activities.
Ensure proper handling, storage, and dispatch of dairy products.
Monitor logistics expenses and maintain relevant supporting documents.
Administrative and Operational Support
Maintain organized filing systems for financial and logistics records.
Prepare routine reports and operational summaries.
Support procurement and supplier coordination activities.
Assist management in ensuring smooth and efficient daily operations.
Safeguarding and Code of Conduct
The applicant must comply with PCC's organizational policies, including safeguarding, child protection, prevention of sexual exploitation and abuse, confidentiality, non-discrimination, disability inclusion, and professional conduct policies.
The Officer must ensure that all interactions with children, persons with disabilities, caregivers, and vulnerable community members are conducted with respect, dignity, safety, confidentiality, and informed participation.
Additional Requirements
Required Qualifications and Experience
Minimum 1–2 years of professional experience in cash handling, cashier operations, logistics, inventory management, or a related field.
Strong numerical, bookkeeping, and record-keeping skills.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, particularly MS Excel.
Ability to maintain accurate financial records and supporting documentation.
Good communication, coordination, and organizational skills.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience in the dairy, FMCG, retail, agribusiness, or social enterprise sectors.
Familiarity with inventory management systems and stock control procedures.
Experience in rural supply chain management or distribution operations.
Knowledge of basic accounting principles and financial procedures.
Required Competencies
High level of honesty, integrity, and accountability.
Strong attention to detail and accuracy in financial and inventory record-keeping.
Good problem-solving and organizational abilities.
Ability to work under pressure and meet deadlines.
Positive attitude and ability to work effectively in a team.
Willingness to travel within operational areas when required.
Compensation & Other Benefits
Monthly salary of BDT 20,000–22,000, depending on qualifications and experience.
Mobile and travel allowances as per organizational policy.
Professional development opportunities.
Opportunity to contribute to a growing social enterprise supporting dairy farmers and local communities.
Company Address: Nathpara, Raghobpur, Sambhugonj Mymensingh.

BRAC
Project Officer, Market Linkage, Humanitarian Development Context Nexus (HDC), HCMP
Application Deadline: Nov 10, 2026
Location: Coxs Bazar (Teknaf, Ukhia)
Salary: Negotiable
Experience: At least 2 years
Published: Nov 3, 2026
Requirements
Education
Bachelor/Honors
Bachelor’s or any equivalent degree in Development Studies, Business Administration, Vocational Education from any UGC approved reputed University/ Institute
Training or certification in market linkage, job placement, entrepreneurship or business development, or apprenticeship/work-based learning is preferred
Workplace
Work at office
Employment Status
Contractual
Application
Online
Job Description
BRAC is an international development organisation founded in Bangladesh that partners with over 100 million people living with inequality and poverty globally to create sustainable opportunities to realise potential.
Working at BRAC is not like any other job. It is a platform where you can bring about real change for people who need it the most. We are not just dreaming of a better world; we are building it. Join us to find the way.
Job Purpose:
Ensuring Market Linkage Related Activity delivery and support to the Deputy project Manager -Market Linkage. Engagement Self and Wage Employment is primarily to facilitate the self and wage employment of the skills graduates, and to work with other stakeholders in the Host and camps that is relevant to that task under the guidance of Deputy Project Manager (Market linkage).
Major Responsibilities:
The role of Project Officer-Market Linkage Self and Wage Employment is primarily to facilitate the self and wage employment of the skills graduates, and to work with other stakeholders in the camps that is relevant to those tasks under the guidance of Deputy Project Manager (Market linkage).
Market linkage of the skills graduates for informal wage employment.
Mapping of potential stakeholders for self & wage employment and maintaining liaison with them.
Facilitate wage employment of the skills graduates as volunteers with BRAC and other organizations.
Support and facilitate self-employment of the skills graduate’s business subsector.
Follow up, tracking and database maintenance of the employment & earnings of the skills graduates, and reporting of the wage and Self information of the graduates.
Explore and find the institutional participants (volunteer already engaged in jobs) for skills training.
Lead the role of the participant selection process for vocational training
Volunteer recruitment, management, and documentation as per procedure/practice.
Make monthly payments to volunteers, skill training participants, laborers, utility bills, house/land rent, and others.
Support to the Deputy Project Manager- Market Linkage to contract/renewal of the contract training of Master craft Person (MCP), Skill Trainer and Technical Trainer.
Training facilitation offer career counseling to the skills participants under the guidance of the supervisor.
Provide overall technical expertise guidance and management to the self-employed skills graduates.
Regular field visit, monitor, document and report work progress on daily and weekly basis..
Safeguarding:
Ensure the safety of Programme Participants, people who come into contact with the organisation and team members from any harm, abuse, neglect, harassment and exploitation including sexual exploitation and abuse (SEA) to achieve the programme's goals of safeguarding implementation. Act as a key source of support, guidance and expertise on safeguarding for establishing a safe working environment
Practice, promote and endorse the issues of safeguarding policy among team members and ensure the implementation of safeguarding standards in every course of action
Follow the safeguarding reporting procedure in case any reportable incident takes place and encourage others to do so
Additional Requirements
Knowledge:
●	Knowledge of relevant Market Linkage, livelihood, coordination, monitoring, report writing, presentation preparation, and safeguarding.
●	Knowledge of people management.
Skills:
●	Ability to establish and maintain good working relationships with stakeholders in a sensitive environment.
●	Must have proven practical expertise in Market Linkage especially engagement of graduate learners in wage and Self livelihood Activities.
●	Effective communication and presentation skills.
●	Have computer skills with all Microsoft Office programs (MS Word, Power Point, and Excel).
●	Working knowledge of MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) and basic data/MIS reporting
●	Excellent influencing, negotiating and communication skills.
●	Excellent organization, and coordination skills.
Competencies:
●	Demonstrated ability to think technically, prioritize and meet deadlines in a challenging environment; must be culturally sensitive.
●	Ability to operate in a multipurpose organization, across functions and work on own initiative and collaboratively as part of diverse teams.
●	The applicants should have experience in the volunteer placement.
Skills: Livelihoods
Compensation & Other Benefits
Medical allowance,Mobile bill,Weekly 2 holidays
Salary Review: Yearly
Festival Bonus: 2
Health & Life Insurance
Paternity/ Maternity leave and
Others as per Organisation policy
Company Address: BRAC 75 Mohakhali, Dhaka-1212, Bangladesh
Company Business
BRAC believes that everyone we work with—including our staff, programme participants, partners, and the communities we serve—has the right to be protected from all forms of harm, abuse, neglect, harassment, and exploitation, including sexual exploitation and abuse. We uphold human dignity and inclusion for all, regardless of age, race, religion, gender, disability, ethnic origin, or socio-economic background. We are an equal opportunity employer. We especially encourage those who have shown resilience—who have faced personal struggles, bounced back, and continued to move forward—to apply. Selected candidates will have to go through a rigorous reference and background checking process which may include police verification.

bdjobs.com/h/details/1552350?ln=1.source_content:
Centre for Disability in Development
HR & Admin Officer
Application Deadline: Nov 8, 2026
Vacancy: 1
Age: 18 to 45 years
Location: Coxs Bazar (Teknaf, Ukhia)
Salary: Tk. 70000 - 70000 (Monthly)
Experience: At least 3 years
Published: Nov 3, 2026
Requirements
Education
Masters
Workplace
Work at office
Employment Status
Full Time
Application
Online
Job Description
Job Context:
The Centre for Disability in Development (CDD) is a non-profit organization established in 1996 to develop a more inclusive society for persons with disabilities. CDD simultaneously builds technical capacities of the development stakeholders and the communities in how to be more inclusive whilst also enabling persons with a disability to participate in society by strengthening their leadership and providing them with essential rehabilitation and other supports.
CDD is one of the most renowned organizations in the field of disability-inclusive development. CDD’s work in Bangladesh is supported by international and national donor agencies/development partners. CDD offers an inclusive, amicable, and respectable work environment.
The Ramon Magsaysay Award (Asian version of the Noble prize) has been awarded to its former Executive Director in 2010. In 2018, CDD was recognized by the Government of Bangladesh as one of the best organizations working on disability and development issues.
CDD is implementing multiple humanitarian and development projects at Ukhiya and Teknaf in Cox's Bazar and BhasanChar with the support of Handicap International (HI), Humanity & Inclusion. These projects serve both Rohingya refugee and host communities and focus on disability inclusion, rehabilitation, protection, social inclusion and humanitarian assistance.
The selected candidate will initially be hired for a three-month probationary period. Upon successful completion of this period, his/her employment contract will be renewed on an annual basis.
Brief Job Description:
HR Strategy:
In collaboration with the Project Managers, assist in developing the Human Resources Plan, including the staff recruitment plan, ensuring an efficient and timely process in consultation with the respective managers and the Rohingya Response Focal Point.
Ensure the consistent application and implementation of HR and administrative policies and procedures across the programme.
Recruitment:
Facilitate the entire recruitment process, including job advertisement, application screening, shortlisting, interviews, and final selection, ensuring efficiency and compliance with CDD policies and the requirements of the Cox's Bazar team.
Ensure that systematic, professional, and comprehensive documentation is maintained throughout each recruitment process to clearly demonstrate the rationale and basis for all decisions.
Maintain a sound understanding of volunteer recruitment procedures at the Rohingya camp level. Coordinate volunteer recruitment with the respective CiC offices and ensure compliance with relevant RRRC and ISCG guidelines.
Ensure that newly recruited staff receive and sign their employment contracts in a timely manner and that all relevant joining documents are completed and forwarded to the concerned departments or offices.
Ensure that individual personnel files are opened for all new employees, regularly updated using a standard checklist, and maintained in an organized and systematic manner.
Ensure the integrity, security, and confidentiality of all staff-related data and personnel records.
Maintain an effective filing and documentation system for all HR-related records and provide relevant information to managers and staff as required, in line with confidentiality requirements.
Ensure that all newly recruited staff receive appropriate orientation and induction on organizational policies, procedures, roles, and responsibilities.
Maintain and regularly update the HR directory, ensuring that all necessary staff information is accurate and up to date.
Performance Appraisal:
Provide support in developing, reviewing, and updating job descriptions in consultation with the respective line managers.
Support the development of staff skills, competencies, and professional capabilities through appropriate learning and development initiatives.
Monitor employee performance and coordinate with relevant staff to ensure that performance evaluations are conducted within the specified timelines and the results are communicated to the respective employees.
Compensation, Benefits Management:
Ensure the timely and accurate preparation of monthly payroll, including verification of working days, applicable benefits, and other relevant entitlements.
Ensure proper tracking and management of staff leave, attendance, movement, and absences, and maintain appropriate supporting documentation.
Monitor and maintain volunteer attendance records, prepare volunteer payment sheets in a timely manner, and submit them to the Finance Department for processing within the stipulated timeframe.
Review compensation and benefits packages periodically in collaboration with the Accounts and Management Team.
Support annual salary scale assessments to ensure that CDD's salary structure and compensation packages remain fair, consistent, and competitive.
Employee Relations:
Ensure the timely processing and documentation of new employment contracts, contract extensions, staff transfers, promotions, and other changes in employment status.
Manage and coordinate processes related to disciplinary actions, staff separation, and employment termination in accordance with organizational policies and procedures.
Respond promptly and effectively to all HR-related queries and requests from employees.
Ensure that employee personnel files and HR records are properly maintained, up to date, and readily available for real-time audits in compliance with organizational policies and relevant donor requirements.
Training & Development:
Coordinate and facilitate staff training and professional development initiatives to enhance employees' knowledge, skills, and competencies.
Support the planning and implementation of team-building activities and initiatives to promote teamwork, collaboration, and a positive working environment.
Develop and implement a staff training and development plan in coordination with the Management and Finance Teams, ensuring alignment with organizational priorities and available resources.
Administrative and Procurement work:
Coordinate administrative and logistical support, including fleet management and transport arrangements, for project offices and field teams in Ukhiya, Teknaf, and Cox’s Bazar.
Arrange hotel accommodation, training venues, and vehicle reservations for national and international staff and consultants.
Ensure timely issuance and replacement of staff ID cards.
Prepare and submit administrative reports and statistics as required.
Maintain office health, safety, hygiene, and security standards.
Ensure timely payment of utility bills and other office-related expenses.
Ensure smooth office operations through proper maintenance and management of facilities, supplies, equipment, and vehicles.
Supervise support staff and ensure regular office cleaning and maintenance.
Ensure timely processing of purchase requisitions, requests for quotations (RFQs), and purchase orders in accordance with CDD policies and procedures.
Prepare, review, and update lease and service contracts, ensuring compliance with organizational and statutory requirements.
Lead and coordinate procurement activities in compliance with CDD's procurement policies and procedures.
Conduct periodic physical verification of project assets and maintain an updated asset inventory.
Maintain proper records of asset handover and takeover during staff joining, transfer, and separation.
Ensure all assets are properly tagged with unique serial numbers and that the inventory records are regularly updated.
Perform any other relevant duties assigned by the authorized supervisor.
Safeguarding Responsibilities:
Adhere to CDD's Children and Adults at Risk Safeguarding policy, ensuring the safety and well-being of all project participants.
Promote a safe and secure environment for all participants and stakeholders of the project.
Report any safeguarding concerns promptly and follow the designated reporting procedures.
Additional Responsibilities:
Perform any other responsibility/ special duty delegated by project and CDD management.
Additional Requirements
Age 18 to 45 years
Educational Requirement:
Master's degree in any discipline from a reputed university or institute, preferably with a major in Human Resource Management (HRM), Business Administration, or another relevant field.
A Postgraduate Diploma (PGD) in Human Resource Management (HRM) will be an added advantage
Desired Requirement:
3 years of relevant work experience; experience in the Rohingya response will be considered an added advantage.
Good skills in coordinating HR and administrative activities related to project implementation.
Proficiency in standard computer applications and office software.
Experience in using HR management software, Zoom, Google Meet, Microsoft Teams, and the administrative panel of
Bdjobs.com
Proactive attitude with strong analytical thinking skills and the ability to identify opportunities and mechanisms to strengthen programme implementation.
Strong problem-solving and decision-making skills.
Ability to work effectively in challenging and demanding environments.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills in both Bangla and English.
Skills: Leadership, Microsoft Excel, Payroll Processing, Performance Management, Recruitment & Selection
Compensation & Other Benefits
Weekly 2 holidays,Insurance,Mobile bill
Festival Bonus: 2
Company Address: A-18/6, Genda, Savar, Dhaka-1340
Company Business
The Centre for Disability in Development (CDD) is a not for profit organization established in 1996 to develop a more inclusive society for persons with a disability. CDDs mission is to address this by simultaneously educating the community in how to be more inclusive whilst also enabling persons with a disability to participate in society by providing them with essential supports. In this way persons with disabilities can be given the same rights, freedoms, dignity and quality of life as everyone else. CDD respects rights and dignity of all human beings including children, women and persons with disabilities . All staff members of CDD must sign a Child safeguarding Code of Conduct.

Technical Support	: UN Women

Employment Type	: Project-based / Contractual
Duration		: 15 October 2026 to 30 September 2028
Reporting To		: Coordinator Finance, JAGO NARI
Job Summary:
JAGO NARI is a non-government development organization in the central coastal region of Bangladesh. The main focusing area of work is women’s empowerment, Climate Change Adaptation, Health & Nutrition, Disaster Risk Reduction, and Education. Recently JAGO NARI is implementing a new Project in the She Leads the Shore: Women's Climate Justic and Recovery in Costal Bhola District of Bangladesh with the technical support of the UN WOMEN. The project title is “She Leads the Shore: Women's Climate Justic and Recovery in Costal Bhola District of Bangladesh Project” The objective of the project is to Strengthen the organizational, financial and technical capacities of WROs so that they can participate in preventing and responding to climate security risk at local level regional and international level. We will work with the Women's Rights Organization to prevent, response, and adaptation to climate Change. JAGO NARI is seeking a S/he will play a vital role in financial management, Accounting & Reporting, Budget Monitoring & Control, Administrative Management, Risk Management etc. The detailed responsibilities are outlined below but are not limited to:
Responsibilities and Task:	% of Time
Financial management:30%
	Receive the bill/vouchers from the staff and vendors ensuring that all formalities are followed.
	Make payment against the advance request and maintain all relevant documents and advance ledger as per policy.
	Ensure timely adjustment of the advances with support from all concerned.
	Make available adequate funds in petty cash for timely payment against expenditures.
	Preserve petty cash in safe custody under lock and key.
	Receive advance requests with the recommendation of the concerned authority.
	Ensure security of the office for night and day.
	Prepare procurement plans as per the DIP of the project and get input from senior staff of JAGO NARI.
	Supply the items to the concerned staff as per request and maintain all formalities.
	Establish and maintain liaison/coordination with the senior staff of the project.
	Update day-to-day financial records in accounting software (Tally Prime).
	Provide necessary input for budget preparation/revision.
	Ensure security of office operations and coordinate with house owners/vendors as per organizational policy and donor compliance.
Accounting & Reporting:25%
	Check bill/vouchers ensuring accuracy.
	Have approval from the concerned authority and make payments on time.
	Prepare monthly finance reports as per donor requirements.
	Prepare monthly reports on stock of store items and circulate them to all concerned.
	Maintain stock and ledger books as required.
	Prepare reports on financial records and stock to ensure documentation is up-to-date.
	Provide necessary inputs for budget preparation and revisions as well as monitor expenses.
Budget Monitoring & Control:20%
	Monitor expenses and control them according to the approved budget.
	Provide necessary input for budget preparation/revision and ensure expenses are controlled per the budget.
	Make sure that all procurement and expenditure follow the budget plans in alignment with project objectives.
Administrative Management:15%
	Reach agreements with house owners and vendors as per organizational policy and donor compliance.
	Prepare a potential list of vendors involving the procurement committee as per policy and donor compliance.
	Receive procurement requests and arrange to procure the items involving the procurement committee.
	Coordinate with the procurement committee to ensure all purchases meet organizational and donor compliance standards.
	Oversee office security and ensure compliance with administrative procedures for day-to-day operations.
	Supervise administrative processes such as documentation, procurement, and vendor agreements.
Risk Management:5%
	Ensure proper security of financial assets like petty cash and relevant documents.
	Ensure timely adjustment of advances to prevent risks of financial discrepancies.
	Address potential risks related to procurement, financial mismanagement, and security of office and project funds.
Compliance and Auditing:5%
	Ensure that financial processes comply with donor regulations, organizational policies, and relevant laws.
	Make sure that procurement and payment processes follow donor compliance and organizational policy.
	Assist in internal and external audits by maintaining records and documents as per standards.
	Prepare financial reports and ensure compliance with donor requirements.
	Ensure all documentation is prepared in line with government and donor regulations.
Additional Requirements
Female candidates will be given strong preference for this position.
Education may be relaxed for the highly experienced person
Proven skill in financial management, managing of donor funds, BAS, GAAP, GOB rules (VAT, Tax etc.) Donor rules and regulations etc.
Skilled in budgeting, budget monitoring and review of project expenses.
Sound and prompt in different program reporting as well as reconciliation of Program vs Financial Report.
Clear concept on different procurement/payment procedure
Strong safety and security awareness.
Sound knowledge of Finance and Administration policies
Proficiency in computer skills
Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English
Good understanding of MS Office applications
Core Competencies
Skilled in budget preparation, budget monitoring and review of project expenses
Facilitation of Audit (internal and external)
Knowledge on internal control process, HR and administration
Ability to work in a team with good interpersonal skills
Strong communication skills
Good negotiation skills
Ability to prioritize activities to act and decide promptly
Good understanding on issues related to gender equity and protect.
Reporting to: Program Manager of the Project and Coordinator Finance of JAGO NARI
Compensation & Other Benefits
The salary package is Monthly BDT 35,759, including all admissible benefits. Yearly increments and other benefits will be provided as per the organization's policy.
Company Address: Ashahi Mansion (2rd floor), College Road, Barguna
Company Business
JAGO NARI has started its activities in 1998 with its own resource with a view to help the poor people in many respects of Barguna a under developed costal District in the southern part of Bangladesh in terms of socio economic perspective as well as livelihood. It is a non-political, nonprofit, rights based and non-government Organization (NGO) committed to participate in and promote national development through upgrading the socio economic condition and promoting and protecting the rights of the disadvantaged, deprived backward and poor communities of the society. Some likeminded, qualified and experienced women of the society established JAGO NARI in the middle of 1998.

Full Time

Job Description
Job Context
Resinova Polymer Chemicals Industries is a leading provider of premium construction solutions, specializing in Polyurethane (PU) Flooring Materials, Industrial Flooring Systems, Epoxy Flooring, and high-quality Construction Chemicals.
We are looking for a dynamic, self-motivated, result-oriented, and experienced professional to join our team as a
Technical Sales Engineer – Industrial Flooring
.
The ideal candidate will be responsible for driving business growth by identifying new project opportunities, developing strong relationships with key decision-makers, and generating B2B and B2C sales opportunities across the construction and industrial sectors. The candidate should possess a strong technical sales mindset, excellent communication and negotiation skills, and the ability to work independently in the field to achieve business targets.
Job Responsibilities
1. Market Penetration:
Identify and develop new business opportunities for PU Flooring Systems and Construction Chemicals across industrial, commercial, and residential projects.
2. Client Acquisition:
Identify potential clients and build strong business relationships with real estate developers, industrial owners, factory authorities (particularly in the RMG, Pharmaceutical, and Food Processing sectors), consultants, architects, and structural engineers.
3. Project Sales:
Conduct regular client meetings and site visits, understand project requirements, recommend suitable technical solutions, prepare quotations, negotiate commercial terms, and close sales to achieve monthly and annual targets.
4. Technical Presentation:
Conduct technical presentations and product demonstrations on PU Flooring Systems, Epoxy Flooring, and Construction Chemical applications for prospective clients.
5. Tender & Proposals:
Prepare and submit commercial proposals, quotations, BOQs, and tender documents accurately and professionally.
6. Market Intelligence:
Monitor market trends, competitor activities, pricing strategies, and upcoming construction and industrial projects to identify new business opportunities.
7. After-Sales Coordination:
Coordinate with the technical and application teams to ensure smooth project execution, resolve client concerns, and maintain long-term customer satisfaction.
8. Payment Recovery:
Follow up on project payments and ensure timely collection of outstanding bills and receivables from assigned clients and projects.
Additional Requirements
Age 25 to 40 years
Must have a personal motorcycle and a valid motorcycle driving license.
Skills: Business Development, Client Acquisition, Sales & Marketing, Sales Target Achievement, Tender Preparation
Compensation & Other Benefits
T/A,Tour allowance,Mobile bill,Performance bonus
Lunch Facilities: Partially Subsidize
Salary Review: Yearly
Festival Bonus: 2
Company Address: R & K Resident,House-31 (Level 05),RD-05, Block-E,Sector -1 Aftabnagar, Dhaka-1212.

Welcome to Resinova Polymer Chemicals Industries — where quality, reliability, and integrity come together to power the future of Bangladesh’s construction and industrial sectors. We are a trusted importer, supplier & Manufucter of high-performance building materials, specialized industrial goods, premium swimming pool equipment, waterproofing systems, and cutting-edge flooring solutions. With global reach and local commitment, Resinova Polymer Chemicals Industries delivers not just products — but solutions that shape progress.

Job Description
BRAC is an international development organization founded in Bangladesh that partners with over 100 million people living with inequality and poverty globally to create sustainable
opportunities to realize potential.
Working at BRAC is not like any other job. It is a platform where you can bring about real change for people who need it the most. We are not just dreaming of a better world, we are building it. Join us to find the way.
In 2007, Bangladesh faced a demographic dividend with 1.6 million youth lacking education, employment, or training. To address this, BRAC launched an apprenticeship program for school dropouts, which officially evolved into the BRAC Skills Development Programme (SDP) in 2015. Today, SDP spans 26 projects offering market-aligned skills, entrepreneurship training linked with microfinance, and career counseling. Aligning with national policies and UN SDGs, the program promotes deep inclusivity, even adapting to 100% online training during the COVID-19 pandemic. To date, SDP has empowered over 428,000 marginalized individuals—including women, disabled, and transgender people. With a high job placement rate, the program has proven to be a transformative socio-economic force, successfully reducing child marriage, boosting household incomes, and supporting a prosperous future for Bangladesh.
we are seeking Programme Organizer,
who will responsible for ensure effective programme implementation and quality training through stakeholder coordination, regular monitoring, learner support, and employment facilitation, resulting in improved learners’ skills, successful job placement, and safe, inclusive learning environments.
Major Responsibilities
Organize and manage training batches according to the approved training calendar, ensuring quality training delivery and a conducive learning environment. Ensure coordination with other BRAC programmes.
Conduct learner surveys, facilitate admissions, maintain updated learner databases and profiles, and regularly monitor trainees’ attendance, performance, and progress.
Ensure occupational health and safety standards, maintain necessary registers and documentation, and ensure the availability of required training materials and resources.
Conduct regular follow-ups with graduates, monitor their employment and entrepreneurial progress, and facilitate self-employment opportunities.
Ensure job placement for at least 80% of graduates in the local market by establishing and maintaining relationships with potential employers.
Organise meetings and workshops, prepare and submit monthly progress reports, achieve assigned project targets, and coordinate timely processing of training centre bills and payments.
Safeguarding Responsibilities
Ensure the safety of Programme Participants, people who come into contact with the organisation and team members from any harm, abuse, neglect, harassment and exploitation including sexual exploitation and abuse (SEA) to achieve the programme`s goals of safeguarding implementation. Act as a key source of support, guidance and expertise on safeguarding for establishing a safe working environment.
Practice, promote and endorse the issues of safeguarding policy among team members and ensure the implementation of safeguarding standards in every course of action.
Follow the safeguarding reporting procedure in case any reportable incident takes place and encourage others to do so.
“ BRAC does not charge any fees at any stage of the recruitment process.”
This position is open for Bangladeshi nationals only.
Additional Requirements
Age At least 20 years
Company Address: BRAC Centre, 75 Mohakhali, Dhaka-1212
Company Business
BRAC is an international development organisation founded in Bangladesh that partners with over 100 million people living with inequality and poverty globally to create sustainable opportunities to realise potential.
